Eligibility Criteria

  • Essential Education Qualification: Matriculation from a recognised Board
  • Sports Qualifications: Players who have participated in any International Competition/ National Competitions/ Inter-University Tournaments/ National Sports/ Games for Schools/ Khelo India University Games/ Khelo India Youth Games/ Khelo India Winter Games
  • Age as per Certificate: Only Matriculation certificate or Higher secondary school certificate will be accepted as proof for establishing age of the candidates
  • Certificate Requirements: All educational certificates other than Central Board/State Boards should be accompanied with Government notifications declaring the equivalence of such qualification for service under Central Government
  • Sports Certificate: Candidates must possess valid sports certificates from competent authorities as specified in the notification
  • Caste Certificate: Candidates seeking relaxation under SC/ST/OBC category should submit the certificate as per prescribed format
  • Document Possession: The candidates must fulfil all eligibility conditions and should be in possession of all sports and education certificates at the time of joining

Salary/Stipend

  • Pay scale and other allowances will be as admissible to Assam Rifles personnel as per 7th CPC
  • Candidates Provisionally Selected will be covered under New Pension Scheme (NPS)

Age Limit (as on 01/01/2026)

  • For General & OBC Candidates: 18 to 28 years as on 01 Jan 2026. Candidates should have not been born earlier than 01 Jan 1998 and later than 01 Jan 2008
  • For SC/ST Candidates: 18 to 33 years as on 01 Jan 2026. Candidates should have not been born earlier than 01 Jan 1993 and later than 01 Jan 2008
  • Upper Age Relaxation: For Gen/OBC is Five years and SC/ST is Ten years respectively for players who have participated in specified competitions

Category Fee Amount
General and OBC Category Rs. 100/- (Rupees One Hundred Only) - Non-refundable
SC/ST and Female Candidates No Fee
Payment Mode Online payment or deposit at any SBI Branch
Bank Details SBI Current Account No. 37083046712 in favour of Recruitment Branch, HQ DGAR, Shillong - 793010
IFSC Code SBIN0013883 (SBI HQ DGAR Laitkor Branch)

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 01/12/2025
Online Application Start Date 10/01/2026
Last Date for Online Application 09/02/2026
Recruitment Rally Period (Tentative) Feb 2026 to May 2026
Age Criteria Date 01/01/2026

Selection Process

  • Candidate Verification: Candidates in possession of valid call letters and photo ID proof like Voter ID, Driving License, Aadhaar Card will only be permitted to enter the recruitment rally site
  • Initial Documentation: All candidates will have to undergo documentation, in which candidates will have to produce all original documents/certificates pertaining to age, education, caste, sports and domicile/Permanent Resident Certificate (PRC)
  • RFID Based Physical Standard Test (PST): PST of candidates will be carried out by using Radio Frequency Identification Devices (RFID) with specific height, chest and weight standards
  • Motor Ability Test (MAT): MAT in all sports disciplines will be conducted by a Board of Officers at rally site as per norms of Lakshmibai National College of Physical Education (LNCPE) manual of Sports Authority of India (SAI)
  • Field Trial: Field Trial in all disciplines will be conducted by a Board of Officers at Rally site. Marks will be awarded to candidates as per their performance in the Field Trial
  • Detailed Medical Examination (DME): Candidates who qualify in Field Trial in respective sports discipline will undergo Detailed Medical Examination with specific visual acuity and medical standards
  • Review Medical Examination (RME): If a candidate is declared UNFIT in DME, they will be allowed to undergo RME provided they give written consent
  • Merit List: Candidates who qualify in all respects will be placed in Merit List. Final selection will be done on the basis of achievements and performance in Field Trials and level of participation
  • Pregnancy Disqualification: Pregnancy at the time of PST, MAT/Field Trial & DME will be considered a disqualification

General Information/Instructions

  • Online applications are invited from eligible male and female Indian citizens for filling up vacancies for the Post of Rifleman/Riflewomen (General Duty) under Sports Quota recruitment in Assam Rifles for the Year 2026
  • The Recruitment Rally will be held at various locations. RFID Based PST, MAT & Field Trial will be conducted at Assam Rifles Training Centre and School Dimapur (Nagaland), Sukhovi (Nagaland), HQ DGAR Laitkor Shillong (Meghalaya), and HQ IGAR(S) Mantripukhri, Imphal (Manipur)
  • Assam Rifles reserves the right to divert vacancies, wherein, in case of non availability of suitable candidates against the vacancies of male candidates, the same may be filled up by suitable female candidates in the same sports discipline and vice versa
  • Candidates should be in possession of personal sports dress/gear, kit, equipment and tools which are requisite for Field Trial in the sports discipline they applied for. No dress and kits will be provided by the Recruitment Agency
  • Candidates will not be considered for recruitment if involved/convicted/arrested in any criminal case under IPC or any other Act
  • Candidate belonging to the physically handicapped category is not eligible to apply for this recruitment
  • Mobiles and other electronic gadgets are banned within the premises of recruitment rally sites/trial centres
  • Assam Rifles authorities are not responsible for any type of arrangement of accommodation/food/transportation for the candidates during the recruitment process
  • Assam Rifles authorities will not be held responsible for any damage/injury/death/loss to the individual sustained during the entire recruitment process
  • Compassionate ground appointment scheme is not applicable to this Recruitment Rally
  • The first phase of the recruitment may take 40 to 60 days to complete
  • No TA/DA is admissible
  • To avoid over-crowding, only candidates will be permitted to enter Recruitment Rally Site. Parents/friends are advised not to accompany candidates
  • Providing functional/in use Email ID and mobile phone number in Online Application Form by the applicants is mandatory. The mobile phone number should not be DND activated
  • All further information regarding conduct of various events will be intimated through notification on website and email only

How to Apply

  • Application Mode: Online applications only
  • Application Portal: Visit the official website www.assamrifles.gov.in
  • Steps to Apply:
    • Click on "ONLINE APPLICATION" option on the web page
    • Fill up the online application with requisite details as prescribed in the application form
    • After filling the application, make online payment via the link given or alternatively payment can be made at any SBI Branch
    • Upload copy of the challan or receipt online
    • Download and print the completed Online Application Form and Call Letter
  • Documents Required While Reporting: Candidates must produce original copy of payment receipt/challan, printed copy of online Application Form duly completed, and copy of Call Letter downloaded from the website
  • Original Documents: During PST, MAT, Field Trial, DME & RME, candidates must produce all original documents/certificates pertaining to age, education, caste, sports and domicile/PRC
  • Important Note: In case of non uploading of receipt/challan during online registration, the candidature of such applicants will be rejected
  • Application Validity: The online applications portal will be functioning from 10 Jan 2026 to 09 Feb 2026
  • Late Applications: Applications received thereafter will not be entertained

IRCTC WZ Hospitality Monitors Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details

Post Name Total Posts Reservation (as per Govt. of India policy)
Hospitality Monitors 43 SC – 15%; ST – 7.5%; OBC-NCL – 7%; PwBD – 4%; EWS – 10%; Ex-servicemen – 10%

Eligibility Criteria

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • Educational Qualification (any one of the following full-time/recognized degrees):
    • Full time B.Sc. in Hospitality and Hotel Administration from a Central or State Institute of Hotel Management (CIHM/SIHM/PIHM) affiliated to NCHM&CT/UGC/AICTE/Government of India.
    • BBA/MBA (Culinary Arts) from Indian Culinary Institutes under Ministry of Tourism.
    • B.Sc. Hotel Management and Catering Science from Government recognized Universities affiliated to UGC/AICTE/Government of India/State Government.
    • MBA (Tourism and Hotel Management) from Government recognized Universities affiliated to UGC/AICTE/Government of India/State Government.
  • Freshers with relevant educational qualification will only be eligible to apply.
  • All educational, professional and technical qualifications must be from recognized Boards/Universities.

Salary/Stipend

  • Total CTC: Rs. 30,000/- per month (inclusive of statutory deductions) and other allowances as applicable.
  • Daily Allowance: Rs. 350/- per day for on-duty on-board in trains (100% for more than 12 hours, 70% for 6–12 hours, 30% for less than 6 hours).
  • Lodging Charges: Rs. 240/- per night if night stay is involved at outstation.
  • National Holiday Allowance (NHA): As per extant policy, if worked.
  • Medical Insurance: On per month basis as per extant policy, reimbursable on submission of valid documents.

Age Limit

  • Upper age limit: 27 years for UR candidates.
  • Upper age relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST applicants.
  • Upper age relaxable by 3 years for OBC applicants.
  • Upper age relaxable by 10 years for PwBD applicants.
  • For Ex-servicemen: Up to the extent of service rendered in defence forces (Army, Navy & Air Force) plus 3 years.

Application Fee

  • No application fee is mentioned in the notification.

Important Dates

Event Date & Day Venue
Walk-in Interview – Bhopal (Madhya Pradesh) 17-02-2026 (Tuesday) 10:30 AM to 05:30 PM Institute of Hotel Management (IHM) – Bhopal, Near Academy of Administration, 1100 Quarters, Arera Colony, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh – 462016
Walk-in Interview – Mumbai (Maharashtra) 24-02-2026 (Tuesday) 10:30 AM to 05:30 PM IRCTC West Zone Office, Conference Hall, 3rd Floor, Forbes Building, Charanjit Rai Marg, Fort, Mumbai – 400001
Walk-in Interview – Porvorim (Goa) 27-02-2026 (Friday) 10:30 AM to 05:30 PM Institute of Hotel Management (IHM) – Goa, Alto Porvorim, Bardez, Penha de Franca, Goa – 403521
Walk-in Interview – Ahmedabad (Gujarat) 05-03-2026 (Thursday) 10:30 AM to 05:30 PM Institute of Hotel Management (IHM) – Ahmedabad, Bhaijipura Chokdi, PDPU Road, Airport Gandhinagar Highway, Gandhinagar, Gujarat – 382426

Selection Process

  • Candidates must fill the prescribed application form (attached with the notification) completely and submit it at the interview venue.
  • The completed form must be accompanied by original documents, one set of attested copies of requisite documents and two recent passport-size photographs.
  • Selection will be based on credentials and performance in personal interview; shortlisted candidates will be placed in order of merit and offered engagement subject to verification of antecedents.
  • In addition to selected candidates, a 100% Reserve Panel will be formed.
  • Engagement is subject to medical fitness as prescribed by IRCTC.

General Information/Instructions

  • This engagement is purely contractual and does not confer any right for regular/permanent employment in IRCTC.
  • Initial contract is for 2 years and may be extended by one year based on requirement and satisfactory performance; contract may be terminated by one month’s notice by either side, or without notice if performance is not satisfactory.
  • Those working in Government/PSUs may apply through proper channel or submit NOC at the time of interview or proper relieving letter in case of selection.
  • IRCTC reserves the right to cancel/amend the advertisement and/or selection process at any time without prior notice.
  • The number of vacancies (including Reserve Panel) may increase or decrease depending on actual requirement at the time of engagement.
  • Candidates must ensure they fulfil eligibility criteria; furnishing false/incorrect information or suppression of material facts will lead to termination of candidature/services.
  • Selected candidates must furnish a security deposit of Rs. 25,000/- in the form of Demand Draft payable to IRCTC Ltd., Mumbai.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for attending the walk-in interview.
  • Knowledge of computer (MS Office) and report preparation, and ability to solve problems and make rational decisions, are desirable.
  • Candidates can appear for interview at any one convenient place only.

How to Apply

  • Download and fill the prescribed application form attached with the notification, ensuring all fields are complete and accurate.
  • Report at the chosen walk-in venue on the specified date and time with:
    • Duly filled and signed application form.
    • Original certificates and one set of attested copies of educational qualification, experience, date of birth and category certificates (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/Ex-servicemen/PwBD) as applicable.
    • Two recent passport-size photographs.
  • Submit the application form and documents at the venue for verification before the interview.
  • Attend the personal interview as per the schedule; latecomers beyond the stated time window will not be entertained.
  • Keep checking the IRCTC website (www.irctc.com) for any corrigendum/clarification including changes in date/place of interview.

Persons employed in Government/Semi Government Organizations/Autonomous Bodies/ PSU etc. should process their application through proper channel and submit No Objection Certificate (NOC) with vigilance clearance. Those who are unable to process their application through proper channel may submit 'No Objection Certificate (NOC)' mentioning clearly regarding vigilance clearance from their present employer during the time of interview/final selection. Merely fulfilling the eligibility criteria does not entitle an applicants to be called for selection process.   11. The age limit shall be 57 years across all the cadres for regular employees of the Institute.

  14. No correspondence/queries will be entertained from applicants regarding email delays, conduct and result of interview/written test and reasons for not being called for interview/written test. However, all information/corrigendum related to this advertisement/ correspondence (viz. list of shortlisted applicants/syllabus/date of examination/call letter for test or interview), results, etc shall be uploaded on Careers@IITGoa page of IIT Goa's website. The applicants are advised to check the Institute website on regular basis. Applicants are also advised to provide correct email address and regularly check their emails including spam.
  15. In case of any inadvertent mistake in the process of selection which is detected at any stage even after the issue of appointment letter, the Institute reserves the right to modify/cancel the appointment and withdraw any communication made to the applicants.
  16. Decision of the Institute in all matters relating to the eligibility of the applicant, skill/written test and selection shall be final and binding on all the applicants. No correspondence or personal inquiries shall be entertained.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Executive Engineer (Civil): Degree or equivalent in Civil Engineering from a recognised University/Institution.

  • Trainee Pilot: Must hold a Certificate of Competency as Master of foreign going ship issued by the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways, Government of India or equivalent qualification recognised by the same Ministry.

  • Indian citizens with foreign Certificate of Competency recognized by India must acquire relevant endorsement from DG Shipping.
  • Dy. Chief Engineer: Degree or equivalent in Civil Engineering from a recognised University/Institution.
  • Twelve years’ experience in executive cadre in Planning/Construction/Design/Maintenance, preferably of Port and Marine Structures, in an Industrial/Commercial/Government Undertaking.
  • Sr. Dy. Secretary: A degree from a recognised University.
  • Twelve years’ experience in executive cadre in General Administration, Personnel, Industrial Relations etc. in an Industrial/Commercial/Government Undertaking.
  • Desirable: Post Graduate degree/diploma in Personnel Management/Industrial Relations/Social Work/Labour Welfare or allied subjects, or degree in Law from a recognised University/Institution.

Salary/Stipend

  • Executive Engineer (Civil): Pay scale Rs. 50,000-1,60,000/- (pre-revised Rs. 20,600-46,500/-; Rs. 10,750-16,750).
  • Trainee Pilot: Pay scale Rs. 70,000-2,00,000/-.
  • Dy. Chief Engineer: Pay scale Rs. 80,000-2,20,000/-.
  • Sr. Dy. Secretary: Pay scale Rs. 80,000-2,20,000/-.
  • Pay package includes Basic Pay, DA based on IDA pattern and Cafeteria allowance @ 35% of Basic Pay.

  • The crucial date for determining educational qualification, experience and age is 01.01.2026.

  • Trainee Pilot: Maximum age 40 years.
  • Dy. Chief Engineer: Maximum age 42 years.
  • Sr. Dy. Secretary: Maximum age 42 years.
  • Age relaxation for different categories will be applicable as per Government of India guidelines.
  • Regular employees of Board of Major Port Authorities of India possessing required qualification and experience may apply with an upper age limit of 55 years.

Application Fee

  • No application fee details are mentioned in the notification.

How to Apply

  • For Executive Engineer (Civil) & Trainee Pilot:

    • Two recent colour passport size photographs must be pasted on the application.
    • The envelope should be super-scribed with “Application for the post of …………” and must reach the Office of the Secretary, General Administration Department, Mormugao Port Authority, 3rd Floor, Administrative Office Building, Headland Sada, Goa – 403 804 on or before 17.02.2026.
    • Candidates applying for multiple posts must submit separate applications for each post.

  • PwBD candidates belonging to OBC category are eligible to apply against Assistant Superintendent (Finance) post.
  • The posting shall be at GSL/any other GSL units/project sites as desired by GSL. However, depending upon project requirements, the candidates are liable to be transferred within different units of GSL.
  • The appointment to the post carries with it the obligation to serve in any department of GSL or on-board ships or in any of the units/work sites/projects undertaken in any part of India or abroad as the case may be.
  • The candidates may note that the applications are to be made only through online application system as per the instructions given. Applications made in any other manner shall not be considered and shall be summarily rejected.
  • Candidates have to clearly declare the complete experience while filling the online application from initial appointment to the cutoff date.
  • Management reserves the right to fill or not to fill the posts and also to fill up future vacancies, if any from the valid panel of selected candidates as per the rules of the company.
  • At the sole discretion of GSL Management the number of vacancies notified may be increased or reduced.
  • Mere fulfillment of qualifications and other requirements as laid down does not entitle a candidate to be called for selection process.
  • Candidates working in Government/Quasi Government/Public Sector Undertaking/Autonomous Bodies must apply through proper channel or produce "No Objection Certificate" at the time of selection process.
  • Management reserves the right to transfer any selected candidate in any position as per requirement of Company, irrespective of position he has been originally selected for.
  • The candidates applying for more than one post must apply separately for each post.
  • The Government directives on reservation will be strictly followed.
  • Interim enquiries will not be entertained.
  • Canvassing in any form may lead to disqualification of candidature.
  • Management reserves the right to call for any additional documentary evidence in support of qualification, experience, etc. of the applicants.
  • In case, at any time, it is found that the candidate is not meeting the eligibility criteria, the candidature will summarily be rejected forthwith.
  • Management reserves the right to raise the eligibility criteria for short listing the applications.
  • Management reserves the right to reject the candidature if it is found that false or fabricated information is furnished in the application.
  • Applications received without following the online process will not be entertained. Only ONLINE applications received through GSL recruitment portal will be considered.
  • Management reserves the right to cancel the advertisement and/or the selection process there under without assigning any reason.
  • Corrigendum, if any, will be uploaded on our website only. Candidates are requested to check our website regularly under the heading "Notice Board - Careers - Advertisement".
  • Call letters for selection process will be sent only through E-mail to shortlisted candidates' registered Email ID.
  • Information regarding names of shortlisted candidates, date of written test, names/roll number of selected candidates etc. will be hosted on the website.
  • Management will not be responsible for non-receipt of email and loss of their E-mail ID and password.
  • In the event of finding difficulty to apply online you may contact us through Email: [email protected]
  • Applications received contrary to instructions given shall be rejected.
  • For any dispute, the Jurisdiction shall be Goa only.

How to Apply

  • Visit the official website www.goashipyard.in
  • Under the link Notice Board - 'careers' click the link 'GSL Careers'.
  • Click on 'Apply Now' button and select the post you wish to apply for.
  • Go through the eligibility criteria and the Terms and Conditions of the advertisement before applying online.
  • Keep scanned copies ready before proceeding to fill up the Online Application:
    • Passport size color Photograph with light background (preferably white) - Size below 450 kb
    • Candidate's signature on plain white paper with black ink - Size below 450 kb
    • SSC certificate as proof of date of Birth - Not more than 500 kb
    • Educational qualification mark sheet & degree - Not more than 1 Mb
    • Caste/Disability certificate/Ex-Serviceman certificate - Not more than 500 kb
    • Experience certificates - Not more than 1 Mb
    • Aadhar Card - Not more than 500 kb
  • After completion of Personal information in online application form, fill the Payment details and make the online payment of application fees.
  • Pay application fee of Rs.200/- (Non-Refundable) online through SBI e-pay (by debit card/credit card/net banking etc.). ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempted from payment.
  • After submitting payment information, please wait for the intimation from the server. Do not press back or refresh button.
  • On successful completion of the transaction, "Fee receipt" would be generated. Download and take print of fee receipt.
  • After completing the Online application, SUBMIT the application form without which the form will be considered as incomplete.
  • Take print out of auto generated filled in Application Form as the same is required to be produced for subsequent Selection Process.
  • After completing the Online application, the candidate will not be allowed to edit his application details.
  • Candidates should ensure all uploaded documents are clear, legible and in the prescribed format and size.
  • Online Application opens from 00:00 hrs. on 05.01.2026 and closes at 17:00 hrs. on 04.02.2026.

Department-wise Vacancy Distribution:

  • Lower Division Clerk (LDC): Public Health Engineering and Water Supply (31 posts), Education - Higher and Technical Education (1 post), DC Rada Lepa (1 post), DC Itanagar Capital Region (1 post), Finance - Audit & Pension (1 post), Small Savings (1 post), Food and Civil Supplies (2 posts), Environment Forest and Climate Change (5 posts), Women and Child Development (4 posts), Urban Development and Housing (5 posts), Health and Family Welfare (2 posts), DC Tirap (3 posts), DC Siang (2 posts), Cultural Affairs - Public Libraries (2 posts), Disaster Management (1 post), DC Changlang (1 post), DC Lower Dibang Valley (5 posts), DC Tawang (1 post), Tourism (3 posts), Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (1 post), DC Upper Subansiri (2 posts), DC Namsai (2 posts), DC Upper Siang (1 post), Power (5 posts)
  • Junior Secretariat Assistant (JSA): Secretariat Administration (14 posts)
  • Driver: Environment Forest and Climate Change (25 posts), Health and Family Welfare (6 posts), Food and Civil Supplies (12 posts), and various other departments

Eligibility Criteria

  • For Lower Division Clerk (LDC) - Post Code 2/26:
    • Class XII pass certificate from a recognized Board or Institution
    • Typing Speed test of 35 words per minute on computer (35 words per minute corresponds to 10500 Key Depression per hour - KDPH on an average of 5 Key Depression for each word)
  • For Junior Secretariat Assistant (JSA) - Post Code 3/26:
    • Class XII pass certificate from a recognized Board or Institution
    • Typing Speed test of 35 words per minute on computer (35 words per minute corresponds to 10500 Key Depression per hour - KDPH on an average of 5 Key Depression for each word)
  • For Driver - Post Code 4/26:
    • Class X/ITI or equivalent pass certificate from a recognized Board or Institution
  • Minimum Qualifying Service for LDC & JSA:
    • Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) of the concerned Department with 8 (Eight) years of regular service in the grade, and possessing Class-XII pass certificate from a recognized Board/Institution, OR
    • Skilled Contingency Staff with minimum of 12 (Twelve) years of continuous service as skilled contingency in the concerned Department/office and possess educational qualification of Class-XII pass certificate from a recognized Board/Institution
  • Minimum Qualifying Service for Driver:
    • Contingency skilled driver who possess Class X/ITI or equivalent pass certificate from a recognized Board or Institution with 10 (Ten) years of service in the concerned Department/Office, OR
    • Handyman who possess Class X/ITI or equivalent pass Certificate from a recognized Board/Institution with 6 (Six) years of regular service in the concerned Department/Office
  • General Eligibility:
    • The candidate must be a citizen of India
    • The educational qualification, required length of service, age, category as stipulated shall be determined as on the closing date of submission of application i.e. 25-02-2026
    • The name of the candidate should be in the certified list of eligible candidates submitted by the HoD/HoO
    • Only those candidates who have been certified as eligible by their Head of Department are eligible to apply

Salary/Stipend

  • Pay Matrix Level: Level-4
  • Salary Range: Rs. 25,500 - Rs. 81,100 Per Month
  • This pay scale is applicable for all three posts: Lower Division Clerk (LDC), Junior Secretariat Assistant (JSA), and Driver

Age Limit (as on 25-02-2026)

  • For LDC (Post Code 2/26) & JSA (Post Code 3/26):
    • Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS): Should not be more than 45 years (50 years in case of candidates belonging to APST)
    • Skilled Contingency Staff: Not applicable (eligibility determined by the Departments)
  • For Driver (Post Code 4/26):
    • Not applicable (eligibility determined by the Departments)

Application Fee

Category Fee Amount
APST Candidates Rs. 150
General Candidates Rs. 200
Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) Nil (Exempt)
  • Payment Mode: Online only
  • The application fee is non-refundable

Important Dates

Event Date
Opening Date of Application 12/02/2026 (Thursday)
Closing Date of Application 25/02/2026 (03:00 PM) (Wednesday)
Tentative Date of Written Examination 29/03/2026 (Sunday)

Selection Process

  • For LDC (Post Code 2/26) & JSA (Post Code 3/26):
    • Stage-I (Written Examination): Objective Type Multiple Choice Questions - 200 Marks, Duration: 2 Hours
      • General Awareness: 50 marks (25 questions of 2 marks each)
      • General Intelligence & Reasoning Ability: 50 marks (25 questions of 2 marks each)
      • Arithmetical & Numerical Ability: 50 marks (25 questions of 2 marks each)
      • Test of English Language and Comprehension: 50 marks (25 questions of 2 marks each)
    • Minimum Qualifying Marks: 33% aggregate marks in the written examination paper
    • Stage-II (Skill Test): Typing Speed Test of 35 words per minute on computer (10500 KDPH). The Typing Test is of qualifying nature only and marks will not be counted for final merit
  • For Driver (Post Code 4/26):
    • Stage-I (Written Examination): Objective Type Multiple Choice Questions - 200 Marks, Duration: 2 Hours
      • General Awareness: 25 marks (10 questions of 2.5 marks each)
      • General Intelligence & Reasoning Ability: 25 marks (10 questions of 2.5 marks each)
      • Arithmetical & Numerical Ability: 25 marks (10 questions of 2.5 marks each)
      • Test of English Language and Comprehension: 25 marks (10 questions of 2.5 marks each)
      • Technical Paper: 100 marks (50 questions of 2 marks each)
    • Minimum Qualifying Marks: 33% aggregate in both the papers separately i.e., for Common Paper and Technical Paper
    • Stage-II (Driving Test): Qualifying nature only. Candidate shall produce a valid Driving License for appearing in the Driving Test
  • Shortlisting for Stage-2: The total number of candidates shortlisted for Stage 2 will be in 1:3 ratio (if total vacancies are 10, then 30 candidates will be shortlisted)
  • Final Merit List: Will be prepared on the basis of marks secured in written examination only. Marks in Skill Test/Driving Test will not be counted but candidates must qualify
  • Note: There is no negative marking in the examination

General Information/Instructions

  • Application Mode: Only online applications will be accepted. Applications received through any other mode shall be summarily rejected
  • Login Credentials: Login credentials will be sent to eligible candidates through e-mail & SMS to their respective e-mail addresses and mobile numbers furnished by their Departments/Offices
  • Eligibility Determination: APSSB will not entertain any representations from candidates with regards to eligibility and the same shall be determined solely by the concerned Head of Department/Office
  • Provisional Candidature: Candidature of applicants shall be purely PROVISIONAL at all stages of the recruitment process
  • Examination Centre: The Centre for the examination will be ITANAGAR
  • ID Proof Requirement: Candidate will have to provide a valid Aadhar Card/Government authorized Photo Identity Card. They will have to carry the same ID card in original along with the admit card to the Examination Centre
  • Prohibited Items: Use of Calculator, Laptop, Palmtop, other digital instrument/Mobile/Cell Phone/Pager/Electronic watches etc. is not allowed. Candidates found in possession of any such gadget will be debarred from examination
  • Admit Card: Individual Admit cards will not be sent to candidates and have to be downloaded from the website www.apssb.nic.in
  • Vacancy Status: The vacancies published are provisional and subject to change. In case the vacancy position is reduced or withdrawn by the user department, the Board shall not be liable to compensate the applicant
  • No Re-evaluation: There is no provision of re-evaluation/re-checking of Answer sheet/Answer scripts
  • Board's Rights: The Board reserves the right to reject candidature at any stage, cancel part or entire examination process, change examination scheme, conduct medical test for PwBD candidates, and make any amendments as deemed necessary
  • Scribe Facility for PwBD: Facility of scribe will be provided to eligible PwBD/PwD candidates as per Government guidelines. Compensatory time of 20 minutes per hour of examination will be provided to persons allowed use of scribe
  • Multiple Applications: In case an applicant applies multiple forms for the same post, only the latest application form shall be considered by APSSB
  • Malpractice Action: Candidates found involved in violating guidelines, impersonation, using unfair means, submitting fabricated documents etc. will face strict action including police action, FIR lodging and debarment from all future APSSB examinations
  • Final Selection: The Board makes provisional selection and recommends to the Indenting/User Department. The Appointing Authority verifies and satisfies about authenticity of documents before finally appointing the candidate

How to Apply

  • Eligible departmental candidates are required to apply online only through the website www.apssb.nic.in using their unique login credentials/passwords
  • Login credentials will be sent to eligible candidates' respective mobile numbers & e-mail IDs by their departments
  • Application period: 12-02-2026 to 25-02-2026 (03:00 PM)
  • Only those candidates who have been certified as eligible by their Head of Department are eligible to apply
  • Documents to be scanned and uploaded at time of online application:
    • Scanned signature of the candidate on white paper with black ink pen (10-50 kb in jpg/jpeg/png format)
    • Latest/recent passport size photo (50-100 kb in jpg/jpeg/png format)
  • Documents to be submitted during Document Verification:
    • Recent passport size Photograph (2 copies)
    • Matriculation certificates/II issued by the Board/Institute for proof of date of birth
    • Class XII pass certificate & marksheet issued from a recognized Board/University
    • APST Certificate (if applicable)
    • Valid Driving License (for Driver post)
    • Print out of Admit Card
    • Any other documents as may be relevant
  • Shortlisted candidates will have to produce above-mentioned Certificates/Documents in original during Document Verification failing which candidature will be summarily rejected
  • The applicants are advised to fill up the application form carefully. They will not be allowed to edit/modify the details after the closing date
  • Application with incomplete or invalid details will be summarily rejected
  • Candidates are advised to keep track of the Board website www.apssb.nic.in for any latest information related to the examination
  • No request for change in date, time and centre of exam will be accepted under any circumstances

Eligibility Criteria

  • Essential Qualifications:

    • Relaxation of 5% marks (from 55% to 50%) at Master's and Bachelor's Degree level for ST/SC candidates
  • Additional Requirements (Any One):

    • Cleared similar test accredited by UGC like SLET/SET
    • Awarded Ph.D. Degree in accordance with UGC (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of M.Phil/Ph.D. Degree) Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and amendments

  • Desirable:

    • Teaching/Post-Doctoral experience
    • Awards from International Organizations/Government of India recognized bodies

  • Screening Committee: Commission will constitute a Screening Committee to shortlist candidates eligible for interview as per Appendix-II (Table 3B), UGC Regulations 2018

  • Relaxation for PwBD: As per Government notification

Candidate should have diploma in Coaching from SAI/NS NIS or from any other recognized Indian/Foreign University and should have represented India in Olympics/World Cup/World Championship. Central Government / State Government / PSU employees may be allowed to apply for the position. However, the applicable recruitment rules of the Department of Personnel & Training (DoPT) will be applicable for all such postings on deputation.

Desired Qualification:- 

  • Demonstrated experience in planning, organising and implementing a comprehensive high performance coaching programme for international teams and athletes.
  • Knowledge of leading trends in coaching, including coaching science, practices and the appropriate application of leading technology tools.
  • A background in teaching to provide mentoring and instruction to other support Coaches and Staff involved with the KISCE, DoS&YA, Silvassa
  • The ability to attain excellence from players, coaches, staff and all stakeholders through the establishment of a 'winning'culture.
  • Effective management skills that reflect ability to build and successfully implement longterm strategic plans that are supported by informed operational decisions.

Important Dates

  • Starting Date for Apply: 20-01-2026
  • Last Date for Apply: 31-01-2026

Selection Process

  • The applications received will be scrutinized/ shortlisted on the basis of relevant experience and job description and the eligible candidates will be called for Interview at cost to the applicant.
  • Candidates applied for more than one post will be interviewed only once.

General Information/Instructions

  • Tenure: The contractual engagement will be for a period of four years on the basis of satisfactory performance, periodic reviews, result oriented, etc. and at all times coterminous with the Khelo India Scheme.
  • Age Limit: None
  • Tax Deduction at Source: The Income Tax or any other tax liable to be deducted, as per the prevailing rules will be deducted at source before effecting the payment, for which the KISCE, DoS&YA, Silvassa will issue TDS /Service Tax Certificates, as applicable.
  • Other Allowances: No TA/DA shall be admissible for joining the assignment or on its completion. No other facilities like DA, Accommodation, Residential Phone, Conveyance Transport, Personal Staff, Medical reimbursement, HRA and LTC etc. would be admissible.
  • Extension: Performance of the selected candidates would be continuously reviewed and their extension will be considered on the basis of periodic review / requirement.
  • Leave: Selected candidates will be entitled for 30 days leave in a calendar year on pro-rata basis. Thereafter, candidates shall not draw any remuneration in case of his/her absence beyond30 days in a year. Also unveiled leave in a calendar year will lapse and will not be carried forward to the next calendar year.
  • In case he/she is required to proceed outstation from the place of posting on tour for official duty, he/she will be entitled to TA/DA as admissible under the rules.
  • In case the performance of Candidate is not found satisfactory, his/her services will be discontinued / terminated after giving one month notice.
  • Without any prejudice to the above condition, the candidate will be terminated from his services with immediate effect without any obligations, in case the candidate is found guilty of violating any of the conditions contained in the terms of employment or is guilty of any misconduct including negligence of duties, unauthorized absence, etc.
  • Decision of KISCE, DoS&YA, Silvassa in all matters regarding eligibility, selection and posting would be final and binding upon all candidates. No representation or correspondence will be entertained by KISCE, DoS&YA, Silvassa in this regard.
  • KISCE, DoS&YA, Silvassa shall be the final authority in case of any dispute.
  • The appointment will be purely on contract basis and does not confer any right to claim to permanent employment in KISCE, DoS&YA, Silvassa.
  • Any litigation matters pertaining to employment at KISCE, DoS&YA, Silvassa shall be restricted to the jurisdiction of the Mumbai courts.
  • Organization reserves the right to terminate the contract, by giving one month notice to Candidates.
  • The applications received will be scrutinized/ shortlisted on the basis of relevant experience and job description and the eligible candidates will be called for Interview at cost to the applicant.
  • Candidates applied for more than one post will be interviewed only once.
  • KISCE, DoS&YA, Silvassa reserves the right to cancel the advertisement and/or the selection process at any stage without assigning any reason.
  • Selected persons will not be allowed to publish a book or a compilation of articles or participate in a radio broadcast or contribute an article or anonymously or pseudonymous in the name of any other person, if such book, article, broadcast, uses any information that the/she may gather as part of this assignment.
  • During the period of engagement with KISCE, DNH & DD, Employee would be subject to the provisions of the Indian Official Secret Act, 1923 and will not divulge any information gathered by him/her during the period of his/her engagement to anyone who is not authorized to know.
  • The Selected personnel at no instance can represent or give opinion or advice to others in any matter, which is adverse to the interest of the Government.

How to Apply

  • Permanent employees of Sports Authority of India (SAI) interested in applying for the position must send a self-attested letter addressed to the Deputy Secretary and email at [email protected] and not apply through the advertisement.
  • Whereas contractual employees of SAI must apply as per process directly to the KISCE in reply to this advertisement.

  • RFID Based Physical Standard Test (PST): PST of candidates will be carried out by using Radio Frequency Identification Devices (RFID) with specific height, chest and weight standards
  • Motor Ability Test (MAT): MAT in all sports disciplines will be conducted by a Board of Officers at rally site as per norms of Lakshmibai National College of Physical Education (LNCPE) manual of Sports Authority of India (SAI)
  • Field Trial: Field Trial in all disciplines will be conducted by a Board of Officers at Rally site. Marks will be awarded to candidates as per their performance in the Field Trial
  • Detailed Medical Examination (DME): Candidates who qualify in Field Trial in respective sports discipline will undergo Detailed Medical Examination with specific visual acuity and medical standards
  • Review Medical Examination (RME): If a candidate is declared UNFIT in DME, they will be allowed to undergo RME provided they give written consent
  • Merit List: Candidates who qualify in all respects will be placed in Merit List. Final selection will be done on the basis of achievements and performance in Field Trials and level of participation

  • Mobiles and other electronic gadgets are banned within the premises of recruitment rally sites/trial centres
  • Assam Rifles authorities are not responsible for any type of arrangement of accommodation/food/transportation for the candidates during the recruitment process
  • Assam Rifles authorities will not be held responsible for any damage/injury/death/loss to the individual sustained during the entire recruitment process
  • Compassionate ground appointment scheme is not applicable to this Recruitment Rally
  • The first phase of the recruitment may take 40 to 60 days to complete
  • No TA/DA is admissible
  • To avoid over-crowding, only candidates will be permitted to enter Recruitment Rally Site. Parents/friends are advised not to accompany candidates
  • Providing functional/in use Email ID and mobile phone number in Online Application Form by the applicants is mandatory. The mobile phone number should not be DND activated
  • All further information regarding conduct of various events will be intimated through notification on website and email only

How to Apply

  • Application Mode: Online applications only
  • Application Portal: Visit the official website www.assamrifles.gov.in
  • Steps to Apply:
    • Click on "ONLINE APPLICATION" option on the web page
    • Fill up the online application with requisite details as prescribed in the application form
    • After filling the application, make online payment via the link given or alternatively payment can be made at any SBI Branch
    • Upload copy of the challan or receipt online
    • Download and print the completed Online Application Form and Call Letter
  • Documents Required While Reporting: Candidates must produce original copy of payment receipt/challan, printed copy of online Application Form duly completed, and copy of Call Letter downloaded from the website
  • Original Documents: During PST, MAT, Field Trial, DME & RME, candidates must produce all original documents/certificates pertaining to age, education, caste, sports and domicile/PRC
  • Important Note: In case of non uploading of receipt/challan during online registration, the candidature of such applicants will be rejected
  • Application Validity: The online applications portal will be functioning from 10 Jan 2026 to 09 Feb 2026
  • Late Applications: Applications received thereafter will not be entertained

Selection Process

  • The examination shall be conducted through the Computer Based Test (CBT) mode.
  • Scheme of Examination:
  • General Knowledge: 50 Questions, 50 Marks
  • Basic Mathematics: 25 Questions, 25 Marks
  • English Language: 25 Questions, 25 Marks
  • Questions of subjects listed will be of Class X level. Questions on General Knowledge are to assess the candidate's knowledge on politics, history, geography, literature, sports, arts and culture etc.
  • The questions shall be of MCQ type carrying 1(one) mark each. For every wrong answer 0.5 mark shall be deducted. The duration of the examination shall be for 75(seventy-five) minutes. For DAP candidates using a scribe, 20 minutes per hour extra time shall be provided (100 minutes in total).

General Information / Instructions

  • Candidates should be in possession of the following certificates on the closing date for receipt of application form: (i) Permanent Resident Certificate. (ii) Domicile certificate (iii) Certificate for passing H.S.L.C./ Matriculate from a recognized Board. (iv) Mark Sheet of H.S.L.C./ Matriculate examination
  • Candidates should produce original documents to prove qualifications, experience, age, community, disability etc. as and when called for by the Commission. Failure to produce the original documents as and when called for by the Commission shall result in cancellation of candidature.
  • Candidates are cautioned that they must ensure that they fulfil all the criteria as per the Recruitment Rules/Advertisement before applying. They must belong to the category as filled in the application form and should be able to prove the same by furnishing the requisite certificate from the competent authority when such certificates are sought by the Commission at the time of document verification, failing which their candidature will be cancelled.
  • Note 1: Candidates should note that payment of examination fee can be made only through online mode as mentioned above. Payment of fee through any other mode is neither valid nor acceptable. Application submitted without prescribed fee/mode shall be summarily rejected.
  • Note 2: No claim for refund of the fee shall be entertained unless- a. a candidate has unfortunately expired before he/she takes the examination and the claim of refund is preferred by the legal heirs within six months of the date of examination; or b. a candidate has paid the fee more than once and the fee has been actually credited into the account of the Commission more than once.
  • Note 3: For the Applicants in whose case payments details have not been received from the bank, they will be treated as fictitious payment cases and their applications will be rejected in the first instance. A list of such applicants shall be made available on the Commission's website after the last date of online application. On receipt of documentary proof, genuine fee payment cases will be considered, and their applications will be revived, if they are otherwise eligible.
  • All candidates in service other than casual or muster roll will be required to submit/upload the "NO OBJECTION CERTIFICATE" duly issued by the concerned Department/Authority for appearing in the examination.
  • The eligible candidates shall be issued an e-Admission Certificate. The e-Admission certificate will be made available in the MSSC website for downloading by the candidates. The Schedule for downloading of e-Admit cards shall be notified separately. No admission Certificate will be issued from MSSC Office or sent by post.
  • No candidate will be admitted to the Examination venue unless he/she holds the above-mentioned e-Admission Certificate.
  • Mere fact that an e-Admission certificate of the examination has been issued to a candidate, will not imply that his/her candidature has been finally cleared by the Commission or that entries made by the candidate in his/her application to the examination has been accepted by the Commission as true and correct.
  • The decision of the Commission as to the eligibility or otherwise of a candidate for admission to the Examination shall be final.
  • The Provisional Answer Keys of MCQ based examinations shall be uploaded online as soon as possible after its conduct for inviting objection(s) for which 3 (three) days' time shall be given from the day of publishing of provisional answer key. (day of publishing of the answer key plus next 3 days) to submit their objection(s) in an online mode only along with Rs.200/- (Rupees two hundred only) as fee for each challenged question. All these objections shall be referred to a team of Experts constituted for the purpose. The decision of the team of experts shall be final and binding upon all the concerned stakeholders.
  • The Commission reserves the right to amend this notification in parts or to the whole.
  • Note: A candidate found to be furnishing incorrect information to the Commission, suppressing information, violating instructions, adopting various unfair means in the Examination like impersonation, cheating, etc. is liable to be disqualified and/or debarred from writing the Examinations and any other subsequent examinations conducted by this Commission.
  • Schedule of the Examination shall be notified separately.
  • Candidates are advised to visit the official website of the Commission regularly and check for updates. In case, the candidates face any difficulty in submitting the form please visit the technical support link.

How to Apply

  • Applications are to be submitted online through the link provided on the Commission's website: https://manipurssc.mn.gov.in. Only those candidates who have been sponsored by the concerned employment exchange shall be allowed to submit applications online.
  • Click the link provided.
  • Register on the portal.
  • Log in using the User ID and password provided on registration.
  • Click on "Application Form" Link.
  • Enter your Details properly in the form provided. Check everything especially Name, address, email Address, Mobile Number and Date of Birth, Gender, Employment Status (Government Employee), Physical Nature, Category, Educational qualifications, Language and Work Experience details (if any).
  • After adding all required details Click on "Continue" link and proceed to upload live Photo.
  • Upload your documents, Signature and Other Details, Click on Save and Continue to proceed to Final Confirmation Page
  • Give one final Check, tick the Declaration Checkbox (candidates have to sign a declaration to the effect that he/she possesses the requisite essential educational qualifications and all the other mandatory requirements for the post and in the event of the particulars or information given being found false or incorrect his/her candidature is liable to be cancelled even after shortlisting/selection for the post).
  • Click on Confirm and Pay Button.
  • You will be redirected to payment gateway where you will be asked to make the payment. Select your desired mode and make the payment. Form submission shall be completed, and acknowledgement receipt shall be generated.

Eligibility Criteria

Salary / Stipend

  • All Multi Tasking Staff posts carry Level-1 pay scale [Rs.18,000-56,900] as per 7th CPC.
  • Total emoluments are approximately Rs.36,000/- per month on minimum of scale including admissible allowances in ‘Y’ class city.

Age Limit 

  • Minimum Age: 18 years.
  • Maximum Age: 25 years.
  • Upper age limit relaxable up to 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC(NCL) where posts are reserved for these categories, as per Government of India orders in force.
  • Age relaxation of 10 years (15 years for SC/ST, 13 years for OBC(NCL)) for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities as per applicable rules.
  • Relaxation for Ex-servicemen as per Ex-servicemen (Re-employment in Civil Services and Posts) Rules and related Government instructions.

Application Fee

  • Candidates are required to pay application fee of Rs.500/- (five hundred only) through SB Collect (SBI Collect) link provided in the online application.

Important Dates

Notification / Opening of Online Applications 05.01.2026 (from 11:00 hours IST)
Application Start Date 05.01.2026 (11:00 AM)
Application Last Date 06.02.2026 (upto 17:00 hours IST)

Selection Process

  • Shortlisting of candidates by a Committee constituted by the Director, CSIR-NML, based on fulfillment of qualification, terms and conditions of the advertisement; only shortlisted candidates will be allowed to appear in the Competitive Written Examination.
  • Selection will be made on the basis of merit list of Competitive Written Examination.
  • Competitive Written Examination will be Computer Based Objective Type Multiple Choice Examination, with questions in English and Hindi (except English language section), standard of Class X, total 150 questions and total time of 2 hours (2 hours 40 minutes for candidates eligible for scribe).
  • The paper will have four parts: Part I General Intelligence (25 questions, 75 marks), Part II Quantitative Aptitude (25 questions, 75 marks), Part III General Awareness (50 questions, 150 marks), Part IV English Language (50 questions, 150 marks), with three marks for every correct answer and one negative mark for every wrong answer.
  • Merit list will be prepared on the basis of performance in Competitive Written Examination, with tie resolved by lesser negative marks, older age, earlier acquisition of minimum educational qualification, and alphabetical order of first name.

General Information / Instructions

  • The applicant must be a citizen of India and must possess the essential qualification and fulfill all conditions stipulated in the advertisement; minimum essential qualification is compulsory even if higher qualification is possessed.
  • The age limit for Multi Tasking Staff is 18-25 years with relaxations as per Government/CSIR rules; crucial date for determining age, qualifications, experience and reserved category status is the closing date for receipt of online applications.
  • All new entrants will be governed by the New Pension Scheme as adopted by CSIR; the post carries usual allowances (DA, HRA, TA) and benefits such as medical reimbursement, LTC, advances, and CSIR residence allotment as per rules.
  • Normal place of posting is CSIR-NML, Jamshedpur, including centres at Chennai and Digha (West Bengal), but appointees can be posted in any CSIR Lab/Institute or its centres in India at the discretion of competent authority.
  • Candidates will not be paid any TA/DA for appearing in Competitive Written Examination and canvassing in any form or bringing political/other influence will be treated as disqualification.
  • The Director, CSIR-NML reserves the right to cancel the advertisement or not to fill the posts and the number of vacancies may increase or decrease at the time of selection.
  • Selected candidates will be on probation for two years, which may be extended or curtailed at the discretion of the competent authority.
  • Any further information, addendum/corrigendum, and details regarding tests will be provided only on CSIR-NML website https://www.nml.res.in, and candidates are advised to visit the website regularly.

How to Apply

  • Candidates are advised to go through the instructions for applying online available in the online application portal on CSIR-NML website https://nml.res.in.
  • Eligible and interested candidates are required to apply online only through CSIR-NML website; the online application link will be available from 05.01.2026 (11.00 AM) to 06.02.2026 (05:00 PM), and no other mode of application will be accepted.
  • Candidates are required to submit only one application against any given post code; two or more applications against one post code may lead to cancellation of candidature.
  • Candidates desirous to apply for more than one post code should submit separate applications for each post code with requisite application fee for each, wherever applicable.
  • Candidates should submit the online application form well in advance without waiting for the last date/time; CSIR-NML will not be responsible for non-submission of application or payment of fee for any reason.
  • Candidates must have a valid and active personal email ID to be kept active till completion of the recruitment process and must upload latest passport size colour photograph and signature as per specified size and format.
  • Application fee of Rs.500/- (if applicable) must be paid through SBI Collect link provided in the online application; fee once paid will not be refunded or kept in reserve for any other recruitment.
  • Candidates working in Government Departments/Autonomous Bodies/PSUs must attach NOC or proof of having applied for NOC and must produce NOC with vigilance clearance when asked, failing which candidature will be terminated.
  • Required certificates (educational, category, PwBD, Ex-servicemen, NOC, etc.) and a handwritten declaration must be scanned and uploaded as separate PDF files (each not more than 4 MB) along with the online application.
  • Applications without proper signature, photograph, applicable fee or clear documents will be summarily rejected, and no interim enquiry or correspondence will be entertained.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Essential Educational Qualification: A person who is appointed as Drug Inspector under the Act shall be a person who has a degree in Pharmacy or Pharmaceutical Sciences or Medicine with Specialization in Clinical Pharmacology or Microbiology from a University established in India by law (as per Rule No. 49 of Drug & Cosmetics Rules 1945).
  • Experience Requirement: Only those Inspectors who have not less than 18 months experience in the Manufacture of at least one of the substance specified in Schedule C, OR who have not less than 18 months experience in testing of at least one of the substances in Schedule C in a laboratory approved for this purpose by the licensing authority, OR who have gained experiences of not less than three years in the inspection of firms manufacturing any of the substances specified in Schedule C during the tenure of their services as Drugs Inspectors, shall be authorised to inspect the manufacture of the substances mentioned in Schedule C.
  • Essential Qualifications: Degree in Pharmacy or Pharmaceutical Sciences or Medicine with specialization in Clinical Pharmacology or Microbiology from a University established in India by law.
  • Desirable: As per Drug & Cosmetics Rules 1945, Rule 49 specifications.

Salary/Stipend

Important Dates

Event Date

Online Registration Last Date 18/02/2026 (05:00 PM)
Last Date for Fee Payment 19/02/2026 (05:00 PM)
Hard Copy Submission Last Date (By Registered/Speed Post/Hand Delivery) 05/03/2026 (05:00 PM)

Selection Process

  • Written Examination: The written examination will be objective type consisting of 5 papers of 200 marks each. Each paper will be of 2 hours duration. Total marks for written examination: 1000 marks.
  • Paper-I: Pharmaceutics for Degree in Pharmacy/Pharmaceutical Sciences; General Medicine for Degree in Medicine with specialization (200 marks)
  • Paper-II: Microbiology (200 marks)
  • Paper-III: Pharmacology (200 marks)
  • Paper-IV: Pharmaceutical Chemistry for Pharmacy degree holders; Biochemistry for Medicine degree holders (200 marks)
  • Paper-V: Pharmaceutical Jurisprudence & Ethics (200 marks)
  • Interview: 100 marks
  • Total Marks: 1100 (1000 Written + 100 Interview)
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks:
    • General Category: 40%
    • Backward Class: 36.5%
    • Backward Class (Category-I): 34%
    • SC/ST and Female Category: 32%
    • Primitive Tribal Group: 30%
    • EWS: 40%
  • Syllabus: The syllabus for written examination is available on the Commission's website www.jpsc.gov.in

General Information/Instructions

  • Post Type: Permanent position with 2 years probation period
  • Department: State Drug Control Directorate, Namkum, Ranchi under Health, Medical Education and Family Welfare Department, Government of Jharkhand
  • Reservation Benefit: Reservation benefit will be given only to permanent residents of Jharkhand State. All categories of candidates claiming reservation must submit Local Resident Certificate. Caste/income and asset certificates issued for educational purposes will not be acceptable for determining reservation category.
  • Caste Certificate: SC/ST candidates of Jharkhand State must submit caste certificate issued by competent authority in prescribed format (Form-5/Form-V for ST and Form-4/Form-IV for SC). Central Format caste certificates are not valid for state government services.
  • OBC Certificate: EBC-I and BC-II category candidates must submit caste certificate in prescribed Format-XI/Form-11 (Non-Creamy Layer) issued by competent authority of Jharkhand State. If the validity of Non-Creamy Layer certificate has expired, candidates must submit self-declaration in Form-XV.
  • EWS Certificate: Economically Weaker Section candidates must submit valid and updated Income & Asset Certificate issued by competent authority of Jharkhand State in prescribed format (Annexure-I).
  • Change of Category: Changes in reservation category claimed in online application cannot be made during the recruitment process.
  • Document Verification: Original certificates of all documents mentioned in application must be presented at the time of document verification before interview, otherwise reservation benefit will not be given.
  • NOC Requirement: Government servants must enter details of No Objection Certificate issued by controlling authority in online application, or if NOC is not issued at that time, must indicate "Applied for NOC" and submit original NOC at time of document verification.
  • Misconduct: Candidates found guilty of misconduct including providing false information, suppressing material information, impersonation, using unfair means, submitting fabricated documents, etc. may be disqualified and debarred from examinations as per Jharkhand Competitive Examination (Prevention and Prohibition of Unfair Means in Recruitment) Act, 2023.
  • Pre-examination Training: Information regarding pre-examination training syllabus is available on Commission's website.
  • Commission's Rights: The Commission reserves the right to postpone or cancel the selection process at any time without assigning any reason.
  • Canvassing: Canvassing in any form will disqualify a candidate.
  • Final Authority: The decision of the Commission regarding eligibility and other matters will be final.

How to Apply

  • Candidates can apply online only through One Time Registration (OTR) System available on JPSC website www.jpsc.gov.in from 29.01.2026 to 18.02.2026 (05:00 PM).
  • Before filling online application, candidates must read "How to Register for OTR" available on Commission's website.
  • Candidates must have valid email ID and mobile number which should be kept active till final result declaration.
  • Upload clear colored passport size photograph and signature at designated places through OTR System. Application will be rejected if photograph and signature are not uploaded.
  • Fill application form in BLOCK LETTERS (except signature).
  • Write name and father's name spelling exactly as mentioned in Matriculation certificate/mark sheet.
  • Enter date of birth as mentioned in Matriculation certificate/mark sheet.
  • Pay examination fee through Credit Card/Debit Card/Net Banking/Wallet/Bharat QR/UPI via Payment Gateway.
  • After successful submission, login to dashboard and download filled application from "Download Filled Application Section". Take two printouts.
  • Upload required documents in OTR and also send hard copy of online application along with self-attested copies of all required certificates by Registered Post/Speed Post/Hand Delivery to: Examination Controller, Jharkhand Public Service Commission, Circular Road, Ranchi, 834001 by 05.03.2026 (05:00 PM).
  • Write on envelope: Advertisement No. 12/2025, Post Name: Drug Inspector, OTR No., Registration No. in BOLD letters.
  • Applications received through any other medium or after last date will not be accepted.
  • Documents to be submitted (hard copy with original at time of document verification):

CSIR-CIMFR Security Officer 2026 Vacancy Details

The total number of vacancies for CSIR-CIMFR Security Officer Recruitment 2026 is 01 post.

Post Name Total Posts
Security Officer 01

Note: CSIR-CIMFR strives to have a workforce that reflects gender balance and women candidates are encouraged to apply.

Eligibility Criteria

1. Educational Qualification & Experience

Candidates must possess the following essential qualification and experience for the Security Officer post:

  • Ex-Servicemen JCO (Subedar or higher rank) OR equivalent rank in other Para-military forces with minimum of 10 years’ experience in security.
  • For Short Service Commissioned Officers and incumbents holding the position of Assistant Commandant in CRPF/BSF/ITBP etc. in pay scale Rs. 8000–13500 (Pre-revised) – minimum 05 years’ experience in security.
  • For Inspector from Para-Military Forces – minimum 10 years’ experience in security.

2. Age Limit & Relaxation

  • Maximum Age: 35 years as on 02-02-2026 (last date of receipt of application).
  • The date for determining age limit, experience and qualifications is 02-02-2026 up to 5:30 PM.
  • SC/ST/OBC candidates applying against UR vacancy are not eligible for age relaxation.
  • Relaxation in age limit is available only for eligible Ex-Servicemen as per Government of India rules under Ex-Servicemen (Re-employment in Central Civil Services and Posts) Rules, 1979 as amended.
  • Not applicable to serving Armed Forces personnel (except those being released after earning pension) and Paramilitary Forces personnel.

3. Nationality

The applicant must be a citizen of India. All applicants must fulfill the essential requirements and conditions as on 02-02-2026.

Job Description

The Security Officer will be responsible for overall security management of CSIR-CIMFR campus and its units, including supervision of security measures, record maintenance, and handling security-related emergencies.

  • Supervising security measures for safety of CSIR-CIMFR properties and units.
  • Maintaining records related to movement of men and materials, deployment of security personnel in all shifts, handling visitors, security cameras, and enforcement of security rules and procedures.
  • Working round the clock (24x7) as required and attending in person to security-related emergencies.
  • Conducting investigations into theft, pilferage, accidents, sabotage or subversive activities and coordinating with local law and order authorities; knowledge of local language is an added advantage.
  • Use and maintenance of firearms.
  • Firefighting and combating fire in emergencies.
  • Any other duty assigned by the competent authority.

Age Limit

  • Upper age limit not exceeding 35 years as on the last date of submission of application (02-02-2026 at 5:30 PM).
  • Date for determining age limit, experience and qualifications is the closing date for receipt of applications.
  • No age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC candidates applying against UR vacancy.
  • Age relaxation available only for eligible Ex-Servicemen as per Government of India rules under Ex-Servicemen (Re-employment in Central Civil Services and Posts) Rules, 1979 as amended.

Application Fee

  • Candidates are required to pay a non-refundable Application Fee of Rs. 500/- (Rupees Five Hundred only).
  • Payment must be made through SBI payment gateway available at CSIR-CIMFR website (www.cimfr.nic.in) via SBI Collect.
  • Web generated e-receipt of SBI payment must be enclosed with the application form.
  • No other mode of payment is accepted.
  • SC/ST/Women candidates are exempted from payment of application fee (as mentioned in the “How to apply” section).

Selection Process

Candidates will be selected through the following stages:

  • Physical and Personality Assessment Test (qualifying in nature).
  • Written Test (for candidates who qualify the physical and personality assessment test).
  • Final merit list based on performance in competitive written examination (primarily Paper-II as per syllabus).
  • Tie cases will be resolved as per CSIR Letter No. 5-1(211)/2014-PD dated 30.05.2023 and any subsequent amendments.

Written Test Pattern

Candidates who qualify the physical test will be allowed to appear for the written test, consisting of two papers:

  • Paper-I: OMR-based or Computer Based Objective Type Multiple Choice Test.
  • Paper-II: Subjective type.
  • Paper-I (Mental Ability and Personality Assessment Test): 100 questions, 100 marks, 90 minutes, no negative marking.
  • Threshold marks for Paper-I: 30%. Only candidates securing at least 30% in Paper-I will have Paper-II evaluated.
  • Paper-II: Total 100 marks, 2 hours duration – Comprehension (25), Report Writing (25), Security Regulations & Firefighting (25), General Awareness (25).
  • Minimum threshold marks for Paper-II shall not be less than 35% (to be notified before test).
  • Final merit list based on Paper-II marks only for candidates who secure more than minimum threshold marks.
  • Medium of exam: English and Hindi (bilingual question papers; exam can be taken in either language).
  • Standard of exam: Graduation level.

Salary / Stipend

  • Scale of Pay: Level-7 as per 7th CPC, Rs. 44,900–1,42,400.
  • Approximate total emoluments: Rs. 78,000/- per month at minimum of scale, including House Rent Allowance as admissible in Dhanbad.
  • Benefits include DA, HRA (if accommodation not provided), Transport Allowance and other allowances as per CSIR/GoI norms.
  • New entrants governed by New Pension Scheme (NPS) 2004 as adopted by CSIR; those from Government/Autonomous Bodies/PSUs with Govt. pattern pension continue under CCS (Pension) Rules 1972 (now 2021), as applicable.

How To Apply

Candidates must submit applications only in offline mode using the prescribed format.

  1. Visit CSIR-CIMFR website: www.cimfr.nic.in.
  2. Go to “Vacancies” section (http://cimfr.nic.in/vacancies.html) and download the prescribed Application Form (A4 size).
  3. Read the advertisement completely before filling the form. All columns are mandatory; write “Not Applicable (NA)” where not relevant.
  4. Fill the application form in English/Hindi, affix recent self-attested passport size colour photograph and sign the form.
  5. Pay the application fee of Rs. 500/- (if applicable) through SBI Collect via SBI payment gateway available at CIMFR website and take a print-out of the e-receipt.
  6. Attach self-attested copies of required documents (age proof, educational qualifications, experience, discharge certificate, caste certificate, NOC if applicable, etc.) along with web generated SBI e-receipt.
  7. Place the application and enclosures in an envelope superscribed:
    “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF __________ (Post Code: _______), Advt. No. _______”
  8. Send the envelope by Registered/Speed Post only to:
    The Controller of Administration, Central Institute of Mining & Fuel Research, Barwa Road, Dhanbad – 826001 (JHARKHAND)
  9. Ensure that the application reaches on or before 02-02-2026 by 5:30 PM. Applications received after the closing date/time will not be entertained.
  10. Applications without photograph, signature, application fee (if applicable), or required enclosures will be summarily rejected.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifications: Minimum prescribed qualification mentioned against each trade.
  • Essential qualifications: As per the eligible courses for each trade.

Salary/Stipend

  • Rate of stipend payable to apprentices per month shall be as prescribed under Apprentices Act, 1961/1973, Apprentices Rules 1992/2019/2025 as amended from time to time.

Age Limit (as on 28-02-2026)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 25 years
  • Relaxation in upper age limits to SC, ST, OBC [NCL] PwBD & others applicable categories shall be as per Government of India guidelines.

Important Dates

Commencement of online registration of application of candidates 01.02.2026
Last date for receipt of online application 28.02.2026

Selection Process

  • Selection of the candidates will be on merit basis i.e. on the basis of percentage of marks obtained in the respective fields.

General Information/Instructions

  • Mere fulfillment of eligibility criteria/norms does not entitle a candidate to be considered for engagement as Apprentice. Management reserves the right to reject the application without assigning any reason and to raise standard of specifications to restrict the number of candidates to be called for engagement as Apprentices. The selection process can be cancelled/suspended/restricted/enlarged/modified without assigning any reasons. The decision of the Management will be final and no appeal will be entertained.
  • The candidature is liable for rejection at any stage of training process in case of suppression/furnishing of false information.
  • UCIL can place the candidate for training at any of its unit.
  • First preference shall be given to candidates belonging to Land Displaced Category. Second preference shall be given to local candidates (within 5 km) radius for project affected family [as per R&R Policy] of all the units of UCIL in Jharkhand region and Third preference shall be given to Employees [who are working in any unit of UCIL] Wards relevant documents shall be verified at the time of joining. Hard copy regarding Land Displaced and Employees Son may be sent to the Central Personnel Section of UCIL, Jaduguda for Jaduguda/Narwapahar and Turamdih on or before the last date of submission of application in this advertisement by post.
  • Those candidates awaiting their mark sheet/certificates are NOT eligible to apply for the above apprentice training.
  • The candidate has to upload all mark sheets and certificates. The candidate shall not be considered without uploading all mark sheets and certificates. Merely passing certificate shall not be entertained. It must mention marksheet.
  • No communication shall be done with the applicant regard to incomplete application. Incomplete application shall be summarily rejected.
  • Interested candidate can apply through NAPS portal & NATS portal.
  • No other method of application shall be considered except application received through NAPS portal & NATS portal.
  • Any other information not covered under this notice shall be applicable as per The Apprentice Act and The Apprenticeship Rules.
  • Any kind of arbitration shall be under the jurisdiction of Ranchi High Court [Jharkhand].
  • No previously posted applications prior to publication date of this advertisement shall be considered for apprenticeship under this advertisement.
  • Application shall not be received in offline mode.
  • The result shall be published on our UCIL website www.uraniumcorp.in. No correspondence in this regard shall be made. Candidates are requested to visit UCIL website for publication of result. The selected candidates shall be informed through their registered email ID.
  • Any change/amendment in the advertisement shall be published on UCIL website.
  • Screening and selection will be based on the details provided in the on-line application form, hence it is necessary that only accurate, full and correct information is furnished by the applicants. Furnishing of wrong/false information will be a reason for disqualification and UCIL will NOT be responsible for disqualification as a consequence of furnishing of such wrong/false information.
  • Provisional merit list shall be prepared based on the information entered in the portal. Physical verification of the original documents shall be done during joining.
  • Mail for further any communication: [email protected]

How to Apply

  • For registration visit Govt. portal website a) Trade Apprentice https://apprenticeshipindia.gov.in/ b) Technician Apprentice – Diploma at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php c) Graduate Apprentice: https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php
  • Candidate Registration:- Candidate must click on the Registration Tab for registering themselves for Apprenticeship Training. After registration a confirmation e-mail will be sent to the registered e-mail address of the candidate. The candidate has to click on the link provided in the e-mail for activation (example:- Registration Number-A000000000) and thereafter the candidate has to login and complete his profile for confirmation of registration. The applicant should apply in online mode through official website of apprenticeship portal with the following documents to be uploaded:- [a] Matriculation Cert. & All Mark Sheets [b] Caste Certificate [for SC/ST/OBC [NCL] only] [c] Certificate applicable for EWS candidates [d] Medical Certificate applicable for physically handicapped only [e] Photo and signature [f] Aadhaar Card & Pan Card [g] Aadhaar card linked bank account [h] Land Acquisition Certificate for Land Displaced Person /Adhaar Card for Project affected family and UCIL ID card of employee for Employee son.
  • Apprenticeship Opportunities:- After registering online the candidate must click on the Apprenticeship Opportunities Tab section for selecting the desired trade in which Apprenticeship Training is being sought. Thereafter the candidate must also select one or more than one unit i.e. (Uranium Corporation of India Limited, Jaduguda / Narwapahar and Turamdih) in which he/she wishes to undergo Apprenticeship Training on or before 28.02.2026
  • Candidate who have applied through online portal from date of this advertisement till date 28.02.2026 shall be considered for further scrutiny. All previous application uploaded prior to this advertisement shall not be considered. They need to apply afresh.
  • Applications received after the expiry of the due date 28.02.2026 shall not be considered for further scrutiny.
