Vacancy Details

The total number of vacancies for JIPMER Project Technical Support-III Recruitment 2026 is 1 posts. One post is under the project “Identification of Novel Extracellular Vesicle-Associated Bacterial Antigens and Host Biomarkers in Bacterial Pneumonia”, and one post is under the project “Development of a Nanopore-based long read sequencing panel for culture-free detection of drug resistance in Mycobacterium tuberculosis”.

Note: Each position is intended for one candidate only.

Eligibility Criteria 

1. Educational Qualification

Candidates must possess B.Sc. (Medical Laboratory Technology) or BMLS (Bachelor of Medical Laboratory Science) with three years of research experience or PG in a relevant field or subject to apply for the Project Technical Support-III positions.

Desirable qualifications include field experience at the time of sample collection, fluency in reading, writing and speaking Tamil, and computer knowledge (MS Excel and MS Word).

2. Age Limit

The maximum age limit for JIPMER Project Technical Support-III Recruitment 2026 is 35 years as on the last date of receipt of applications. Age relaxation will be applicable to various categories in accordance with Government of India instructions.nt.

Selection Process

The recruitment process will be carried out after evaluation of the application form, CV and supporting documents submitted by the candidates. Applicants will be shortlisted based on the details furnished in the application, CV and documentary proof provided, and the list of eligible candidates will be displayed on the JIPMER website tentatively on or before 05/02/2026.

The final selection will be based on CV, application and written test/interview. Shortlisted candidates must report for document verification followed by a written test and an interview on the notified date and time at the Department of Microbiology, JIPMER.

How to Apply 

Eligible and interested candidates must apply by email for the JIPMER Project Technical Support-III 2026 posts by following the procedure given in the notification.

  1. Fill the prescribed application form (attached with the advertisement).
  2. Prepare your CV and supporting documents and scan them together with the filled application form into a single PDF file.
  3. Name the PDF file as “Candidate name_Post-name_year_application”, for example “James_PTS-III_2026_application”.
  4. Send the PDF file by email to [email protected].
  5. Mention the advertisement number and the project title in the email subject line.
  6. Applicants applying for both positions must send two separate applications by email.
  7. Ensure that the application is in the prescribed format; applications not in the prescribed format will not be processed or accepted.
  8. Send the complete application by email on or before 02/02/2026 up to 4:30 PM.

Instructions

  • This position is purely on contract basis for an externally sponsored project, and the person engaged will have no claim to any regular post in JIPMER at any time.
  • The position is only for the duration of the project and is based purely on external funding support; engagement may be extended or curtailed at the discretion of the Project Investigator.
  • Qualification and experience should be in a relevant discipline/field and from a reputed institution/organization, and the experience should have been gained after acquiring the essential qualification.
  • Qualification, experience and other terms and conditions may be relaxed or altered at the discretion of the Principal Investigator.
  • A valid email ID and mobile number are compulsory.
  • Consolidated salary of the post may vary from time to time; no other allowance or facilities apart from the consolidated salary will be extended.
  • Submission of wrong or false information at any stage or canvassing of any kind will lead to disqualification or termination if detected after engagement.
  • Only shortlisted candidates will be called for written test and/or interview; if the number of applications is very large, more stringent criteria than those specified may be used to determine eligibility.

  • Incomplete applications, applications not in the prescribed format and applications not fulfilling the essential criteria are likely to be summarily rejected; applications with CV alone without the prescribed form and certificates will also be rejected.

Salary/Stipend

The consolidated remuneration for the Project Technical Support-III post is INR 33,600 per month (INR 28,000 + 20% HRA) for each position.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Applicants should have qualification, experience and expertise in cinematography / videography / news gathering / broadcast journalism.
  • Academic qualifications must be furnished with proof in duplicate as per the application form enclosed in the notification.
  • Technical qualifications may include degree/diploma/certificates in cinematography, videography, journalism, broadcast journalism or related fields as detailed in the application form.
  • Experience as cameraperson/news cameraperson/videographer and as newsman/electronic journalist etc. has to be provided with organizational details and period of work.
  • Applicants must submit documentary evidence/certificates to support the quality of work, including details of visual assignments, specialization areas and other relevant credentials.
  • Applicants should have adequate facilities and equipment including cameras, audio equipment, lights and preferably ENG equipment as specified in the application form and guidelines.

Salary/Stipend

  • Stringers will be paid Rs. 1,500/- per local coverage of duration less than 6 hours, inclusive of transportation and delivery charges.
  • If the duration of local coverage exceeds 6 hours or involves locations apart by more than 10 kms, it will be treated as two coverages and the second coverage will be paid at Rs. 1,000/-.
  • For outstation coverage undertaken beyond the geographical limits of the District headquarters where the Stringer is empanelled, the Stringer’s fee will be Rs. 1,800/- per coverage, inclusive of transportation and delivery charges.
  • Payments are on per coverage basis irrespective of length of footage or its usage.

Age Limit

  • Age limit details are not mentioned in the notification.

Application Fee

  • Applications must be supported with a Demand Draft of Rs. 1,180/- (inclusive of GST) towards non refundable processing fee.
  • The Demand Draft should be drawn in favour of “DDO/ DDK, Vijayawada” payable at Vijayawada.
  • The Demand Draft must be enclosed along with the application in a sealed cover.

Important Dates

Event Date
Last date of receipt of Application 20 February 2026 till 5 PM

Selection Process

  • Applications will be scrutinised and eligibility of candidates will be assessed based on qualification, experience, equipment, technical facilities, credibility etc. as per the Assessment Scale in the guidelines.
  • Shortlisted applicants will be asked to provide test coverages using their own equipment and raw material to ascertain the quality of their work.
  • Applicants will have to undergo interview and verification of equipment and documents, including physical verification of equipment by the Empanelment Committee or Technical Committee.
  • A test coverage assignment will be given to all applicants for submission to RNU before their interview date; submission on time is essential for being called for interview.
  • The final panel of Stringers will be drawn by the Committee based on assessment scale, interview and quality of test coverages, and names of selected Stringers will be published and informed in writing.
  • Stringers will be removed from the panel for reasons such as refusal to cover assignments, poor content or technical quality, delay in coverage, subcontracting work, cartel operations, incorrect information or any act causing embarrassment to Prasar Bharati.

General Information/Instructions

  • The Regional News Unit, Doordarshan Kendra, Vijayawada invites applications for Empanelment as Stringers from individuals with experience in news coverages for districts of Andhra Pradesh listed in the notification.
  • Applicants should mention in the application form the name of the district where they wish to be empanelled and must be based in that district.
  • The key person for operation of stringership must be clearly mentioned and he/she must be working in the applied district and must continue to be in the same district once selected.
  • Empanelled Stringers are expected to cover news and short features on news, current affairs, sports, business and other subjects and also alert RNU on major news or breaking stories.
  • Applications should be submitted in sealed cover with superscription “Empanelment of Stringers of DD News-2026” on or before the last date of submission.
  • Proof in duplicate of Academic and Technical Qualifications, Experience and Equipment ownership must be submitted along with the application in the model form provided in the notification.
  • Separate annexures can be given along with the application detailing experience or qualification of the applicant and team, if required.
  • For any clarification, candidates may write to the RNU Email ID – [email protected] as mentioned in the notification.
  • The panel of Stringers shall be revised every two years and existing Stringers will also go through the processes as per revised guidelines.

How to Apply

  • Download and fill the prescribed Application Form for Empanelment as Stringer in Doordarshan (Annexure-A) as given in the notification.
  • Provide details such as district headquarters for empanelment, personal particulars, academic qualifications, technical qualifications, experience, equipment and facilities, and corporate status as required in the form.
  • Enclose attested copies of certificates supporting qualifications, experience, equipment ownership and other information furnished in the application.
  • Attach a Demand Draft of Rs. 1,180/- (inclusive of GST) towards non refundable processing fee in favour of “DDO/ DDK, Vijayawada” payable at Vijayawada.

Vacancy Details

The total number of vacancies for IIT Tirupati Senior Project Associate / Project Scientist I Recruitment 2026 is 1 post.

Note: Category-wise vacancy details are not mentioned in the advertisement.

Eligibility Criteria

1. Educational Qualification

Candidates must possess a Doctoral Degree in Engineering or Technology from a recognized University or equivalent and have at least four years of experience in Research and Development in Industrial and Academic Institutions or Science and Technology Organizations and Scientific activities and services to apply for IIT Tirupati Senior Project Associate / Project Scientist I positions.

2. Desired Experience

  • Working knowledge in interdisciplinary fields of civil and infrastructure engineering, including: innovative pavement materials such as asphalt-rubber, polymers, fibers; advanced materials characterization techniques such as asphalt binder rheology, FTIR, XRD, SEM, DSC; roadway construction and quality control; vehicle-pavement interaction; pavement condition assessment and evaluation; numerical modeling and analysis.
  • Ability to work efficiently in a team environment, self-motivated, and able to work under a variety of challenging research conditions.
  • Experience in mentoring undergraduate and postgraduate students.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills.
  • Strengths in critical thinking, innovative and positive outlook, development of scientific hypothesis and research planning, and troubleshooting.
  • Commitment to results and organization, with highest work ethics and management skills.
  • Willingness to travel for site visits and roadway construction purposes.
  • Willingness to write proposals and secure grants.

3. Age Limit

The age limit for IIT Tirupati Senior Project Associate / Project Scientist I Recruitment 2026 is:

  • Maximum Age: 40 Years )

Selection Process 

Candidates will be selected based on the following process:

  • Shortlisting based on qualifications and experience.
  • In-person interview at IIT Tirupati.
  • No TA/DA shall be paid to candidates appearing for the interview.
  • The interview date will be notified to shortlisted candidates by email.

Note: The institute reserves the right to discontinue the position with one month notice if performance is not satisfactory.

How to Apply 

Eligible candidates can apply online for IIT Tirupati Senior Project Associate / Project Scientist I 2026 by following these steps (as per the notification):

  1. Prepare a detailed CV (maximum 2 pages) specifying qualifications and experience.
  2. Keep scanned copies of experience certificates and marksheets from Class X till date ready for upload.
  3. Visit the application link: https://forms.gle/J1iB3CbCnKNALCy39.
  4. Fill in the required details in the online form accurately.
  5. Upload the detailed CV and scanned copies of required documents as instructed.
  6. Submit the application on or before 01/02/2026.
  7. Wait for email communication from IIT Tirupati regarding shortlisting and interview schedule.

For any queries, candidates may send mail to [email protected].

The consolidated monthly salary for the IIT Tirupati Senior Project Associate / Project Scientist I position is Rs. 56,000 + HRA @ 8% per month.

The tenure of assignment is 01 year (12 months), extendable based on performance.

Instructions

  • The position is purely temporary and is in a time-bound National Highways Authority of India (NHAI), New Delhi sponsored collaborative project undertaken by IIT Tirupati, CSIR-Central Road Research Institute, IIT Palakkad, and NIT Rourkela.

  • • The candidate will have to arrange his/her own scribe at his/her own cost.
  • • The scribe arranged by the candidate should not be a candidate for the same examination. If violation of the above is detected at any stage of the process, candidature of both the candidate and the scribe will be cancelled. Candidates eligible for and who wish to use the services of a scribe in the examination should invariably carefully indicate the same in the online application form. Any subsequent request may not be favourably entertained.
  • • A person acting as a scribe for one candidate cannot be a scribe for another candidate.
  • • The scribe may be from any academic stream.
  • • Both the candidate as well as scribe will have to give a suitable undertaking confirming that the scribe fulfils all the stipulated eligibility criteria for a scribe mentioned above. Further in case it later transpires that he/she did not fulfil any laid down eligibility criteria or suppressed material facts the candidature of the applicant will stand cancelled, irrespective of the result of the examination.
  • • Those candidates who use a scribe shall be eligible for compensatory time of 20 minutes for every hour of the examination or as otherwise advised.
  • • Scribe should not answer on his/her own. Any such behaviour observed will result in cancellation of candidature.
  • • Only candidates registered for compensatory time will be allowed such concessions since compensatory time given to candidates shall be system based, it shall not be possible for the test conducting agency to allow such time if he / she is not registered for the same. Candidates not registered for compensatory time shall not be allowed such concessions.
  • • During the exam, at any stage, if it is found that scribe is independently answering the questions, the exam session will be terminated, and candidate’s candidature will be cancelled. The candidature of such candidates using the services of a scribe will also be cancelled if it is reported after the examination by the test administrator personnel that the scribe independently answered the questions.
  • A compensatory time of twenty minutes per hour or otherwise advised shall be permitted for the candidates with locomotor disability and cerebral palsy where dominant (writing) extremity is affected to the extent of slowing the performance of function (minimum of 40% impairment).
  • Visually Impaired candidates (who suffer from not less than 40% of disability) may opt to view the contents of the test in magnified font and all such candidates will be eligible for compensatory time of 20 minutes for every hour or otherwise advised of examination.
  • These guidelines are subject to change in terms of GoI guidelines/ clarifications, if any, from time to time.

How to Apply

  • Candidates need to apply online only from January 26, 2026, up to February 15, 2026. No other mode of application will be accepted.
  • Scan their: Photograph (4.5cm × 3.5cm), Signature (with black ink), Left thumb impression (on white paper with black or blue ink), A handwritten declaration (on a white paper with black ink) (text given below), The consolidated Mark Sheets of Graduation and Post-Graduation, Graduation and Post-Graduation Degree, Caste Certificate (if applicable) Ensuring that all these scanned documents adhere to the required specifications as given in this Advertisement.
  • Signature in CAPITAL LETTERS will NOT be accepted.
  • The left thumb impression should be properly scanned and not smudged. (If a candidate is not having left thumb, he/she may use his/ her right thumb for applying.)
  • The text for the handwritten declaration is as follows – “I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required.”
  • The above-mentioned handwritten declaration has to be in the candidate’s handwriting and in English only. If it is written and uploaded by anybody else or in any other language, the application will be considered as invalid.
  • Keep the necessary details/documents ready to make Online Payment of the requisite application fee/ intimation charges.
  • Have a valid personal email ID and mobile no., which should be kept active till the completion of this Recruitment Process. Bank may send intimation to download call letters for the Examination etc. through the mentioned e-mail ID and / or SMS. In case a candidate does not have a valid personal e-mail ID, he/she should create his/her new e-mail ID and mobile no. before applying on-line and must maintain that email account and mobile number.
  • Candidates to visit Online Application and click on the option "APPLY ONLINE" which will open a new screen.
  • To register, choose the tab "Click here for New Registration" and enter Name, Contact details and Email-id. A Provisional Registration Number and Password will be generated by the system and displayed on the screen. Candidate should note down the Provisional Registration Number and Password. An Email & SMS indicating the Provisional Registration number and Password will also be sent.
  • In case the candidate is unable to complete the application form in one go, he / she can save the data already entered by choosing "SAVE AND NEXT" tab. Prior to submission of the online application, candidates are advised to use the "SAVE AND NEXT" facility to verify the details in the online application form and modify the same if required. Visually Impaired candidates should fill the application form carefully and verify/ get the details verified to ensure that the same are correct prior to final submission.
  • Candidates are advised to carefully fill and verify the details filled in the online application themselves as no change will be possible/ entertained after clicking the COMPLETE REGISTRATION BUTTON.
  • The Name of the candidate or his /her father/ Husband etc. should be spelt correctly in the application as it appears in the Certificates/ Mark sheets/Identity proof. Any change/alteration found may disqualify the candidature.
  • Validate your details and save your application by clicking the 'Validate your details' and 'Save & Next' button.
  • Candidates can proceed to upload Photo & Signature as per the specifications given in the Guidelines for Scanning and Upload of Photograph and Signature detailed under point "C".
  • Candidates can proceed to fill other details of the Application Form.
  • Click on the Preview Tab to preview and verify the entire application form before COMPLETE REGISTRATION.
  • Modify details, if required, and click on 'COMPLETE REGISTRATION' ONLY after verifying and ensuring that the photograph, signature uploaded and other details filled by you are correct.
  • Click on 'Payment' Tab and proceed for payment.
  • Click on 'Submit' button.
  • The application form is integrated with the payment gateway and the payment process can be completed by following the instructions.
  • The payment can be made by using Debit Cards (RuPay/Visa/MasterCard/Maestro), Credit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards/ Mobile Wallets.
  • After submitting your payment information in the online application form, PLEASE WAIT FOR THE INTIMATION FROM THE SERVER. DO NOT PRESS BACK OR REFRESH BUTTON IN ORDER TO AVOID DOUBLE CHARGE.
  • On successful completion of the transaction, an e-Receipt will be generated.
  • Non-generation of 'E-Receipt' indicates PAYMENT FAILURE. On failure of payment, Candidates are advised to login again using their Provisional Registration Number and Password and repeat the process of payment.
  • Candidates are required to take a printout of the e-Receipt and online Application Form containing fee details. Please note that if the same cannot be generated, online transaction may not have been successful.
  • For Credit Card users: All charges are listed in Indian Rupee. If you use a non-Indian credit card, your bank will convert to your local currency based on prevailing exchange rates.
  • To ensure the security of your data, please close the browser window once your transaction is completed.
  • There is facility to print application form containing fee details after payment of fees.
  • While filling in the Online Application Form the candidate will be provided with separate links for uploading Photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration.
  • Click on the respective link “Upload Photograph / signature / Upload left thumb impression / handwritten declaration/ other relevant documents”.
  • Browse and select the location where the Scanned Photograph / signature / left thumb impression / handwritten declaration/ other relevant document’s file has been saved.
  • Select the file by clicking on it
  • Click the ‘Open/Upload’
  • If the file size and format are not as prescribed, an error message will be displayed.
  • Preview of the uploaded image will help to see the quality of the image. In case of unclear / smudged, the same may be re-uploaded to the expected clarity /quality.

Eligibility Criteria for Special Assam TET 2026

Basic Eligibility Requirements

A. Residency: Candidates must be permanent residents of Assam.

B. Academic and Professional Qualifications: Candidates must meet NCTE-prescribed minimum qualifications.

Minimum Qualification for Lower Primary TET (Classes I to V)

Candidates must have any one of the following qualifications:

  1. Senior Secondary (or equivalent) with at least 50% marks + 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education
  2. Senior Secondary (or equivalent) with at least 50% marks + 4-year Bachelor of Elementary Education (B.El.Ed.)
  3. Senior Secondary (or equivalent) with at least 50% marks + 2-year Diploma in Education (Special Education)
  4. Graduation + 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education

Minimum Qualification for Upper Primary TET (Classes VI to VIII)

Candidates must have any one of the following qualifications:

  1. Graduation + 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education
  2. At least 50% marks in Graduation + B.Ed.
  3. At least 55% marks in Post Graduation (or equivalent grade) + 3-year integrated B.Ed.-M.Ed.
  4. Senior Secondary (or equivalent) with at least 50% marks + 4-year Bachelor in Elementary Education (B.El.Ed.)
  5. Senior Secondary (or equivalent) with at least 50% marks + 4-year B.A./B.Sc. Ed. or B.A. Ed./B.Sc. Ed.
  6. Graduation with at least 50% marks + 1-year B.Ed. (Special Education)

Important Note: Minimum percentage requirements in graduation do not apply to candidates who took admission to B.Ed. or B.El.Ed. or equivalent courses before July 29, 2011.

Relaxation in Eligibility

  • 5% relaxation in academic marks (HSSLC or Graduation) for SC/ST/OBC/MOBC/PWD(PH) candidates
  • PWD candidates must have a minimum 40% degree of handicap certified by competent authority

Validity of Certificate

The Special Assam TET 2026 certificate will remain valid for lifetime from the date of issue by the Empowered Committee, TET, Government of Assam (unless otherwise notified by the appropriate government).

Important Points to Remember

  1. No Automatic Appointment: Qualifying the Special Assam TET 2026 does not confer automatic right to appointment. Teacher recruitment in government/provincialized schools is a separate process conducted when vacancies arise.
  2. Document Verification: No document verification during examination. However, documents will be thoroughly verified during the teacher engagement process. False information can lead to criminal liability.
  3. State-Specific Validity: Qualified candidates can participate in teacher recruitment processes only in Assam.
  4. TET as Qualifying Criteria: TET is one of the qualifying criteria for teacher recruitment. Candidates must also meet other academic and professional qualifications as per NCTE norms.
  5. Both Papers: Candidates intending to appear in both Paper I and Paper II must submit separate applications and pay fees for each paper separately.
  6. Regular Updates: Candidates should regularly visit the official websites for updates on application dates, admit cards, and examination schedules.

Selection Process

Phases of Recruitment Tests:

  • Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and Medical Examination followed by Physical Standard Test (PST)
  • Written Test
  • Oral/Viva Voce

Physical Efficiency Test (PET) - 40 Marks:

For Male Candidates:

  • Race (20 marks): 1600 meters race to be completed within 450 seconds (7.5 minutes)
    • Maximum 20 marks for time 300 seconds or less
    • Minimum qualifying time: 450 seconds
    • Marks decrease progressively based on time taken
    • Conducted under CCTV surveillance using RFID chips
  • Long Jump (20 marks): Minimum 335 cm required
    • 3 chances given; longest valid jump considered
    • Minimum qualifying jump: 335 cm (10 marks)
    • Maximum 20 marks for jump of 500 cm or more
    • Conducted under CCTV surveillance

For Female Candidates:

  • Race (20 marks): 800 meters race to be completed within 240 seconds (4 minutes)
    • Maximum 20 marks for time 160 seconds or less
    • Minimum qualifying time: 240 seconds
    • Marks decrease progressively based on time taken
    • Conducted under CCTV surveillance using RFID chips
  • Long Jump (20 marks): Minimum 244 cm required
    • 3 chances given; longest valid jump considered
    • Minimum qualifying jump: 244 cm (10 marks)
    • Maximum 20 marks for jump of 389 cm or more
    • Conducted under CCTV surveillance

Medical Examination:

  • Conducted after qualifying in PET
  • Examination by Medical & Health Officer as per medical standards

Physical Standard Test (PST) - Qualifying (No Marks):

  • Conducted after qualifying in Medical Examination
  • Parameters checked as per physical standards mentioned

Written Test - 50 Marks:

  • Shortlisting: 5 times the number of posts in order of merit based on PET marks
  • 100 multiple choice questions on OMR sheet
  • Each correct answer carries 0.5 marks (Total 50 marks)
  • No negative marking
  • Questions of Class IX and X level
  • Subjects: Elementary Arithmetic, General English, Logical reasoning/Mental ability, Assam's History, Geography, Polity, Economy, General Awareness/GK and current affairs
  • Question paper available in Assamese/Bodo/Bengali/English languages
  • Date and venue to be notified in due course

Oral/Viva Voce - 5 Marks:

  • Shortlisting: 2 times number of vacancies based on total marks in PET & Written Test
  • Candidates scoring same marks as last selected candidate will also be called

NCC Weightage - Maximum 5 Marks:

  • NCC 'C' Certificate: 5 marks
  • NCC 'B' Certificate: 3 marks
  • NCC 'A' Certificate: 2 marks

Final Merit Calculation - Total 100 Marks:

  • Physical Efficiency Test (PET): 40 marks
  • Written Test: 50 marks
  • NCC Weightage: 5 marks
  • Oral/Viva Voce: 5 marks
  • Total: 100 marks

Tie-Breaking:

  • In case of tie in marks, older candidate placed higher in merit list
  • If same date of birth with equal marks, candidate with higher height placed higher

  • Domestic Data Entry Operator (Skill Certificate Holders): Minimum 12th Pass (but below Graduate). Additionally, candidates should possess Skill Certificate of Domestic Data Entry Operator for training of less than one year issued by an awarding body recognized under National Skill Qualifications Framework or any other authority recognized by the Central Government.

Essential Qualifications

  • Candidate should have already passed the prescribed qualification on the date of reckoning eligibility criteria which is 31/01/2026.
  • Candidates whose result of the qualifying examination is awaited on the date of reckoning eligibility criteria are not eligible to apply.
  • The prescribed qualification for Graduate/Diploma holders shall be from a recognized University/Institute as a regular full-time course in the relevant trade/discipline with a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate (45% for SC/ST and PwBD category candidates for the posts reserved for them).
  • Candidates holding a qualification acquired through part-time/correspondence/distance education mode are not eligible.
  • Candidates possessing higher professional qualifications such as BE/B.Tech., MBA, CA, LLB, MCA, or any such equivalent qualification or pursuing higher qualification and having completed the same on or before joining apprenticeship training, shall not be eligible.
  • Wherever CGPA/OGPA or Letter Grade is awarded in the ITI/Degree/Diploma examinations, its equivalent aggregate percentage of marks must be indicated by the candidates in the Online Application as per the norms adopted by Board/University/Institute.

Experience

  • Candidates having job experience for a period of one year or more after the attainment of the qualification shall not be eligible to be engaged as Apprentice.
  • Candidates who have completed five years after acquiring the prescribed qualification as on date of reckoning eligibility criteria shall also not be eligible for engagement as Apprentices.
  • A Candidate may undergo maximum two apprenticeship training and the second training shall not be in the same trade. There shall be minimum one year gap between two apprenticeship training, provided that the previous training is completed.

Salary/Stipend

  • Rate of stipend payable to apprentices per month shall be as prescribed under Apprentices Act, 1961/1973.
  • The stipend will be in accordance with The Apprenticeship Rules, 1992 read with The Apprenticeship (Amendment) Rules, 2019 & 2025 as amended from time to time and Corporation's guidelines.
  • During the period of Apprenticeship, apart from monthly stipend as prescribed above, no other monetary or non-monetary benefit/facility such as accommodation, HRA, conveyance, medical facility etc. shall be admissible to apprentices.
  • Candidates have to make their own arrangement for accommodation, conveyance, medical etc.
  • Duration of Apprenticeship Training: 12 months from the date of engagement.

Age Limit (as on 31/01/2026)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 24 years
  • Age Relaxation for SC/ST: Relaxation in upper age up to 5 years to SC/ST candidates considered against reserved positions will be allowed.
  • Age Relaxation for OBC (NCL): Relaxation in upper age up to 3 years to OBC (NCL) candidates considered against reserved positions will be allowed.
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD: Relaxation in upper age up to 10 years for PwBD candidates will be allowed irrespective of reservation of posts to them.
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD-SC/ST: Further, upper age relaxation of 5 years to PwBD candidates belonging to SC/ST category will be allowed.
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD-OBC(NCL): Upper age relaxation of 3 years to PwBD-OBC(NCL) candidates will be allowed.

Application Fee

  • No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 23/01/2026
Date of Opening of Online Application 28/01/2026
Last Date of Submission of Online Application 10/02/2026, 11:59 PM (IST)
Cut-off Date for Age, Qualification etc. 31/01/2026

Selection Process

  • Candidates registered in the NAPS/NATS Portal and applying against the notification shall be considered for selection.
  • Panel cum Merit List of all the candidates, who have applied against a respective post in the portal and meeting the notified eligibility criteria, shall be prepared based on the percentage of marks in descending order obtained in the essential qualification applicable to the trade applied for.
  • Aggregate of marks of all subjects of all years/semesters will be considered for eligibility.
  • In case of a similar rank in merit based on the percentage of marks obtained in the essential qualifying examination, a candidate with an earlier date of birth (older in age) shall be considered. In case of same date of birth, candidates having a higher percentage of marks in Matriculation shall be considered.
  • There shall be No Written Test or Personal Interview.
  • In case a reserved seat remains unfilled, the same shall be reallocated in the following order of priority: first to SC, then to ST, thereafter to OBC, followed by EWS, and finally to UR.
  • Verification of the original documents shall be done before joining of the candidate as an Apprentice.
  • Engagement of selected candidates is subject to their being declared medically fit as per the requirement of the Corporation.

General Information/Instructions

  • Reservation of seats to SC/ST/OBC (Non Creamy Layer-NCL)/PwBD/Economically Weaker Section (EWS) candidates shall be as per the applicable Government guidelines.
  • The minimum prescribed qualification marks will be relaxed by 5% for candidates belonging to SC/ST/PwBD categories considered against reserved positions.
  • In case of candidates belonging to OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) category, name of OBC caste mentioned in the certificate should fall in the Central List of OBCs of the respective State and Non-Creamy Layer status should be valid as on cut-off date of reckoning eligibility criteria.
  • Candidates are advised to ensure that they are Medically Fit as per IndianOil's pre-engagement medical standard.
  • The trades are suitable for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) as per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, with minimum 40% disability.
  • Candidates can apply for one Trade Code ONLY. Candidates applying for more than one Trade Code will not be considered for any post and their applications will be summarily rejected.
  • Only one mobile number and one email ID can be used for applying for the post. The same mobile number and email ID cannot be used by any other candidate for filling online application for this notification.
  • Candidates, who are pursuing higher qualification on the date of final submission of online application but have acquired/completed the same subsequently at the time of document verification, shall also not be eligible for engagement and shall not be allowed to Join.
  • Suppression of information regarding possession or pursuing higher qualification shall render a candidate ineligible for consideration at any stage of selection & termination any time during engagement, if engaged.
  • The terms and conditions of engagement of the apprentices shall be governed by The Apprentices Act, 1961 and Rules 1992 as amended from time to time.
  • Upon completion of the apprenticeship period, the Corporation shall have NO obligation to offer employment to such Apprentices NOR can an Apprentice claim the right for employment on the grounds of completion of Apprenticeship.
  • Candidates are advised to maintain the same registered e-mail ID and mobile number till the completion of apprenticeship training.
  • Candidates are advised to periodically visit the official website https://www.iocl.com/apprenticeships as all future correspondence and latest information shall be shared only on the website.

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Candidates willing to apply must register as a Technician/Trade/Graduate Apprentice online in the following portals under the respective State as per their Trades:
    • Trade Apprentice: Data Entry Operator (Fresher Apprentices)/Domestic Data Entry Operator (Skill Certificate Holders) at https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in
    • Technician Apprentice: (Mechanical/Electrical/Telecommunication & Instrumentation) at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php
    • Trade Apprentice (Assistant-Human Resource/Accountant) at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php
  • Step 2: Candidates meeting the prescribed eligibility criteria may LOGIN to the respective NATS/NAPS Portal using their User ID/Email ID and APPLY for the apprenticeship Openings/Opportunities with the Establishment ID of Indian Oil Corporation Limited mentioned below:
    • Eastern Region Pipelines (ERPL) - NATS: EWBKOC000079, NAPS: E11181900005
    • Western Region Pipelines (WRPL) - NATS: WGJRAC000006, NAPS: E11182400087
    • Northern Region Pipelines (NRPL) - NATS: NHRPPC000001, NAPS: E12180600006
    • Southern Region Pipelines (SRPL) - NATS: STNCHC000040, NAPS: E12183300008
    • South Eastern Region Pipelines (SERPL) - NATS: EORBBSC000001, NAPS: E02252100002
  • Step 3: Candidates must complete the application for Openings/Opportunities in respective NATS/NAPS Portal from 28/01/2026 to 10/02/2026. Before applying against an opportunity, the candidate MUST ensure that their profile (Personal details, Educational details, Category etc.) along with aggregate percentage are appearing correctly in their application.
  • Step 4: After applying against an opportunity in the respective NAPS/NATS Portal, the candidate must complete their registration/application for apprentice positions in Indian Oil Pipelines portal at https://plapps.indianoilpipelines.in/
  • Step 5: The candidate must use the same e-mail ID and Mobile Number used in respective NAPS/NATS Portal which must be valid for the entire apprenticeship period.
  • Step 6: There are two steps for Registration process (Part-I & Part-II) in Indian Oil Pipelines portal:
    • Part-I Registration: Candidate must fill their basic details like name, category etc. and must create their own password. After successful Part-I registration, system generated registration number is sent to their registered email id/SMS.
    • Part-II Registration: Candidates must upload their scanned photograph (Size: between 20-50 KB in JPG Format) and signature in black ink (Size: between 10-30 KB in JPG Format) and furnish educational qualification, experience details etc. and submit the same. This is the final submission process and after that candidates cannot change the details furnished.
  • Step 7: Candidates must complete the application process in Indian Oil Pipelines portal at https://plapps.indianoilpipelines.in/ from 28/01/2026 to 10/02/2026.
  • Step 8: The candidate must mention the registration/enrolment number of NAPS/NATS Portal while applying for apprentice positions in Indian Oil Pipelines Portal.
  • Step 9: After successfully applying/registration of Online Application in Indian Oil Pipelines Portal, the candidate must take a printout of the filled-in online application for future reference.
  • Important: No other means/mode of application shall be accepted other than what is mentioned above. Candidates to ensure that they have successfully applied for the relevant opportunity through respective NAPS/NATS Portal BEFORE applying/registration in Indian Oil Pipelines Portal.
  • Applications/Registration which are incomplete or are received in any other mode/form or not fulfilling the eligibility criteria and/or those received after the last date of submission of application shall not be considered "Eligible" and treated as "Rejected".

  • Maximum Age: 45 years

Selection Process for HPRCA English & Mathematics Teacher 2026

Candidates will be selected based on the following process:

  • Computer Based Test (CBT) / Written Objective Screening Test of 120 marks of 1½ hours duration or as decided by HPRCA.

  • Syllabus:
    • Subject/field up to the level of prescribed essential qualifications.
    • General Knowledge including Himachal Pradesh, Current Affairs, Everyday Science, Logical Reasoning, Social Science, General English & General Hindi (Matric level).

Tech or PhD level or certifications in anyone of CEH (Certified Ethical Hacker)/ Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP) / CISSP/ Comp TIA CySA + / GSEC/ OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional)/ CISM. Possess and maintain broad technical and business knowledge of all aspects of IT Infrastructure security and management technologies including end-point security, mobility management, client operating systems, Sandboxing, Firewall, DLP, VDI, WAF, PAM, Active Directory, Application whitelisting, File Integrity Monitoring, Network Access Control, CDR, Infrastructure and endpoint security solutions including Anti-malware, EDR, MDM, Network Access Control, Proxy etc. 2. Should have experience on handling of security threats/threat Intelligence tools and framework/threat attack methods/cyber forensics. 4. Should have experience on VAPT tools (Burp Suite/ Metasploit/ (Ryby)/ Accunetix/ Open VAS/ Nessus/ ZAP/ CommandoV, Wireshark, NMAP) 5. Knowledge on monitoring and managing Threat Intelligence Platform, consume and manage threat feeds, detecting Cyber threats and alerting and work on cyber threats, indicators of compromise (IoCs), and MITRE, kill chain methodologies. 6. Knowledge of conducting digital forensic analysis using Forensic and Log analysis Tools (Commercial and Open-source tools) such as EnCase, Forensic Toolkits (FTK), ELK, The Sleuth Kit (TSK) etc.

Branch/ Cadre Vacancy Gender
Executive Branch (GS(X)/ Hydro Cadre) 76 (including 06 Hydro) Men and Women (maximum of 10 vacancies in GS (X) and 01 vacancy in Hydro for women)
Pilot 25 Men and Women (maximum of 03 vacancies for women)

Logistics 10 Men and Women (maximum of 01 vacancies for women)

Submarine Tech Electrical 08 Only for Men

Eligibility Criteria

  • Executive Branch (GS(X)/ Hydro Cadre): BE/ B.Tech in any discipline with minimum 60% marks.
  • Pilot: BE/ B.Tech in any discipline with minimum 60% marks. (Candidate must have 60% aggregate marks in class X and XII and minimum 60% marks in English in class X or class XII).
  • Naval Air Operations Officer (Observers): BE/ B.Tech in any discipline with minimum 60% marks. (Candidate must have 60% aggregate marks in class X and XII and minimum 60% marks in English in class X or class XII).
  • Air Traffic Controller (ATC): BE/ B.Tech in any discipline with minimum 60% marks. (Candidate must have 60% aggregate marks in class X and XII and minimum 60% marks in English in class X or class XII).
  • Logistics: BE/ B.Tech in any discipline with First Class or MBA with First Class, or B.Sc/ B.Com/ B.Sc.(H) with First class along with PG Diploma in Finance / Logistics / Supply Chain Management / Material Management or MCA/ M.Sc.(H) with First Class.
  • Education: MSc/MA with minimum 60% marks in Maths/ Operational Research (with Physics in BSc) or MSc/MA with minimum 60% marks in Physics/ Applied Physics (with Maths in BSc)/ Meteorology/ Oceanography/ Atmospheric Sciences (with Physics and Maths in BSc) or BE/ B.Tech with minimum 60% marks in Mechanical/ Production Engineering or BE/ B.Tech/ M.Tech with minimum 60% marks in Computer Science Engineering/ MCA (with either Physics or Mathematics in graduation level) or BE/ B.Tech with minimum 60% marks in Electrical/ Electronics and Communication/ Electronics and Instrumentation or ME/ M.Tech with minimum 60% marks in Electronics & Communication/ Controls/ Radar and Microwave/ Optical Fibre Communication/ Digital Signal Processing/ Wireless Communication/ Laser and Electro Optics/ VLSI/ Power Systems/ Communications Systems/ Electronics & Instrumentation or ME/ M.Tech with minimum 60% marks in Thermal/ Production Engineering/ Machine Design/ System and Controls/ Manufacturing/ Mechatronics/ Meteorology/ Oceanography/ Atmospheric Sciences (with Physics and Maths at graduation level). Candidates applying for the Education entry must have scored minimum of 60% marks in class X or class XII.
  • Engineering Branch (General Service (GS)): BE/ B.Tech with minimum 60% marks in the following streams :- Marine Engineering, Aero Space Engineering, Metallurgy Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, Automobiles Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering.
  • Submarine Tech Engineering: BE/ B.Tech with minimum 60% marks in the following streams :- Production Engineering, Control Engineering, Aeronautical Engineering, Industrial Engineering & Management, Instrumentation & Control, Mechanical/Mechanical with Automation.
  • Electrical Branch (General Service (GS)): BE/ B.Tech with minimum 60% marks in the following streams :- Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, Power Electronics, Electronics Engineering, Tele Communication, Power Engineering.
  • Submarine Tech Electrical: BE/ B.Tech with minimum 60% marks in the following streams :- Electrical & Electronics, Electronics & Tele Communication, Applied Electronics and Communication (AEC).

Salary/Stipend

  • The initial gross salary of Sub Lieutenant starts from Rs 1,25,000/- (approximately) per month alongwith other allowances as applicable.
  • Pilot/ NAOO allowance of Rs 31,250/- will be admissible to candidates post successful completion of training.
  • Submarine allowance of Rs 31,250/- will be admissible to candidates post successful completion of training.
  • Submarine allowance will be admissible to candidates post successful completion of submarine training in accordance with extant rules.

Age Limit (as on 01-01-2027)

  • Executive Branch (GS(X)/ Hydro Cadre): Born Between 02 Jan 2002 to 01 Jul 2007
  • Pilot: Born Between 02 Jan 2003 to 01 Jan 2008
  • Naval Air Operations Officer (Observers): Born Between 02 Jan 2003 to 01 Jan 2008
  • Air Traffic Controller (ATC): Born Between 02 Jan 2002 to 01 Jan 2006
  • Logistics: Born Between 02 Jan 2002 to 01 Jun 2007
  • Education: Born Between 02 Jan 2002 to 01 Jan 2006
  • Engineering Branch (General Service (GS)): Born Between 02 Jan 2002 to 01 Jul 2007
  • Electrical Branch (General Service (GS)): Born Between 02 Jan 2002 to 01 Jul 2007

Important Dates

Event Date
Apply Online from 24 Jan 2026
Last date for Online Application 24 Feb 2026
Course commencing Jan 2027
Inform final result to Indian Navy prior 20 Dec 2026

Selection Process

  • Shortlisting of application will be based on normalised marks obtained by the candidates in the qualifying degree. Marks obtained by the candidates in the qualifying degree will be normalised using formulae mentioned in Join Indian Navy website (URL: - https://www.joinindiannavy.gov.in/files/normalisation.pdf)
  • BE/ B.Tech. For candidates who have completed or are in final year of BE/ B.Tech, marks obtained upto fifth semester will be considered for SSB shortlisting.
  • Post-Graduate Degree Programme. For candidates who have completed MSc, MCA, MBA, M.Tech, marks obtained in all semesters will be considered. For candidates who are in final year, shortlisting will be based on pre-final year performance.
  • Candidates selected in the final merit list will be required to submit the proof of completing the qualifying degree with minimum 60% marks by sending an email at the address [email protected]. Candidates failing to meet the criteria will not be permitted to join the Academy.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be informed about their selection for SSB interview through e-mail or SMS (provided by candidates in their application form). Candidates are advised not to change their e-mail/ mobile number till selection process is over and check their inbox and spam folder periodically.
  • Change of SSB Centre for interview is not permissible under any circumstances.
  • Any correspondence regarding change of SSB dates be addressed to the call up officer of the concerned SSB on receipt of call up letter. Candidates are to download the call up letter on receiving intimation from Naval Headquarters through SMS/ email (provided by candidates in their application).
  • No compensation is admissible in case of any injury sustained as a result of tests during SSB interviews.
  • AC 3 tier rail fare is admissible for the SSB interview, if appearing for the first time for particular type of commission. Candidates are required to bring photocopy of the first page of pass book or cheque leaf where the name, A/C No. & IFSC details are mentioned, while appearing for SSB.
  • Details of SSB procedure are available on Indian Navy website www.joinindiannavy.gov.in
  • Merit list will be prepared based on SSB marks for all entries as per availability of vacancies and medical clearance for respective entry. Candidates declared fit in medical examination would be appointed as per availability of vacancies in the entry.

General Information/Instructions

  • Vacancies mentioned in para 2 are tentative and may be changed depending on availability of training slots.
  • Only one application can be filled by a candidate. In case of multiple applications, candidature will be cancelled.
  • Male Candidates shortlisted for GS(X) are also eligible to volunteer for submarine arm subject to medical fitness, vacancies and service requirements. Candidates exercising option for this branch will have to additionally indicate option for submarine specialisation while filling the online application form.
  • Eventual selection/ nomination to undergo submarine specialisation will be subject to clearing submarine medicals (after joining INA) and service requirements.
  • Submarine allowance will be admissible to candidates post successful completion of submarine training in accordance with extant rules.
  • Candidates selected under GS(X) may be nominated to undergo specialisation in RPA (after completion of training at INA), subject to medical fitness and service requirements.
  • Candidates having Government of India, Ministry of Shipping & Transport Certificate of Competency (Foreign going) either as a Second Mate, Mate or Master and born between 02 Jan 1997 to 01 Jul 2007 (both dates inclusive) can apply for Executive Branch entry (General Service) as per stipulations stated at Para 2(1).
  • Candidates having Government of India, Ministry of Shipping & Transport Certificate of Competency as 1st class Engineer and born between 02 Jan 1997 to 01 Jul 2007 (both dates inclusive) can apply for Technical Branch entry (SSC Engineering) as per stipulations stated at Para 2(7) and 2(8).
  • Candidates having valid CPL issued by DGCA (India) and born between 02 Jan 2002 to 01 Jan 2008 (both dates inclusive) can apply for Pilot entry as per eligibility criteria stated at Para 2(2).
  • NCC 'C' certificate holders will be given relaxation of 5% in cut off marks towards shortlisting for SSB subject to meeting following criteria: Having NCC 'C' certificate of Naval/Army/Air Wing with minimum 'B' Grade. Not served less than two academic years in the Senior Division, Naval/Army/Air Wing of the NCC. 'C' certificate should not be dated prior to 01 Jan 2024.
  • The final selection will be subject to verification of the certificate by DG(NCC) concerned NCC unit for its validity. Candidature of individual will be cancelled at any stage of selection/ training/ post-commissioning, in case of false declaration, misinformation or concealing of information.
  • The candidate will be required to fulfil the educational qualification stipulated above before joining INA, Ezhimala by Jan 2027.
  • The candidate failing to meet stipulated educational criteria will not be permitted to join INA, Ezhimala.
  • All SSB recommended candidates would be required to inform their final result of respective degree to Indian Navy at the email ID [email protected] prior 20 Dec 2026.
  • Specified number of candidates based on service requirement, who have chosen SSC (Pilot) entry will be considered for SSB/ CPSS/ Aviation Medical Examination and are advised to check physical/ medical standards (Height, leg length etc) for this entry prior selecting this option. Remaining candidates will be considered for other preferences opted by them.
  • Candidates must indicate their preference for other branches/ cadres also, if they wish to be considered for those branches/ cadres.
  • Candidates will not be considered for branches/ cadres that they have not selected.
  • Candidates are advised to ascertain their eligibility for branches/ cadres, with respect to applicable medical standards, prior to indicating their preference.
  • No equivalent stream of BE/ B.Tech qualifications other than those mentioned in para 2(5), 2(6), 2(7), 2(8), 2(9) and 2(10) above, will be considered valid for selection process at any stage.
  • Candidates will be denied to appear SSB if any backlog in any subject is pending at the time of document verification at SSB centers.
  • Medical standards/ Relaxation in Height and Weight/ Tattoo. Please visit website www.joinindiannavy.gov.in for information. SSB recommended candidates are required to undergo medical examination as applicable to their entry. Change of medical hospital/ centre is not permissible under any circumstances.
  • Selected candidates will be granted Short Service Commission initially for 12 years extendable by maximum 02 years, subject to service requirement, performance, medical eligibility and willingness of candidates
  • Candidates will be inducted in the rank of Sub Lieutenant subject to clearing of induction medical examination at INA, Ezhimala post reporting.
  • Only unmarried candidates are eligible for training. Any candidate who is found to be married or marries while under training will be discharged from service and shall be liable to refund full pay and allowances drawn by him/ her and other expenditure incurred on the candidate by the Government.
  • If the officer voluntarily withdraws from initial training or resigns during the probationary period, he/ she shall be required to refund the cost of training in whole or in part, as may be determined by Govt and all money received by him/ her as pay and allowances from the Govt together with the interest on the said money calculated at the rate in force for Govt loans.
  • Probation period for all branches/cadres is two years. The probation period will commence from the date of grant of the rank of Sub Lieutenant and will terminate after two years or on completion of initial training (whichever is later). During probation the officers are liable to be discharged in case of unsatisfactory performance at any stage.
  • All officers/ cadets would be compulsorily members of the Naval Group Insurance Scheme (NGIS) as received and approved for insurance cover on contribution basis. The cover would be applicable whilst in service and post retirement as per extant regulations.
  • Mere inclusion of candidates in the Select List/Merit list does not confer upon them a vested right to appointment.
  • Candidates may also note that mere empanelment is under no circumstances be treated as final selection and is not an enforceable claim to the post applied for.
  • All vacancies are to be filled as per service requirement and as per statutory guidelines issued in this regard from time to time.
  • Please read the instructions given on the website carefully before finally submitting your online application.
  • Your candidature will be cancelled if any declaration is found wrong at any stage of selection.
  • Use/ possession of narcotics is banned. Candidate may be tested for presence of drugs in the body during SSB selection/ medical/ training and subsequently during service. If candidate is found to be using/ in-possession of narcotics during any time of selection/ medical/ training/ service, candidate would be debarred from joining the Indian Navy or be removed from service if already joined.
  • Your application is subject to subsequent scrutiny and the application can be rejected, if found INELIGIBLE/ INVALID at any point of time.

How to Apply

  • Candidates are to register and fill application on Indian Navy website www.joinindiannavy.gov.in. To save time during the application submission window, candidates can fill in their details and upload documents in advance.
  • Whilst filling up the e-application, it is advisable to keep the relevant documents readily available to enable the following: Correct filling up of personal particulars. Details are to be filled up as given in the Matriculation Certificate. Fields such as e-mail address, mobile number are mandatory fields and need to be filled.
  • All relevant documents (preferably in original), marks sheets upto 5th & 7th semester for regular and integrated BE/ B.Tech courses respectively and all semesters for other degree examination, date of birth proof (as per 10th & 12th certificate), CGPA conversion formula for BE/ B.Tech, Merchant Navy certificate issued by Government of India, Ministry of Shipping and Transport, NCC 'C' certificate issued by National Cadet Corps and a recent passport size colour photograph should be scanned in original JPG/TIFF format, for attaching the same while filling up the application.
  • If any scanned document is not legible/readable for any reason, the application will be rejected. Candidates are to take print out of application and carry it while appearing for SSB interview.
  • The application once submitted will be final and no request for amendments/change will be entertained.

  • Candidates currently undergoing Apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act, 1961 in any Govt./Public Sector/Private industrial establishment are NOT eligible.
  • Candidates who have already undergone Apprenticeship Training in IREL or any other organization are not eligible.

3. Age Limit

  • Minimum age: 18 years as on the last date of application.
  • Maximum age: 25 years as on the last date of application.
  • Age relaxation: SC/ST up to 5 years; OBC (NCL) up to 3 years; PWBD up to 10 years.

Age Limit

  • As on the last date of application, the candidate should be between 18 and 25 years of age.
  • Relaxation in upper age limit is applicable as per Government guidelines: SC/ST – 5 years; OBC (NCL) – 3 years; PWBD – 10 years.
  • Proof of age must be supported by Matriculation/10th certificate or Birth Certificate.

Selection Process

  • Selection is based on merit list prepared from marks scored in the specified educational qualification, subject to being found “Medically Fit” by the company’s authorised Doctor.
  • In case of tie, higher marks in the qualifying exam will be considered; if still equal, elder candidate (earlier date of birth) will be given preference.
  • Priority order for selection at Rare Earths Division:
    • Candidates belonging to Land Affected Category (if applicable, with documentary proof).
    • Candidates from peripheral villages within 10 km radius of RED and wards of serving/deceased employees of IREL.
    • Candidates from Ernakulam District.
    • Candidates from Kerala State.
    • Others.
  • Merit list candidates will be called for document verification; originals and self-attested photocopies of all required documents must be produced.
  • Shortlisted candidates must undergo medical examination and be declared “Medically Fit” before engagement.
  • Entry to RED, a highly protected area, requires submission of Police Verification Certificate from the concerned Police authorities prior to joining.
  • Final selection and department allocation within the unit are at the discretion of management; there is no obligation to offer regular employment during or after apprenticeship.

Application Fee

The advertisement does not specify any application fee for engagement of apprentices at IREL Rare Earths Division.

How To Apply

  1. Portal Registration:
    • Technician and Graduate Apprentices: Enroll in National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS 2.0) portal of BOAT(SR) at https://nats.education.gov.in (if not already enrolled).
    • Trade Apprentices: Register in the apprenticeship portal of Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship at https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in (if not already registered).
  2. Apply through Establishment Registration Numbers:
    • Trade Apprentices: Apply against Establishment Registration No. E11153200006.
    • Technician & Graduate Apprentices: Apply against Establishment Registration No. SKLERC000015.
  3. Download & Fill Application (Annexure-A): Fill the application in the prescribed proforma (preferably on A4 size paper) as given in the advertisement.
  4. Prepare Scanned Documents: Scan and self-attest photocopies of:
    • 10th Pass/Matriculation Certificate or Birth Certificate (proof of date of birth).
    • 10th Mark Sheet.
    • SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS/Disability certificates (as applicable) in prescribed format.
    • Declaration form for OBC-NCL, if applicable.
    • All semester/year-wise mark sheets and final certificate of ITI/Diploma/Degree, as applicable to the apprentice category.
    • Nativity Certificate.
    • Aadhaar Card.
    • Proof of enrollment/registration in the respective apprenticeship portal (NATS/NAPS).
  5. Email Submission: Send the scanned copy of duly filled application form affixed with passport size photograph along with all supporting documents to [email protected].
  6. Subject Line: Mention in email subject: “APPLICATION FOR ENGAGEMENT OF APPRENTICES AGAINST NOTIFICATION NO. IREL/RED/HRM/Apprentices Engagement/2026-27/01”.
  7. Ensure that the email with complete scanned application and documents reaches on or before 15/03/2026; applications after this date will not be considered.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 23/01/2026
Last Date for Online Application in NATS/NAPS & Email Submission 15/03/2026
Duration of Apprenticeship 1 year for all trades

Instructions

  • Applications without registration in the respective apprenticeship portal will not be accepted.
  • Applications which are incomplete or not fulfilling the eligibility criteria will be treated as “Rejected”.
  • Service terms and conditions will be governed by the Apprentices Act, 1961 and Apprenticeship Rules, 1992 as amended.
  • IREL has no obligation to offer regular employment during or after completion of apprenticeship; apprentices will be relieved after successful completion.
  • Any corrigendum/addendum or updates will be available only on www.irel.co.in; candidates should check the website regularly.
  • Candidature is provisional and subject to verification of certificates. If at any stage it is found that eligibility norms are not fulfilled or information is false/incorrect/suppressed, candidature/engagement will be cancelled/terminated.
  • Management’s decision regarding eligibility, selection, acceptance/rejection of applications, mode of selection and filling of seats will be final and binding; no correspondence will be entertained.

Salary/Stipend

  • Stipend shall be paid at the rates prescribed under the Apprenticeship Rules, 1992 and Government notifications from time to time for respective categories of Apprentices.
  • In addition to stipend, apprentices will be entitled to a food coupon valued at ₹1,500 per month.
  • No other benefits or financial assistance will be provided during the training period.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Specialisation in at least one technical field such as finance, agri-business, food processing, rural development, food technology, data analytics, agri & allied sector, civil engineering, business administration, etc.

  • Executed minimum 5 consultancy assignments over the last three years in relevant thematic areas as specified in the notification.

2. Associate Consultant

  • First Class Graduate and/or Post-Graduation with 55% at aggregate from a recognized University.
  • Specialisation in at least one technical field such as finance, agri-business, food processing, rural development, food technology, data analytics, agri & allied sector, civil engineering, business administration, etc.

  • Minimum 3 years of work experience in consultancy organisation / Financial Institution / developmental agency.

  • First Class Graduate and/or Post-Graduation with 55% at aggregate from a recognized University in any subject.
  • 3 years of experience in HR / Admin / Finance / Accounting / business development function with minimum 2 years’ experience in a reputed organisation operating in the area of Agriculture and rural development.
  • Preference for work experience in handling ERP software.
  • Proficiency in MS Office and other productivity and communication tools.

4. Other Common Criteria

  • Laboratory Assistant: DMLT / Class-1 Lab Tech Course (Armed Forces) with minimum 05 years experience in Lab.
  • Laboratory Technician: B.Sc (Medical Lab Technology) OR 10+2 with Science and Diploma in Medical Lab Technology from recognized institution with minimum 03 years experience as Lab Assistant in medical Lab.

  • Maximum age for technical and support staff such as Dental Hygienist, Radiographer, Physiotherapist, Nursing Assistant, Pharmacist, Laboratory Assistant, Laboratory Technician is 56 years.
  • Maximum age for Driver, Safaiwala, Female Attendant, Chowkidar, Peon, Clerk/Data Entry Operator and similar support staff categories is 53 years.

Application Fee

  • No application fee details are mentioned in the notification.

Important Dates

Event Date
Last date for receipt of application 10 Feb 2026

Selection Process

  • Applications will be scrutinized at ECHS Cell, Station Headquarters Thiruvananthapuram based on eligibility, mandated qualifications and experience.
  • Shortlisted candidates will only be called for written test and interview.
  • Written test will be conducted prior to interview except for Peon, Chowkidar, Female Attendant and Safaiwala.
  • Eligible candidates will be informed telephonically/through e-mail regarding written test and interview schedule.
  • Appointing authority reserves the right to reject/cancel applications based on incomplete applications/certificates/mandated qualifications/experience without assigning reasons.
  • Employment will be purely contractual for 11/12 months and at the discretion of the appointing authority. Contract can be terminated by either side by giving one month notice.
  • Hiring duration of the vacancy reserved for ESM/Civilian is 12 months. Civilian selected in lieu of Ex Servicemen vacancy will be for a period of 11 months only.
  • All those candidates who have worked in Empanelled Hospitals will have a clear gap of one year between appointments.
  • Selected Officers (Officer in Charge, Medical Officer, Medical Specialists, Radiologist, Gynaecologist and Dental Officer) will undergo 10 days On Job Training (OJT); this duration will remain unpaid and is mandatory before assuming contractual appointment.

General Information/Instructions

  • Applications are invited for short listing suitable candidates for contractual hiring for 11/12 months duration on required basis for vacancies occurring in ECHS Polyclinics during 2026–27 as noted against each category.

  • Attested copies of documents to be forwarded with application include Bio-data, educational certificates (10th/12th and final exam passed certificate), experience certificates for total experience period, mark sheets, attempts certificate, registration and renewed registration certificates, compulsory rotatory internship certificate, any other certificate required for the post, copy of full Discharge book and PPO for Armed Forces candidates, latest medical fitness certificate, Aadhar Card and PAN Card.
  • Applications received by post after 10 Feb 2026 will not be considered.
  • Candidates may preferably apply for only one post/vacancy in two ECHS Polyclinic locations.
  • Candidates earlier selected in last one year but declined to join duty need not apply.
  • Employment terms and conditions are subject to change arising out of unforeseen circumstances at any stage of employment without compensation at the discretion of appointing authority.
  • Changes to the notice, if any, will be posted on the specified web site only.
  • All Ex-Servicemen/dependents applying for the posts must register their names with AWPO and the Registration Number must be quoted in the application.
  • Written exam schedule, if conducted on a prior date, will be notified to eligible candidates through SMS/e-mail; candidates must bring pen/pencil, eraser, writing board etc.

How to Apply

  • Download the application form for employment in ECHS which is attached with the notification in editable PDF format.
  • Type all data in the application form, take a printout and affix a recent passport size photograph in the space provided.
  • Fill details of post applied for, personal particulars, postal address with pincode, category, date of birth, Aadhaar number, PAN card number, AWPO Registration number, higher qualification and educational qualifications as per table in the form.
  • Provide complete details of work experience with period of employment, total experience and reason for leaving the job; attach experience certificates for consideration.
  • Ex-servicemen must provide details such as Arms/Service, unit last served, total period of service including SSC if any, previous service in Army/Central/State Govt, PPO and full discharge book details.
  • Attach attested photocopies of all required documents including educational certificates, mark sheets, attempts certificates, registration certificates, internship certificates, medical fitness certificate, Aadhar and PAN cards as specified.
  • Ensure all statements in the application form are correct and complete; sign the declaration with place, date and name of applicant.
  • Send the duly filled and signed application form along with attested copies of documents by post so as to reach Station Headquarters (ECHS), Pangode, Thirumala PO, Thiruvananthapuram - 695 006 on or before 10 Feb 2026.

Date Type Date

Selection Process

  • Selection will be based on the evaluation of qualifications carrying 40% weightage, based on gradings or percentage of marks obtained, and weightage for over and above each extra completed year of experience, subject to maximum of 30% weightage. Cochin Port Reserves the right to fix qualifying cut-off marks and limit the number of candidates for shortlisting, if deemed necessary. Candidates shortlisted or scoring above the prescribed cutoff marks at this stage will be required to make a presentation before a Board of Selectors on a topic given by them, which will carry 20% weightage. Thereafter, an interview carrying the 10% weightage will be held and selection will be based on the cumulated weightage score.
  • An evaluation committee will be constituted by the Port under the Chairmanship of an appropriately high ranked officer, for selection of the functionaries. The Committee will first shortlist the applications on the basis of the criteria decided by it. Thereafter, the Committee will hold a personal interaction/interview.

General Information/Instructions

  • Duration: The tenure of contract is for a period of 3 years from the date of joining, which may be extended by another 2 years based on the performance of the candidate/ necessity of engagement.
  • He/ She will be allowed to avail weekly day off, closed holidays, national holidays & Casual Leave as applicable to regular officers with prior permission of reporting HoD. Failure to report for duty will entail deduction of wages on pro-rata basis.
  • Working days/ hours would be on par with regular employee/ officer. This includes overstay beyond normal working hours in case of exigencies.
  • He/ She should not leave the headquarters without prior permission.
  • The Port will reserve the right to terminate the contract at any time on the ground of misconduct or otherwise, without any notice.
  • He/ She has to give 3 months advance notice prior to leaving the contract engagement. If he/ she leaves without notice, or without acceptance of notice of termination, the amount due i.e. consolidated pay payable will be forfeited.
  • The engagement is purely on contract basis and will not confer any right to claim regular appointment, etc.
  • He/ She cannot claim any right/ title/ interest at par with the regular employees of the Port on similar or any other post doing similar work or otherwise.
  • He/ She will be entitled for medical treatment in the Port hospital to the extent the facilities are available in house, for self only. No medical claims for treatment in any other hospital/facility will be entertained.
  • He/ She may be provided with residential quarters of the Port as per availability, upon mutual agreement, and on payment of user charges as applicable to regular employees/officers.
  • The contractual appointment will be subject to verification of antecedents by the Police. If any adverse report is received from the Police, his/her services are liable to be terminated.
  • He/ She will not be permitted to take any other assignment during the period of contract with the Port.
  • On official tour outside the headquarters, he/she will be the entitled to draw TA/DA as applicable.
  • The contractual appointment will be subject to the candidate being found medically fit, as per requirement of the Port.
  • He/ she will maintain absolute integrity and devotion to duty and will be liable for penal action for misconduct or causing loss to Port property attributable to him/her during the period of contractual engagement.
  • He/ She will be governed by the Official Secrets Act, 1923, as amended from time to time and will not disclose any information/data available during their engagement to any unauthorized person(s).
  • It is advised that the Employees working in Central State Government/Semi-Govt. Autonomous Bodies/CPSEs shall get approval from their competent authority to apply. They shall be required to submit No Objection Certificate, if shortlisted.
  • The crucial date for determining the qualification and age shall be 16.02.2026 (closing date of on-line registration in the OAP). Vacancy advertised can be cancelled at the discretion of Cochin Port Authority without assigning any reasons thereof. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate(s).
  • The date and schedule of interview, if any, will be intimated to the shortlisted candidates through email ID only provided in the applications by the candidates. For any enquiries, candidates may contact the office of Secretary, Cochin Port Authority (Ph.No.0484-258-2113) or email ID provided herein during office hours (0930 hrs to 1700 hrs).
  • Candidates are advised to complete their online application process well in advance to avoid any difficulties caused due to internet traffic surges towards the closing date.

How to Apply

  • Eligible and willing candidates have to submit their applications through the online application portal (OAP) in the link mentioned below, and which is published in career page of website of Cochin Port Authority (www.cochinport.gov.in), which will be opened from 16.01.2026 Link :- https://career.itiltd.in/careers_cochin_port/login_form.php?id=MTg=
  • This online application process is the only valid method. No other application modes will be accepted.
  • Online registration on the portal will close on 16.02.2026 at 17:00 hrs. Candidates are advised to regularly check the website/ OAP for any updates regarding the selection process. Candidates are advised to keep the essential documents ready by the time of start of online registration. CoPA shall not be responsible for any omission on part of the candidates to keep themselves informed of the updates provided through the website/ portal/e-mail.
  • While applying for the post, the applicant should ensure that he/she fulfills the eligibility and other norms mentioned above. In case, it is detected at any stage of recruitment that a candidate does not fulfill the eligibility norms and /or that he/she has furnished any incorrect/false information or has suppressed any material fact(s), his/her candidature will stand rejected. If any of the above shortcoming(s) is/are detected even after contract engagement, his/her services are liable to be terminated without any notice.
  • The mere fact that a candidate has submitted the application against the advertisement would not bestow upon him/her the right to be considered for the contract engagement.
  • Cochin Port reserves the right to shortlist the number of candidates for interview out of eligible candidates.

  • Fifteen years’ experience in managerial capacity dealing with Mechanical/Electrical/Marine/Electronics Engineering works.
  • Out of the above, 8 years’ experience shall be in workshops undertaking maintenance of cargo handling equipments/Electrical Installations/Ship Repairs in any Major Port Trusts/Industrial/Commercial/Government Undertaking.

  • Officers holding posts in the scale of pay of Rs. 90,000 – 2,40,000 with two years’ regular service; OR
  • Officers holding posts in the scale of pay of Rs. 80,000 – 2,20,000 with three years’ regular service in the Mechanical and Electrical Engineering Department and Marine Department (applicable to categories of Marine Engineers only) in a Major Port.

4. Eligibility for Deputation (other than Major Ports)

  • Officers holding posts of Chief Mechanical Engineer and equivalent in Mechanical and Electrical Engineering Department in the scale of pay of Rs. 1,00,000 – 2,60,000 with two years’ regular service in the grade; OR
  • Officers holding posts of Deputy Chief Mechanical Engineer and equivalent in Mechanical and Electrical Engineering Department in the scale of pay of Rs. 80,000 – 2,20,000 and above with five years’ regular service in the grade in Central Government/State Governments/Union Territory Administration/Public Sector Undertakings/Autonomous Bodies (other than Major Port Trusts).
