General Information / Instructions

  • Applicants are advised to update their one time registration before filling the application form.
  • The application form together with instructions for filling up the application forms will be available on the website of the commission from 05.01.2026.
  • Applicants are advised to go through the instructions and all the eligibility conditions prescribed for the post, before filling up the online application form.
  • Last date for filling up of online application form complete in all respects (including uploading of the requisite documents) alongwith the requisite fee (online mode only) is 04.02.2026.
  • The last date for receipt of online applications provided in the notification shall be the cut-off date for determining the eligibility as regards acquisition of educational / professional qualification or any other certificate on the basis of which any reservation is claimed, notwithstanding any extension in the last date of submission of applications.
  • The minimum and maximum age will however be reckoned with reference to 1st january, 2025.

It may be noted that no further opportunity to upload any document shall be provided after the cut off date and action under rules including rejection of application/candidature may be taken.
  • The certificate must be in the format prescribed in the rules as applicable.
  • Applicants will not be required to submit a hard copy of the online application form or any other documents to the commission at the time of filling up online application form.
  • The applicant will however be required to present/produce a downloaded copy of the online application form alongwith the original certificates at the time of document verification.
  • Applicants are advised in their own interest to submit online applications much before the closing date and not wait till the last date to avoid the possibility of disconnection/inability to pay fee or failure to login to the online application portal on account of heavy load on the website during the closing days.
  • An Applicant seeking his/her consideration under Reserved Categories must ensure that he/she possesses a valid Category certificate on the cut-off date in the format prescribed in Rules as applicable.
  • The candidature of the applicants will be provisional till the genuineness of the reserved Category certificate is verified by the Appointing Authority.
  • The Applicants may note that in case a claim for reservation is made on the basis of false/fake/fraudulent certificate, he/she shall be debarred from the examination(s) conducted by the J&K Public Service Commission, in addition to any other penal action as may be deemed appropriate.
  • Submission of multiple applications by way of prefixing Mr./Ms. or through generation of multiple User ID's or any other mode, followed by either non-payment of fee particulars or fee particulars (TID) of one application (RID) being mentioned against another application with a different RID would lead to rejection of the online application. The applicants who are submitting multiple applications should note that only the applications with higher Registration ID (RID) number shall be entertained by the Commission and fee paid against one RID shall not be adjusted against any other RID number. Besides a strict disciplinary action shall be taken including the cancellation of candidature and debarment for future examinations of J&K PSC will be taken against such applicants.
  • The application Form submitted without deposition of the fee, which gets substantiated through reflection of the same on the application form, shall be treated as incomplete and candidature of the said applicant shall be deemed to have been rejected without any notice. No representation against such rejection shall be entertained.

Candidates are advised that they should not furnish any particulars that are false or suppress any material information. A candidate who is, or has been, declared by the Commission, to be guilty of:

i. Seeking his/her candidature by any wrongful means, or

ii. impersonating, or

iii. procuring impersonation by any person, or

iv. submitting fabricated documents or documents which have been tampered with, or

v. making statements which are incorrect, or false or suppressing material information, or

vi. resorting to any other irregular or improper means in connection with his/her candidature for the selection, or

vii. using unfair means during the test, or

viii. writing irrelevant matter including obscene language or pornographic matter, in the script(s), or

ix. misbehaving in any other manner in the examination hall, or

x. harassing or doing bodily harm to the staff employed by the Commission for the conduct of their test, or any other candidate, or

xi. attempting to commit or, as the case may be, abetting the Commission of all or any of the acts specified in the foregoing clauses may, in addition to rendering himself/herself liable to criminal prosecution, shall be liable:

i. to be disqualified by the Commission from selection for which he/she is a candidate; and/or

ii. to be debarred either permanently or for a specified period:-

a) By the Commission from any examination or selection held by them;

b) By the Union Territory Government from any employment under them, and

c) if he/she is already in service under Government, disciplinary action can be taken against his/her under the appropriate rules.

How to Apply

  • a) Candidates are required to apply online through the website of the Commission i.e. http://www.jkpsc.nic.in. No other means/ mode of application shall be accepted.
  • b) Candidates are first required to go to the JKPSC website http://www.jkpsc.nic.in and click on the link "One Time Registration" or click on Login menu if they have already created their profile with the JK PSC.
  • c) After logging into their account, candidates are required to fill all the requisite fields of One Time Registration (OTR) i.e. personal information, contact information & educational qualification, service details etc.
  • d) The candidate shall also be required to upload the image of date stamped recent passport size colour photograph and signature. The photograph should not be taken earlier than 01.01.2025.
  • e) Size of the photograph (passport size) and signature must be between 10kB to 20kB in *.jpeg or *.jpg only.
  • f) After successful submission of all the details in the OTR account, check the eligibility conditions as mentioned in the advertisement notification before applying for the post.
  • g) On Clicking on the "show examination" a window will appear on the computer screen. Select the month of the advertisement notification for which candidate wants to apply, a link(s) for the post(s) will appear on the computer screen.
  • h) An "APPLY" button is shown against the respective post and the candidates will click on the APPLY button against the post he/she is eligible.
  • i) On clicking "APPLY" button, an instruction window will appear. Candidates should read instructions carefully before clicking on "APPLY" button at the bottom of the webpage.
  • j) On clicking "APPLY" button, the system will display all facts/particulars that a candidate may have mentioned while filling up the necessary fields of his/her OTR account. Candidate shall fill up the remaining required fields in the application form and accept the declaration thereof.
  • k) Once the candidate is satisfied about the correctness of the filled in details, then, he or she may click on "SUBMIT" button to finally push the data into server with successful submission report.
  • l) On successful submission of the basic details, the candidates will be required to pay the online fee and uploading of the documents, for final submission of the online application form.
  • m) Candidates can pay the requisite fee through online mode in the "SUBMITTED APPLICATIONS" menu in their account.
  • n) After successful payment of the fee, the fee status will get reflected on the Online Application form. Candidates can check the fee status by clicking on the Print Application Button in the submitted Applications menu in their JKPSC account. In case the payment status shows either "not submitted or under processing or status has not been reflected on the submitted application form", candidates(s) are advised to contact the JKPSC office at Solina Srinagar/ Resham Ghar Colony Jammu immediately for clarification. Further where the online fee is paid through other service providers the candidate must ensure that not only the amount of fee is debited from his/service provider's Account but also credited into the official account of JKPSC.
  • o) After successful submission of fee, the candidates will be required to upload requisite documents as specified in the advertisement/application form.
  • p) The candidate would be able to get the printout of his/her submitted application only after the payment of the requisite fee and uploading of requisite documents.
  • q) Please note that the above procedure is the only valid procedure for applying. No other mode of application or incomplete steps would be accepted and such applications would be rejected.

Selection Process

  • In pursuance of SRO No. 325 dated 12.07.2013 read with amendment made vide SRO No. 388 dated 10.09.2018, the candidates will be selected on the basis of written test comprising the Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs).
  • As far as possible the Multiple Choice Questions will be of the standard as have been prescribed for the National Entrance Eligible Test (NEET) for admission to PG courses.
  • The written examination (MCQ type) will be of two hours duration (120 minutes) having 100 questions.
  • There will be negative marking for incorrect answers (as detailed below) for all questions: a) There are four alternative for the answers to every question. For each question for which a wrong answer has been given by the candidate, one fourth (0.25) of the marks assigned to that question will be deducted as penalty. b) If a candidate gives more than one answer, it will be treated as a wrong answer even if one of the given answers happens to be correct and there will be same penalty as above for that question. c) If question is left blank i.e. no answer is given by the candidate, there will be no penalty for that question.

General Information/Instructions

  • Applicants Are Advised To Update Their One Time Registration Before Filling The Application Form.
  • The Application Form Together With Instructions For Filling Up The Application Forms Will Be Available On The Website Of The Commission From 05.01.2026.
  • Applicants Are Advised To Go Through The Instructions And All The Eligibility Conditions Prescribed For The Post, Before Filling Up The Online Application Form.
  • Last Date For Filling Up Of Online Application Form Complete In All Respects (Including Uploading Of The Requisite Documents) Alongwith The Requisite Fee (Online Mode Only) Is 04.02.2026.
  • The Last Date For Receipt Of Online Applications Provided In The Notification Shall Be The Cut-off Date For Determining The Eligibility As Regards Acquisition Of Educational / Professional Qualification Or Any Other Certificate On The Basis Of Which Any Reservation Is Claimed, Notwithstanding Any Extension In The Last Date Of Submission Of Applications.
  • The Minimum And Maximum Age Will However Be Reckoned With Reference To 1st January, 2025.
  • Applicants Can Edit Some Of The Fields In Their Online Application Form W.e.f 05.02.2026 To 07.02.2026. Instructions In This Regard Will Be Separately Made Available On The Website.
  • Applicants Are Required To Upload All The Mandatory Prescribed/requisite Documents Alongwith The Online Application Form.
  • An Applicant Seeking Consideration Under Any Reserved Category Must Ensure That He/she Possesses The Requisite Category Certificate Valid On The Cut Off Date And The Same Is Required To Be Uploaded While Submitting Online Application. It May Be Noted That No Further Opportunity To Upload Any Document Shall Be Provided After The Cut Off Date And Action Under Rules Including Rejection Of Application/candidature May Be Taken.
  • The Certificate Must Be In The Format Prescribed In The Rules As Applicable.
  • Applicants Will Not Be Required To Submit A Hard Copy Of The Online Application Form Or Any Other Documents To The Commission At The Time Of Filling Up Online Application Form.
  • The Applicant Will However Be Required To Present/produce A Downloaded Copy Of The Online Application Form Alongwith The Original Certificates At The Time Of Document Verification.
  • Applicants Are Advised In Their Own Interest To Submit Online Applications Much Before The Closing Date And Not Wait Till The Last Date To Avoid The Possibility Of Disconnection/inability To Pay Fee Or Failure To Login To The Online Application Portal On Account Of Heavy Load On The Website During The Closing Days.
  • Syllabus Is Available On The Website Of The Commission.
  • Tentatively The Written Examination Will Be Held In March, 2026.
  • The selected candidates shall not be permitted to continue their PG courses or tenure positions such as Senior Residency/ Registrars/Demonstrators. They will be given a one-time option to either accept the selection or continue with their ongoing PG/ tenure.
  • On appointment, the selected candidates shall have to serve mandatorily in peripheral and far-flung areas of the Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir, in the interest of equitable healthcare delivery.
  • An Applicant seeking his/her consideration under Reserved Categories must ensure that he/she possesses a valid Category certificate on the cut-off date in the format prescribed in the J&K Reservation Rules - 2005.
  • The candidature of the applicants will be provisional till the genuineness of the reserved Category certificate is verified by the Appointing Authority.
  • The Applicants may note that in case a claim for reservation is made on the basis of false/fake/fraudulent certificate, he/she shall be debarred from the examination(s) conducted by the J&K Public Service Commission, in addition to any other penal action as may be deemed appropriate.
  • Horizontal reservation @4% will be provided to the persons with benchmark disability, in terms of Government Order No. 127 of 2020 dated 20.04.2020 read with G.O. No. 59-JK (SWD) of 2021 dated 15.04.2021.

How to Apply

  • Candidates are required to apply online through the website of the Commission i.e. https://www.jkpsc.nic.in. No other means/ mode of application shall be accepted.
  • Candidates are first required to go to the JKPSC website https://www.jkpsc.nic.in and click on the link "One Time Registration" or click on Login menu if they have already created their profile with the JK PSC.
  • After logging into their account, candidates are required to fill all the requisite fields of One Time Registration (OTR) i.e. personal information, contact information & educational qualification, service details etc.
  • The candidate shall also be required to upload the image of date stamped recent passport size color photograph and signature. The photograph should not be taken earlier than 01.01.2025.
  • Size of the photograph (passport size) and signature must be between 10kB to 20kB in *.jpeg or *.jpg only.
  • After successful submission of all the details in the OTR account, check the eligibility conditions as mentioned in the advertisement notification before applying for the post.
  • On Clicking on the "show examination" a window will appear on the computer screen. Select the month of the advertisement notification for which candidate wants to apply, a link(s) for the post(s) will appear on the computer screen.
  • An "APPLY" button is shown against the respective post and the candidates will click on the APPLY button against the post he/she is eligible.
  • On clicking "APPLY" button, an instruction window will appear. Candidates should read instructions carefully before clicking on "APPLY" button at the bottom of the webpage.
  • On clicking "APPLY" button, the system will display all facts/particulars that a candidate may have mentioned while filling up the necessary fields of his/her OTR account. Candidate shall fill up the remaining required fields in the application form and accept the declaration thereof.
  • Once the candidate is satisfied about the correctness of the filled in details, then, he or she may click on "SUBMIT" button to finally push the data into server with successful submission report.
  • On successful submission of the basic details, the candidates will be required to pay the online fee and uploading of the documents, for final submission of the online application form.
  • Candidates can pay the requisite fee through online mode in the "SUBMITTED APPLICATIONS" menu in their account.
  • After successful payment of the fee, the fee status will get reflected on the Online Application form. Candidates can check the fee status by clicking on the Print Application Button in the submitted Applications menu in their JKPSC account. In case the payment status shows either "not submitted or under processing or status has not been reflected on the submitted application form", candidates(s) are advised to contact the JKPSC office at Solina Srinagar/Resham Ghar Colony Jammu immediately for clarification. Further where the online fee is paid through other service providers the candidate must ensure that not only the amount of fee is debited from his/service provider's Account but also credited into the official account of JKPSC.
  • After successful submission of fee, the candidates will be required to upload requisite documents as specified in the advertisement/application form.
  • The candidate would be able to get the printout of his/her submitted application only after the payment of the requisite fee and uploading of requisite documents.
  • Please note that the above procedure is the only valid procedure for applying. No other mode of application or incomplete steps would be accepted and such applications would be rejected.

Eligibility Criteria

Public Relations Officer (Level 10)

  • Essential Qualifications: Master degree in Mass Communication and Journalism or equivalent degree with 60% marks and above or equivalent grade 'B' in UGC seven-point scale OR Master Degree in any discipline with 60% marks and above with Post Graduate Diploma in Journalism and Mass Communications
  • Essential Experience: At least five years of experience in centre of any established English Newspaper, periodical, national news agency, radio or television or film media or equivalent experience as Public Relation Officer in recognized University
  • Desirable: Working knowledge of Computer applications, ability to communicate in local languages, preference to those with at least 60% marks in all boards/University examination, two years experience in writing reports/news/press release in print or electronic media, experience in handling social media

Assistant Registrar (Level 10)

  • Essential Qualifications: Master degree or equivalent in any discipline from recognized University with 60% marks and above or equivalent Grade B in UGC seven-point scale with consistently good academic record
  • Essential Experience: At least 05 years relevant administrative experience in supervisory capacity in Govt. office/university/technological institution or organization of repute in Pay Matrix Level 7/Level 8 as per 7th CPC
  • Desirable: Preference to those with at least 60% marks in all boards/University examination, degree in Law/Management/Engineering/Actuarial Science, Chartered or Cost Accountant qualification, SAS qualified, experience in handling computerized administration/financial matters, proficiency in use of latest office automation tools

Sports Officer (Level 10)

  • Essential Qualifications: Master degree with 60% marks and above in Physical Education/Sports Science or equivalent with 5 years of relevant experience in pay level 7/8 in any recognized Institutions and should have represented University/Institute at State/National level OR Bachelor of Physical Education (B.P.Ed) or equivalent with 60% marks and above with 7 years of relevant experience
  • Essential: Should have specialization in at least one sport such as Hockey, Athletics, Swimming, Football, Basketball, Badminton, etc.
  • Desirable: Preference to those with at least 60% marks in all boards/University examination

Fire and Safety Officer (Level 8)

  • Essential Qualifications: Bachelor Degree with at least 60% marks or equivalent CGPA from recognized University/Institute
  • Essential Certification: A diploma/certification for at least one year duration in Fire and Safety Management/Fire Technology & Industrial Safety Management/Safety and Disasters management or equivalent
  • Essential Experience: 05 years experience in capacity of Supervisor or equivalent safety professional in Fire Fighting in Civil/Defence Fire Service department/Public Undertaking/CFTIs or in reputed private organisation
  • Essential: Must be able to handle fire arms with sound health and active habits
  • Desirable: Post Graduate Degree/Advanced Diploma in Industrial Safety with 5 years relevant experience, valid driving license for LMVs

Senior Laboratory Officer (Level 8)

  • Essential Qualifications: Master Degree in Engineering/Science or equivalent in appropriate field with minimum 60% marks with 05 year relevant experience in Pay Matrix Level 6 OR Bachelor Degree (four years) in Engineering with minimum 60% marks with 07 years relevant experience OR Bachelor's Degree in Science (Three years) with minimum 60% marks with 08 years relevant experience OR Three years Diploma in Engineering with minimum 60% marks with 08 year relevant experience
  • Desirable: Proficiency in use of latest office automation tools and applications

Laboratory Officer (Level 6)

  • Essential Qualifications: Master Degree in Engineering/Science or equivalent in appropriate field with minimum 60% marks with 03 year relevant experience in Pay Matrix Level 4 OR Bachelor Degree (four years) in Engineering with minimum 60% marks with 05 year relevant experience OR Bachelor's Degree in Science (Three years) with minimum 60% marks with 06 year relevant experience OR Three years Diploma in Engineering with minimum 60% marks with 06 year relevant experience
  • Desirable: Proficiency in use of latest office automation tools and applications

Junior Section Officer (Level 6)

  • Essential Qualifications: Master Degree in any discipline from recognized university with 60% marks and above with 03 year experience in Administration/Accounts/Audit/Purchase etc. as Senior Assistant or equivalent in Pay Matrix Level 4 OR Bachelor's Degree in any discipline with 60% marks and above with 05 years experience in Administration/Accounts/Audit/Purchase etc as Senior Assistant or equivalent
  • Desirable: Preference to those with at least 60% marks in all boards/University examination, Higher Degree/PG Diploma in relevant discipline like HR, Labor Laws, Financial Management, inter ICWA/CA, proficiency in use of latest office automation tools

Assistant Sports Officer (Level 6)

  • Essential Qualifications: Bachelor of Physical Education (B.P.Ed) or equivalent with 60% marks and above with 3 years of relevant experience in any recognized Institutions and should have represented University/Institute at State/National level
  • Essential: Should have specialization in at least one sport such as Hockey, Athletics, Swimming, Football, Basketball, Badminton, etc.
  • Desirable: Preference to those with at least 60% marks in all boards/University examination, N.I.S Coaching Diploma holders and medal winners in inter University/national games, representation at international level, certificate from national/international federation recognized by GoI, at least 02 years experience in coaching at University level

Laboratory Assistant (Level 5)

  • Essential Qualifications: Master's Degree in Engineering/Science or equivalent in appropriate field with minimum 60% marks with 01 year relevant experience at Pay Matrix Level 2 OR Bachelor Degree (four years) in Engineering with minimum 60% marks with 02 year relevant experience OR Bachelor's Degree in Science (Three years) with minimum 60% marks with 03 year relevant experience OR Three years Diploma in Engineering with minimum 60% marks with 03 year relevant experience
  • Desirable: Proficiency in use of latest office automation tools, applications and latest trade related softwares

Senior Assistant (Level 5)

  • Essential Qualifications: Master Degree in any discipline from recognized university with 60% marks and above with 01 year experience in Administration/Accounts/Audit/Purchase etc as Junior Assistant or equivalent in Pay Matrix Level 2 OR Bachelor's Degree in any discipline with 60% marks and above with 03 years experience in Administration/Accounts/Audit/Purchase etc. as Junior Assistant or equivalent
  • Desirable: Preference to those with at least 60% marks in all boards/University examination, proficiency in use of latest office automation tools and applications

  • Group A Posts (Public Relations Officer, Assistant Registrar, Sports Officer): Level-10, Pay Matrix ₹56,100 - ₹177,500 per month
  • Group B Posts (Fire and Safety Officer, Senior Laboratory Officer): Level-8, Pay Matrix ₹47,600 - ₹151,100 per month

  • Age of Superannuation: 60 years

Category Fee Details

General/OBC/EWS Candidates (Group B & C) ₹500/- (₹300 application fee + ₹200 processing fee) - Inclusive of GST
SC/ST/PwD/Women Candidates ₹200/- (Processing fee only) - Exempted from application fee
Payment Mode Online through link provided inside the portal
Refund Policy Fee once paid will not be refunded or re-adjusted under any circumstances

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Release Date 29/12/2025
Online Application Start Date 03/01/2026 (10:00 AM)
Online Application Last Date 03/02/2026 (05:00 PM)
Payment of Application Fee 03/01/2026 to 03/02/2026
NOC Submission (Through Proper Channel) Within 40 days of submitting online application

Selection Process

  • Institute will conduct a multistage assessment process for advertised positions
  • For Group A Posts: May include screening, written test, proficiency test, computer test, presentation and interviews as per requirement
  • For Group B & C Posts: May include screening, written test, proficiency test and computer test as per requirement
  • Each stage will be an elimination round, candidate must qualify each test to appear for next stage
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks: 50% individually in each stage, however final total qualifying marks shall be 60% of total marks
  • Relaxation/Concession to SC/ST/OBC candidates may be given as per Government of India rules
  • Institute reserves right to reduce or increase stages of recruitment
  • All stages may be conducted on same day without any prior notice
  • Final selection shall depend on merit over and above minimum level as determined by respective Selection Committee

General Information/Instructions

  • Online applications are invited from Indian Nationals only
  • Number of vacancies including those under reserved categories are provisional and may change depending on actual requirement
  • Reservation policy as per Government of India norms is followed
  • One post is reserved for PwD-VH/OH candidate on horizontal basis, one post reserved for PwD-HH candidate on horizontal basis, one post reserved for PwD-VH candidate on horizontal basis
  • Institute reserves right to select any candidate on contractual basis initially for period of 02 years extendable on year-to-year basis maximum upto 05 years
  • OBC (Non-creamy layer) certificate issued on or after 01/04/2025 shall only be considered
  • EWS certificate issued on or after 01/04/2025 shall only be considered
  • Institute reserves right NOT to fill any of post advertised without assigning any reason
  • All candidates irrespective of category may be considered against UR vacancies subject to fulfilment of eligibility criteria
  • Candidates should read carefully requisite minimum essential qualifications, age and eligibility, experience criteria before applying
  • Application once submitted online cannot be altered or resubmitted under any circumstances
  • Incomplete application will be summarily rejected
  • Canvassing in any form will be treated as disqualification
  • No hardcopy submission of online submitted application required at initial stage
  • Candidates shortlisted shall be required to produce printout of online completed and duly signed application along with all supporting educational and experience certificates duly self-attested
  • Persons serving in Government/Semi-Government/PSUs should submit NOC at time of written test/interview
  • Institute reserves right to verify antecedents and documents submitted by candidate at any stage of recruitment process
  • Decision of Institute in all matters relating to eligibility, written test, interview would be final and binding on all candidates
  • Appointment of selected candidates will be subject to their being found medically fit as per requirements of Institute

How to Apply

  • Candidates are required to apply ONLINE only from 03 January 2026, 10:00 AM till 03 February 2026 upto 05:00 PM
  • Visit official application portal: https://apply.iitjammu.ac.in
  • Fill the online application form carefully with all required details
  • Upload all necessary documents including educational qualifications, experience certificates, category certificates, PwD certificate (if applicable)
  • Upload recent passport size photograph
  • Pay application fee online through link provided inside portal
  • Submit the application form and take printout for future reference
  • Keep printout of online application form for future reference
  • Candidates who desire to apply for more than one post should apply online separately for each post
  • Candidates shortlisted for written test/interview shall produce printout of online application along with all supporting documents in original at time of test/interview
  • No correspondence whatsoever will be entertained from candidates regarding conduct and result of interview
  • Candidates should visit Institute website and portal regularly for status updates in recruitment
  • For any discrepancy/query, contact [email protected] within one week from date of display of list

Selection Process

  • Stage 1 - Written Test: Candidates shall be subjected to a Written Examination (Objective Type Multiple Choice Questions). Questions will be set in English Language only. There will be Negative Marking for each wrong answer to the extent of one-fourth of marks assigned to that question.
  • NCC Bonus Marks: Candidates possessing National Cadet Corps (NCC) Certificate shall be awarded bonus marks - 5% for NCC "C" Certificate holders, 3% for NCC "B" Certificate holders, and 2% for NCC "A" Certificate holders.
  • Stage 2 - Physical Standard Test (PST): Candidates shall be shortlisted for PST on the basis of written test which shall be six times the total number of vacancies to be filled up in each category. This test is of qualifying nature.
  • Physical Standards for Males: Height 5'-6" (minimum), Chest girth 32" (unexpanded), Chest girth 33½" (expanded)
  • Physical Standards for Females: Height 5'-2" (minimum)
  • Relaxation: For candidates belonging to Gorkha Community/Bot Tribe, minimum Height shall be relaxable by 2".
  • Stage 3 - Physical Endurance Test (PET): Candidates who meet the physical standards shall undergo PET, which is of qualifying nature.
  • PET for Male Candidates: Long Race 1600 meters in 6½ minutes and 20 Pushups
  • PET for Female Candidates: Long Race 1000 meters in 6½ minutes and Shot put (4Kgs) 14½ feet in three attempts
  • Relaxed Standards for Ex-Servicemen: Age-wise relaxation provided for Long Race and Pushups/Shot put as per notification
  • Stage 4 - Medical Examination: Selected candidates will be medically examined to assess their physical and medical fitness.

  • Candidates must be Domicile of the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir.
  • The examination will consist of Objective Type Multiple Choice Questions in English Language only.
  • Candidature will be accepted only provisionally subject to verification of documents.
  • Candidates must write their Name, Date of Birth, Father's Name and Mother's Name strictly as given in the Matriculation Certificate.
  • Request for change/correction in any particulars in the application form, once submitted, will not be entertained under any circumstances.
  • Candidates are advised to submit online applications much before the closing date.
  • Only one online application for the same item number is allowed.
  • Reservation shall be applicable as per the Jammu & Kashmir Reservation Act/Rules.
  • Horizontal Reservation: 15% for women candidates, 15% for SPOs (with minimum 3 years engagement), and 4% for Volunteer Home Guards (with minimum 3 years engagement).
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) are not eligible for these posts.
  • Use of mobile phones or any electronic equipment is strictly prohibited during examination.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for participation in the written test/document verification.
  • The decision of the Board in all matters will be final and binding on the candidates.

How to Apply

  • Mode of Application: Online mode only through the official website www.jkssb.nic.in
  • Step 1: Visit the official website of JKSSB at www.jkssb.nic.in
  • Step 2: Click on the "Apply Online" link for Advertisement Notification No. 12 of 2025
  • Step 3: Register yourself by providing required details like Name, Date of Birth, Email ID, Mobile Number, etc.
  • Step 4: Fill the online application form carefully with all required details
  • Step 5: Upload recent passport size colour photograph and signature (as per prescribed specifications)
  • Step 6: Upload valid Category Certificate (if claiming reservation) which should be valid as on cut-off date (17.02.2026)
  • Step 7: Pay the application fee online through Net Banking/Credit Card/Debit Card
  • Step 8: Review the application form carefully before final submission
  • Step 9: Submit the application and take printout of the filled application form for future reference
  • Step 10: Candidates must carry the printout at the time of Document Verification
  • Important: No hard copies of online application form should be submitted to the JKSSB office either in person or by post/email.
  • In-Service Candidates: Must submit printout of filled online application form along with duly filled, signed and stamped Certificate through proper channel via the concerned Head of Department/Designated Authority.

  • B.E./B.Tech or equivalent in ECE/EIE/EEE/ETC/EE or other allied branches with 60% marks or a CGPA of 6.0 on a 10.00-point scale; OR
  • A valid GATE Score for a candidate applying for Ph.D. directly after B.E./B.Tech./M.Sc.

For SC/ST/PH Category Candidates:

  • M.E./M.Tech or equivalent in ECE/EIE/EEE/ETC/EE or other allied branches with 55% marks or a CGPA of 5.5 on a 10.00-point scale; OR
  • B.E./B.Tech or equivalent in ECE/EIE/EEE/ETC/EE or other allied branches with 55% marks or a CGPA of 5.5 on a 10.00-point scale; OR
  • A valid GATE Score for a candidate applying for Ph.D. directly after B.E./B.Tech./M.Sc.

Note: No percentage criteria will be applied for class 10th and 12th marks for all categories of application.

Additional: Candidates who have submitted/defended PhD thesis in Microelectronics or allied subjects can also apply.

2. Age Limit

The age limit for IIT Jammu Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 is:

  • Maximum Age: 28 years
  • Age Relaxation: As per Government of India rules
    • 5 years for SC/ST candidates
    • 3 years for OBC (NCL) candidates
    • Women and other eligible categories as per GoI norm

4. Desirable Knowledge

  • Basic knowledge of semiconductor physics
  • Basic knowledge of device simulation

Project Objective and Job Description

Brief Objective of Project

The project is titled "Design and development of Ultraviolet detectors based on wideband gap semiconductors" and is sponsored by ISRO. The project objectives include:

  • Design and optimization of wide band-gap semiconductor (AlGaN) based UV photodetector devices with the initial help of simulation
  • Growth optimization of device layers for UV photodetector
  • Detailed material characterizations to estimate the suitability of the grown multilayer structures for device fabrication
  • Implementation of the device fabrication process flow for the photodetector
  • Electrical and optical characterizations of the fabricated photodetector to obtain the performance parameters
  • Implementation of the required modifications in the simulation, growth and fabrication steps to improve the performance parameters
  • Improvement of the device performance in terms of Dark current, Responsivity, Detectivity and rise/fall time

Job Description

The selected candidate is expected to work on:

  • Modeling
  • Device Fabrication
  • Characterizations – Both material and Device

    Good computer skills and proficiency in MS Office and computer typing.
    At least 3 years of experience working on gender-related issues in government/semi-government organizations or NGOs/institutions.
    At least 3 years of experience working on women's issues.

Salary / Stipend

  • Rs 25780

Age Limit 

  • The age should not be less than 21 years or more than 45 years.

Important Dates

Application deadline 06/02/2026

Selection Process

  • A maximum of 60 marks will be awarded based on the percentage obtained in the required minimum educational qualification, with a weightage of 100 marks.
    2 marks will be awarded for each additional year of experience beyond the minimum required experience, up to a maximum of 18 marks.
    Applicants who are residents of Chhattisgarh will be given 2 bonus marks.
    A merit list will be prepared based on a total of 80 marks, derived from the above three points. 20 marks will be allocated for the walk-in interview/skill test.

General Information / Instructions

  • For the Gender Specialist position, the candidate's age should not be less than 21 years and not more than 45 years as on 01.01.2026. In addition, local residents of Chhattisgarh will be eligible for age relaxation as per the instructions issued by the State Government from time to time, but the maximum age limit, including all relaxations, will not exceed 50 years.
    Age verification/confirmation will be done on the basis of the birth certificate or the mark sheet of Class 8th or 10th, which mentions the date of birth. It will be mandatory to bring the original and self-attested copies of the documents at the time of document verification.
    Being a resident of Chhattisgarh state is not mandatory for the Gender Specialist position, but applications from residents of Chhattisgarh state will be given priority. For this purpose, in the merit determination, local residents of Chhattisgarh will be given 02 bonus marks for these positions.
    It will be mandatory to attach a permanent caste certificate issued by the competent authority for the reserved category.
    Any candidate who has married before attaining the minimum age prescribed for marriage will not be eligible for appointment.
    A candidate who has married a person who already has a living spouse will not be eligible.
    The application form should be submitted in the prescribed format. The required certificates, mark sheets, and other documents attached with the application form must be attested/verified by a gazetted officer/self-attested.
    Regarding experience, the candidate must attach a full-time work experience certificate issued by the employer of the concerned institution, certified/verified by a gazetted officer.
    The decision of the appointing authority (District Collector) regarding the acceptance of the experience mentioned in the application will be final.
    No certificate of voluntary service will be considered as experience.
    Employees working in Government/Semi-Government/Non-Government Organizations/Institutions will be required to submit their application form along with a No Objection Certificate from their employer, otherwise, the application form will not be considered. Candidates will not be given separate notice regarding incomplete, unclear, or erroneous application forms, and such applications will be rejected.
    Candidates who do not possess the prescribed qualifications should not apply.
    The name of the post and the category for which the application is being submitted must be clearly mentioned on the envelope and in the application form; otherwise, the application will be rejected.
    The sender's name and complete correspondence address (including email address and mobile number) must be clearly mentioned on the envelope and in the application form.
    Applicants should verify their eligibility themselves and submit the application form only if they meet the prescribed qualifications and conditions for the advertised post.
    If an applicant is found ineligible at any stage of the selection process, their application will be rejected, and their candidature will be terminated.
    For all these posts, eligible candidates will be selected/appointed on a contractual basis/fixed salary for a maximum period of 02 years in the first instance. Thereafter, based on work performance, efficiency, conduct, and the department's requirements, and on the recommendation of the controlling officer, the suitability will be assessed, and the contract/service period may be extended by the District Collector for one year at a time. Otherwise, the appointment will automatically terminate upon the expiry of the appointment period.
    The appointment of the selected candidate will be purely temporary and can be terminated without assigning any reason.
    The tenure of these posts will be limited to the duration of the scheme's operation by the Government of India, and thereafter, the posts will be abolished.

How to Apply

  • Duly filled application forms will be accepted only through registered post/speed post/courier.
    The application forms must reach the Joint District Office, Women and Child Development Department, Room No. 79, Balod District (Chhattisgarh) by the stipulated date, i.e., February 06, 2026, during office hours (up to 5:30 PM).

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualification: (10+2) examination passed from a recognized education board or old higher secondary examination passed along with first year of graduation from a recognized university.
  • Essential Qualification: One year diploma/certificate in Data Entry Operator/Programming from a recognized institution.
  • Essential Qualification: 5000 key depression per hour in Hindi typing on computer (skill test will be conducted).
  • Essential Qualification: Certificate in Hindi or English stenography at 5000 key depression per hour through computer and software from a recognized board/institution or Chhattisgarh Shorthand and Typewriting Examination Council (skill test will be conducted).

Salary/ Stipend

  • Rs. 5200-20200 + Grade Pay 1900 (Pay Matrix Level 4)

Age Limit (as on 01-01-2026)

  • Minimum age not less than 18 years.
  • For local residents of Chhattisgarh, maximum age limit extended by 5 years to 40 years, with further relaxations up to 45 years including all concessions.
  • Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, and Other Backward Class (non-creamy layer) residents of Chhattisgarh: 5 years relaxation.
  • Ex-servicemen: Deduct the period of defense service, but not exceeding 3 years beyond the upper age limit.
  • Women: 10 years relaxation as per Chhattisgarh Civil Services (Special Provision for Appointment of Women) Rules 1997.
  • Widow, deserted, and divorced women: 5 years relaxation.
  • Inter-caste marriage incentive scheme beneficiaries: 5 years relaxation.
  • Green card holders under family welfare program (Chhattisgarh applicants): 2 years relaxation.
  • Recipients of Shahid Rajiv Pandey, Gupt Dhur Samman, Maharaja Pravir Chandra Samman, and national youth award winners: 5 years relaxation.
  • Differently-abled applicants: 10 years relaxation, provided disability is 40% or more, with valid certificate from district medical board.
  • Permanent/temporary employees of Chhattisgarh state and its corporations/boards: Upper age limit 38 years.
  • Contract employees: Relaxation equal to years served on contract, up to maximum age of 38 years.

Important Dates

Application Start Date 22 January 2026
Application Last Date 20 February 2026

Selection Process

  • After scrutinizing received applications, prepare merit list based on marks obtained in educational qualification for shortlisting, then prepare provisional list of 10 times the number of vacancies category-wise for document verification.
  • After document verification, prepare provisional list of eligible/ineligible candidates.
  • Invite eligible candidates for computer proficiency/skill test.
  • Total 100 marks: 80 marks for educational qualification (80% of the percentage of marks in prescribed qualification), 20 marks for skill test.
  • Must obtain at least 8 marks in skill test; less than 10 marks in skill test will be disqualified.
  • If marks are equal, preference to higher marks in skill test; if still equal, preference based on date of birth (earlier date preferred).
  • Prepare category-wise merit list by adding educational marks and skill test marks for selection.
  • If eligible candidates not available after skill test, prepare provisional list of next 5 times candidates per post from lower merit for document verification and proceed accordingly.

General Information / Instructions

  • The number of advertised posts may increase or decrease category-wise depending on circumstances.
  • In case women or ex-servicemen are not available, the post will be filled by male candidates of the same category.
  • Appointing authority: Collector, Kabirdham District (Chhattisgarh).
  • For computer qualifications, certificates from recognized ITI in Computer Operator and Programming Assistant, Diploma in Computer Science/IT/Modern Office Management from recognized Board of Technical Education/State Technical University (minimum 2 years), PG Diploma/Degree in Computer Science/IT/Computer Application from recognized university/deemed university/Indira Gandhi Open University/Bhoj University are valid.
  • Age calculation as on 01 January 2026.
  • Applicant must be original resident of Chhattisgarh.
  • Applicant must have live registration in Chhattisgarh State Employment Office.
  • Certificates for age relaxation must be attached with application.
  • Ex-servicemen must attach self-attested copy of discharge book.
  • Applications not accepted before advertisement date or after last date.
  • Applicants should self-verify eligibility before applying.
  • Selected candidates in government/semi-government service must submit no objection certificate from employer.
  • No travel allowance for skill test.
  • Incomplete, unclear, or erroneous applications will be rejected without notice.
  • At skill test or after selection, must submit original certificates for caste, residence, age, qualification, employment registration, etc.
  • Information for skill test to eligible candidates via district official website https://kawardha.gov.in; no separate individual notice.
  • If any information found false during or after selection, candidature/appointment will be cancelled and legal action may be taken.
  • Details of received applications published on district official website https://kawardha.gov.in.
  • Selected candidates on 3 years probation.
  • In case of any dispute, final decision by appointing authority, i.e., Collector Kabirdham.
  • Any factual/clerical errors in advertisement will be corrected and published on https://kawardha.gov.in.
  • Posting of selected candidate in district office or subordinate project offices.
  • Merit list, objections, document verification, skill test, selection list etc. uploaded on Collector office notice board and https://kawardha.gov.in.
  • All information regarding direct recruitment only through https://kawardha.gov.in; no other correspondence.
  • Ineligibility: Candidate married before minimum marriage age; male with more than one living wife or female married to such male; not medically fit; not suitable after inquiry; convicted of offense against women.

How to Apply

  • On the envelope, clearly write the name of the applied post, applicant's name, address with pin code. Also, attach a blank envelope of 9x4 size with Rs.5 postage stamp and self-address.
  • Paste recent self-attested passport size photo at designated place in application form.
  • Attach self-attested photocopies of educational qualification, technical qualification, residence certificate, caste certificate, employment registration certificate, and other necessary documents.
  • Send application in prescribed format from 22 January 2026 to 20 February 2026 by 05:30 PM only via registered post or speed post to "Office of District Program Officer, Women and Child Development Department, Kabirdham District (Chhattisgarh) Pin Code-491995". Ordinary post or hand-delivered applications not accepted.

Eligibility Criteria

Further following shall also be essential qualification without insisting on credit point requirements at Assistant Professor level: (i) M.Arch. or M.Plan. or equivalent with one-year professional experience: Assistant Professor at Academic Grade Pay of Rs. 6000 (ii) M.Arch. or M.Plan. or equivalent with two-year professional experience: Assistant Professor at Academic Grade Pay of Rs. 7000 (iii) For higher cadres the educational qualifications and credit point requirement shall remain same as given in the Table of Schedule‘E’ for Engineering and Sciences
  • Essential Qualification: For Non-Engineering Departments: Ph.D. degree in the relevant or equivalent discipline with first class in preceding Degrees.
  • Desirable Qualification: In case, first class is not mentioned in the preceding Degrees by the University / Institution, then the candidates should have secured at least 6.5 CGPA (on a 10-point scale) or 60% marks in aggregate.
  • Desirable Qualification: In case the candidate has secured CGPA under any other point scale (other than 10-point scale), then certificate issued by the authorized signatory (not the Mentor/Supervisor/Head of the Department) of the Institute / University to the effect of having secured first class in such Degree must be attached. Alternately, the CGPA may be equivalently converted on 10- point scale for determination of eligibility.
  • Desirable criteria for Professor (Level 14A): (a) Good quality publications with at least 20 papers in SCI/SCIE/SSCI Journals. (b) At least three, in combination of ongoing/ completed externally sponsored research project AND/OR patent granted. (c) Supervised at least two Ph.D. completed and one ongoing. (d) Organized three activities in cumulative of Conference(s) OR at least 5 days Workshop/ STTP/FDP course(s).
  • Desirable criteria for Associate Professor (Level 13A2): (a) Good quality publications with at least 10 papers in SCI/SCIE/SSCI Journals. (b) At least two, in combination of ongoing/ completed externally sponsored research project AND/OR patent granted. (c) Supervised at least one Ph.D. completed and one ongoing. (d) Organized two activities in cumulative of Conference(s) OR at least 5 days Workshop/ STTP/FDP course(s).
  • Desirable criteria for Assistant Professor (Level -12): (a) Good quality publications with at least 5 papers in SCI/SCIE/SSCI Journals. (b) At least one ongoing/ completed externally sponsored research project OR one patent granted. (c) Supervised at least one Ph.D. completed/ ongoing. (d) Organized one Conference OR at least 5 days Workshop/ STTP/FDP course.
  • Desirable criteria for Assistant Professor (Level -10): (a) Good quality publications with at least 3 papers in SCI/SCIE/SSCI Journals.
  • Experience: Experience as per Clarification no. 7, GoI, Ministry of Education(MoE, erstwhile MHRD), F.No.33-9/2011-TS.III, Dated 16th April, 2019, (including prior to implementation of NIRF) shall be considered if acquired in any of the following Institutions: • Fully Funded Central Educational Institutions. • IIMs, Other Management Institutions and Research institutions ranked by NIRF up to 50 for any two years. • State Educational Institutions funded by respective State Government. • Other Educational Institutions (Universities and Engineering institutes) ranked by NIRF up to 100 in Overall, and 10 for Architecture, for any two years.
  • Experience: Experience as mentioned above and as per RRs in an Institution/ Organization will only be considered for calculating total experience.
  • Administrative Experience: Contributions to Institute/Department Administration shall be recommended by concerned Head and approved by the Head of the Institution. [As prescribed in Note 1, Point no. 4 of Schedule ‘E’ of NITs Statutes (vide Gazette of India No. 651, Dated, July 24, 2017)].

General Information / Instructions

  • This being an advertisement governed by the four-tier flexible Faculty Recruitment Rules, relevant instructions from MoE issued till the date of interview will be applicable to this recruitment process.
  • The Institute reserves the right to increase/decrease number of vacancies including those in the Reserved Categories without notification.
  • Since all the posts are to be filled-in by open advertisement, candidates working in NIT Raipur who are aspiring for higher Pay levels are required to submit their application even if the posts in the concern Department are not advertised.
  • For the Departments which are not having any vacancy, movement in higher Pay Level or Cadre will be carried out as per specified selection process but restricted to only for serving faculty members of the respective Departments of the Institute (as per Note 1(5) of Schedule ‘E’ of Statutes 23[5](a) of the First Statutes of the National Institute of Technology (Amendment) Statutes, 2017) and as directed by MoE, Government of India, from time to time.
  • The Institute reserves the right to modify/ defer or cancel full / part of the advertisement / recruitment process at any stage of processing without assigning any reason whatsoever and no communication in this regard will be made.
  • Financial assistance for attending national/international conferences for presenting research papers or Chairing sessions, for sponsored training in India and abroad, for membership of professional Societies etc. under the Scheme of Cumulative Professional Development Allowance [CPDA] limited to Rs.1.00 lakh per annum subject to the maximum limit of Rs.3.00 lakh in a block period of three years or as per rules.
  • An initial Research Grant (Seed Grant) up to Rs. 5.00 Lakh for new Faculty as per Institute norms.
  • Provision for undertaking consultancy and testing work as per Institute norms.
  • On campus residence [depending on availability].
  • Medical Facilities to Faculty and their dependent family members as per rules.
  • Reimbursement of expenses on telephone as per approved norms.
  • Group Insurance Scheme for Faculty as per Institute norms.
  • Provision of Child care Leave, Children Education Allowance and maternity/paternity Leave as per Government of India (GoI) norms.
  • LTC as per Government of India (GoI) norms.
  • HRA as per the Government of India (GoI) norms.

  • Leave will be granted as per CCS Leave Rules, 1972.

  • All recruitment and pay-fixation shall be done by the Appointing Authority, i.e., Board of Governors (BoG) of the Institute only on the recommendations of duly constituted Selection Committees. The decision of the Appointing Authority shall be final. There is no scope for fixing or altering the pay (pay in Level/Cell) outside the Selection Committee for Level10 and 12. The Selection Committee shall be the only entity empowered to consider the past services and qualifications of a candidate. However, higher starting Pay and/or Pay Level may be offered to deserving candidates on recommendation of the Selection Committee upon approval of the Board of Governors for Levels 13A2 and 14A. Selected candidates to the above faculty positions will be fixed in the minimum basic pay as per norm and only the regular service at NIT Raipur, will be counted for any purpose thereafter.

  • Original documents along with one set of self-attested copies will have to be produced at the time of interview for verification.
  • All Degrees and Certificates should have been obtained from recognized Institute/University.
  • Mere possession of minimum qualification/ experience will not entitle the candidate to be called for interview/ selection or appointment.
  • The Institute has the right to set higher norms than minimum and the areas of specialization while shortlisting, taking into account the specific requirements of the individual departments. The short-listing norms may not be uniform across the departments/ posts of the Institute and shall be binding on all the applicants. Priority of shortlisting shall be as under: (i) All three degrees (UG/PG/PhD) from IIT/IISc/IIM/NIT or reputed institute with NIRF ranking within 100 for universities and engineering institutes or 50 for management institutes for three years or foreign university an institute in QS/THE world ranking upto 500. (ii) At least two degrees (UG/PG/PhD) from IIT/IISc/IIM/NIT or reputed institute with NIRF ranking within 100 for universities and engineering institutes or 50 for management institutes for three years or foreign university an institute in QS/THE world ranking upto 500.   • The reserved candidates who have applied for unreserved posts will not be eligible for any age relaxation or any other concessions as per DOPT Office Memorandum No. 36011/1/98 Est. (Res) Dated, 1-7-98.
  • The directives contained in the matter of reservation in posts and implementation of Central Educational Institutions Act, 2019 enunciated in the Ministry of Education’s letter dated 05.11.2019 (attached herewith as Annexure-VIII) shall be applicable.

The applicants need to keep on visiting Institute Website www.nitrr.ac.in for updates. No correspondence will be made regarding non-eligibility/ not-short listing/ non-selection of the candidates.
  • Information uploaded on the website shall not be provided to the candidate or any other person under R.T.I Act. 2005. The information uploaded on the website shall remain for a specific period only. Therefore, the candidates are advised to download the uploaded information and keep with them for future. During ongoing process of recruitment, neither any application under Right to Information Act. 2005 shall be entertained nor information will be provided. Factual information under the R.T.I Act shall be provided only after declaration of final results of the process. Inferential questions or speculative questions shall not be answered in RTI.

  • Complete hardcopy of Application Form(s) for each applied Branch/Discipline/ Post must be submitted in separate envelopes. The envelope containing the application must be superscribed as “Application for the Post of ‘Assistant Professor’/ ‘Associate Professor’/ ‘Professor’ in the Department of ………………………………”
  • Please note that the deadline for online application is 17/02/2026 till 5:30 PM and the last date of receiving hard copies of the print-out of the online application prepared as given in point 12 above, is 27/02/2026 up to 5:30 PM.
  • Please also note that an online application for which hard-copy application along with necessary documentation is not received in the Institute upto the stipulated time, the online application will be rejected summarily.
  • NIT Raipur shall in no case be responsible for postal delays and hard copies of the applications received after the last date will be rejected along with its online version.
  • The Institute reserves the right to extend the last date. Therefore, candidates are advised to keep visiting the Institute Website regularly.

Important Dates

Start Date 22 January 2026
Last Date 05 February 2026

Selection Process

  • Applications will be invited online based on the qualifications mentioned above.
  • Merit will be prepared based on the marking system.
  • In case of equal marks in the merit list, preference will be given based on seniority in age.
  • Priority will be given to applications from surplus service providers of Sakhi One Stop Center whose services have been terminated or are under process, based on their qualification and experience.
  • The committee will prepare the merit list based on the marking system as above and select accordingly.
  • The selection committee will send the recommendation list for selection to the District Collector, and the District Collector will issue the appointment order.

General Information / Instructions

  • Age verification/support will be based on birth certificate or mark sheet of class 6th or 10th where date of birth is mentioned. Original and self-attested copy mandatory at document verification.
  • The candidate must be a native resident of Chhattisgarh. Residence certificate issued by competent authority will be valid.
  • For reserved category, permanent caste certificate issued by competent authority must be attached.
  • The selected candidate's educational documents will be sent for verification to the concerned board/university and experience to the concerned institution. If documents are found fake, criminal case will be registered and action taken as per rules.
  • The selected candidate must undergo medical examination within 01 month after selection and submit fitness certificate. If found unfit, services will be terminated.
  • Sakhi One Stop Center is extremely sensitive work, so selected candidate must undergo police background verification before appointment and submit the certificate at the time of joining. At the time of application, non-conviction certificate must also be submitted.
  • The nature of work at Sakhi One Stop Center is sensitive and confidentiality of victims is legally very important. Selected candidate must maintain confidentiality of all work-related matters, victims/cases, and data, and submit an affidavit. On violation, services will be terminated.
  • Any candidate who has married before the minimum age limit for marriage will not be eligible for appointment. In case of selection, the selected candidate must submit an affidavit notarized on Rs. 50/- stamp paper.
  • A candidate who has married a person who already has a living spouse will not be eligible. In such cases, the government may decide otherwise if satisfied with sufficient reasons.
  • Application form must be submitted online on the portal along with desired certificates, mark sheets, and other documents attested by gazetted officer or self.
  • For experience, the candidate must attach full-time work experience certificate issued by the employer of the concerned institution, certified by gazetted officer.
  • The decision of the appointing authority District Collector regarding validation of experience given in the application will be final.
  • Any voluntary service certificate will not be considered as experience.
  • Employees working in government/semi-government institutions must submit their application with no objection certificate from employer, otherwise application will not be considered.
  • Incomplete, unclear, and erroneous application forms will not be notified separately to candidates and such applications will be rejected. Candidates without prescribed qualification please do not apply.
  • Separate online applications must be submitted for each post.
  • Applicants should self-check their eligibility and apply only if they meet the prescribed eligibility and conditions for the advertised post. If found ineligible at any stage of selection, the application can be canceled and candidature terminated.
  • Service providers appointed on lump sum service fee under the scheme will be governed by Chhattisgarh Civil Services Conduct Rules 1965 and bound to follow them.
  • Appointed service providers will be paid only lump sum service fee and no other salary allowances, gratuity will be payable.
  • These service providers will be eligible for maternity leave facility. In special circumstances, if sent on travel or training, travel allowance will be payable as per rules after appropriate approval.
  • The service fee of the above service providers is as per the limit and instructions set by Government of India and in future, if increased by Government of India, the service fee will be given accordingly.
  • All posts under Sakhi One Stop Center will have District Collector as the appointing authority.
  • The district level selection committee will carry out the recruitment process as per prescribed criteria for vacant posts at Sakhi One Stop Center and recommend to District Collector.
  • The committee will determine transparent process for appointment/recruitment criteria (merit) and process, and invite applications through advertisement via online medium. Merit will be prepared based on marking system on received applications as per prescribed criteria.
  • All these posts will be selected/appointed on lump sum service fee initially for a maximum period of 02 years, and thereafter, based on work performance, capacity, behavior, and department's need, and on recommendation of controlling officer, the suitability will be assessed and service period can be extended by 01 year each time by District Collector, otherwise on expiry of service period without extension, appointment will be considered automatically terminated.
  • The appointment of selected service provider will be completely temporary and can be terminated without assigning any reason.
  • During the work period, appointment can be terminated by either party by giving one month notice or one month salary in lieu thereof.
  • The duration of these posts will be limited to the period of scheme operation by Government of India and thereafter posts will be abolished. After abolition of posts, the department will have no responsibility for the service providers working on these posts.
  • The decision of District Collector regarding selection will be final and acceptable to all.
  • For online application, can be viewed on Women and Child Development Department website https://sakhionestop.e-bharti.in/ and for detailed information of advertisement, can be seen on www.raipur.gov.in at District Information and Science Officer (NIC) Raipur.

How to Apply

  • Online applications can be made from 22 January 2026 to 05 February 2026 on the Women and Child Development Department website https://sakhionestop.e-bharti.in/.
  • Separate applications must be made for each post on the online portal.
  • Along with the application, attach desired certificates, mark sheets, and other documents attested by gazetted officer or self.

    • Diploma in Vocational Rehabilitation (DVR); or
    • Advanced Diploma in Child Guidance and Counselling (ADCGC); or
    • Bachelor of Rehabilitation Science (B.R.Sc.).
  • Early Intervention Therapist
    • PGDDT / PGDEI / BMR / BRSc / BRT / MRSc / MSc-EI.
  • Trans-Disciplinary Special Educator
    • D.Ed.SE / B.Ed.SE in Hearing Impairment; and/or
    • D.Ed.SE / B.Ed.SE in relevant disability categories as specified (e.g. ID/CP/ASD/MD/Db/SLD).
  • Common Age Criteria
    • Candidate’s age should be 40 years or less on the date of application.
    • Relaxation in upper age limit for ST and SC candidates as per Government of Tripura norms.

Salary/Stipend

  • Honorarium is specified as annual amount for each post:
    • Clinical Psychologist: Rs. 24,600/- per annum.
    • Sr. Prosthetist/Orthotist: Rs. 24,600/- per annum.
    • Audiologist & Sr. Speech Therapist: Rs. 24,600/- per annum.
    • Hearing Assistant/Jr. Speech Therapist: Rs. 17,400/- per annum.
    • Mobility Instructor: Rs. 17,400/- per annum.
    • Multi-Purpose Rehabilitation Worker: Rs. 17,400/- per annum.
    • Vocational Counsellor cum Computer Assistant: Rs. 17,400/- per annum.
    • Early Intervention Therapist: Rs. 17,400/- per annum.
    • Trans-Disciplinary Special Educator: Rs. 17,400/- per annum.
  • Engagement is purely contractual for 11 months; honorarium and conditions are as per DDRC norms for these posts.

Age Limit

  • Maximum age: 40 years or less on the date of application.
  • Age relaxation will be given to ST and SC candidates as per Government norms.
  • No specific mention of minimum age apart from the overall upper limit and usual eligibility for the qualifications.

Application Fee

  • No application fee is mentioned in the recruitment notification.
  • Candidates only need to submit Bio-data and supporting documents through the specified email within the given dates.

Important Dates

Event Date & Time
Start date for receiving applications (by email) 22/01/2026
Last date for receiving applications (by email) 10/02/2026 up to 5:30 PM
Period of contractual engagement 11 months from date of appointment (posts purely contractual)
Written test and interview date & venue To be informed in leading daily newspapers

Selection Process

  • Written test will be held for technical and administrative posts, followed by personal interview.
  • For non-technical post such as Attendant cum Peon cum Messenger (if advertised separately), only personal interview will be held (not part of the current table).
  • Written test pattern:
    • Total 20 marks of Multiple Choice Questions (MCQ).
    • Personal interview carries 5 marks.
    • Total: 25 marks.
  • Written test content: subject-oriented and post-related questions, including General Knowledge.
  • Pass mark: 50% in written test; candidates scoring 50% or more will be selected for personal interview.
  • Number of posts may increase or entire selection process may be cancelled at any time before or after the interview.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the written examination and interview.

General Information/Instructions

  • All posts are purely contractual for a period of eleven months; no claim for regular appointment will be entertained.
  • Applications must be submitted in soft copy (PDF) format by email only, along with recent passport-size colour photograph and self-attested copies of relevant documents.
  • Candidates’ age must be 40 years or less on the date of application; ST/SC candidates will receive age relaxation as per Government norms.
  • Applications received after 5:30 PM on 10/02/2026 will not be accepted; DDRC will not be liable for any delay in submission.
  • Examination date and venue will be notified through leading daily newspapers.
  • The number of posts may increase or the entire process may be cancelled at any stage without assigning reasons.
  • No travelling allowance or dearness allowance is payable for the written test or interview.

How to Apply

  • Prepare Bio-data strictly in the prescribed “BIO-DATA FORMAT” provided in the notification.
  • Fill in all required details including:
    • Name, Father’s/Husband’s name.
    • Permanent address with PIN code (attach address proof).
    • Date of Birth (with proof certificate).
    • Nationality (with proof).
    • Sex and category (UR/ST/SC) with caste certificate (for ST/SC candidates).
    • Contact number and valid email ID.
    • Educational qualifications (name of exam, Board/University, year of passing, percentage of marks).
    • Technical qualifications, registration numbers and experience details, if any, with supporting documents.
  • Attach self-attested copies of:
    • All relevant mark sheets and pass certificates.
    • Address proof and nationality proof.
    • Caste certificate (for ST/SC candidates).
    • Experience and registration certificates where applicable.
  • Scan the complete Bio-data and documents into soft copies (PDF), including a recent passport-size colour photograph.
  • Email the application between 22/01/2026 and 10/02/2026 (up to 5:30 PM) to the official DDRC email ID:
    [email protected]
  • Ensure that all documents are clearly legible; applications received after the deadline will not be accepted.
