Selection Process

  • The recruitment methodology is structured into a two-stage process: a Computer based online written test, called Computer Based Test (CBT) and a Coaching Ability Test (CAT).
  • The final composite weightage in the recruitment methodology shall be 60% for the Coaching Ability Test and 40% for the Computer based online written test.
  • The candidates who fulfil the eligibility criteria shall be called for an online written examination called the Computer Based Test (CBT).
  • The candidates appearing in the written examination i.e CBT shall be shortlisted for the Coaching Ability Test (CAT) in the ratio of 1:3 i.e. the number of candidates to be shortlisted for the coaching ability test will be 3 times the number of vacancies in each sport and in each category.
  • The selection will be made on the basis of merit list prepared by the Selection Committee based on the written Computer Based Test (CBT) and Coaching Ability Test (CAT).
  • Written Examination (CBT): The Computer Based Test (CBT) is designed to assess the candidate’s sports-specific knowledge, understanding of sports sciences and familiarity with general awareness, reasoning and aptitude, which are essential competencies for the post of Assistant Coach.
  • The written test (CBT) shall be for two (02) hours with a total of 100 multiple choice questions (MCQs). There shall be negative marking of one-fourth of the marks assigned to a question for each incorrect answer.
  • The written test shall include the following broad topics: Sports-specific knowledge 65 marks, Sports Science 25 marks, General Awareness, Reasoning, Aptitude 10 marks.
  • Coaching Ability Test: The Coaching Ability Test shall have 60 % weightage in the final merit list. The Coaching Ability Test is designed to measure a candidate’s capacity to apply foundational coaching knowledge in a way that builds a positive, effective, and transformative coaching relationship.
  • The candidates appearing in the Computer Based Test (CBT) will be shortlisted for the coaching ability test in the ratio of 1:3 i.e. the number of candidates to be shortlisted for the coaching ability test should be 3 times the number of vacancies in each sport and in each category.
  • The Coaching Ability Test shall have 40 assessment parameters.
  • Candidates must secure the minimum qualifying marks/standards, if any, as prescribed by SAI in the Coaching Ability Test. Failure to do so shall result in disqualification, irrespective of performance in the CBT.

General Information/Instructions

  • Only Indian Nationals can apply for the above posts.
  • The online test will be held at the Delhi, Lucknow, Chandigarh, Bhopal, Gandhinagar, Mumbai, Kolkata, Bhubaneswar, Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Thiruvananthapuram, Guwahati and Imphal. The number of centres can be reduced or increased, depending upon the number of candidates.
  • Candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC will have to produce the original caste certificate from the competent authority, along with attested copy of the same, at the time of physical verification of documents failing which his candidature shall be cancelled and he will not be admitted for further selection process.
  • OBC Candidates availing reservation will have to produce latest OBC CERTIFICATE with “NON-CREAMY LAYER STATUS” in the prescribed format by the Government of India for Government services at the time of physical verification of the documents.
  • A candidate will be eligible to get the benefit of community reservation only in case the particular caste to which the candidate belongs is included in the list of reserved communities issued by the Central Government.
  • A candidate will be eligible to get the benefit of the Economically Weaker Section reservation only in case the candidate meets the criteria issued by the Central Government and is in possession of the certificate issued anytime during this Financial Year of recruitment shall be treated as valid, but not later than the closing date of the Online Application Form for this recruitment.
  • Candidates seeking reservation/relaxation benefits available for SC/ST/OBC/EWS/Ex-servicemen must ensure that they are entitled to such reservation/relaxation as per eligibility. They should also be in possession of all the requisite certificates in the prescribed format in support of their claim for such benefits by the closing date of the online application.
  • Only those candidates who are fulfilling the eligibility criteria will be allowed to appear in the online test. The candidates shall appear for the Computer Based Test (CBT)/Coaching Ability Test for the above posts at their own expenses.
  • The qualification must be obtained from Govt. Recognized institutions/Universities.
  • Canvassing in any manner and bringing outside influence shall make the candidature liable for rejection.
  • The authority reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates to be called for test and change of exam centre on the basis of any other norms decided by the Authority at a later date.
  • The decision of the selection committee is not liable for challenge and same shall stand final and binding on each candidate.
  • Before applying for the post, the candidate should ensure that he fulfills the eligibility and other norms mentioned in the Advertisement. Furnishing of wrong/false information shall result in disqualification and SAI will not be responsible for any consequence of furnishing of such wrong/false information.
  • The eligibility of new applicants with respect to age, experience etc. will be determined as on the date of advertisement. For Educational qualification, candidates whose result for final year examination is awaited are also allowed to appear in the written examination subject to the condition that they will have to produce the final results before appearing in the further selection process.
  • Candidates employed in Govt. Departments/PSUs/Autonomous bodies must produce No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of verification of documents from their employer. In case, the candidate fails to produce the NOC, his candidature will not be considered.
  • Mere fulfilling of the minimum qualifications and experience will not vest any right on candidates for being called for online exam. No interim correspondence will be entertained.
  • Selected candidates are liable to be posted anywhere in India.
  • Candidature is liable to be cancelled at any stage of recruitment process or after recruitment or joining if any information provided by the candidates is found false or is not found in conformity with eligibility criteria mentioned in the advertisement.
  • Decision of SAI in all matters regarding eligibility of the candidate, the stages at which such scrutiny of eligibility is to be undertaken, the documents is to be produced for the purpose of the conduct of selection and any other matter relating to recruitment will be final and binding on the candidate. SAI reserves the right to fix the standard and specifications for screening and calling the number of candidates for online exam and/or CAT, etc.
  • SAI reserves the right to modify, alter, restrict, enlarge, cancel, or discontinue the recruitment process, without assigning any reason or issuing further notice. No appeal shall lie against such decision.
  • Appointment shall be subject to the candidate being found medically fit as per the standards prescribed by SAI.
  • Inclusion of a candidate’s name in the merit list does not confer any right to appointment unless a formal offer of appointment is issued by SAI.
  • Candidates from Government organisations applying for the post are required to intimate their parent department/office immediately upon submission of the online application, in accordance with the consolidated instructions issued by the Department of Personnel & Training (DoPT).
  • Further notifications/corrigendum in this regard, if any, shall be published on SAI website only. You are advised to visit the SAI website regularly for further updates.
  • All communications, including call letters, examination intimation and selection-related information, shall be made through the registered e-mail ID and/or SAI website only. SAI shall not be responsible for non-receipt of information due to incorrect or inactive e-mail ID.
  • In case of any ambiguity or dispute regarding interpretation of any provision of this notification, the decision of SAI shall be final and binding.
  • Any dispute arising out of or relating to this recruitment shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of courts at Delhi.
  • In case of any dispute, English version of the Employment notice shall prevail and be treated as final.

No application through other mode will be accepted. Candidates are not required to send any hard copy or supporting documents to SAI at the application stage.
  • Before registering/submitting applications on the website the candidates should possess the following: a) Valid E-mail ID: The e-mail ID entered in the online application form should remain active until the recruitment process is completed. No request for change in the e-mail ID shall be entertained once it has been registered. b) While applying online candidate should keep the scanned copy of their passport size color photograph and their signature in digital format for uploading with the online application. The files must be in jpg or jpeg file/format only, with photograph not exceeding 80kb and signature not exceeding 30kb .

  • After applying online, candidate is required to download the registration slip generated by the System with unique registration number and password, which may be retained for future reference.
  • Following documents are compulsory to be uploaded with the application:- (a) Certificate for the proof of age (b) Any valid ID proof issued by the Government of India (c) Certificates to support the essential qualification (d) Certificates of SC/ST/OBC/Ex-serviceman/EWS/meritorious sports person, etc. issued by Competent Authority for availing relaxation.   • Consolidated Remuneration: ₹35,000/- fixed per month (no other allowances like DA, HRA, accommodation, medical, etc.)

Objectives & Roles

Young Professionals will support DAIC's mission as a Centre of Excellence for research, analysis, and policy-making in socio-economic transformation, reducing inequalities, and Buddhist studies. Key areas include:

  • High-quality research on social and economic issues
  • Developing national databases and disseminating knowledge
  • Policy review, research, and advocacy
  • Acting as a think tank for government, corporates, and NGOs
  • Public involvement in research
  • Training/orientation for scholars and government personnel
  • Research on Dr. Ambedkar's vision, sustainable development, livelihoods
  • International collaboration with knowledge hubs

Terms of Reference (ToR) will be specific, measurable, results-based, and time-bound as part of the contract.

Educational Qualifications

Essential:

  • Graduate from any recognized University with minimum 55% marks
  • Minimum one year experience in a reputed firm / Government of India organization, etc.

Desirable:

  • Expertise in socio-economic transformation and Buddhist studies
  • Knowledge of MS Office, media, IT, LAN, software/hardware, latest technologies
  • Good communication skills in English and Hindi
  • Knowledge of GeM, CPP Portal, and GFR Rules

Leave & Other Conditions

  • 8 days leave per year (pro-rated from joining date; no carry-forward; no remuneration for absence beyond this)
  • Working hours same as regular DAIC employees (no extra pay for overtime/holidays)
  • Confidentiality required; no publishing/sharing information without sanction
  • One month's notice or salary in lieu for resignation
  • Automatic termination for unauthorized absence of 8 continuous days
  • Income Tax deducted at source

How to Apply & Attend

This is a walk-in-interview process (no online application mentioned). Bring on the interview day:

  • 2 sets of self-attested photocopies of:
    • Application form (proforma provided in the circular)
    • Identity proof
    • Updated CV
    • Educational qualifications certificates
    • Experience documents
    • Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwD, if applicable)

Selected candidates undergo 49 weeks of training at OTA Gaya starting October 2026, with stipend of ₹56,100 per month during training and pay scale of Lieutenant ₹56,100-₹1,77,500 plus allowances upon commissioning. No written exam; selection via shortlisting, SSB interviews, and medical tests. No guarantee of permanent employment beyond SSC tenure (initial 10 years, extendable).

Note: The vacancies mentioned are tentative and may be changed or re-appropriated by the Army depending on organizational requirements during any stage of the selection process.

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

  • Essential Qualification: B.E./B.Tech degree in the notified Engineering streams from recognized Universities/Institutions by an Act of Central or State Legislature in India or other educational institutions established by an Act of parliament or declared to be deemed as Universities/Autonomous Universities under UGC Act 1956, IIT Act 1961, AICTE Act 1987, NITSER Act 2007 and IIIT Act 2024.
  • For Final Year Students: Candidates studying in the final year of Engineering degree course are eligible to apply. They must submit proof of passing Engineering Degree Examination alongwith marksheets of all semesters/years by 01 October 2026 and produce the Engineering Degree Certificate within 12 weeks from the date of commencement of training at PCTA.
  • Important Note: Candidates with graduation from foreign countries are not permitted to apply for this course.
  • Stream Requirement: Only the Engineering streams and their acceptable equivalent streams as strictly notified in the official notification will be accepted. Any variation between the nomenclature of Engineering stream on degree parchment/marksheet and online application will result in cancellation of candidature.

Nationality

  • A citizen of India, or
  • A subject of Nepal, or
  • A person of Indian origin who has migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka and East African countries with the intention of permanently settling in India (certificate of eligibility required)

Marital Status

  • Only unmarried male candidates are eligible to apply
  • Candidates will neither be allowed to marry during the period of training nor be allowed to live with Parents/Guardians
  • A candidate who marries subsequent to the date of application, though successful at SSB interview and medical examination, will not be inducted for training

Physical Standards

  • 2.4 Km Run: 10 Minutes 30 Seconds
  • Push-Up: 40
  • Pull-Up: 06
  • Sit-Up: 30
  • Squats: Two sets of 30 repetitions
  • Lunges: Two sets of 10 repetitions
  • Swimming: Should know fundamentals of swimming

Salary/Stipend

During Training Period

  • Stipend: ₹56,100 per month (Starting pay in Level-10 of Pay Matrix)
  • Pay and allowances will be paid after successful completion of training

After Commissioning - Pay Structure

  • Lieutenant (Level-10): ₹56,100 - ₹1,77,500
  • Captain (Level-10B): ₹61,300 - ₹1,93,900
  • Major (Level-11): ₹69,400 - ₹2,07,200
  • Lieutenant Colonel (Level-12A): ₹1,21,200 - ₹2,12,400
  • Colonel (Level-13): ₹1,30,600 - ₹2,15,900
  • Brigadier (Level-13A): ₹1,39,600 - ₹2,17,600
  • Major General (Level-14): ₹1,44,200 - ₹2,18,200
  • Lieutenant General HAG Scale (Level-15): ₹1,82,200 - ₹2,24,100
  • Lieutenant General HAG+ Scale (Level-16): ₹2,05,400 - ₹2,24,400
  • VCOAS/Army Commander/Lieutenant General (NFSG) (Level-17): ₹2,25,000 (Fixed)
  • COAS (Level-18): ₹2,50,000 (Fixed)

Other Allowances

  • Military Service Pay (MSP): ₹15,500 per month (Fixed) - for officers from Lieutenant to Brigadier rank
  • Dearness Allowance: Admissible at the same rates and under same conditions as applicable to civilian personnel from time to time
  • Para Reserve Allowance: ₹2,625 per month
  • Technical Allowance (Tier-I): ₹3,000 per month
  • Technical Allowance (Tier-II): ₹4,500 per month
  • Transport Allowance (TPTA): ₹7,200 + DA (Higher TPTA Cities) / ₹3,600 + DA (Other Places)
  • Dress Allowance: ₹20,000 per year
  • Children Education Allowance: ₹2,250 per month per child for two eldest surviving children (Nursery to 12th class)
  • Hostel Subsidy: ₹6,750 per month per child for two eldest surviving children (Nursery to 12th class)
  • Ration in Kind: Provided in peace and field areas
  • Field Area Allowances: Risk and Hardship allowances depending upon rank and area of posting (maximum up to ₹42,500)

Additional Benefits

  • CTC (Cost to Company): Approximately ₹17-18 lakh per annum (excluding free medical cover and travel to hometown once a year)
  • Army Group Insurance Fund (AGIF): Insurance coverage of ₹1.25 Crore
  • Academic Degree: Post Graduate Diploma in Defence Management and Strategic Studies upon successful completion of training

Age Limit (as on 01 October 2026)

  • Minimum Age: 20 years
  • Maximum Age: 27 years
  • Date of Birth: Candidates must be born between 01 October 1999 and 30 September 2006 (both dates inclusive)
  • Age Proof: The date of birth recorded in the Matriculation/Secondary School Examination Certificate or equivalent examination certificate on the date of submission of application will only be accepted. No other document relating to age will be accepted and no subsequent request for its change will be considered or granted.

Application Fee

  • No application fee mentioned in the official notification
  • Candidates need to apply online through the official website only

Important Dates

Event Date
Online Application Start Date 07 January 2026 at 1500 hours
Online Application Closing Date 05 February 2026 at 1500 hours
Publication of Cut-off % for Shortlisting First week of March 2026
SSB Interview Period April - June 2026 (Five day SSB)
Choice for SSB Dates and Centre Open Two weeks in March 2026
Proof of Passing Engineering Degree Submission Deadline (for final year students) 01 October 2026
Training Commencement October 2026
Training Completion September 2027

Selection Process

  • Step 1 - Online Application: Candidates must apply online through www.joinindianarmy.nic.in
  • Step 2 - Shortlisting: Applications will be shortlisted based on cumulative percentage of marks obtained by candidates upto final semester/year. Cut-off will be applied for each Engineering stream based on vacancy to call up ratio.
  • Step 3 - Allotment of Selection Centre: After shortlisting, centre allotment will be intimated via email. Candidates will select their SSB dates on first come first serve basis.
  • Step 4 - SSB Interview: Two-stage selection procedure conducted at one of the Selection Centres - Prayagraj (UP), Bhopal (MP), Bengaluru (Karnataka) and Jalandhar Cantt (Punjab). Duration is maximum five days.
  • Step 5 - Medical Examination: Candidates who get recommended after Stage-2 of SSB will undergo medical examination. Validity of SSB medical examination is 270 days.
  • Step 6 - Merit List: Merit list will be prepared engineering stream/subject wise based on SSB interview marks.
  • Step 7 - Joining Letter: Candidates in merit list who come within stipulated stream-wise vacancies and are medically fit will be issued joining letters for pre-commissioning training at PCTA, subject to meeting all eligibility criteria.

Note: Mere qualifying at SSB interview does not confirm final selection. Selection is based on merit, medical fitness and availability of vacancies.

General Information/Instructions

  • Type of Commission: Short Service Commission (SSC)
  • Training Duration: 49 weeks at Officers Training Academy, Gaya, Bihar
  • Rank After Training: Lieutenant
  • Commission Grant: Selected candidates will be granted Short Service Commission on probation in the rank of Lieutenant from the date of commencement of the course
  • Ante Date Seniority: One year ante date seniority from the date of commission will be granted to Engineering Graduates
  • Tenure of Engagement: Officers shall be liable to serve for ten years
  • Option for Release:
    • First option - After 5 years of service (with Army HQ approval)
    • Second option - After 10 years of service
    • Third option - After 14 years of service
  • Option for Permanent Commission: Officers desirous of seeking Permanent Commission may be considered in the 10th year of service based on eligibility and suitability
  • Service Extension: Ten year service tenure may be extendable by further four years subject to eligibility
  • Arms/Services Allocation: Primary Arms/Services are Corps of Engineers, Corps of Signals and Corps of Electronics and Mechanical Engineers. Candidates may get commissioned in other Arms/Services as well based on organizational requirements
  • Training Cost: Entire cost of training at PCTA is at Government expense
  • Cost Recovery: Candidates withdrawn from training academy for personal reasons will be liable to refund cost of training at ₹16,260 per week (as on 2023) or as notified from time to time
  • Promotion Criteria: Promotion to Captain after 2 years, Major after 6 years, Lieutenant Colonel after 13 years of reckonable commissioned service
  • Liability of Service: Officers may be granted commission in any Arm/Service and will be liable for service in any part of the world
  • Marriage Restriction: Candidates must not marry until they complete full training at Officers Training Academy. Marriage during training will result in discharge and recovery of expenditure

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Visit the official website www.joinindianarmy.nic.in
  • Step 2: Click on 'Officer Entry Apply/Login' and then click 'Registration' (if not already registered)
  • Step 3: Fill the online registration form carefully after reading instructions
  • Step 4: After registration, click on 'Apply Online' under Dashboard
  • Step 5: A page 'Officers Selection - Eligibility' will open. Click 'Apply' shown against Technical Graduate Course
  • Step 6: Fill Application Form with details under various segments - Personal information, Communication details, Education details and details of previous SSB
  • Step 7: Click 'Save & Continue' each time before moving to next segment
  • Step 8: After filling all details, review on 'Summary of your information' page
  • Step 9: After ascertaining correctness of all details, click on 'Submit'
  • Step 10: Take out two copies of application having Roll Number, 30 minutes after final closure of online application

Documents Required for SSB Interview

  • One copy of printout of application duly signed and affixed with self-attested photograph
  • Matriculation/Secondary School Examination Certificate or equivalent certificate and Marksheet issued by concerned Board of Education
  • 12th class marksheet and certificate or equivalent certificate/Diploma marksheet and certificate (for Diploma holders)
  • Engineering Degree/Provisional Degree issued by recognized university (Provisional Degree should not be more than six months old at time of joining Academy)
  • Marksheets of all semesters/years
  • Certificate issued by Controller of Examination/Registrar regarding formula for conversion of CGPA/Grades into marks
  • Certificate regarding cumulative percentage of marks upto 6th semester/3rd year (for final year appearing candidates)
  • Certificate from Principal/Head of Institution stating candidate is studying in final year and result will be declared by 01 October 2026 (for final year students)
  • Declaration by final year candidate about submission of degree proof by 01 October 2026
  • Documents related to civil verification
  • All original certificates must be carried for verification (DIGILOCKER certificates not accepted)

Important Notes

  • Applications will only be accepted online - no offline applications
  • Candidates must submit only one online application. Multiple applications will result in cancellation of candidature
  • No changes to details submitted in online application can be made after closure of application
  • CGPA/Grades must be converted into marks as per formulae adopted by concerned University
  • Candidate's name/Parent's name/Date of Birth in profile and online application must match Matriculation Certificate exactly
  • Aadhaar number and Matriculation Certificate are mandatory for registration on website
  • Candidates serving in Armed Forces must inform their Commanding Officer and get application countersigned
  • No hard copy needs to be sent to Directorate General of Recruiting

General Information / Instructions

  • IREL (India) Limited was incorporated on 18 August, 1950 under Indian Companies Act, 1913 as a joint venture with the then Government of Travancore, Cochin and in 1963, IREL (India) Limited became a full-fledged Central Public Sector Undertaking. Its main objective is to emerge as a significant contributor to the global clean energy mission by providing high-quality performance-enhancing materials and to maintain a global reputation and sustainably grow the core business of heavy minerals and rare earths. IREL is a Schedule-'B' Mini Ratna Category-1 CPSE in Minerals and Metals sector under the administrative control of Department of Atomic Energy.
  • The company is a MoU signing company with its administrative ministry. The company has been rated as Excellent under MoU, consecutively for the last 7 years. Its Registered and Corporate Office is in Mumbai, Maharashtra.
  • The company employed 717 regular employees Executives-229, Non-Unionized Supervisors NUS-85 and Non-Executives-403 as on 31.03.2025.
  • The authorized and paid-up capital was Rs.1000 crores and Rs.345.46 crores respectively as on 31.03.2025.
  • The shareholding of the Government of India in the company is 100% as on 31.03.2025.
  • Director (Marketing) is a member of Board of Directors and reports to the Chairman & Managing Director of the company. He/She is responsible for supervising the commercial marketing activities, marketing planning, product technical services, quality control and quality system functions of the organization.
  • The applicant must, on the date of application, as well as on the date of interview, be employed in a regular capacity – and not in a contractual/ad-hoc capacity – in one of the following:- (a) Central Public Sector Enterprise (CPSE) (including a full-time functional Director in the Board of a CPSE); (b) Central Government Group 'A' officers including the Armed Forces of the Union and All India Services; (c) State Public Sector Enterprise (SPSE) where the annual turnover is *Rs.1,000 crore or more; (d) Private Sector in company where the annual turnover is *Rs.1,000 crore or more. Preference would be given to candidates from listed Companies. (* The average audited annual turnover of three financial years preceding the calendar year in which the post is advertised shall be considered for applying the approved limits.)
  • Eligible Scale of Pay (i) Rs. 6250-7475 (IDA) Pre 01/01/1992 (ii) Rs. 8520-10050 (IDA) Post 01/01/1992 (iii) Rs. 18500-23900 (IDA) Post 01/01/1997 (iv) Rs. 43200-66000 (IDA) Post 01/01/2007 (v) Rs. 100000-260000 (IDA) Post 01.01.2017 (vi) Rs. 14300-18300 (CDA) Pre-Revised (vii) Rs. 37400-67000 + GP 8700 (CDA) (viii) Rs. 123100-215900 (Level 13) CDA The minimum length of service required in the eligible scale will be one year for internal candidates and two years for others, as on the date of vacancy.
  • (b) (i) Group 'A' officers of the Central Government including All India Services (AIS) and Autonomous Bodies, etc. should be holding a post of the level of Director in Govt. of India or carrying equivalent scale of pay on substantive basis on the date of application. (ii) Applicants from Public Sector Banks/ Financial Institutions should be holding at Board level or at least a post of the level immediately below the Board level for one year on the date of application. (iii) Applicants from the Armed forces of the Union should be holding a post of the level of Brigadier in the Army or equivalent rank in Navy/Air Force on the date of application. (c) Applicants from State Public Sector Enterprises/ Private Sector should be working at Board level position or at least a post of the level immediately below the Board level on the date of application.
  • Central Government Officers, including those of the Armed Forces of the Union and the All India Services and officers from Public Sector Banks/ Financial Institutions/ Autonomous Bodies etc., will be eligible for consideration only on immediate absorption basis.
  • The appointment shall be for a period of five years from the date of joining or upto the date of superannuation or until further orders, whichever is earlier.
  • The cadre controlling authority/competent authority should forward applications of only those applicants who are clear from vigilance angle, as per the guidelines issued by DPE from time to time, latest being issued vide OM No. 15(2)/2001-DPE(GM)-FTS-4199 dated 28.10.2025. The vigilance profile, in the prescribed proforma should also invariably be attached with the application form.
  • An applicant has to give an undertaking as a part of the application that he/she will join the post, if selected. If an applicant does not give such undertaking, the application would be rejected.
  • 1. For candidates from Central Government including the Armed Forces of the Union and All India Services and officers from Public Sector Banks/Financial Institutions/ Autonomous Bodies etc: (a) The appointment is on immediate absorption basis. (b) If a candidate conveys his/her unwillingness to join after the interview is held, he/she would be debarred for a period of two years from the date of interview, for being considered for a Board level post in any CPSE. (c) Further, if a candidate conveys his/her unwillingness to join after the issue of offer of appointment, he/she would be debarred for a period of two years from the date of offer of appointment for being considered for a Board level post in any CPSE.
  • 2. For candidates from CPSE a. If a candidate conveys his/her unwillingness to join after the interview is held, he/she would be debarred for a period of two years from the date of interview, for being considered for a Board level post in any CPSE other than the one to which the candidate belongs. b. Further, if a candidate conveys his/her unwillingness to join after the issue of offer of appointment, he/she would be debarred for a period of two years from the date of offer of appointment for being considered for a Board level post in any CPSE other than the one to which the candidate belongs.
  • 3. For candidates from SPSE/ Private Sector a. If a candidate conveys his/her unwillingness to join after the interview is held, he/she would be debarred for a period of two years from the date of interview, for being considered for a Board level post in any CPSE. b. Further, if a candidate conveys his/her unwillingness to join after the issue of offer of appointment, he/she would be debarred for a period of two years from the date of offer of appointment for being considered for a Board level post in any CPSE.
  • 4. In the above cases, no request for relaxation or otherwise would be entertained.
  • Total timeline for receipt of applications (complete in all respect) in PESB is 30 days from the date of uploading the Job Description on website of PESB. Last date for submission of applications by the applicants is by 03:00 PM on 10.02.2026. Last date for nodal officers to forward applications to PESB is by 05:00 PM on 19.02.2026. No application shall be entertained under any circumstances after the stipulated date. Incomplete applications and applications received after the stipulated date shall be REJECTED.
  • Applications are to be addressed to Secretary, Public Enterprises Selection Board, Public Enterprises Bhawan, BlockNo. 14, CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi-110003.
  • ALL CORRESPONDENCE WITH THE PUBLIC ENTERPRISES SELECTION BOARD SHOULD BE ADDRESSED TO SECRETARY, PUBLIC ENTERPRISES SELECTION BOARD ONLY.

  • The applicants should submit their applications through proper channel as follows: (a) Group 'A' Central Government Officers, including those of the Armed Forces of the Union and All India Services; through Cadre Controlling authority. (b) Officers from Public Sector Banks/ Financial Institutions/ Autonomous Bodies, etc. through their Administrative Ministry/ Department of the Govt. of India. (c) CMDs/MDs/Functional Directors in CPSE: through the concerned Administrative Ministry; (d) Below Board level in CPSE: through the concerned CPSE; (e) CMDs/MDs/Functional Directors in State PSE: through the concerned Administrative Secretary and Cadre Controlling Authority, if any, of the State Government; (f) Below Board level in SPSE: through the concerned SPSE. (e) Relevant Jobs handled in the past with details.
  • (a) fill up the Application Form online only against this Job Description on the website of PESB - https://pesb.gov.in/ and thereafter forward it online, as specified in para V(1);
  • Or (b) fill up the Application Form online only against this Job Description on the website of PESB - https://pesb.gov.in/, take a printout and send it offline, as specified in para V(1).

Company Name Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR)
Post Name Consultant Finance, Consultant Technical (Non-Medical), Young Professional-I (Admin)
No of Posts 3
Qualification Any Graduate, B.Tech/B.E, Any Post Graduate, CA, ICWA, M.Pharma, M.E/M.Tech, MBA/PGDM
Age Limit 35 to 70 years
Salary Rs. 30,000/- to Rs. 1,80,000/-
Walk in Date 28, 30 January 2026
Official Website https://www.icmr.gov.in

Vacancy Details

Post Name No of Vacancies
Consultant-Finance 1
Consultant-Technical (Non-Medical) 1
Young Professional-I (Admin) 1

Eligibility Criteria

  • For Consultant-Finance:
    • MBA-Finance/CA/ICWA with at least 10 yrs experience in Finance & Accounts/Investments/Project financing / regulatory affairs with Govt. Dept /PSU/Autonomous Bodies.
    • Knowledge of MS-Office and Commercial accounting software is must.
  • For Consultant-Technical (Non-Medical):
    • Post-graduate in Science / B.Tech/ M.Tech/ M. Pharma with at least 10 yrs. experience of working (PhD will be considered as 4 yrs experience) in R&D.
    • Working in Govt research scheme / projects with knowledge of MS-Office will be given preference.
  • For Young Professional-I (Admin):
    • Graduate in any discipline with minimum 55% marks with one year experience, knowledge of IT application, MS Office will be given preference.
    • Minimum one year of post qualification experience in noting and drafting, presentation preparation and co-ordination.
  • Desirable Experience (Young Professional-I): Knowledge of IT applications, virtual meeting platforms and computer skills (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint etc.)

Salary/ Stipend

  • Consultant Finance & Consultant Technical (Non-Medical): Rs. 1,00,000-1,80,000/- per month (Consolidated) - This will be decided by the Selection Committee on the basis of Educational Qualification, Experience and performance in the interview
  • Young Professional-I: Rs. 30,000 / Month. YP is not entitled for benefits like HRA, Provident Fund, Leave Travel Concession, Medical claim, Child Care Allowance etc.

Age Limit

  • Consultant Finance & Consultant Technical (Non-Medical): 40 to 70 years
  • Young Professional-I: Not more than 35 Years as on date of walk-in interview. Age relaxation will be applicable as per ICMR guidelines.

Important Dates

Walk-in Interview for Consultant Finance & Consultant Technical 28 January 2026
Walk-in Interview for Young Professional-I 30 January 2026

Selection Process

  • Short-listing for the interview will be based on educational qualifications, age, and relevant experience.
  • If required, a written test or assignment may be conducted prior to the interview.
  • Final selection will be based on performance in the interview.

General Information / Instructions

  • The positions are purely temporary and co-terminus with the project requirements.
  • ICMR is not obligated to fill all advertised positions and may withdraw, cancel, or modify the process at any time.
  • The working hours will be same as regular employees of ICMR. No extra benefit will be allowed for working beyond office hours. Unauthorized absence for a continuous period of 08 days without valid reasons shall lead to automatic termination of the engagement.
  • Leave Entitlement: Consultant - Paid leave of absence may be allowed at the rate of 1.5 days for each completed month of service. Young Professional-I - Eligible for 08 days leave in a calendar year on pro-rate basis. 02 Restricted Holidays as per the rules of Government of India / ICMR.
  • Candidates must bring all original documents for verification and submit two sets of self-attested copies, a duly filled and signed application form with photograph, and resume.
  • Incomplete / unsigned applications or submission of false / incorrect information will result in rejection.
  • No TA / DA shall be paid for attending the interview or joining the post.
  • Candidates in regular service under any Central / State Government, Autonomous Body, Department or PSU are not eligible to apply.
  • Any addendum or corrigendum will be published only on the ICMR website. Applicants must visit https://www.icmr.gov.in regularly for updates.

How to Apply

  • Candidates who meet the prescribed age limit and possess the required qualifications and experience may appear for the Walk-in interview.
  • Reporting Time: 09:30 AM
  • Venue: ICMR Headquarters, New Delhi
  • Candidates who do not report on the specified date and time will not be allowed to participate in the interview under any circumstances.
  • Bring original documents, two sets of self-attested copies, filled application form (prescribed format), resume, and recent passport-size photograph.

Ministry of Ayush Young Professional 2026 Vacancy Details

The total number of Young Professionals proposed to be engaged on contract basis in the Ministry of Ayush is 06, subject to changes as decided by the Ministry. These positions form a panel of Young Professionals for various functional areas in the Ministry on a purely contractual basis.

Eligibility Criteria for Ministry of Ayush Young Professional 2026

1. Educational Qualification

Candidates must meet the following qualification requirements:

  • Essential: Bachelor degree in a relevant subject or technical qualifications such as B.Tech, MBA or equivalent in relevant field/subject.
  • Desirable: Masters / M.Phil / Ph.D or MD with research experience, published papers and working experience in the relevant field.
  • The candidate should have good command over writing English or Hindi, good working knowledge of technology-based skills on the computer and ability to work on ICT applications.
  • Candidates should possess strong communication and interpersonal skills.

2. Age Limit

The age conditions for Young Professional engagement are:

  • Maximum Age: Below 32 years of age as on 1st July 2026 (01/07/2026).
  • Age Relaxation: Criteria may be relaxed in exceptional cases based on justification in the interest of Government with the approval of Secretary (Ayush), as per guidelines.
  • Age calculation date: 01 July of the year of advertisement (01/07/2026).

3. Other Eligibility & Attributes

  • Young Professionals are expected to provide high quality professional inputs in areas like AYUSH Systems, Budget, Finance, AYUSH Education, Public Health & Infrastructure, Commerce & Trade, Marketing & Export Promotion of Medicinal Plants, Skill Development, IT, Media and related domains.
  • Candidates must demonstrate proven academic credentials, professional achievements and leadership qualities.

Selection Process for Ministry of Ayush Young Professional 2026

The selection of Young Professionals will follow the procedure and guidelines notified by the Ministry of Ayush:

  • Short-listing of applications based on eligibility criteria and requirements of various divisions as per Terms of Reference.
  • Short-listed candidates will undergo the recruitment process as per Ministry guidelines and requirements.
  • Final selection will be based on merit as decided by the Selection Committee.
  • Applications will be scrutinized by a Screening Committee; shortlisted applications will be sent to concerned divisions to recommend a panel (with waitlist, if required).
  • A Performance Appraisal Board (PAB) chaired by Joint Secretary (Admn.) will appraise work and performance for extension beyond the first year.

Note: Ministry of Ayush reserves the right to accept or reject any application without assigning any reason and to cancel the advertisement at any stage.

Application Fee for Ministry of Ayush Young Professional 2026

  • The notification does not mention any application fee for Young Professional engagement.

How to Apply for Ministry of Ayush Young Professional Recruitment 2026?

Interested and eligible applicants can apply for Ministry of Ayush Young Professional 2026 by following these steps:

  1. Download or use the enclosed application format (Annexure-II) provided with the notification.
  2. Fill the application form strictly in the enclosed format, providing all personal details, educational qualifications and professional experience.
  3. Prepare a CV and attach self-attested copies of relevant documents supporting qualifications and experience.
  4. Place the completed application form, CV and relevant documents in an envelope.
  5. Superscribe the envelope clearly with: “Application for the assignment of Young Professional in Ministry of Ayush”.
  6. Send or submit the application to:
    Establishment-II Section, Ministry of Ayush, Ayush Bhawan, GPO Complex, INA, New Delhi – 110023.
  7. Ensure that the application reaches the above address by 08 February 2026 till 5:30 PM.

AAI Co-Pilot (P2) 2026 Vacancy Details

The Airports Authority of India, Flight Inspection Unit (FIU) at Safdarjung Airport, New Delhi, invites applications from eligible Indian nationals for the following position on contract basis:

Position No. of Posts Base
Co-Pilot (P2) – Beechcraft B350/B360 02 Flight Inspection Unit, Safdarjung Airport, New Delhi

AAI FIU operates four aircraft (Dornier Do-228, SKA B-350, SKA B-360) equipped with Fully Automatic Flight Inspection System (AFIS) for flight calibration services of CNS facilities such as ILS (up to Cat-III), VOR, DME, NDB, VGSI, RADAR, GBAS/RNAV/RNP/LPV procedures, ADS-B etc.

Eligibility Criteria for AAI Co-Pilot (P2) 2026

1. Educational Qualification & License Requirements

  • 10+2 (with Physics & Mathematics) from a recognized board/university.
  • Current valid CPL issued by DGCA, India with:
    • Minimum of 500 flying hours on multi-engine.
    • Minimum of 1000 total flying hours.
  • Current FRTOL issued by DGCA, India.
  • Current IR Endorsement.
  • Current RTR (A) or RTR (P) or RTR (C) issued by WPC, Ministry of Communication, India.
  • Current Class-1 medical fitness certificate issued by DGCA, India.
  • Valid English Language Proficiency (ELP).
  • Candidates should be in possession of an Indian current passport; if not available, proof of submission of passport application must be attached.

2. Age Limit

  • Maximum age for engagement of Co-Pilot: up to 60 years, as per DGCA India rules (age calculated as on 01/02/2026).
  • Co-Pilot can be re-engaged up to maximum age of 65 years, subject to license currency and fulfillment of DGCA requirements.

3. Other Eligibility Conditions

  • Data provided in the application must be discrete and supported by self-certified documents/certificates.
  • Candidates employed in Government/Semi Government/Public Sector Undertakings must bring a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer at the time of interview.

Selection Process for AAI Co-Pilot (P2) 2026

The selection process includes:

  • Scrutiny of applications and supporting documents submitted by email.
  • Shortlisting of eligible candidates based on laid down qualification and experience criteria.
  • Intimation to shortlisted candidates via email regarding personal interview schedule (venue, date and time).
  • Personal interview of shortlisted candidates at the stipulated venue, as intimated by AAI FIU.

The shortlisted candidates will be considered for engagement on fixed term contract basis. Candidature is purely provisional and liable to rejection at any stage if eligibility criteria or document authenticity is not satisfied. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature.

Application Fee for AAI Co-Pilot (P2) 2026

  • The advertisement does not mention any application fee for Co-Pilot (P2) recruitment.

How to Apply for AAI Co-Pilot (P2) Recruitment 2026?

Eligible candidates can apply for AAI Co-Pilot (P2) Beechcraft B350/B360 2026 by following these steps:

  1. Download the application format (Annexure-I) from the AAI website as given in the advertisement.
  2. Fill the application form carefully with all required details including personal information, qualifications, license details, flying hours and experience.
  3. Paste a recent color passport size photograph in the designated space.
  4. Attach colored scanned copies of all supporting documents, including:
    • Proof of date of birth and educational qualifications.
    • Licenses/Endorsements and updated flying logbook.
    • Current Class-1 Medical Fitness Certificate issued by DGCA, India.
    • Current valid ATPL/CPL issued by DGCA, India.
    • Current FRTOL issued by DGCA, India.
    • IR Endorsement.
    • Current RTR (A) or RTR (P) or RTR (C) issued by WPC, Ministry of Communication, India.
    • Valid ELP.
    • Valid Passport, or proof of application if passport not yet issued.
  5. Submit the duly filled application along with colored scanned copies of all supporting documents by email to:
    • [email protected]
    • [email protected]
  6. Ensure that the complete application is submitted on or before 11/02/2026. Incomplete, ambiguous or late applications are liable to be rejected.
  7. For queries, candidates may write to [email protected] or [email protected].

Important Dates for AAI Co-Pilot (P2) 2026

Event Date
Age Calculation Reference Date 01/02/2026 (maximum age as per DGCA rules)
Application End Date 11/02/2026
Interview Date To be intimated by email to shortlisted candidates

Instructions & Terms for AAI Co-Pilot (P2) 2026

  • Contract period is 3 years, extendable for another 2 years (year-on-year basis) subject to satisfactory performance and mutual consent.
  • Annual increment of 5% may be allowed on the negotiable monthly package.
  • During training period, stipend of Rs. 50,000 per month will be paid; full remuneration starts from commencement of supervisor line flying (SLF).
  • Aviation Personal Accident (PA) / Loss of License (LOL) insurance premium will be borne by AAI as per guidelines, with current cover of Rs. 50 lakhs each.
  • Co-Pilot must make himself/herself available for license and medical renewals, IR/PPC and simulator checks as scheduled; failure makes the pilot ineligible to draw contracted amount on pro rata basis until currency is restored.
  • AAI will arrange hotel accommodation and transportation at outstations during calibration duties as per entitlement of Joint General Manager, AAI; accommodation at base station (Delhi) is to be arranged by the Co-Pilot.
  • Co-Pilot will be eligible for 12 days casual leave and 18 days sick leave in a calendar year; un-availed leave cannot be carried forward or encashed and excess leave attracts pro rata deduction.
  • No Gratuity, CPF or medical facility will be provided by AAI to Co-Pilot or dependents.
  • Contract can be terminated by either side by giving 6 months’ notice; AAI can also terminate if Co-Pilot remains absent continuously for more than 15 days beyond entitled leave.
  • During contract, Co-Pilot must make himself/herself available for AAI calibration duties and related jobs and cannot engage elsewhere without approval of Executive Director (FIU) for license currency or additional flying hours.

Salary/Stipend & Training for AAI Co-Pilot (P2) 2026

  • Monthly Package: Negotiable, starting from Rs. 2.50 lakhs per month, including assured flying allowance of 50 hours; overtime flying allowance for hours beyond 50 per month as per guidelines.
  • Annual Increment: 5% on negotiable monthly package, subject to AAI policy.
  • Training & Bonds (Initial Currency / Non-rated Pilots):
    • Initial currency training on type and associated expenditure arranged by AAI, subject to execution of a 3-year bond; costs recovered on reducing basis @ Rs. 1 lakh per month.
    • Non-rated co-pilots on type, if selected, will undergo DGCA-approved training arranged by AAI against suitable bank security and must execute a 3-year bond. If training is not successfully completed, repeat training at own cost is required; otherwise AAI recovers expenses from bank security.
    • Training & associated TA/DA expenses recovered @ Rs. 1.5 lakhs per month after attaining initial currency.
    • For IR/PPC simulator training, co-pilot must execute a bond to serve AAI for minimum 1 year from completion of simulator training; fees/charges paid by AAI against bank guarantee/postdated cheque.
    • Stipend during training: Rs. 50,000 per month; full remuneration from start of SLF.
  • Sustenance Allowance: 50% of monthly hiring charges will be paid during suspension period on pro rata basis; in case of adverse outcome, this allowance must be returned by the co-pilot.

  • Experience for COO: Minimum 8 years of overall experience in the IT industry, start-up ecosystem as co-founder/founder/CxO and/or as an enabler of Start-up, Innovation & entrepreneurship ecosystem by virtue of managing/leading/scaling reputed Innovation & start-up promoting organizations/ incubators/ accelerators/ centres-of-entrepreneurship/ entrepreneurship development cells / mentoring organization etc

Selection Process for CSIR-NPL Recruitment 2026

The selection for CSIR-NPL vacancy 2026 will be conducted through following stages:

Stage 1 - Screening by Committee

  • Applications will be scrutinized by duly constituted Screening Committee
  • Committee will adopt its own criteria for shortlisting candidates
  • Only shortlisted candidates called for Trade Test

Stage 2 - Trade Test (Qualifying Nature)

  • Trade test in relevant trade/discipline
  • Schedule: May/June 2026
  • Nature: Qualifying test
  • Minimum threshold marks to be determined by Selection Committee
  • Only candidates qualifying in Trade Test will be called for Written Examination

Stage 3 - Competitive Written Examination

Mode: OMR Based or Computer Based Objective Type Multiple Choice Examination

Medium: Questions in both English and Hindi (except English Language questions)

Standard: Diploma/Graduation Level

Total Questions: 200

Total Time: 3 hours

Examination Pattern:

Paper-I (Mental Ability Test) - 1 Hour, Qualifying

  • Questions: 50
  • Maximum Marks: 100 (2 marks per correct answer)
  • Negative Marking: None
  • Topics: General Intelligence, Quantitative Aptitude, Reasoning, Problem Solving, Situational Judgement

Paper-II - 30 Minutes

  • General Awareness: 25 questions, 75 marks (3 marks each), 1 negative mark per wrong answer
  • English Language: 25 questions, 75 marks (3 marks each), 1 negative mark per wrong answer
  • Total: 50 questions, 150 marks

Paper-III (Concerned Subject) - 90 Minutes

  • Questions: 100
  • Maximum Marks: 300 (3 marks per correct answer)
  • Negative Marking: 1 mark per wrong answer
  • Topics: Concerned subject as per post code applied

Merit List Preparation:

  • Paper-I is qualifying in nature
  • Paper-II and Paper-III evaluated only for candidates securing minimum threshold marks in Paper-I
  • Final merit based on performance in Paper-II and Paper-III combined
  • Minimum threshold marks (Cut-off) will be notified before written exam

Tie Resolution (in order of precedence):

  1. Higher marks in concerned subject/trade papers
  2. Lesser negative marks in concerned subject/trade
  3. Lesser negative marks in all evaluated papers
  4. Older candidate (Date of Birth)
  5. Earlier acquisition of Essential Degree
  6. Alphabetical order of first names

Electronics Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electronics & Instrumentation, Instrumentation, Electronics Engineering, Electronics & Telecommunication, Telecommunication, Opto Electronics, Micro Electronics & Microwave, Fibre Optics, Satellite Communication 06

Entry Vacancy Qualifications
SSCW Tech-67 (Oct 2026) Course 01 BE/B.Tech in any streams

Note: The vacancies mentioned are tentative and may be changed or re-appropriated by the Army depending on organizational requirements during any stage of the selection process.

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

  • Essential Qualification: B.E./B.Tech degree in the notified Engineering streams from recognized Universities/Institutions by an Act of Central or State Legislature in India or other educational institutions established by an Act of parliament or declared to be deemed as Universities/Autonomous Universities under UGC Act 1956, IIT Act 1961, AICTE Act 1987, NITSER Act 2007 and IIIT Act 2024.
  • For Final Year Students: Candidates studying in the final year of Engineering degree course are eligible to apply. They must submit proof of passing Engineering Degree Examination alongwith marksheets of all semesters/years by 01 October 2026 and produce the Engineering Degree Certificate within 12 weeks from the date of commencement of training at PCTA.
  • Important Note: All final year appearing candidates whose final year/final semester exam will be scheduled after 01 October 2026 are not eligible to apply for this course.
  • For Widows of Defence Personnel: Educational qualification for SSCW (Tech) is BE/B.Tech in any engineering stream, and for SSCW (Non-Tech) (Non UPSC) is Graduation in any discipline.
  • Stream Requirement: Only the Engineering streams and their acceptable equivalent streams as strictly notified in the official notification will be accepted. Any variation between the nomenclature of Engineering stream on degree parchment/marksheet and online application will result in cancellation of candidature.
  • Foreign Degrees Not Accepted: Candidates with graduation from foreign countries are not permitted to apply for this course.

Nationality

  • A citizen of India, or
  • A subject of Nepal, or
  • A person of Indian origin who has migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka and East African countries with the intention of permanently settling in India (certificate of eligibility required except for Gorkha subjects of Nepal)

Marital Status

  • Only unmarried female candidates are eligible to apply
  • Widows of Indian Armed Forces Defence Personnel who died in harness are eligible, provided they have not remarried
  • Candidates will neither be allowed to marry during the period of training nor be allowed to live with Parents/Guardians
  • A candidate who marries subsequent to the date of application, though successful at SSB interview and medical examination, will not be inducted for training

Physical Standards

  • 2.4 Km Run: 13 Minutes
  • Push-Up: 15
  • Pull-Up: 02
  • Sit-Up: 25
  • Squats: Two sets of 30 repetitions
  • Lunges: Two sets of 10 repetitions
  • Swimming: Should know fundamentals of swimming

Salary/Stipend

During Training Period

  • Stipend: ₹56,100 per month (Starting pay in Level-10 of Pay Matrix)
  • Pay and allowances will be paid after successful completion of training

After Commissioning - Pay Structure

  • Lieutenant (Level-10): ₹56,100 - ₹1,77,500
  • Captain (Level-10B): ₹61,300 - ₹1,93,900
  • Major (Level-11): ₹69,400 - ₹2,07,200
  • Lieutenant Colonel (Level-12A): ₹1,21,200 - ₹2,12,400
  • Colonel (Level-13): ₹1,30,600 - ₹2,15,900
  • Brigadier (Level-13A): ₹1,39,600 - ₹2,17,600
  • Major General (Level-14): ₹1,44,200 - ₹2,18,200
  • Lieutenant General HAG Scale (Level-15): ₹1,82,200 - ₹2,24,100
  • Lieutenant General HAG+ Scale (Level-16): ₹2,05,400 - ₹2,24,400
  • VCOAS/Army Commander/Lieutenant General (NFSG) (Level-17): ₹2,25,000 (Fixed)
  • COAS (Level-18): ₹2,50,000 (Fixed)

Other Allowances

  • Military Service Pay (MSP): ₹15,500 per month (Fixed) - for officers from Lieutenant to Brigadier rank
  • Dearness Allowance: Admissible at the same rates and under same conditions as applicable to civilian personnel from time to time
  • Para Reserve Allowance: ₹2,625 per month
  • Technical Allowance (Tier-I): ₹3,000 per month
  • Technical Allowance (Tier-II): ₹4,500 per month
  • Transport Allowance (TPTA): ₹7,200 + DA (Higher TPTA Cities) / ₹3,600 + DA (Other Places)
  • Dress Allowance: ₹20,000 per year
  • Children Education Allowance: ₹2,250 per month per child for two eldest surviving children (Nursery to 12th class)
  • Hostel Subsidy: ₹6,750 per month per child for two eldest surviving children (Nursery to 12th class)
  • Ration in Kind: Provided in peace and field areas
  • Field Area Allowances: Risk and Hardship allowances depending upon rank and area of posting (maximum up to ₹42,500)

Additional Benefits

  • CTC (Cost to Company): Approximately ₹17-18 lakh per annum (excluding free medical cover and travel to hometown once a year)
  • Army Group Insurance Fund (AGIF): Insurance coverage of ₹1.25 Crore
  • Academic Degree: Post Graduate Diploma in Defence Management and Strategic Studies upon successful completion of training

Age Limit (as on 01 October 2026)

  • For General Candidates:
    • Minimum Age: 20 years
    • Maximum Age: 27 years
    • Date of Birth: Candidates must be born between 01 October 1999 and 30 September 2006 (both dates inclusive)
  • For Widows of Indian Armed Forces Defence Personnel:
    • Maximum Age: 35 years as on 01 October 2026
  • Age Proof: The date of birth recorded in the Matriculation/Secondary School Examination Certificate or equivalent examination certificate on the date of submission of application will only be accepted. No other document relating to age will be accepted and no subsequent request for its change will be considered or granted.

Application Fee

  • No application fee mentioned in the official notification
  • Candidates need to apply online through the official website only

Important Dates

Event Date
Online Application Start Date 06 January 2026 at 1500 hours
Online Application Closing Date 04 February 2026 at 1500 hours
Offline Application Last Date (For Widows of Defence Personnel) 19 February 2026
Publication of Cut-off % for Shortlisting First week of March 2026
SSB Interview Period April - June 2026 (Five day SSB)
Choice for SSB Dates and Centre Open Two weeks in March 2026
Proof of Passing Engineering Degree Submission Deadline (for final year students) 01 October 2026
Training Commencement October 2026
Training Completion September 2027

Selection Process

  • Step 1 - Online Application: Candidates must apply online through www.joinindianarmy.nic.in (Offline application for widows of defence personnel to be sent to Directorate General of Recruiting)
  • Step 2 - Shortlisting: Applications will be shortlisted based on cumulative percentage of marks obtained by candidates upto final semester/year. Cut-off will be applied for each Engineering stream based on vacancy to call up ratio.
  • Step 3 - Allotment of Selection Centre: After shortlisting, centre allotment will be intimated via email. Candidates will select their SSB dates on first come first serve basis.
  • Step 4 - SSB Interview: Two-stage selection procedure conducted at one of the Selection Centres - Prayagraj (UP), Bhopal (MP), Bengaluru (Karnataka) and Jalandhar Cantt (Punjab). Duration is five days.
  • Step 5 - Medical Examination: Candidates who get recommended after Stage-2 of SSB will undergo medical examination. Validity of SSB medical examination is 270 days.
  • Step 6 - Merit List: Merit list will be prepared engineering stream/subject wise based on SSB interview marks.
  • Step 7 - Joining Letter: Candidates in merit list who come within stipulated stream-wise vacancies and are medically fit will be issued joining letters for pre-commissioning training at PCTA, subject to meeting all eligibility criteria.

Note: Mere qualifying at SSB interview does not confirm final selection. Selection is based on merit, medical fitness and availability of vacancies.

General Information/Instructions

  • Type of Commission: Short Service Commission (SSC)
  • Training Duration: 49 weeks at Officers Training Academy, Gaya, Bihar
  • Rank After Training: Lieutenant
  • Commission Grant: Selected candidates will be granted Short Service Commission on probation in the rank of Lieutenant from the date of commencement of the course
  • Ante Date Seniority: One year ante date seniority from the date of commission will be granted to Engineering Graduates
  • Tenure of Engagement: Officers shall be liable to serve for ten years
  • Option for Release:
    • First option - After 5 years of service (with Army HQ approval based on merit)
    • Second option - After 10 years of service
    • Third option - After 14 years of service
  • Option for Permanent Commission: Officers desirous of seeking Permanent Commission may be considered in the 10th year of service based on eligibility and suitability
  • Service Extension: Ten year service tenure may be extendable by further four years subject to eligibility
  • Arms/Services Allocation: Primary Arms/Services are Corps of Engineers, Corps of Signals and Corps of Electronics and Mechanical Engineers. Candidates may get commissioned in other Arms/Services as well based on organizational requirements
  • Training Cost: Entire cost of training at PCTA is at Government expense
  • Cost Recovery: Candidates withdrawn from training academy for personal reasons will be liable to refund cost of training at ₹16,260 per week (as on 2023) or as notified from time to time
  • Promotion Criteria: Promotion to Captain after 2 years, Major after 6 years, Lieutenant Colonel after 13 years of reckonable commissioned service
  • Liability of Service: Officers may be granted commission in any Arm/Service and will be liable for service in any part of the world
  • Marriage Restriction: Candidates must not marry until they complete full training at Officers Training Academy. Marriage during training will result in discharge and recovery of expenditure
  • Special Provision for Widows: Widows of Indian Armed Forces Defence Personnel who died in harness, including those with children, are eligible provided they have not remarried. Their candidature will be considered only against specific vacancies released for said category.

How to Apply

For General Candidates (Online Application)

  • Step 1: Visit the official website www.joinindianarmy.nic.in
  • Step 2: Click on 'Officer Entry Apply/Login' and then click 'Registration' (if not already registered)
  • Step 3: Fill the online registration form carefully after reading instructions. Aadhaar number and matriculation certificate is mandatory for registration
  • Step 4: After registration, click on 'Apply Online' under Dashboard
  • Step 5: A page 'Officers Selection - Eligibility' will open. Click 'Apply' shown against Short Service Commission Technical Course
  • Step 6: Fill Application Form with details under various segments - Personal information, Communication details, Education details and details of previous SSB
  • Step 7: Click 'Save & Continue' each time before moving to next segment
  • Step 8: After filling all details, review on 'Summary of your information' page
  • Step 9: After ascertaining correctness of all details, click on 'Submit'
  • Step 10: Take out two copies of application having Roll Number, 30 minutes after final closure of online application

For Widows of Defence Personnel (Offline Application)

  • Application form to be downloaded from www.joinindianarmy.nic.in
  • Application should be sent offline to: Rtg 'A'(TGC) section, Dte Gen of Rtg, AG's Branch, Integrated HQ, Ministry of Defence (Army), West Block-III, R K Puram, New Delhi-110066
  • Last date for receipt of offline applications: 19 February 2026 (15 days after closing of online applications)
  • Required Documents: Application form, Class 10th & 12th certificates and marksheets, Degree certificate and marksheet, Part II Order of Marriage, Part II Order of demise of husband, Initial report of Battle/Physical casualty, Detailed report of Battle/Physical casualty, Battle/Physical casualty certificate
  • Documents from serial (v) to (ix) must be attested by an officer ex MP Directorate (MP-5 & 6), IHQ of MoD (Army) for officers and by Concerned Record office for JCO/OR
  • Envelope should be superscribed in Red ink clearly indicating the name of Officer/JCO/OR with rank. For example, 'Widows of late________'

Documents Required for SSB Interview (For All Candidates)

  • One copy of printout of application duly signed and affixed with self-attested photograph
  • Matriculation/Secondary School Examination Certificate or equivalent certificate and Marksheet issued by concerned Board of Education
  • 12th class marksheet and certificate or equivalent certificate/Diploma marksheet and certificate (for Diploma holders)
  • Engineering Degree/Provisional Degree issued by recognized university (Provisional Degree should not be more than six months old at time of joining Academy)
  • Marksheets of all semesters/years
  • Certificate issued by Controller of Examination/Registrar regarding formula for conversion of CGPA/Grades into marks
  • Certificate regarding cumulative percentage of marks upto 6th semester/3rd year (for final year appearing candidates)
  • Certificate from Principal/Head of Institution stating candidate is studying in final year and result will be declared by 01 October 2026 (for final year students)
  • Declaration by final year candidate about submission of degree proof by 01 October 2026
  • Documents related to civil verification
  • All original certificates must be carried for verification (DIGILOCKER certificates not accepted)

Important Notes

  • Online applications will only be accepted through the official website - no offline applications for general candidates
  • Candidates must submit only one online application. Multiple applications will result in cancellation of candidature
  • No changes to details submitted in online application can be made after closure of application
  • CGPA/Grades must be converted into marks as per formulae adopted by concerned University
  • Candidate's name/Parent's name/Date of Birth in profile and online application must match Matriculation Certificate exactly
  • Candidates serving in Armed Forces must inform their Commanding Officer and get application countersigned
  • No hard copy needs to be sent to Directorate General of Recruiting (except for widows of defence personnel)
  • Candidates applying for SSCW (Non-Tech) (Non UPSC)-124 should mention the correct course number on their application

General Information / Instructions

1. The applicant must be the citizen of India and below 56 years of age.

2. The candidates should go through all the instructions & recruitment rules carefully and ensures that they fulfill all eligibility conditions. Their candidature to any stage of the recruitment process will be provisional subject to satisfying the eligibility criteria for the post.

3. The candidates should carefully fill up all the details required in the application form as no correspondence regarding change of details will be entertained after the submission of application/last date for applying. If any of their claims is found to be incorrect, it will lead to the rejection of their candidature.

4. The applicant will be responsible for the authenticity of submitted information, other documents and photograph. Furnishing of any false information and/or suppression / concealment of facts shall lead to rejection/cancellation of selection/appointment.

5. The Institute reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates, by shortlisting, to be called for selection process to a reasonable limit on the basis of qualifications, relevance of experience higher than the minimum prescribed in the advertisement, other academic / professional achievements. Mere fulfillment of eligibility criteria does not guarantee candidates being called for selection process. The qualifications prescribed should have been obtained from recognized University / Institutions.

6. The Institute reserves the right to decide the mode of screening of applications for short listing. Institute reserves the right to reject or accept the candidature of any applicant at any stage and also has right to cancel/restrict/modify/alter the advertisement / recruitment process, if need arises, without issuing any further notice or assigning any reason thereto. The mode of selection process for the post may be through presentation and/or interview, or through interview only.

7. Candidates are advised to fill their correct and active e-mail addresses in the online application as all correspondence will be made by the Institute through e-mail only. Schedule for selection process will be e-mailed in due course to the candidates in their registered e-mail. No separate letter (Hard copy) will be sent for this purpose. Further, for any updates, please visit the Institute website regularly, for subsequent amendments, if any, in the advertisement and for results.

8. The Institute reserves the right not to fill the advertised post.

9. The details regarding qualification and experience etc. are as per the recruitment rules for non-teaching staff of NITs notified by the Ministry of Education (MoE) vide letter no. F.35-5/2018-TS.III dated 04th April 2019. However, any modification in the recruitment rules notified by MoE will be applicable. The selection procedure will governed by the latest recruitment rules and OMs issued by MoE till the date of interview.

10. The age limit and qualifications/experience etc. for the post shall be determined as on the last date of submission of application form.

11. Date of birth mentioned in Online Recruitment Application is final. No subsequent request for change of date of birth will be considered or granted.

12. The Candidate should pay a non-refundable processing fee through online mode as below: ➢ For the candidates other than SC/ ST/ PwD/ Woman Category: Rs. 1,000 (Rupees One Thousand only) ➢ For SC/ ST Category: Rs.500 (Rupees Five hundred only) ➢ For Woman/ PwD Category: No fee is required. ➢ Application processing fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances.

13. Application form without self-attested copies of certificates/testimonials and prescribed application fee will not be considered and shall be rejected.

14. Mere fulfillment of the required qualifications and experience etc., does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview/selection.

15. Further, the provisionally selected eligible candidates may be required to go through the skill and aptitude test (Situation Analysis Test & Presentation) on the date of interview for their final short-listing to appear for Interview so as to restrict the numbers to a reasonable limit.

16. Besides the pay in the pay matrix as per the 7th CPC, admissible allowances applicable for the post like DA, HRA etc. in accordance with Institute Rules in force from time to time are payable. The employees of the Institute will be entitled to medical benefits for self and family as per the relevant rules. Leave Travel Concession for self and family as per Central Government Rules.

17. Officers under the Central/State Governments/Universities/Recognized Research Institutes or Institute of national importance or Govt. laboratory or PSU are eligible to apply for the post through proper channel for appointment on Deputation (including Short Term Contract).

18. The print out of application duly signed in each page should be routed through proper channel and accompanied with required self attested documents and duly certified attested copies of Annual Confidential Report (ACR)/Annual Performance Assessment Report (APAR) for the last five years, Experience certificate, Vigilance Clearance Certificate from the Competent Authority. If the candidates anticipate unavoidable delay in their applications being forwarded through proper channel, they may submit advance copies of their applications alongwith self-attested copies of other credentials directly to The Deputy Registrar, Establishment Section, Prabha Bhawan, Malaviya National Institute of Technology, Jaipur, JLN Marg, Jaipur, Rajasthan-302017, India, which will be considered provisionally. Candidates will be allowed to appear for the selection process only if the applications are duly received being forwarded through proper channel by the employer. Institute shall not be responsible for any postal /courier delay.

19. Applications submitted online but not followed by sending complete hard copies will not be considered. Applications through any mode, without the online version of the application submitted through the online portal of the Institute, shall also be summarily rejected and no further correspondence will be entertained.

20. Any Vigilance/Disciplinary cases/Criminal cases should not be pending/ contemplated against the candidates working in any Government Organization. In such cases, application shall not be considered.

21. Canvassing in any form / bringing in any influence, political or otherwise will be treated as a disqualification for the post. Interim enquiries will not be entertained. If it is found at any stage that any information given in the application is incorrect / false, the candidature / appointment is liable to be cancelled / terminated.

22. The review of performance of incumbent appointed on the post of Registrar will be carried out by a Committee (to be constituted by the Board) upon completion of one year of service of the incumbent.

23. In case of any dispute/ambiguity that may occur in the process of selection, the decision of the Director MNIT Jaipur in all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, mode of selection, conduct of examination/ interview will be final and no query or correspondence will be entertained in this connection from any individual.

24. In case of any mistake occurring inadvertently in the process of selection, which may be detected at any stage even after the issue of offer of appointment, the Institute reserves the right to withdraw /cancel / modify any communication made to the candidates.

25. Any Vigilance/ Disciplinary cases / Criminal cases should not be pending/ contemplated against the applicant in any Government Organization. In such cases, application shall not be considered. A Certificate in this regard is to be submitted by the applicant.

26. The pay and conditions of deputation of the Officer selected will be regulated in accordance with the Department of Personnel & Training (DoPT), Govt. of India O.M. No.6/8/2009-Estt. (Pay-II) dated 17.06.2010, as amended from time to time and other instructions of the Ministry of Education, Govt. of India or Board of Governors of MNIT, Jaipur issued in this regard from time to time. For the meaning of deputation and short term contract, the DoPT, Govt. of India O.M. No.AB.14017/13/2013-Estt. (RR) (1349) shall be taken into reference.

27. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for interview.

28. No TA/DA or local conveyance shall be paid to the applicants called for Interview.

29. The candidates will be called for the interview on the basis of information furnished by them. The appointment will be solely subject to fulfillment of all the eligibility conditions for the advertised post.

30. All original documents will have to be produced at the time of interview for verification.

31. Pay of the selected candidate will be fixed as per the recommendations of the selection committee and subsequent approval of the Board of Governors (BoG) of the Institute. No request for higher pay/pay protection not recommended by the selection committee will be entertained before or after joining.

32. The decision of the Institute in all matters will be final. No correspondence, whatsoever, will be entertained from the candidates in connection with the process of selection/interview. Canvassing in any manner would entail disqualification of the candidature.

33. The applicants are required to visit the Institute website regularly as any subsequent corrigendum/addendum etc. shall be published on the Institute website only.

34. In case the last date of receiving the hard copy of applications falls on a holiday, then the next working day (till 5 PM only) shall be treated as last day.

35. Legal disputes, if any, with Malaviya National Institute of Technology, Jaipur will be restricted within the jurisdiction of Jaipur, Rajasthan only.

36. Helpline e-mail ID for any query related to online fee and form submission is [email protected]

How to Apply

  • Interested candidates must apply ONLINE only through the Institute website https://www.mnit.ac.in.
  • Applications received through any other mode shall not be accepted and summarily rejected.
  • Every completed online application shall be identified by a unique application reference number, which should be used for all future communication.
  • All the candidates are advised to download the same from Institute website and send hard copy of the downloaded PDF of the filled application form along with the self-attested copies of the relevant testimonials, certificates, enclosures etc. before the last date by speed post/registered post/courier to:
  • The Assistant Registrar, Establishment Section – II, Prabha Bhawan, Malaviya National Institute of Technology, Jaipur JLN Marg, Jaipur, Rajasthan-302017, India Failing which their candidature will not be considered.
  • The envelope containing the application be super scribed as “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF REGISTRAR”.

All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) Jodhpur has released the BHISHM Cubes Contractual Recruitment 2026 notification for three posts — Nursing Officer, Technician, and Data Entry Operator. The recruitment is under the PM-ABHIM initiative for operationalization and maintenance of BHISHM Cubes. Eligible candidates can apply online from 20 January to 9 February 2026. The monthly remuneration ranges from ₹30,000 to ₹40,000, depending on the post, with no claim for permanent employment.
