AIIMS Jodhpur BHISHM Cubes Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details 

Name of the Post Category No. of Posts
Nursing Officer UR 01
Technician UR 01
Data Entry Operator UR 01

Note: Vacancies are provisional and subject to variation; reservation will be as per Government of India guidelines.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Nursing Officer
    • B.Sc Nursing from a recognized university.
    • Registered with Indian Nursing Council with 2 years of experience post qualification.
    • OR 10+2 with Science stream (PCB) from a recognized institute.
    • Approved diploma in GNM Nursing from an institute recognized by Indian Nursing Council (as applicable).
    • Registered with Nursing Council (as applicable).
    • 3 years’ experience post essential qualification as Nurse.
    • Desirable: Working knowledge of computer applications.
  • Technician
    • B.Sc in Radiological Imaging Techniques from recognized institutes with 2 years’ experience post essential qualification as Radiographer.
    • OR Diploma in Radiological Imaging Techniques from recognized institutes with 3 years’ experience post essential qualification as Radiographer.
    • OR B.Sc in Emergency Medical Technology from recognized institutes with 2 years’ experience post essential qualification as Medical Technician.
    • Desirable: Experience in handling radiological equipment.
  • Data Entry Operator
    • Graduate with a Diploma in Computer Applications.
    • At least 2 years of relevant experience in health programme.
    • Working knowledge and experience in computer applications.

Salary/Stipend

  • Nursing Officer: Consolidated remuneration of ₹ 40,000/- per month.
  • Technician: Consolidated remuneration of ₹ 40,000/- per month.
  • Data Entry Operator: Consolidated remuneration of ₹ 30,000/- per month.
  • Emoluments are all-inclusive and subject to deduction of tax at source and other statutory deductions as applicable.
  • No annual increment or percentage increase during the contract period; no travelling or other allowances will be paid for joining the post.

Age Limit 

  • Upper age limit shall be determined as on the last date of receipt of applications.
  • Permissible relaxation of upper age limit for SC/ST: 5 years; OBC: 3 years; PwBD: 10 years; PwBD + OBC: 13 years; PwBD + SC/ST: 15 years.
  • Age relaxation of 5 years for personnel serving in Central/State Government and Autonomous Institutions and regular employees of AIIMS Jodhpur with three years’ regular service.
  • Additional relaxations for Ex-Servicemen, Central Government Civilian Employees and existing contractual/outsourced employees of AIIMS Jodhpur as per detailed conditions in the advertisement.

Application Fee

  • Candidates (except Female/SC/ST/Persons with Benchmark Disability candidates) are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 100/- (Rupees One Hundred only).
  • Payment must be made through Online Mode only via the payment gateway of AIIMS Jodhpur; transaction/processing fee, if any, is payable to the bank by the candidate.
  • Applications without the prescribed fee will not be considered and will be summarily rejected.
  • Application fee, once remitted, shall not be refunded under any circumstances, even if the application is rejected due to ineligibility.

Important Dates

Event Date & Time
Issue of Advertisement 16 January 2026
Start of Online Application 20 January 2026
Last Date for Online Application Submission 09 February 2026 up to 5:00 PM
Cut-off date for age and qualification Last date of submission of application (09 February 2026)

Selection Process

  • Only Indian citizens are eligible for the posts.
  • Candidates must apply online; incomplete or late applications will not be considered.
  • Candidates shortlisted for interview on the basis of information provided in online applications will be required to send self-attested copies of documents in support of their claims when demanded.
  • The competent authority reserves the right to conduct a screening test depending upon the number of applications received for a particular post.
  • Original documents will be verified at the time of interview; candidature is liable to be cancelled if any information is found false or eligibility conditions are not met.
  • Success in the examination/selection process confers no right of appointment unless the Government is satisfied about the candidate’s suitability in all respects.
  • AIIMS Jodhpur reserves the right to cancel or modify the recruitment process, increase or decrease vacancies and change selection criteria without assigning reasons.

General Information/Instructions

  • Applications can be submitted only in online mode through the official website of AIIMS Jodhpur; candidates should keep a copy of the online application and proof of fee payment.
  • Applicants must ensure that their photograph and signature are clearly visible in the online application; unclear images will lead to rejection.
  • Only the date of birth recorded in the Matriculation/Secondary Examination certificate will be accepted.
  • Reservation will be as per Government of India guidelines for SC, ST, OBC, EWS and PwBD candidates; valid certificates in prescribed format are mandatory.
  • OBC (NCL) certificates must be issued between 01.04.2025 and 31.03.2026 and must conform to DoPT formats; EWS certificates must be based on income of financial year 2024–2025 and issued between 01.04.2025 and 31.03.2026.
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities must have disability of not less than 40% and produce disability certificate in prescribed format.
  • Candidates in Government/semi-Government/PSU service must produce No Objection Certificate at document verification and relieving certificate at the time of joining.
  • Canvassing of any kind will disqualify the candidate; candidates must not indulge in malpractices, tampering of documents or misbehavior during examinations/interviews.
  • The tenure of the contract shall be till March 2026 or until further extension as applicable; engagement is purely contractual and does not confer any right to regular appointment.
  • Either party may terminate the contract with one month’s notice or salary in lieu thereof; disciplinary violations, misconduct or non-performance may lead to termination without notice.
  • Contractual appointees must maintain confidentiality, avoid conflict of interest, and comply with CCS Conduct Rules and other institutional regulations.
  • All disputes will be subject to jurisdiction of Court of Law at Jodhpur.

How to Apply

  • Visit the official website of AIIMS Jodhpur and access the online application link available under the relevant recruitment advertisement.
  • Register and fill in the online application form carefully, ensuring that all eligibility conditions regarding age, qualification and experience are satisfied as on the closing date.
  • Upload recent photograph and signature in the prescribed format, ensuring they are clearly visible in the preview.
  • Pay the applicable application fee of Rs. 100/- (if not exempted) through the online payment gateway and retain the payment receipt/challan for record.
  • Submit the online application before the closing date and time; no physical copies of the application are to be sent to AIIMS Jodhpur at this stage.
  • Keep a printed copy of the online application and all supporting documents ready for submission/verification as and when called by AIIMS Jodhpur.

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

  • Candidates must have passed Senior Secondary Examination (10+2) from Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education, Ajmer or Central Board of Secondary Education or equivalent board recognized by the Government
  • Knowledge of working in Hindi written in Devnagri script and knowledge of Rajasthan culture is required
  • Candidates who have appeared or are appearing in the final year examination of the qualifying educational qualification are also eligible to apply
  • However, they must acquire the required educational qualification before the examination date of Forester recruitment
  • Ex-servicemen with 15 years of military service holding equivalent certificate to graduation can apply by filling 'Not Applicable' in roll number field and selecting 'N' grade in result

Essential Qualifications

  • Indian citizenship or citizenship of Nepal or Bhutan
  • Tibetan refugee who came to India before 01-01-1962 with intention of permanently settling in India
  • Person of Indian origin who migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, East African countries for permanent settlement in India
  • For categories (b), (c), (d), (e) mentioned above, eligibility certificate from Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India must be submitted

Salary/Stipend

  • Pay Scale: Level-8 of Pay Matrix as per 7th Pay Commission - ₹56,100 to ₹1,77,500 per month
  • During Probation Period: Monthly fixed remuneration will be paid as per Government orders
  • Probation Duration: 2 years for direct recruitment candidates
  • During probation period, only fixed remuneration will be paid, no other allowances like HRA, DA, City Compensatory Allowance, Special Pay etc. will be payable
  • After successful completion of probation, training, passing post-training examination, and being found suitable for confirmation, regular pay scale and other allowances will be payable as per rules
  • Other benefits like leave etc. during probation will be as per amended provisions of Rajasthan Service Rules

Age Limit (as on 01-01-2027)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years (as on 01-01-2027)
  • Maximum Age: 40 years (as on 01-01-2027)
  • Special Relaxation: Additional relaxation of 03 years is granted to all candidates as Forester recruitment has not been conducted in the past 03 years

Age Relaxation in Maximum Age Limit

  • SC/ST/OBC/MBC Male candidates (Original residents of Rajasthan): 5 years relaxation
  • General Category Female candidates: 5 years relaxation
  • SC/ST/OBC/MBC Female candidates (Original residents of Rajasthan): 10 years relaxation
  • Ex-servicemen: 15 years relaxation as per Rajasthan Civil Services (Absorption of Ex-Servicemen) Rules, 1988. However, after relaxation, if the permissible age exceeds 50 years, the upper age limit will be 50 years. In case of direct recruitment where lower post experience is mandatory, the maximum upper age limit will be 55 years
  • NCC Cadet Instructors: Service period in NCC will be deducted from actual age, provided resultant age does not exceed prescribed maximum age limit by more than 3 years
  • Widows and Divorced Women: No age limit, subject to being less than retirement age fixed by State Government
  • Emergency Commission Officers and Short Service Commission Officers: Considered within age limit even if they have crossed prescribed age limit when appearing before Selection Board
  • Persons who returned to India from Pakistan during 1971 India-Pakistan war: No age limit
  • Age relaxations mentioned above are non-cumulative, meaning candidates can avail benefit of only one provision for age relaxation

Selection Process

  • Selection will be based on marks obtained in Common Eligibility Test (Senior Secondary Level) 2024 conducted by RSSB
  • Written examination will be conducted offline (OMR based)
  • The examination will be objective type (multiple choice questions)
  • Total Questions: 100, Total Marks: 100, Duration: 2 hours
  • All questions carry equal marks
  • Negative marking of 1/3 mark will be deducted for each wrong answer
  • Questions will be based on General Knowledge, Social Studies, Geography, History, Art and Culture, Everyday Science, Mathematics, Current Affairs with special reference to Rajasthan State at Senior Secondary Level
  • If examination is conducted in multiple shifts, normalization process will be applied
  • Physical fitness test will be conducted after written examination for shortlisted candidates
  • Document verification will be conducted for finally selected candidates
  • Final merit list will be prepared based on written examination marks and physical fitness test

  • Female Candidates: Must complete 16 km distance on foot within 4 hours
  • Physical measurement standards and efficiency test will be qualifying in nature

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates must login through SSO Portal at http://sso.rajasthan.gov.in and select Recruitment Portal from Citizen Apps (G2C)
  • If One Time Registration (OTR) fee is not paid, candidates must first complete OTR process by selecting their category (UR or Reserved), disability status, and home state, and pay prescribed fee
  • After OTR completion, candidates can apply using SSO ID by entering their CET (Senior Secondary) 2024 online application number
  • System will verify CET 2024 application number and SSO ID with CET 2024 data before opening application form
  • RSSB has made changes in online application form regarding educational qualification and other documents entry process
  • Detailed guidelines and help documents are available on Board's website
  • Candidates should carefully select their educational qualification in OTR Dashboard
  • Educational qualification documents will be uploaded by candidates in Document Details section as per recruitment notification rules
  • Candidates are solely responsible for correctness and authenticity of their educational qualifications and documents as per recruitment notification rules
  • If any information provided is found incorrect, incomplete or misleading at any stage, candidate's application can be rejected and legal action can be taken as per Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita Section 217 and recruitment notification rules
  • Information entered in OTR will be displayed in application form and cannot be modified
  • All other information must be filled carefully by candidates
  • If e-Mitra operator makes any wrong entry in online application, it will be considered candidate's mistake
  • After Final Submit of application form, online application number will be generated
  • Candidates should keep printout of online application form safely
  • Candidates are advised not to use any other portal or facility for depositing one-time registration fee
  • Candidates must ensure payment of one-time registration fee before last date to verify any pending payment-related transactions
  • Candidates should register their own mobile number and email ID and not change them until completion of appointment process
  • Important information will be sent only on mobile number and email ID registered in application
  • Candidates must apply using their own SSO ID only
  • Application filled from another SSO ID will not be accepted
  • After online application, candidates will receive online application number and if Application ID is not displayed or received, it means application has not been accepted
  • Preview of application form should not be considered as Submit of application
  • Online application must be submitted by prescribed date; offline applications will not be accepted under any circumstances
  • Helpdesk Numbers: E-Mitra Helpline: 0141-2922241/2922238, Online Application related problems: 0294-3057541
  • Email IDs: [email protected], [email protected], [email protected]
  • All information will be published on Board's website rssb.rajasthan.gov.in only
  • No separate correspondence will be made
  • Board reserves right to modify advertised number of posts before examination result
  • Dress code prescribed by Board will be applicable for all candidates
  • Candidates cannot bring mobile phones, purses, electronic gadgets to examination center
  • Only transparent blue pen, one recent photograph (2.5×2.5 cm, not more than 1 month old), original photo ID, e-admit card can be brought to examination hall
  • Bringing prohibited items may result in confiscation and Board/Center Superintendent will not be responsible for their security
  • Marriage registration is mandatory as per Government circular dated 22-05-2006

How to Apply

  • Visit SSO Portal at http://sso.rajasthan.gov.in and login with your SSO ID
  • If you don't have SSO ID, register first by providing required details
  • After login, select Citizen Apps (G2C) and choose Recruitment Portal
  • Click on Apply Now button
  • If you haven't paid One Time Registration (OTR) fee, first complete OTR process by selecting your category (Unreserved or Reserved - EWS/OBC-NC/MBC-NC/SC/ST/SAH), disability status, and home state
  • Pay prescribed OTR fee through available payment modes
  • After OTR completion, enter your CET (Senior Secondary) 2024 application number
  • System will verify your CET 2024 details with SSO ID
  • After successful verification, application form will open
  • Fill all required details carefully in the application form
  • Upload live photograph, scanned signature (in Hindi and English), and thumb impression as per guidelines
  • Upload required documents (educational certificates, category certificates, etc.) in Document Details section
  • Verify all filled information before final submission

Abbreviation used:

  • B/LV - Blindness/Low Vision
  • D - Deaf, HH - Hearing Impaired
  • LD - Locomotor Disability, CP - Cerebral Palsy, LC - Leprosy Cured, Dw - Dwarfism, AAV - Acid Attack Victims, MDy - Muscular Dystrophy
  • ASD - Autism Spectrum Disorder, ID - Intellectual Disability, SLD - Specific Learning Disability, MI - Mental Illness
  • MD - Multiple Disabilities

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification:

  • Company Secretary: Must have passed final examination of The Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI) and shall hold the Membership of the said Institute. Must have minimum of Five years' experience as Company Secretary in a Company having minimum paid capital of Rs 50 Crore or more.
  • Assistant Town Planner: Degree in Architecture (5 years full time course) with minimum 60% marks and Post Graduation in Town Planning from recognized University.
  • Programmer: B.E./B.Tech./M.Sc. in Information Technology/Computer Science/Engineering or Electronics and Communications or M.C.A. from a recognized University OR ME/M.Tech degree in Information Technology or Computer Science/Engineering or Electronics and Communications from a recognized University OR B.Com with minimum 60% Marks from recognized university WITH Certificate Course in Information Technology (RSCIT/DOEACC "O" Level/COPA/DPCS/Diploma in Computer Science/Computer Applications/Information Technology).
  • Assistant Accounts Officer Grade-II: Degree/Diploma/Certificate of CA/CMA from the institute of ICAI/ICMAI from a recognized university OR B.Com with minimum 60% Marks from recognized university WITH Certificate Course in Information Technology (RSCIT/DOEACC "O" Level or Higher/COPA/DPCS certificate/Diploma in Computer Science).
  • Junior Legal Officer: Law graduate (Professional Degree) from a recognized university with minimum 55% marks or LL.M. from a recognized university.
  • Personal Assistant Grade-II: Senior Secondary from a recognized Board or its equivalent examination AND Higher Level Certificate Course conducted by DOEACC under control of the Department of Electronics, Government of India OR Certificate Course on computer concept by NIELIT, New Delhi OR Computer Operator & Programming Assistant (COPA)/Data Preparation and Computer Software (DPCS) certificate OR Degree/Diploma/Certificate in Computer Science/Computer applications OR Senior Secondary Certificate with Computer Science/Computer Application as one of the subjects OR Diploma in Computer Science & Engineering from a polytechnic institution OR RSCIT OR Any equivalent or higher qualification.
  • Draughtsman-cum-Tracer (Civil): Diploma in Architecture from Polytechnic from recognized institute alongwith knowledge of AUTOCAD software OR Certificate course of Draughtsman (Civil) from National Council of Vocational Trade alongwith knowledge of AUTOCAD software.
  • Junior Assistant: Senior Secondary from a recognized Board or its equivalent examination AND "O" or Higher Level Certificate Course conducted by DOEACC OR Certificate Course on computer concept by NIELIT, New Delhi OR Computer Operator & Programming Assistant (COPA)/Data Preparation and Computer Software (DPCS) certificate OR Degree/Diploma/Certificate in Computer Science/Computer applications OR Senior Secondary Certificate with Computer Science/Computer Application as one of the subjects OR Diploma in Computer Science & Engineering OR RSCIT OR Any equivalent or higher qualification.

Citizenship:

  • A citizen of India
  • A subject of Nepal
  • A subject of Bhutan
  • A Tibetan refugee who came over to India before 1st January, 1962 with the intention of permanently settling in India
  • A person of Indian origin who has migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka or East African countries with the intention of permanently settling in India

Note: Candidates belonging to categories (b), (c), (d) and (e) above shall be a person in whose favour a certificate of eligibility has been issued by the Home Department and Justice Department of Government of India.

Salary/Stipend

Appointment of selected candidates will be made for Probation Period for an initial period of two years. A fixed remuneration shall be payable to such candidates during the probation period:

  • Company Secretary: Level-16, Rs.4,7200/- per month (Fixed Remuneration during probation)
  • Assistant Town Planner: Level-14, Rs.3,9300/- per month (Fixed Remuneration during probation)
  • Programmer: Level-12, Rs.3,1100/- per month (Fixed Remuneration during probation)
  • Assistant Accounts Officer Grade-II: Level-11, Rs.2,6500/- per month (Fixed Remuneration during probation)
  • Junior Legal Officer: Level-10, Rs.2,3700/- per month (Fixed Remuneration during probation)
  • Personal Assistant Grade-II: Level-10, Rs.2,3700/- per month (Fixed Remuneration during probation)
  • Draughtsman-cum-Tracer (Civil): Level-8, Rs.1,8500/- per month (Fixed Remuneration during probation)
  • Junior Assistant: Level-5, Rs.1,4600/- per month (Fixed Remuneration during probation)

Note: On successful completion of Probation Period, the salary shall be payable in regular Pay-Matrix. The regular salary with other allowances shall be paid, as per rules.

Age Limit (as on 20/02/2026)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: Less than 40 years

Age Relaxation:

  • SC/ST/BC/MBC/EWS Male Candidates of Rajasthan State: 5 years relaxation
  • General Category Women Candidates: 5 years relaxation
  • SC/ST/BC/MBC/EWS Women Candidates of Rajasthan State: 10 years relaxation
  • Differently Abled Persons: Additional 5 years relaxation beyond the above-mentioned relaxations
  • Widow and Divorcee: No upper age limit, but at the time of appointment, their age should be less than the age of superannuation fixed by RIICO

Note: The provisions for relaxation in upper age limit are non-cumulative i.e. the benefit of any one provision shall be given for relaxation in upper age limit.

Application Fee

Category Fee for Post 1-6 Fee for Post 7-8
Unreserved (General) category and Creamy Layer category of BC/MBC of Rajasthan Rs.700/- Rs.1,000/-
Non-Creamy Layer category of BC/MBC of Rajasthan and EWS of Rajasthan Rs.525/- Rs.750/-
All Specially Abled Persons and SC/ST of Rajasthan Rs.350/- Rs.500/-

Special Note:

  • Candidates of SC/ST/BC/MBC/EWS of a State other than Rajasthan/Union Territories shall be treated as a candidate of General category and are liable to pay the examination fee as fixed for the General category candidates.
  • According to Circular dated 02.05.2018, the candidate's fee for candidates of all categories whose annual income of family is less than Rs.2.50 lakhs shall be payable same as of the candidates of SC/ST.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 20/01/2026
Online Application Start Date 21/01/2026
Online Application Last Date 20/02/2026 (11:59 PM)
Examination Date To be announced
Admit Card Release Date To be announced

Selection Process

  • Selection of the candidates shall be made through a competitive examination conducted online.
  • The merit list shall be prepared on the basis of marks secured in the examination.
  • All questions in written examination paper shall be objective type.

Examination Structure:

  • Company Secretary: Part First (180 Marks) + Part Second (270 Marks) + Interview (50 Marks) = Total 400 Marks
  • Assistant Town Planner: Part First (180 Marks) + Part Second (270 Marks) = Total 450 Marks
  • Programmer: Part First (180 Marks) + Part Second (270 Marks) + Proficiency Test (100 Marks) = Total 550 Marks
  • Assistant Accounts Officer Grade-II: Part First (180 Marks) + Part Second (270 Marks) = Total 450 Marks
  • Junior Legal Officer: Part First (180 Marks) + Part Second (270 Marks) = Total 450 Marks
  • Personal Assistant Grade-II: Part First (180 Marks) + Part Second (270 Marks) + Proficiency Test (100 Marks) = Total 550 Marks
  • Draughtsman-cum-Tracer (Civil): Part First (180 Marks) + Part Second (270 Marks) + Proficiency Test (100 Marks) = Total 550 Marks
  • Junior Assistant: Part First (180 Marks) + Part Second (270 Marks) + Proficiency Test (100 Marks) = Total 550 Marks

Note:

  • Only those candidates who have obtained minimum qualifying marks shall be eligible for appearing in the proficiency test.
  • Maximum five times of candidates of respective vacancies of the posts shall be called for appearing in the proficiency test.
  • For Company Secretary post, candidates who qualify in the written examination will be called for an interview. The number of candidates called for the interview will be five times the number of advertised vacancies.

General Information/Instructions

Reservation Policy:

  • 5% reservation shall be admissible to More Backward Class (non-creamy layer) belonging to State of Rajasthan.
  • 10% reservation shall be admissible to Economically Weaker Section of the State of Rajasthan.
  • Horizontal reservation of vacancies for women shall be 30% category-wise.
  • Out of the 30% reserved posts for women, 8% posts are reserved for widows and 2% for divorced women.
  • 2% reservation for Outstanding Sports Person (horizontal reservation).
  • Reservation for specially abled persons is also horizontal reservation.

Important Points:

  • The benefit of reserved posts of SC/ST/BC/MBC/EWS is only admissible to bonafide residents of the State of Rajasthan.
  • Candidates of SC/ST/BC/MBC/EWS of a State other than Rajasthan State/Union Territories shall be treated as candidates of General category.
  • According to judgment by Supreme Court and Rajasthan High Court, a woman of a State other than Rajasthan State who becomes bonafide resident of Rajasthan State after marriage, the benefit of reservation in SC/ST/OBC/MBC category shall not be allowed to her for public employment.
  • Married female candidates of BC/MBC are required to submit certificate on the basis of father's name, residence and income. Certificate on the basis of husband shall not be valid.
  • No candidate having more than two children on or after 01.04.2007 shall be eligible for appointment to the service.
  • Registration of marriage has been made compulsory for appointment in the services of state from 22.01.2006.
  • The candidate who smokes and/or consumes gutkha will not be eligible for appointment.

Special Instructions:

  • Candidates should fill the online application carefully. No change will be possible after clicking "Complete Registration" button.
  • Prior to filling online application, candidates must go through the detailed advertisement and service rules.
  • Candidates are required to upload Photograph, Signature, Left Thumb Impression and Handwritten Declaration as per guidelines.
  • Mobile phone, Bluetooth, calculator, smart watch and any other electronic/communication devices are not permitted in examination hall.
  • Call letters shall be uploaded on the website www.riico.rajasthan.gov.in and no call letter will be sent by post.
  • Result of examination shall be communicated by uploading on the authorized website.
  • No travelling allowance/meal allowance shall be payable to candidates.

How to Apply

  • Candidates may visit the website www.riico.rajasthan.gov.in and click on the option "Apply Online".
  • To register the application, select the tab "Click here for New Registration" and enter the name, contact details and email-id.
  • A Provisional Registration Number and Password will be generated by the system and sent through email and SMS.
  • Candidates can save the data by selecting "SAVE & NEXT" tab and can complete it later.
  • Before completing the registration, candidates should click on the Preview tab to preview and verify the entire application form.
  • After verifying all details, click on 'Complete Registration'.
  • Click on the 'Payment' tab and proceed for payment through online mode (Credit/Debit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards/Mobile Wallets).
  • After successful payment, an e-receipt will be generated. Take a printout of the e-receipt and online application form.
  • Candidates should upload:
    • Recent colour photograph (maximum one month old) - Size: 20-50 KB, Dimensions: 200 x 230 Pixels
    • Signature (scanned) - Size: 10-20 KB, Dimensions: 140 x 60 Pixels
    • Left thumb impression - Size: 20-50 KB, Dimensions: 240 x 240 pixels
    • Handwritten declaration - Size: 50-100 KB, Dimensions: 800 x 400 pixels
    • Live photograph using webcam or mobile phone
  • All documents should be in JPG/JPEG format only.
  • After successful submission, take a printout of the application form for future reference.

Note:

  • Candidates should submit their online application in the prescribed time without waiting for the last date.
  • Any change/modification may disqualify the candidate if details don't match with certificates.
  • In case of applying through e-mitra or any other source, candidate must get submission in his/her presence.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualification: Passing Intermediate (10+2) or equivalent from a recognized board/institute is mandatory.
  • Note: For the post of Stenographer, Maulvi Certificate, I.T.I. (two-year course certificate issued by NCVT/SCVT) and Polytechnic (three-year engineering diploma) will be considered equivalent to Intermediate.
  • Technical Qualification: Knowledge of shorthand in Hindi and English and computer typing/computer basics/word processing is mandatory.

Salary/ Stipend

  • Level–4 (25500 – 81100/-)

Age Limit (as on 01-08-2025)

  • Minimum 18 years and maximum unreserved (male)– 37 years, backward class/extremely backward class (male and female) and unreserved female– 40 years and scheduled caste/ scheduled tribe (male and female)– 42 years.

Application Fee

  • Each candidate has to deposit an examination fee of only 100/- (one hundred rupees).
  • Note: Those candidates who do not enter Aadhaar No. as identity card in the online application will have to pay an additional 200/- (two hundred) rupees as Biometric fee.

Important Dates

Online Application Start Date 12 January 2026
Last Date for Filling Online Application 2 February 2026

Selection Process

  • Written Examination and Practical Test.
  • A. Written Examination- The written examination will be objective in nature. This examination will have one paper on General Knowledge, which will include the following subjects:-
  • (a) General Studies - Number of questions-50
  • (b) General Science and Mathematics - Number of questions-50
  • (c) Mental Ability Test (Comprehension/Logic/Reasoning/Mental Ability) - Number of questions-50
  • The questions will be objective and multiple choice. Total number of questions-150. 4 marks are fixed for each correct answer and 1 mark will be deducted for each wrong answer. The duration of the examination will be 2 hours 15 minutes. The question papers in the written examination will be in Hindi/English language. If there is any difference in the Hindi and English question papers, then the English questions will be valid.
  • Note: In the light of resolution memo no. 2374 dated 16.07.2007 of Personnel and Administrative Reforms Department, Bihar and resolution memo no. 962 dated 22.01.2021 of General Administration Department, 40 (forty) percent for general category, 36.5 (thirty-six and a half) percent for backward class, 34 (thirty-four) percent for extremely backward class and 32 (thirty-two) percent minimum qualifying marks for scheduled caste/scheduled tribe/women and disabled candidates is mandatory.
  • Through the written examination, candidates equal to 05 times the number of vacancies available category-wise will be selected for the Practical Test (Skill Test).
  • B. Practical Test Examination:-
  • (i) In the shorthand test examination, 80 (eighty) words per minute speed for Hindi and English dictation total 320 (three hundred twenty) words have to be written in sign script in the provided notebook in 04 (four) minutes {(1 minute additional time at the beginning for dictation writing)} duration. After the prescribed dictation, 02 minutes additional time will be given for correction. Total 20 (twenty) minutes will be given for typing the shorthand passage.
  • (ii) Typing test examination (Hindi and English) will be taken on computer.
  • (iii) In Hindi typing test examination, Mangal font in Remington Gail Keyboard Layout will be used.
  • (iv) In Hindi typing test examination, candidates have to type total 300 (three hundred) words at a speed of 30 (thirty) words per minute in 10 (ten) minutes.
  • (v) In English typing test examination, “UTF-8” Under English (US) Keyboard Layout will be used.
  • (vi) In English typing test examination, total 300 (three hundred) words have to be typed in 10 (ten) minutes at a speed of 30 (thirty) words per minute.
  • (vii) Candidates should select the appropriate Keyboard Layout at the beginning of Typing, changing Keyboard Layout during Typing may erase the content typed by the candidate.
  • (viii) Compensatory time will be given to benchmark disabled (visually impaired) candidates as per rules.
  • (ix) More than 10 percent error in shorthand speed and 1.5 percent in typing will not be acceptable for success in the practical test examination.
  • (x) Candidates will ensure to follow the instructions displayed on the Computer Screen from time to time during the examination.
  • Note: Detailed information for the practical examination will be published after the written examination and the practical examination will be conducted in the light of the published information.
  • Candidates who have been debarred from examination for specified period by Union Public Service Commission/Bihar Public Service Commission/Bihar Staff Selection Commission/other selection commission in cases of malpractice will not be entitled to appear in the competition examination. The decision of the Commission on the point of eligibility or ineligibility of the candidates to sit in the examination will be final.
  • C. In the light of memo no. 1003 dated 22.01.2021 and letter no. 12897 dated 28.07.2022 of General Administration Department, Bihar, Patna, preference will be given in regular appointment to contractually appointed employees on similar posts.

General Information / Instructions

  • In the light of resolution memo no. 22218 dated 12.12.2022 of General Administration Department, 05 (five) years relaxation in the maximum age limit prescribed for participation in competitive examinations is permissible for government servants regularly appointed by the Bihar Government, but the relaxation in the said age limit will be allowed only when they have not availed more than 05 (five) opportunities till then.
  • In the light of resolution memo no. 962 dated 22.01.2021 of General Administration Department, Bihar, 10 years relaxation in maximum age limit is permissible for disabled persons.
  • In the light of the letter of General Administration Department, ex-servicemen will be given concession equivalent to 03 (three) years plus the period spent in defense service in the age limit, provided that their actual age does not exceed 57 years on the date of application.
  • Syllabus:- The syllabus of the written examination is as follows:-
  • Section (a):- General Studies:- The objective of the questions will be to test the candidate's general knowledge of the surrounding environment and its application in society. Questions related to current events and subtle observation of day-to-day events and scientific approach towards them will also be included, about which an educated person is expected to have knowledge. Questions may be asked especially about Bihar, India and its neighboring countries.
  • (i) Contemporary Issues:- Scientific progress, National/International Awards, Indian Languages, Book, Script, Capital, Currency, Sports-Players, Important Events.
  • (ii) India and its Neighboring Countries:- History of Neighboring Countries, History of India, Culture, Geography, Economic Scenario, Freedom Movement, Main Features of Indian Agriculture and Natural Resources and Constitution and Polity of India, Political System of the Country, Panchayati Raj, Community Development, Five-Year Plan and Contribution of Bihar in the National Movement.
  • Section (b):- General Science and Mathematics:- Questions may generally be asked from the following subjects at the Matric level-
  • (i) General Science:- Basic questions related to Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Geography and knowledge of computer basics/word processing.
  • (ii) Mathematics:- Questions related to number system, computation of whole numbers, decimals and fractions, interrelationship between numbers, basic arithmetical operations, percentage, ratio and proportion, average, interest and profit and loss.
  • Section (c):- Mental Ability Test:- Both verbal and non-verbal types of questions may be asked such as- analogy, similarity and difference, space visualization, problem solving, analysis, visual memory, discrimination, observation, relationship concept, arithmetical reasoning, arithmetical number series, code writing and code interpretation, series, classification, mirror image, hidden figure, picture matrix, paper cutting, group images, shape construction and dice, analogy, analytical reasoning, water image, pattern completion, paper folding, rule detection, dot situation, picture formation and analysis.
  • 7. Merit List:-After passing the practical test examination, the merit list will be prepared by the Commission by adding the marks obtained in the written examination and the preference marks obtained on the basis of contract. In case of equal marks in the written examination, the merit list will be determined on the basis of marks obtained in General Studies subject. In case of equal marks in General Studies subject also, priority will be given to the marks obtained in General Science and Mathematics subject. If the marks in General Science and Mathematics subject are equal, the candidate with higher age will be placed higher in the merit order on the basis of date of birth and if the date of birth is the same, the candidate whose name comes first according to the alphabet in Devanagari script will be placed higher in the merit order. In this way the final merit list will be prepared.

How to Apply

  • (i) Candidates are not required to send hard copy of application form and related documents to the Commission office. If any supplementary documents or hard copy application is given by the candidate himself, then that hard copy application/documents and any claim made on its basis will not be admissible.
  • (ii) The examination will be conducted considering the educational qualification, technical qualification and reservation related claims filled in the online application by the candidates as true. The preliminary check of the certificates uploaded in the online application and matching with the original certificates will be done only at the time of document verification. Generally it will not be checked before that and if the certificates are not found correct in the later check, or the fact/evidence given by the candidate is found wrong/erroneous, then the application of the candidate will be cancelled and the decision of the Commission on this will be final and the candidate will have no objection on it. Also due to this, the candidate can be declared ineligible for present and future, the full responsibility of which will be of the candidate only.
  • (iii) Necessary (detailed) instructions related to filling online application are displayed on the official website of the Commission www.bpsc.bihar.gov.in.
  • Candidates will study the said guidelines well before filling the online application and will enter all the information correctly and clearly in the course of filling the online application.

Applications are invited in the prescribed format only for a purely time bound research project undertaken at IIT Patna in the Department of Electrical Engineering. Interviews will be conducted online.

Name of Temporary Assignment Number of Posts
Junior Research Fellow (JRF) 02

Eligibility Criteria

1. Educational Qualification

Candidates must possess one of the following:

  • BE/BTech/MSc/ME/MTech/equivalent degree in Electrical Engineering (EE), Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE), Instrumentation, Physics or related discipline, OR
  • BE/BTech/MSc/ME/MTech/MCA/equivalent degree in Computer Science & Engineering (CSE), Information Technology (IT) or related discipline.

2. GATE/NET and Academic Requirements

A candidate must satisfy one of the following criteria:

  • Option 1: BE/BTech/MSc/MCA/equivalent degree with valid GATE score (not before 2023) above the prescribed cut-off level or NET qualification, and CPI of 7.5 or 70% marks.
  • The requirement of GATE score is waived for candidates with Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering from Centrally Funded Technical Institutes (CFTIs) with CGPA > 8.0 (out of 10) and other IITs.
  • Option 2: ME/MTech/equivalent degree with GATE qualification (not before 2023) and minimum CPI of 6.5 or 60% marks.

3. Experience / Domain Preference

  • Candidates willing to work and having some prior knowledge in digital signal processing, Machine/Deep Learning and Artificial Intelligence will be given priority.
  • GATE/NET qualification will be advantageous although not mandatory, subject to fulfilling other criteria.

Age Limit

  • The advertisement does not specify explicit minimum or maximum age limits for the JRF post.
  • Eligibility is governed by the academic and GATE/NET criteria defined for the research project.

Selection Process

  • Applications will be screened based on eligibility and completeness; incomplete applications will not be considered.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be informed to appear for an online interview.
  • The online interview link will be intimated via email to shortlisted candidates.

  4. Sign and date the application form at the designated place.
  5. Send the complete filled application form by email to [email protected] addressed to Dr. Sumanta Gupta, Department of Electrical Engineering, IIT Patna.

How to Apply

  • Step 1 - Registration:
    • Visit the official website: bceceboard.bihar.gov.in
    • Click on "Online Portal of Junior Resident under Health Dept." link
    • Click on "Apply for Junior Resident" link
    • Read all instructions carefully
    • Fill all information correctly in the Online Application Form
    • Use your own or parents' email address and mobile number
    • Verify the verification code sent to mobile and email
    • After successful registration, you will receive Registration Number and Password
    • Keep your password confidential
  • Step 2 - Multi-Step Application Form:
    • (a) Personal Information: Sign in to your account, fill required personal information, click "Save & Continue"
    • (b) Contact Details: Submit Permanent and Correspondence Address, click "Save & Continue"
    • (c) Educational Information: Submit all educational details, click "Save & Continue"
    • (d) Upload Photo & Signature: Upload scanned copy of high contrast color photograph and signature, click "Save & Continue"
  • Step 3 - Application Preview & Final Submit:
    • Check all entries provided in Step-1 and Step-2
    • If any anomalies found, click "Back to Edit" and rectify
    • After rectification, click "Save & Continue"
    • If all information is correct, click "Final Submit & Proceed to Payment"
    • Give declaration and proceed to payment
  • Step 4 - Payment of Counselling Fee:
    • Pay Rs. 2,250/- through online mode only
    • Payment options: Debit Card/Credit Card/Net Banking/UPI
    • Additional processing charges will be applicable
    • If payment fails but amount debited, re-pay the full fee
    • Failed transaction will be refunded in due course
    • Payment must be completed by 06/02/2026 (11:59 PM)
  • Step 5 - Download Confirmation Page & Fee Receipt:
    • After successful payment, download Confirmation Page and Fee Receipt
    • Re-verify all entries on confirmation page
    • If discrepancy found, correct during editing period (07/02/2026 to 08/02/2026)
    • Keep confirmation page for future reference and counselling

Selection Process

  • Written competitive examination and physical efficiency test process will be adopted.
  • Written Examination: The level of written examination will be of Bihar School Examination Committee 10th class (Matric) or equivalent level. Written examination will have objective questions from 1. Hindi, 2. English, 3. Mathematics, 4. Social Science (History, Geography, Civics, Economics), 5. Science (Physics, Chemistry, Zoology, Botany), 6. General Knowledge and Current Affairs. Written examination will be of 100 marks.
  • Question Paper: Two hours one question paper will have total 100 questions. In which one (01) mark will be given for each correct answer.
  • OMR/Answer Booklet: OMR/Answer booklet will be in two copies out of which one copy will be kept safe as invisible carbon copy with the commission for one year after publication of final selection list.
  • Candidates scoring less than 30 percent in written examination will be declared failed for physical efficiency/qualification test.
  • On the basis of marks obtained in written examination as far as possible advertised vacancies reservation category wise 05 (five) times candidates of each category will be selected for physical efficiency test. In case of non-availability of sufficient number of qualified candidates for physical check, the ratio of candidates can be suitably reduced by the commission.
  • Written examination will not be basis of final merit list. Written examination will only be qualifying for physical efficiency test.
  • Physical Efficiency Test: Physical efficiency test will be organized for eligible candidates on the basis of written competitive examination organized by the commission.
  • Process, items and level of physical efficiency test will be same as prescribed for constable post in Bihar Police.
  • Physical efficiency test will be of total 100 (one hundred) marks. No marks will be given for height and chest but candidates not fulfilling prescribed qualifications will be declared failed.
  • Running - maximum 50 marks
  • For all category males: 1 (one) mile (1.6 km) maximum time: 6 minutes.
  • Less than 5 minutes: 50 marks
  • 5 minutes to 5 minutes 20 seconds: 40 marks
  • 5 minutes 20 seconds more and up to 5 minutes 40 seconds: 30 marks
  • 5 minutes 40 seconds more and up to 6 minutes: 20 marks
  • Male candidates taking more than 6 minutes will be declared failed.
  • For all category females: 1 (one) kilometer maximum time: 5 minutes.
  • Less than 4 minutes: 50 marks
  • 4 minutes to 4 minutes 20 seconds: 40 marks
  • 4 minutes 20 seconds more and up to 4 minutes 40 seconds: 30 marks
  • 4 minutes 40 seconds more and up to 5 minutes: 20 marks
  • Female candidates taking more than 5 minutes will be declared failed.
  • Shot Put - maximum 25 marks
  • For all category males: 16 pound shot minimum 16 (sixteen) feet throw.
  • 16 feet to 17 feet: 09 marks
  • 17 feet more and 18 feet: 13 marks
  • 18 feet more and 19 feet: 17 marks
  • 19 feet more and 20 feet: 21 marks
  • 20 feet more: 25 marks
  • Male candidates throwing less than 16 (sixteen) feet will be declared failed.
  • For all category females: 12 pound shot minimum 12 (twelve) feet throw.
  • 12 feet to 13 feet: 09 marks
  • 13 feet more and 14 feet: 13 marks
  • 14 feet more and 15 feet: 17 marks
  • 15 feet more and 16 feet: 21 marks
  • 16 feet more: 25 marks
  • Female candidates throwing less than 12 (twelve) feet will be declared failed.
  • High Jump - maximum 25 marks
  • For all category males: minimum height 4 (four) feet
  • 04 feet: 13 marks
  • 04 feet 4 inch: 17 marks
  • 04 feet 8 inch: 21 marks
  • 05 feet: 25 marks
  • Male candidates jumping less than 4 (four) feet will be declared failed.
  • For all category females: minimum height 3 (three) feet
  • 03 feet: 13 marks
  • 03 feet 4 inch: 17 marks
  • 03 feet 8 inch: 21 marks
  • 04 feet: 25 marks
  • Female candidates jumping less than 3 (three) feet will be declared failed.
  • For Kinnaur/Kothi/Hijda/Transgender (Third Gender) candidates physical standards and physical efficiency test standards will be same as backward class candidates.
  • Candidates completing run in prescribed time (6 minutes for males and 5 minutes for females) but not fulfilling minimum prescribed criteria in shot put/high jump competitions will be declared failed and such candidate will not be given opportunity to participate in other competitions. Candidate has to be successful separately in all competitions. Maximum three chances will be given only in shot put and high jump.

How to Apply

  • Officer-in-Charge Polyclinic: Graduate. Only retired service officers from Indian Army, Indian Navy and Indian Air Force drawing pension from Defence estimates through CDA with minimum 5 years work experience in Health care institution or managerial positions.
  • Gynaecologist: MD/MS in speciality concerned / DNB with minimum 03 years experience in the specialty.
  • Medical Specialist (Gen Med): Recognized Post Graduate qualification in the concerned specialty with requisite post-PG experience as specified in the notification.
  • Radiologist: Recognized medical qualification as per Indian Medical Council Act 1956 with Post Graduate degree in Radiology as per Central Health Service Regulations 1996 and minimum 05 years experience in the specialty after Post Graduation.
  • Medical Officer: MBBS with minimum 03 years experience after internship; preferable additional qualification in Medicine/Surgery.
  • Dental Officer: BDS with minimum 03 years work experience after internship.
  • Dental Hygienist: Diploma Holder in Dental Hygiene / Class 1 DH / DORA Course (Armed Forces) with minimum 05 years experience in dental lab.
  • Radiographer: Diploma / Class 1 Radiographer Course (Armed Forces) with minimum 05 years experience.
  • Physiotherapist: Diploma / Class 1 Physiotherapy Course (Armed Forces) with minimum five years experience.
  • Nursing Assistant: Class 1 Nursing Assistant Course (Armed Forces) with minimum 05 years experience.
  • Pharmacist: B Pharm from a recognized institute OR 10+2 with Science stream (Physics, Chemistry and Biology) and approved Diploma in Pharmacy from an institute recognized by the Pharmacy Council of India, registered as Pharmacist under Pharmacy Act 1948, with minimum 03 years experience.
  • Laboratory Assistant: DMLT / Class-1 Lab Tech Course (Armed Forces) with minimum 05 years experience in Lab.
  • Laboratory Technician: B.Sc (Medical Lab Technology) OR 10+2 with Science and Diploma in Medical Lab Technology from recognized institution with minimum 03 years experience as Lab Assistant in medical Lab.
  • Driver: 8th Class / Class 1 MT Driver (Armed Forces) possessing a civil driving license (LMV) with minimum 05 years experience as driver.
  • Safaiwala: Literate with minimum 05 years experience.
  • Female Attendant: Literate with minimum 05 years experience in Civil / Army Health Institutions.
  • Chowkidar: Class VIII or GD Trade for Armed Forces personnel.
  • Peon: Class VIII / GD Trade (Armed Forces) with minimum 05 years service as mentioned in the notification.
  • Clerk/Data Entry Operator: Graduate / Class-I Clerical trade (Armed Forces) with minimum 05 years service.

  • Gynaecologist: Full Time (5 hrs) Rs 1,30,000/- per month.
  • Medical Specialist (Gen Med): Part Time 4 hrs Rs 4670/- per day.
  • Radiologist: 3 hrs Rs 3500/- per day; 2 hrs Rs 2330/- per day. Per day payment will change in case monthly payment will be revised.
  • Medical Officer: Rs 95,000/- per month.
  • Dental Officer: Rs 95,000/- per month.
  • Dental Hygienist: Rs 36,500/- per month.
  • Radiographer: Rs 36,500/- per month.

  • Maximum age for Medical Officer is 66 years.

  • Maximum age for technical and support staff such as Dental Hygienist, Radiographer, Physiotherapist, Nursing Assistant, Pharmacist, Laboratory Assistant, Laboratory Technician is 56 years.

Selection Process

  • Applications will be scrutinized at ECHS Cell, Station Headquarters Thiruvananthapuram based on eligibility, mandated qualifications and experience.
  • Shortlisted candidates will only be called for written test and interview.
  • Written test will be conducted prior to interview except for Peon, Chowkidar, Female Attendant and Safaiwala.
  • Eligible candidates will be informed telephonically/through e-mail regarding written test and interview schedule.
  • Appointing authority reserves the right to reject/cancel applications based on incomplete applications/certificates/mandated qualifications/experience without assigning reasons.
  • Employment will be purely contractual for 11/12 months and at the discretion of the appointing authority. Contract can be terminated by either side by giving one month notice.
  • Hiring duration of the vacancy reserved for ESM/Civilian is 12 months. Civilian selected in lieu of Ex Servicemen vacancy will be for a period of 11 months only.
  • All those candidates who have worked in Empanelled Hospitals will have a clear gap of one year between appointments.
  • Selected Officers (Officer in Charge, Medical Officer, Medical Specialists, Radiologist, Gynaecologist and Dental Officer) will undergo 10 days On Job Training (OJT); this duration will remain unpaid and is mandatory before assuming contractual appointment.

  • Applications are invited for short listing suitable candidates for contractual hiring for 11/12 months duration on required basis for vacancies occurring in ECHS Polyclinics during 2026–27 as noted against each category.

  • Candidates may preferably apply for only one post/vacancy in two ECHS Polyclinic locations.

  • All Ex-Servicemen/dependents applying for the posts must register their names with AWPO and the Registration Number must be quoted in the application.

  • Download the application form for employment in ECHS which is attached with the notification in editable PDF format.
  • Type all data in the application form, take a printout and affix a recent passport size photograph in the space provided.
  • Fill details of post applied for, personal particulars, postal address with pincode, category, date of birth, Aadhaar number, PAN card number, AWPO Registration number, higher qualification and educational qualifications as per table in the form.
  • Provide complete details of work experience with period of employment, total experience and reason for leaving the job; attach experience certificates for consideration.
  • Ex-servicemen must provide details such as Arms/Service, unit last served, total period of service including SSC if any, previous service in Army/Central/State Govt, PPO and full discharge book details.
  • Attach attested photocopies of all required documents including educational certificates, mark sheets, attempts certificates, registration certificates, internship certificates, medical fitness certificate, Aadhar and PAN cards as specified.
  • Ensure all statements in the application form are correct and complete; sign the declaration with place, date and name of applicant.
  • Send the duly filled and signed application form along with attested copies of documents by post so as to reach Station Headquarters (ECHS), Pangode, Thirumala PO, Thiruvananthapuram - 695 006 on or before 10 Feb 2026.

  • Candidates having work experience in Reserve Bank of India: To the extent of number of years of such experience, subject to maximum of 3 years.

Application Fee

Category Charges Amount*

GEN/OBC/EWS Application fee including intimation charges ₹450/- plus 18% GST
Staff@ Nil Nil

Important Dates

Event Date
Website Link Open January 15, 2026 – February 04, 2026
Payment of Test Fees (Online) January 15, 2026 – February 04, 2026

Selection Process

  • Selection will be through Online Test and Language Proficiency Test (LPT).
  • Online Test (Multiple Choice): Reasoning (30 questions, 30 marks), General English (30,30), General Awareness (30,30), Numerical ability (30,30). Total 120 questions, 120 marks, 90 minutes.
  • There will be negative marks for wrong answers in the Online Test. 1/4th marks will be deducted for each wrong answer.
  • Candidates will have to qualify in each part of the online test separately.
  • Language Proficiency Test (LPT): The candidates provisionally shortlisted from the online test will have to undergo a language proficiency test (LPT). LPT will be of qualifying nature and will be conducted in the Official / Local Language/s of the State concerned. Candidates not proficient in the Official / Local Language as per LPT shall be disqualified.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates can apply for vacancy in one Office only and will have to opt for online test (pre-examination training, if any) centre within the same state/UTs of the office for which he/she is applying.
  • The online test will be bilingual, i.e., available in English and Hindi except for the test of English Language.
  • Candidates will have to visit the Bank's website for downloading call letters for online test. Intimation for downloading call letter will also be sent through email/SMS.
  • Use of MOBILE PHONES and other electronic devices BANNED: Mobile phones or any other communication devices are not allowed inside the premises, where the examination is being conducted. Any infringement of these instructions shall entail disqualification including ban from future examinations.
  • Candidates are not permitted to use or be in possession of calculators in examination premises.
  • Candidates are advised, in their own interest, not to bring any of the banned items including mobile phones to the venue of the examination, as arrangement for safekeeping cannot be assured.
  • The post is also open to the employees of the Bank (staff candidates) who satisfy the eligibility criteria.
  • Any legal proceedings in respect of any matter of claim or dispute arising out of this advertisement and / or an application in response thereto can be instituted only in Mumbai and courts/ tribunals/ forums at Mumbai only shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction to try any cause / dispute.
  • Candidate's admission to the Online Test / LPT is strictly provisional. The mere fact that the call letter has been issued to the candidate does not imply that his candidature has been finally cleared by the Bank.
  • In case it is detected at any stage of recruitment that a candidate does not fulfil the eligibility norms and / or that he / she has furnished any incorrect / false information or has suppressed any material fact(s), his /her candidature will stand cancelled. If any of these shortcomings is / are detected even after appointment, his /her services are liable to be terminated.

How to Apply

  • Candidates can apply online only at the link: "Recruitment for the post of Office Attendant - PY 2025", and no other mode of application will be accepted.
  • Before applying online, candidates should scan their photograph and signature ensuring that both the photograph and signature adhere to the required specifications as given under Guideline for photograph & signature scan and upload.
  • To make online payment of application fees/ intimation charges candidate should keep the necessary details/ documents ready.
  • Candidate should have a valid personal email ID, which should be kept active till the declaration of result.
  • Candidates satisfying the conditions of eligibility as on January 01, 2026, are first required to visit the URL "Recruitment for the post of Office Attendant - PY 2025" in the advertisement page for filling the 'Online Application'.
  • Candidates will have to enter their basic details and upload the photograph, signature, left thumb impression and a hand-written declaration in the online application form as per the specifications given.
  • To register application, choose the tab "Click here for New Registration" and enter Name, Contact details and Email-id. A Provisional Registration Number and Password will be generated by the system and displayed on the screen.
  • In case the candidate is unable to complete the application form in one go, he / she can save the data already entered by choosing "SAVE AND NEXT" tab.

(Res) dated 01.07.1998, and they are treated at par with unreserved candidates with respect to their selection. Application Fee exemption is, however, applicable for eligible candidates in such cases.
  • The OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) are required to additionally furnish a 'Form of Declaration' (Annexure III) supporting their claim that they do not belong to the OBC (Creamy Layer) category based on income for the immediately preceding three financial years.

Eligibility Criteria

  • IT Infrastructure – Lead Systems/Servers (Assistant Vice President):
    • Educational Qualification: M.E / M. Tech in Computer Science / Information Technology / MCA or equivalent degree from a reputed University.
    • Experience: Minimum 7 years of working experience in Application/Database/Network infrastructure Maintenance.
    • Desirable expertise: Strong exposure in Database Management, Network maintenance, Active Directory Domain, Server Maintenance and Storage; understanding of Server Maintenance, Database Installation, Network Architecture, VM, Storage, OpenShift / Kubernetes required for a Banking IT Eco System.
    • Additional: Knowledge and experience in Databases like Oracle/MS SQL/Postgres etc. and Windows Server / AIX / Linux administration; experience in Virtualization technologies (VMware ESXi / Microsoft HyperV / Nutanix) and Containerized platforms (OpenShift / Kubernetes); knowledge in Cloud computing preferred; OCA/OCP or CCNA/CCNP Certification.
  • Software Engineer - Lead API Developer (Senior Manager):
    • Educational Qualification: B.E / B. Tech in Computer Science / Information Technology / MCA or equivalent degree from a reputed University.
    • Experience: Minimum 7 years of working experience in Banking/FinTech Industry having exposure to Software Development & knowledge in emerging trends in Digital Product Eco System.
    • Desirable: 7 years of experience in software development with at least 5 years leading software development teams; experience in Full Stack development and implementation; end to end Software implementation exposure from DRG to go-live; thorough knowledge in API development (Java based API/Web Services – SOAP, REST or GraphQL), web-based architecture using Angular/NodeJS, microservices, API Gateways and ESB systems like IBM CP4I.
    • Additional: Deep understanding of software development methodologies (Agile, Waterfall), proficiency in programming languages (Java, C++, C#, Python etc.), experience with tools and frameworks (Git, Jenkins, Maven), database design (SQL, NoSQL), and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP). Exposure to banking/financial applications, regulations, compliance, financial products and Banking Digital Products.
  • Data Scientist (Manager):
    • Educational Qualification: Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, or a related field.
    • Experience: 5 years of work experience in a Bank / any financial institution / large databases as Data Scientist.
    • Desirable: Strong programming skills in Python, R, or similar languages; proficiency in data visualization tools like SAS, Tableau, Power BI; experience in building predictive models to forecast future outcomes; excellent problem-solving and analytical skills; strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Statistician (Manager):
    • Educational Qualification: Master’s degree or PhD in Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.
    • Experience: 5 years of work experience in a Bank / any financial institution / large databases as Statistician.
    • Desirable: Experience in statistical modelling and analysis techniques; excellent problem-solving and analytical skills; strong knowledge of statistical software packages like R, SAS; strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Data Analyst (Manager):
    • Educational Qualification: B.E / B.Tech in Computer Science / Information Technology / MCA / Master’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.
    • Experience: 5 years of work experience in a Bank / any financial institution as Data Analyst.
    • Desirable: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; proficiency in SQL and data analysis tools; experience with data visualization tools (preferred); good communication and interpersonal skills.
  • IT Infrastructure - System/Server Administrator (Assistant Manager):
    • Educational Qualification: B.E / B. Tech in Computer Science / Information Technology / MCA or equivalent degree from a reputed University.
    • Experience: Minimum 2 years of working experience in Server infrastructure Maintenance.
    • Desirable: Adequate knowledge and experience in Windows Server / AIX / Linux administration; ability to manage Virtualization technologies (VMware ESXi / Microsoft HyperV / Nutanix); experience in Container platforms (OpenShift / Kubernetes) desirable; knowledge in Cloud computing preferred; hands-on experience in Backup Software and Patch Management Tool with system security skills; experience in Enterprise Storage Administration an added advantage.
  • Software Engineer – API Developers (Assistant Manager):
    • Educational Qualification: B.E / B. Tech in Computer Science / Information Technology / MCA or equivalent degree from a reputed University.
    • Experience: Minimum 2 years of working experience in Software Development/Testing/Maintenance.
    • Desirable: Good understanding of Software Development Process; experience in agile/Scrum SDLC; development of Java based API/Web Services (SOAP, REST) or GraphQL APIs; development in web-based architecture using Angular/NodeJS; understanding and development of microservices; working with API Gateways and ESB systems like IBM CP4I; knowledge on Deployment and Docker; prior experience in Financial/Payment services preferred.
  • Software Engineer – Software Programmers (Assistant Manager):
    • Educational Qualification: B.E / B. Tech in Computer Science / Information Technology / MCA or equivalent degree from a reputed University.
    • Experience: Minimum 3 years of working experience in Software Development/Testing/Maintenance.
    • Desirable: Good understanding of Software Development Process; experience in agile/Scrum SDLC; experience in Full stack Java Development (J2EE)/Springboot and unit testing framework; development in web-based architecture using Angular/NodeJS, JavaScripts/JSP; understanding and development of microservices; knowledge on Deployment and Docker; prior experience in Financial/Payment services preferred.
  • Software Engineer – CBS Customization/Admin (Assistant Manager):
    • Educational Qualification: B.E / B. Tech in Computer Science / Information Technology / MCA or equivalent degree from a reputed University.
    • Experience: Minimum 3 years of working experience in large Banking Software.
    • Desirable: Thorough knowledge on Banking Software like Finacle 10x CBS scripting/Development/Customization/Testing/Maintenance; good understanding of Software Development Process; experience in Java, Unix Scripts, Finacle Scripting and unit testing framework; good domain knowledge on various Banking products and experience in Financial/Payment services; knowledge on Finacle CBS architecture/database preferred.
  • Data Analyst & Statistician (Assistant Manager):
    • Educational Qualification: B.E / B. Tech in Computer Science / Information Technology / MCA / MSc Statistics or equivalent degree from a reputed University.
    • Experience: Minimum 3 years of working experience in large databases.
    • Desirable: Good understanding of Software Development Process; experience in managing and processing large data sets with databases Oracle, MSSQL; proficiency in R, Python, Statistical Analysis, Machine learning, SQL, Data Visualization tools; expertise in building Predictive/Prescriptive Analytical models and Statistical analysis in Banking/Financial industry; good domain knowledge on Banking products and experience in Financial/Payment services.
  • Oracle HCM (Payroll & Integrations) – Assistant Manager:
    • Educational Qualification: B.E / B. Tech in Computer Science / Information Technology / MCA or equivalent degree from a reputed University with minimum 2 years of working experience in Financial Compliance, Data Integrity, and Backend Systems, Payroll for India, OIC Services, Compensation Workbench.
    • Desirable Certifications: Oracle Payroll Cloud 2025/2026 Certified Implementation Professional; Oracle Cloud Platform Application Integration 2025/2026 Professional (covers OIC Gen 3).
    • Desirable Experience/Eligibility: Handle end-to-end configuration of Oracle Fusion Payroll for India including statutory compliance (PF, ESI, PT), Investment Declarations (80C), Form 16; write and maintain Fast Formulas; implement Oracle Fusion Compensation Workbench; manage Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) for secure data exchange; monitor error logs and troubleshoot HDL issues; deep expertise in Global Payroll (India Legislation); strong technical knowledge of OIC, HDL, Fast Formulas, SOAP/REST API; experience with financial reporting and reconciliation.
  • Oracle HCM (Talent, Workflow & Experience) – Assistant Manager:
    • Educational Qualification: B.E / B. Tech in Computer Science / Information Technology / MCA or equivalent degree from a reputed University with minimum 3 years of working experience in User Interface, Approval Hierarchies, and Learning/Support, Core HR, Talent Management, Expenses, Learning Management, HR Helpdesk.
    • Desirable Certifications: Oracle Global Human Resources Cloud 2025/2026 Certified Implementation Professional; Oracle Talent Management Cloud 2025/2026 Certified Implementation Professional.
    • Desirable Experience/Eligibility: Develop custom user interfaces and extend pages using VBCS; manage Oracle Fusion HCM Base Cloud Service and Talent Management configurations; configure dynamic approval groups using BPM Worklist; manage Fusion Expense Management; implement Fusion Learning Management for compliance training; deploy HR Helpdesk; strong expertise in Core HR, Talent and Learning; technical proficiency in VBCS and BPM Worklist; experience with OTBI for management dashboards.

  • Oracle HCM (Payroll & Integrations) (Assistant Manager): Maximum age 30 years.

Application Fee

Important Dates

Event Date
Opening date for registering Online e-application 26-01-2026
Closing date for registering Online e-application 09-02-2026

Selection Process

  • The shortlisted candidates should appear for interview.
  • Candidates will be called for personal interview through Direct / Video Conferencing.
  • The mode of interview, date and time will be communicated to the eligible candidates individually.
  • The e-applications will be scrutinized and the shortlisted applicants will be communicated individually by post / e-mail with details of the interview.
  • The Bank reserves the right to eliminate ineligible candidates at any point of time before, during or after the personal interview / selection.

General Information/Instructions

  • Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Ltd. is one of the leading old Private Sector Banks on a high growth path inviting applications from dynamic and result oriented individuals for Specialist Officer (IT) posts.
  • Candidates are requested to apply only ON-LINE through TMB’s website www.ib.tmbonline.bank.in/tmb_careers/. No other mode of submission of application will be accepted by the Bank.
  • Register your correct email ID/ Mobile Number while creating User ID. It should be kept active till completion of the recruitment project as call letters and communications may be sent to the registered email ID.
  • The posting will be at Chennai. The job role is subject to transferability based on requirements.
  • Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.
  • The application should reach the Bank on or before 09.02.2026 as per the online process described.
  • The Bank reserves the right to reject any application without assigning any reason and its decision in eligibility, interview and selection will be final.
  • e-applications with incorrect / incomplete particulars or without copies of certificates attached as required are liable to be rejected.
  • The Bank reserves the right to eliminate ineligible candidates at any point of time and no correspondence in this regard will be entertained.

How to Apply

  • Before applying online, candidates should go through the detailed advertisement by clicking the “Download Advertisement” under the title “Recruitment of Specialist Officers” in the website (www.ib.tmbonline.bank.in/tmb_careers/) and ensure eligibility.
  • Candidates must have a valid personal email ID and contact number which should remain active till completion of the recruitment project. If a candidate does not have a valid email ID, he/she should create one before applying.
  • Candidates are requested to log on to the Bank’s website (www.ib.tmbonline.bank.in/tmb_careers/), click “Apply Online” and register themselves for the appropriate post of “Recruitment of Specialist Officer”.
  • On successful registration, the activation link will be sent to the registered Email ID and the Registration Number and Password will be sent to the registered mobile number. Candidates should note this for future reference.
  • Candidates must click the activation link sent to the registered Email ID to access the Careers portal and login with Application number (Registration Number/Username) and password.
  • Fill all details in the online application carefully and click “Save/Continue” on every page. The name of the candidate and relations should match the certificate/mark sheets.
  • Upload photograph (390 X 520 pixels preferred, size not more than 120 KB) and signature (240 X 240 pixels preferred, size not more than 60 KB). Signature in capital letters will not be accepted.
  • Upload required enclosures (each not more than 250 KB) including self-attested SSLC/Higher Secondary Mark Sheet/Transfer Certificate for age proof, degree certificates, experience certificates and relieving letters, and last month salary slip.
  • On successful submission, click confirm/submit and a message “Registration is successful” will be displayed. A system generated online application form will be sent to the registered Email ID; candidates should take a printout for future reference.
  • Candidates are advised to strictly adhere to eligibility conditions. Any wrong information or ineligibility detected at any stage will result in disqualification.
