Eligibility Criteria

  • Essential qualification, desirable qualifications, age and experience for the above posts are as per Recruitment Rules (2019) for Non-teaching staff in NITs notified vide No.F.35-5/2018-TS.III of MHRD’s letters dated 20.02.2019 and 04.04.2019.
  • For Junior Assistant (Recruitment Rules 2019 extract included in the PDF): Senior secondary (10+2) from a recognized board with a minimum Typing speed of 35 w.p.m. and proficiency in Computer Word Processing and Spread Sheet.
  • Desirable for Junior Assistant: Proficiency in other computer skills; stenography skills.
  • Experience and other conditions are to be read as per the detailed Recruitment Rules (2019) for Non-teaching staff in NITs referred to in the notification.

Salary/Stipend

  • Junior Assistant: Pay Level 3 as per Seventh CPC [equivalent to PB-1 & Grade Pay 2000/- in Sixth CPC].
  • Senior Assistant: Pay Level 4 as per Seventh CPC [equivalent to PB-1 & Grade Pay 2400/- in Sixth CPC].
  • All recruitment and pay-fixation shall be done only on the recommendations of the duly constituted Selection Committee and there shall be no scope of fixing or altering pay outside the Selection Committee.

Age Limit 

  • Maximum age limit shall be as per Recruitment Rules (2019) for Non-teaching staff in NITs.
  • For Junior Assistant (as per Recruitment Rules extract in the PDF): 27 years; relaxable for Departmental Candidates up to five years in accordance with the instructions or orders issued by the Central Government.
  • For Senior Assistant: 33 years Note:- Relaxable for Departmental Candidates upto five years in accordance with the instructions or orders issued by the Central Government
  • Age limit and other eligibility conditions for all the positions shall be determined on the last date of submission of online application, i.e. 30.01.2026.
  • Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PwD/Ex-Servicemen applicants shall be applicable as per Government of India norms. No relaxation is applicable to SC/ST/OBC/PwD applicants applying for Unreserved (UR) vacancies.
  • Category-wise age relaxation beyond the upper age limit:
    • SC/ST: 5 years.
    • OBC (NCL): 3 years.
    • PwD (UR): 10 years.
    • PwD + OBC (NCL): 13 years.
    • PwD + SC/ST: 15 years.
    • Ex-Servicemen: Up to the extent of service rendered in Defence Forces (Army, Navy & Air Force) plus 3 years, subject to production of prescribed certificate.
    • Departmental candidates with three years continuous service in Central Government: 5 years (additional, where applicable).
    • Widows, divorced women and women judicially separated from their husbands and who are not re-married: Up to 35 years (up to 40 years for SC/ST), without relaxation of educational qualification or method of recruitment.
    • Regular staff of NITT who were appointed before 2012: Allowed to participate in the selection process irrespective of age and percentage of marks, as per No.F.35-5/2018-TS.III dated 20th February 2019 – point 4.b.(iii).

Application Fee

  • Applicants belonging to UR, EWS, OBC (Non-creamy layer) & Ex-servicemen category shall be required to pay online non-refundable fee of Rs. 1,000/-.
  • The application fee of Rs. 500/- shall be refunded to the Ex-servicemen candidates subject to appearing for the Selection Process i.e. Screening Test.
  • SC/ST/Women applicants are required to pay online Rs. 500/- only towards online application.
  • The PwBD candidates have been exempted from the Application & Processing Fee.
  • The application fee once paid is non-refundable under any circumstances (except the specified refund to Ex-servicemen as stated).

Important Dates

Details Date
Date of advertisement 02.01.2026
Opening date for online application 02.01.2026
Closing date for submission of online application 30.01.2026
Closing date for submission of hardcopy application 06.02.2026

Selection Process

  • Screening of online applications received may be done to restrict the number of applicants to be called for selection process. The Institute at its discretion may restrict the number of applicants to be called at any stage of the selection process.
  • List of shortlisted applicants to be called for the selection process on a given date and time will be published on the Institute website only, and such applicants may also be intimated on their registered email id.
  • The Institute may decide to conduct a selection process comprising of multiple stages of selection; details of selection process will be published along with the list of shortlisted candidates.
  • All details related to recruitment process shall be available on the Institute website only; applicants are advised to keep a regular watch on the Institute’s website.
  • Screening of applications will be done on the basis of requirements mentioned in the Recruitment Rules and as per the conditions laid down by the duly constituted Screening Committee.
  • Selection process may consist of Screening Test (only for the purpose of shortlisting of applicants), Skill Test (qualifying in nature) and Main Written Test.
  • Canvassing in any manner would entail disqualification of the candidature.

General Information/Instructions

  • Applicants applying in response to this advertisement should satisfy themselves regarding their eligibility for the post applied for and must be fulfilling the eligibility criteria as on the closing date of online applications, failing which their application is liable for rejection at any stage.
  • Any requisite experience gained after the minimum qualifying degree will only be taken into consideration.
  • Applicants would be allowed to appear in the selection process on the basis of the information furnished by them in their application form; issuance of letter for the selection process will not confer any right for appointment.
  • If the applicants are found ineligible at any stage of recruitment process, their candidature may be cancelled and, if selected, appointment may also be cancelled. Hiding information or submitting false information may lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage of recruitment and may invite penal action.
  • The applicants are required to apply through Online mode only. Application in any other form will not be accepted and will be summarily rejected. Applications which are not in prescribed form / without relevant supporting enclosures may be out rightly rejected.
  • NIT Tiruchirappalli strives to have a workforce which also reflects gender balance and hence eligible female applicants are especially encouraged to apply.
  • The Institute has the right to set higher norms than minimum prescribed in the advertisement and reserves the right to reject or accept the candidature of any applicant at any stage and to cancel/restrict/modify/alter the advertisement / recruitment process, if need arises, without issuing any further notice.
  • The Screening Test and Main Written Test will be conducted in the premises of the Institute. No request for change of venue / date of selection process shall be considered.
  • Mere fulfilment of eligibility criteria does not guarantee being called for Screening Test / Main Written Test / Skill Test. The Institute reserves the right to restrict the number of applicants to be called by short-listing on the basis of higher benchmark.
  • Persons serving in Government / Semi-Government / Autonomous Bodies / Statutory Bodies / PSUs / PSBs should furnish a No Objection Certificate from the designated authority at the time of verification.
  • No vigilance/disciplinary cases should be pending against applicants working in any Govt./Semi-Govt./Autonomous organizations; in such cases, the application shall not be considered.
  • Original documents, along with one set of self-attested copies, must be produced at the time of certificate verification prior to skill test; without original certificates, candidature shall be rejected.
  • Applicants are advised to visit the Institute website regularly. Any addendum/corrigendum shall be published only on the Institute website; list of shortlisted applicants will be displayed only on the Institute website.
  • The Institute reserves the right not to fill up the posts and to cancel the advertisement in whole or in part, without assigning any reason.
  • Applicants should not have been convicted by any Court of Law and must be in sound health; selected candidates must be prepared to undergo medical examination before the District Medical Board and produce fitness certificate.
  • All appointments are subject to verification of academic qualifications, experience, conduct, community certificates, medical fitness and police verification; any discrepancy may lead to removal from service and legal action.
  • Applicants must carry at least one photograph-bearing Identity Proof in original (Driving Licence, Voter ID Card, Aadhaar Card, Passport) to the examination centre.
  • No TA/DA shall be paid to candidates attending the Screening Test / Certificate Verification / Skill Test / Main Written Test except PwD candidates, who may avail reimbursement as per Government/Institute norms.
  • All correspondence will be made by the Institute through e-mail only; no separate hard copy letters will be sent.
  • Any dispute with regard to the selection process will be subject to the jurisdiction of the appropriate court/tribunal having jurisdiction over Tiruchirappalli.
  • Applicants are warned not to furnish any false particulars or suppress material information and not to tamper with documents; such actions may result in cancellation/debarment and criminal action.

How to Apply

  • Applicants are required to apply online through SAMARTH portal (https://nittnt.samarth.edu.in/index.php/site/login) of the Institute website: www.nitt.edu from 02.01.2026 to 30.01.2026.
  • Applicants must click on the online application link, read the instructions carefully and fill in the online application form giving accurate information. If the online application is not successfully completed, the applicant is required to register again.
  • After successful submission of online application, applicants must keep a copy of the finally submitted online application, which will be required during the selection process.
  • Incomplete applications and applications received through any mode other than online will not be accepted and will be summarily rejected.
  • No request for change in any data entered by the applicant will be entertained once the online application is submitted successfully.
  • While applying online, applicants need to upload the scanned copy of their recent passport size colour photograph and signature.
  • The Institute will not be responsible for any applicant not being able to submit his/her online application within the last date on account of system error or any other reasons.
  • Application without payment of application fee will be an incomplete application and will be summarily rejected (where fee is applicable as per category).
  • Candidates have to upload the following documents at respective tabs while applying:
    • SSLC Certificate.
    • HSC Certificate.
    • ITI / Diploma / UG / PG Degree Certificate, whichever is applicable.
    • Certificate for typewriting / Shorthand / Computer skill obtained from Central/State Government Institutes such as MEITY, NIELIT, DOTE etc., for certain posts mentioned in the Recruitment Rules.
    • Community Certificate (if applicable).
    • Recent passport size colour photograph as prescribed in the instructions.
    • Scanned copy of the signature.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Junior Technician (Contract) (Machinist): NAC/NTC in Machinist
  • Junior Technician (Contract) (Operator Material Handling Equipment): NAC/NTC/STC in Crane Operations (or) Class X or Equivalent Board Examinations with Driving License for Heavy Vehicles and with minimum of 02 years’ experience in handling Crane Operations.
  • Junior Technician (Contract) (Rigger): NAC/NTC/STC in Rigger (or) Class X or equivalent Board Examinations with minimum of 02 years’ experience in loading and unloading.
  • Junior Technician (Contract) (Heat Treatment Operator): NAC/NTC/STC in Forger and Heat Treater
  • Junior Technician (Contract) (Fitter Auto Electric): NAC/NTC/STC in Auto Electrician
  • Junior Technician (Contract) (Sand & Shot Blaster): Class X or equivalent Board Examinations with minimum of 02 years’ experience in Shot Blasting in an industry.

Salary/ Stipend

  • Basic Pay – Minimum Basic Pay of Rs. 21,000/-
  • Industrial Dearness Allowance (IDA) as applicable
  • Special Allowance @ 5% of Basic Pay
  • Annual increment at the rate of 3% on the Basic Pay during the tenure only on successful completion of the previous tenure.

Age Limit

  • The Upper Age Limit prescribed for all the posts shall not exceed 35 years for Candidates without any relaxation as on the closing date of offline Application.
  • The Upper Age Limit is relaxed by 5 years for SC/ST Candidates and 3 years for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) Candidates in the posts reserved for them.
  • The Upper Age Limit is relaxed by 10 years for Person with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) (plus 5 years for SC/ST Candidates and plus 3 years for OBC (NCL) Candidates)
  • Ex-Apprentice Trainees: The Upper Age Limit is relaxed to the extent of the period for which the Apprentice had undergone training in line with Apprentice Act 1961. (plus 5 years for SC/ST Candidates and plus 3 years for OBC (NCL) Candidates)
  • Ex-Serviceman: The Upper Age Limit shall not exceed 35 years plus 3 years after deducting the period of service from the present age (plus 5 years for SC/ST Candidates and plus 3 years for OBC (NCL) Candidates). However, he should be less than or equal to 55 years of age as on the closing date of offline Application.
  • Work Experience: Relaxation in upper age limit will be given to the Candidates having relevant work experience. The upper age limit is relaxable for the Candidates with relevant post qualification experience, to a maximum extent of 7 years. Relaxation in age would be one year for every completed year of relevant post qualification experience.
  • The Maximum Age Limit after inclusive of all eligible relaxations for any category shall not exceed 55 years of age as on the closing date of offline Application.

Application Fee

  • Application Fee of Rs.300/- (Rupees Three Hundred only) to be paid through Online -> SBI Collect -> PSU -> ARMOURED VEHICLES NIGAM LTD TAMIL NADU -> Payment category -> Heavy Vehicles Factory-RECRUITMENT FEES.
  • (SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-SM/Female Candidates are exempted from payment of application fees).

Selection Process

  • Preference will be given in the following order: 1) Heavy Vehicles Factory Ex-Trade Apprentices, failing which 2) Erstwhile OFB Ex-Trade Apprentices, failing which 3) Other NTC/NAC holders.
  • The Candidates of Heavy Vehicles Factory Ex- Trade Apprentices will be shortlisted based on Month/Year of passing NAC (within which NAC Mark wise out of 400) in the respective trades.
  • The Candidates of erstwhile OFB Ex- Trade Apprentices will be shortlisted based on Month/Year of passing NAC (within which NAC Mark wise out of 400) in the respective trades.
  • For other NTC/NAC Holders: Marks obtained in the final examination of NTC/NAC. [In case of possessing both NTC and NAC, then the marks of NTC will only be considered for shortlisting.
  • For Non-NAC/NTC/STC holders, Candidates possessing only Class 10th with relevant experience will be shortlisted based on years of experience possessed. In case, candidates possess same number of years of experience, then selection will be based on mark of Class 10th.
  • Trade Test (Practical) shall be only qualifying in nature without any marks.
  • Candidates shortlisted shall be subject to Document Verification and those Candidates clearing Document Verification shall be subject to Trade Test.
  • Trade Test shall be conducted only at Heavy Vehicles Factory, Avadi and Chennai.
  • Selection will be based on the order of merit mentioned in Para 8.1 above. If 2 or more candidates has same merit, then Date of Birth will be criteria where older person shall get preference over the younger Trade Apprentices. If the Date of Birth is also same, then the criteria will be Name in alphabetical order of English.

General Information / Instructions

  • Detailed instructions are available in the website www.ddpdoo.gov.in Candidates should read these instructions carefully before making any entry or selecting options for filling up of offline applications.
  • The Candidates applying should ensure that they fulfill all eligibility conditions for the post/trade applied for.
  • Their admission for Trade Test will be purely provisional subject to satisfying the prescribed eligibility conditions at the time of Trade Test after due verification of their original certificates/documents.
  • Mere issue of Admit Card to the Candidate for Document Verification/Trade Test will not imply that his/her candidature has been finally accepted by Heavy Vehicles Factory/AVNL for Contractual Engagement.
  • Verification of eligibility conditions with reference to the original certificates/documents will be done only before Trade Test in Heavy Vehicles Factory/Chennai.
  • Candidates are advised to bring Self Verified Online Police Verification Report (PVR) and Medical Fitness Certificate (Blank Format is enclosed as Annexure-5) during the time of Document Verification.
  • The Competent Authority has right to revise either by increasing or decreasing the advertised number of vacancies at any point of time.
  • In case, Candidates are willing to apply two or more posts, they are advised to apply separate application for each post.
  • Persons with disability can apply against an unreserved vacancy, provided the post is identified suitable for the persons with disabilities of the relevant category.
  • Individual who have attended trade test at Heavy Vehicles FactoryTS/Heavy Vehicles Factory during July 2025 to December 2025 are not eligible to apply. Hence, need not apply.
  • NTC/NAC would mean Certificate issued by National Council for Vocational Training (NCVT) and STC would mean Certificate issued by State Council for Vocational Training.
  • All the Qualifications possessed by the Candidates and also Qualifications / Courses being pursued by them at the time of submitting the Application for engagement, are to be clearly indicated in the Application. In other words, all the qualifications already possessed and Qualifications / Courses which are being pursued / currently undergoing are to be indicated in the Application while submitting the same for notified posts in Heavy Vehicles Factory.
  • Candidates shall possess minimum pass marks in the required educational qualification.
  • Candidates seeking age relaxation shall enclose the relevant certificates issued by Competent Authority, which will be verified by Heavy Vehicles Factory. In the event of suppression of information or forged Certificate submitted, the candidature of the Candidate will be cancelled and will be debarred for all posts in Heavy Vehicles Factory.

How to Apply

  • Interested Indian Citizens shall forward physical applications only in prescribed format. (Refer Annexure –A attached herewith)
  • Candidate must forward the following copy of documents along with the manual application: i. SSLC/ Matric/Xth Certificate. ii. EWS Certificate valid for the year 2025-26. (Format of Certificate is enclosed as Annexure - 3) vi. Discharge Book/Certificate for Ex-Servicemen. vii. Experience Certificate(s), if any. viii. Employees Provident Fund (EPF) Member Pass Book, if any. ix. Bank Pass Book x. Aadhar Card xi. PAN Card xii. Driving License, wherever applicable. xiii. Eligibility Criteria

  • ECHS invites applications from Ex-servicemen and Civilians to be employed as contractual employees on various appointments tenable at Polyclinics under Station Headquarters, Chennai for vacancies from 01 Apr 2026 to 30 Sep 2026.
  • Medical Specialist: MD/MS in speciality concerned/DNB with minimum 3 years’ experience in the subject concerned after Post Graduation.
  • Radiologist: PG degree in the concerned speciality in section A or B of schedule VI of the Central Health Services Regulation 1996 or 5 years’ experience after obtaining Post Graduate Diploma; DMC Registration is a must.
  • Gynaecologist: MD/MS in speciality concerned/DNB with minimum 3 years’ experience in the subject concerned after Post Graduation.
  • Medical Officer: MBBS with minimum 3 years’ experience after Internship; preferable additional qualification in Medicine/Surgery.
  • Lab Assistant: Diploma in Medical Lab Technology (DMLT)/Class-1 Lab Technician course (Armed Forces) with minimum 5 years’ experience in Medical Laboratory.
  • Pharmacist: B Pharmacy or 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry & Biology and Diploma in Pharmacy with minimum 3 years’ experience as a Pharmacist.
  • Radiographer: Diploma/Class-1 Radiographer Course (Armed Forces) with minimum 5 years’ experience.
  • Physiotherapist: Diploma/Class-1 Physiotherapy Course (Armed Forces) with minimum 5 years’ experience as a Physiotherapist.
  • Dental Asst/Tech/Hygienist: Diploma in Dental Hygienist Course/Class-1 DH/DORA Course (Armed Forces) with minimum 3 years’ experience as Dental Hygienist in recognised Dental Laboratory/Clinic/Hospital.
  • Officer-in-Charge: Reserved for Retired Defence Officers with minimum 5 years’ experience in health care institution or managerial positions.
  • Clerk & DEO/Clerk, DEO: Graduate/Class-1 Clerical trade (Armed Forces) with minimum 5 years’ experience.
  • IT Network Technician: Diploma/Certificate/Equivalent in IT Networking, Computer application with minimum 2 years’ experience.
  • Driver: Minimum passed Class-8th/Class-1 Driver MT (Armed Forces) with minimum 5 years’ experience as a driver and holding a civil driving license (LMV).
  • Female Attendant: Literate with minimum 5 years’ experience in civil/Army Health institutions.
  • Safaiwala: Literate with minimum 5 years’ service.
  • Chowkidar: Education Class 8th Std or GD Trade (Armed Forces).
  • Peon: Education Class 8th Std or GD Trade (Armed Forces) with minimum 5 years’ service.

Salary/Stipend

  • Medical Specialist, Radiologist, Gynaecologist: Rs 1,30,000/- per month; part time may also apply with gross monthly part time Rs 4670/- per day (four hours), Rs 3500/- per day (three hours), Rs 2330/- per day (two hours).
  • Medical Officer: Rs 95,000/- per month; selected candidates will undergo 10 days On the Job Training (OJT) and obtain a certificate from OIC Polyclinic before signing the contract; OJT will be unpaid but mandatory.
  • Officer-in-Charge: Rs 95,000/- per month with similar OJT requirement as specified.
  • Lab Assistant, Pharmacist, Radiographer, Physiotherapist, Dental Asst/Tech/Hygienist, IT Network Technician: Rs 36,500/- per month.
  • Clerk & DEO/Clerk, DEO: Rs 29,200/- per month; RC vacancy pay scale in lieu of Peon is Rs 21,800/-.
  • Driver: Rs 25,600/- per month.
  • Female Attendant, Safaiwala, Chowkidar, Peon: Rs 21,800/- per month.

Age Limit 

  • Medical Specialist, Radiologist, Gynaecologist: Maximum age limit for employment – 68 years.
  • Medical Officer: Maximum age limit for employment – 66 years.
  • Officer-in-Charge: Maximum age limit for employment – 63 years.
  • Lab Assistant, Pharmacist, Radiographer, Physiotherapist, Dental Asst/Tech/Hygienist: Maximum age limit for employment – 56 years.
  • Clerk & DEO/Clerk, DEO, IT Network Technician, Driver, Female Attendant, Safaiwala, Chowkidar, Peon: Maximum age limit for employment – 53 years.

Application Fee

  • No application fee details are mentioned in the employment notice.

Event Date
Vacancy period 01 Apr 2026 to 30 Sep 2026
Last date for receipt of application (employment notice text) 16 Feb 2026
Last date for receipt of application (newspaper extract) 15 Feb 2026
Date of publication (newspaper) 10 Jan 2026
Interview date & time To be intimated through E-mail/SMS to eligible candidates

Selection Process

  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for interview through SMS/email; list will also be displayed on the Notice Board.
  • An objective type written test on the relevant subject and practical tests as applicable will be conducted before interview.
  • Only those candidates meeting eligibility criteria and with completed application form, shortlisted by the Board of Officers, will be considered for interview.
  • Candidates will bring all original documents as applicable at the time of interview; no TA/DA will be admissible for attending the interview.
  • Employment of all individuals will be at the discretion of the appointing authority; changes in terms and conditions arising out of unforeseen circumstances may be made without compensation at the discretion of the appointing authority.

General Information/Instructions

  • Employment period for Ex-Servicemen would be 12 months and for others it will be 11 months, renewable for an additional period of one year/till attaining the maximum age, subject to performance and other conditions.
  • Individual application for each post as per format attached and available on www.echs.gov.in (duly affixed with passport size photo) should be submitted along with all supporting documents.
  • The application must reach Station Headquarters ECHS, Fort Saint George, Chennai - 600009 on or before the specified last date duly mentioning “Application for the post of ____” on the top of envelope; incomplete applications will be rejected.
  • Only one application is required to be submitted for a particular post for all Polyclinics.
  • Candidates earlier employed in ECHS whose services were terminated or who had resigned or are blacklisted need not apply; such applications will be rejected.
  • Computer qualified candidates will be given preference.
  • Changes to this notice, if any, will be posted on ECHS website only.
  • Those who have worked in any Empanelled Hospital must have a clear gap of one year between relinquishment of appointment in Empanelled Hospital and joining any ECHS establishment.
  • Anybody found using unfair means or creating a ruckus at the time of interview will be dealt with as per Code of Criminal Procedure Act 1973.

How to Apply

  • Download the application format from www.echs.gov.in or use the format attached with the notice; affix passport size photograph.
  • Fill individual application for each post and attach self-attested photocopies of all supporting documents as listed in the notice.
  • Send the application in duplicate in a sealed envelope duly mentioning “Application for the post of ____” on the top to OIC ECHS Cell, Station Headquarters, Fort Saint George, Chennai - 600009.
  • Ensure that the application reaches on or before the last date mentioned; applications received after the cut-off date will not be accepted.
  • Keep email and mobile number active; eligible candidates will be informed of date and time of interview through email/SMS.

Total Vacancies: 999

Abbreviations

  • GT: General Turn
  • BC: Backward Class
  • BC(M): Backward Class (Muslim)
  • MBC/DNC: Most Backward Class / Denotified Community
  • SC: Scheduled Caste
  • SCA: Scheduled Caste (Arunthathiyars)
  • ST: Scheduled Tribe
  • G: General
  • W: Women
  • DW: Destitute Widow
  • PSTM: Person Studied in Tamil Medium
  • DAP: Differently Abled Person

Eligibility Criteria

Qualifications

  • Must not have completed 32 years of age if recruited direct (age limit relaxed as per special provisions)
  • Must possess the Secondary School Leaving Certificate (SSLC) from recognized school
  • Must possess the certificate for having successfully completed the training course for Nursing Assistants in any of the Government Medical Institutions in the State
  • Adequate knowledge of Tamil language (Tamil as a language in SSLC or all non-language subjects in SSLC in Tamil medium or Second Class Language Test in Tamil)

Essential Qualifications

  • SSLC certificate from recognized school
  • Certificate for successfully completing Nursing Assistant training course from Government Medical Institutions in Tamil Nadu
  • The training course must be completed prior to the date of issue of G.O.(Ms).No.325, Health and Family Welfare Department, dated 20.11.2012 for special category candidates as per G.O.(Ms).No.77, dated 14.03.2024

Desirable

  • Person who has rendered war service as Nursing Assistant if appointed shall pass the Departmental Examination for Nursing Assistant
  • War service includes service in units liable for overseas service, service under military authorities, service in Armed Reserve Police, and other civil defense organizations
  • War service recognition is for the period 1939-1946

Salary/Stipend

  • Pay Scale: Rs. 15,700 – 58,100/- per month
  • Pay Matrix Level: Level-1
  • Selected candidates will be paid as per 7th Pay Commission
  • Pay is subject to modifications as per government orders from time to time
  • Allowances and benefits as applicable to Tamil Nadu Government servants

Age Limit 

  • Minimum Age: 18 years (should have completed)
  • Maximum Age for OC (Open Category): 34 years
  • Maximum Age for SC/ST/SCA/BC/BCM/MBC&DNC: No Maximum Age limit (should not have completed 60 years as on 01.07.2026)
  • Maximum Age for Differently Abled Persons: 44 years (10 years relaxation over OC)
  • Maximum Age for Destitute Widow: No Maximum Age limit (should not have completed 60 years)
  • Note: Applicants not belonging to reserved categories who have put in 5 years or more of service in State/Central Government are not eligible to apply even if within age limit

Application Fee

  • For SC/SCA/ST/DAP/DW categories: Rs. 300/-
  • For Others (General/OC/BC/BCM/MBC/DNC): Rs. 600/-
  • Payment mode: Online only (Net Banking, Credit Card, Debit Card, Mobile Wallet)
  • Additional processing charges will be applicable for online payment
  • Fee once paid will not be refunded or adjusted for any reason
  • Applications once registered will not be allowed to be withdrawn

Important Dates

Event Date
Date of Notification 19/01/2026
Online Registration Start Date 19/01/2026
Last Date for Submission of Application (Online Registration & Online Payment) 08/02/2026
Certificate Verification Will be notified later

Selection Process

  • Selection will be made at the first instance for candidates who passed 10th std and possess Certificate for completing Nursing Assistant training in Government Medical Institutions prior to G.O.(Ms).No.325 dated 20.11.2012
  • Age relaxation of maximum 14 years will be provided for this category as per G.O.(Ms).No.77 dated 14.03.2024 and amendment G.O.(D).No 1602 dated 18.12.2025
  • For remaining vacancies, selection will be based on marks scored in academic and technical qualifications
  • Weightage of Marks:
    • SSLC/10th Certificate: 60%
    • Certificate Course in Nursing Assistant: 40%
  • There will be no oral test (Interview) for the post
  • Selection will follow communal rotation and reservation rules of Tamil Nadu Government
  • Certificate verification will be conducted for provisionally selected candidates
  • Final appointment will be made by the Appointing Authority after selection by MRB
  • If marks are not awarded but only certificate is issued, percentage of marks in SSLC/HSC will be taken for calculating weightage

General Information/Instructions

  • 4% posts reserved for Differently Abled Persons with benchmark disabilities: Hard of Hearing (HH), Dwarfism (DF), Leprosy Cured (LC), Acid Attack Victims (AC) - all with mobility and good physique, Multiple Disability (MD) among the above
  • 10% of women vacancies (out of 30% women reservation) reserved for Destitute Widows
  • Reservation for Person Studied in Tamil Medium (PSTM) as per Tamil Nadu Appointment on Preferential Basis Act, 2020
  • Reservation for Transgender candidates: Female transgender considered for women quota, Male/Transgender considered for general category
  • All recruitments are purely merit-based
  • Candidature is provisional at all stages subject to verification
  • Hard copy of application need not be sent to MRB office
  • All communications from MRB will be through registered email and SMS only
  • Candidates must upload all supporting documents at the time of online application submission
  • Incomplete applications or applications with wrong claims will be summarily rejected
  • Selected candidates must join within stipulated time and cannot claim extension for higher studies
  • After joining, candidates cannot undergo any course within 2 years (excluding leave period)
  • Candidates in service must produce No Objection Certificate
  • Mobile number and email must be kept active till declaration of results

How to Apply

  • Visit the official website: www.mrb.tn.gov.in
  • Click on "Online Registration" on the Home Page
  • Select the post of Nursing Assistant Grade II
  • Fill all required particulars without skipping any field
  • Mobile number and email are mandatory (provide alternate secondary mobile number also)
  • Upload scanned copy of color photograph and signature as per specifications
  • Upload all supporting documents/certificates at the time of submission
  • Fill details such as Community Certificate number, Issuing Authority, Date of issue
  • Verify eligibility before submitting application
  • Read instructions carefully before filling the form
  • After filling all details, click "SUBMIT" button
  • Pay application fee online through Net Banking/Credit Card/Debit Card/Mobile Wallet
  • After successful payment, Registration Number and Password will be generated
  • Download and print confirmation page for future reference
  • Keep the same photograph for certificate verification
  • No modifications allowed after final submission
  • Do not wait till last date to avoid internet connectivity issues
  • For help, contact Help Desk: 022-42706524 or MRB office: 044-24355757

  • Candidates are advised in their own interest that they should not furnish any particulars that are false, tampered with or fabricated and should not suppress any material information while submitting application. At the time of examination, interview or in a subsequent selection procedure, if a candidate is (or has been) found guilty of: (i) Using unfair means (ii) Impersonating or procuring impersonation by any person, OR (iii) Misbehaving in the examination/interview hall or disclosing, publishing, reproducing, transmitting, storing or facilitating transmission and storage of contents of the test(s) or any information therein in whole or part thereof in any form or by any means, verbal or written, electronically or mechanically for any purpose, OR (iv) Resorting to any irregular or improper means in connection with his/ her candidature, OR (v) Obtaining support for his/ her candidature by unfair means, OR (vi) Carrying mobile phones or similar electronic devices of communication in the examination/ interview hall. Such a candidate may, in addition to rendering himself/ herself liable to criminal prosecution, shall be liable; a) to be disqualified from the examination for which he/ she is a candidate: b) to be debarred either permanently or for a specified period from any examination conducted by the Bank. c) for termination of service, if he/ she has already joined the Bank.
  • CANDIDATES REPORTING LATE i.e., after the reporting time specified on the call letter for Examination will not be permitted to take the examination. The reporting time mentioned on the call letter is prior to the Start time of the test. Though the duration of the examination is 2 hours 30 minutes, candidates may be required to be at the venue for about 4 hours including the time required for completion of various formalities such as verification and collection of various requisite documents, giving of instructions, etc.
  • In the examination hall as well as at the time of interview, the call letter along with original and a photocopy of the candidate’s currently valid photo identity (bearing exactly the same name as it appears on the call letter) such as PAN Card/ Passport/ Permanent Driving License/ Voter’s Card/ Bank Passbook with photograph/ Photo identity proof issued by a Gazetted Officer on official letterhead along with photograph / Photo identity proof issued by a People’s Representative on official letterhead along with photograph / valid recent Identity Card issued by a recognized College/ University/ Aadhar card/ E-Aadhar Card with a photograph/ Employee ID/ Bar Council Identity Card with photograph should be submitted to the invigilator for verification. The candidate’s identity will be verified with respect to his/her details on the call letter, in the Attendance List and requisite documents submitted. If identity of the candidate is in doubt the candidate may not be allowed to appear for the Examination.
  • Ration Card and Learner’s Driving License are not valid id proof.
  • Note: Candidates must produce in original the photo identity proof and submit photocopy of the photo identity proof along with Examination call letter as well as the Interview Call Letter while attending the examination/ interview respectively, without which they will not be allowed to take up the examination/ interview. Candidates must note that the name as appearing on the call letter (provided during the process of registration) should exactly match the name as appearing on the photo identity proof. Female candidates who have changed first/last/middle name post marriage must take special note of this. If there is any mismatch between the name indicated in the Call Letter and Photo Identity Proof the candidate will not be allowed to appear for the examination. In case of candidates who have changed their name, will be allowed only if they produce original Gazette notification / their original marriage certificate / affidavit in original.
  • 1. The examination will be conducted at venues given in the respective call letters.
  • 2. No request for change of centre/venue/date/session for Examination shall be entertained.
  • 3. Export-Import Bank of India, however, reserves the right to cancel any of the Examination Centres and/ or add some other Centres, at its discretion, depending upon the number of candidates, administrative feasibility, etc.
  • 4. Export-Import Bank of India also reserves the right to allot the candidate to any Centre other than the one he/she has opted for.
  • 5. Candidate will appear for the examination at an Examination Centre at his/her own risks and expenses and Export-Import Bank of India will not be responsible for any injury, expense or losses etc. of any nature.
  • 6. Choice of centre once exercised by the candidate will be final. If sufficient number of candidates do not opt for a particular centre for examination, OR if the number of candidates is more than the capacity available for exam for a centre, Export-Import Bank of India reserves the right to allot any other centre to the candidate.
  • Decision of Export-Import Bank of India in all matters relating to recruitment will be final and binding on the candidate. No correspondence or personal enquiries shall be entertained by the Export-Import Bank of India in this behalf.
  • Export-Import Bank of India would be analysing the responses (answers) of individual candidates with those of other candidates to detect patterns of similarity of right and wrong answers. If in the analytical procedure adopted by Export-Import Bank of India in this regard, it is inferred/ concluded that the responses have been shared and scores obtained are not genuine/ valid, Export-Import Bank of India reserves the right to cancel the candidature of the concerned candidates and the result of such candidates (disqualified) will be withheld.
  • There will be no sectional cut off but the final list for interviews will be drawn based on the candidate’s performance in the written test.
  • Instances for providing incorrect information and/or process violation by a candidate detected at any stage of the selection process will lead to disqualification of the candidate from the selection process and he/she will not be allowed to appear in any recruitment process of Export-Import Bank of India in the future. If such instances go undetected during the current selection process but are detected subsequently, such disqualification will take place with retrospective affect.
  • A pre-recruitment training will be organised for the candidates from reserved categories. Details of the training and its mode of delivery (online / offline) will be intimated to the candidates who opt for it through the online application form. Details will be shared with such candidates after the last date of registration.
  • Candidates whose writing speed is adversely affected permanently for any reason can use their own scribe at their cost during the examination. In all such cases where a scribe is used, the following rules will apply:
  • • The candidate will have to arrange his/her own scribe at his/her own cost.
  • • The scribe arranged by the candidate should not be a candidate for the same examination. If violation of the above is detected at any stage of the process, candidature of both the candidate and the scribe will be cancelled. Candidates eligible for and who wish to use the services of a scribe in the examination should invariably carefully indicate the same in the online application form. Any subsequent request may not be favourably entertained.
  • • A person acting as a scribe for one candidate cannot be a scribe for another candidate.
  • • The scribe may be from any academic stream.
  • • Both the candidate as well as scribe will have to give a suitable undertaking confirming that the scribe fulfils all the stipulated eligibility criteria for a scribe mentioned above. Further in case it later transpires that he/she did not fulfil any laid down eligibility criteria or suppressed material facts the candidature of the applicant will stand cancelled, irrespective of the result of the examination.
  • • Those candidates who use a scribe shall be eligible for compensatory time of 20 minutes for every hour of the examination or as otherwise advised.
  • • Scribe should not answer on his/her own. Any such behaviour observed will result in cancellation of candidature.
  • • Only candidates registered for compensatory time will be allowed such concessions since compensatory time given to candidates shall be system based, it shall not be possible for the test conducting agency to allow such time if he / she is not registered for the same. Candidates not registered for compensatory time shall not be allowed such concessions.
  • • During the exam, at any stage, if it is found that scribe is independently answering the questions, the exam session will be terminated, and candidate’s candidature will be cancelled. The candidature of such candidates using the services of a scribe will also be cancelled if it is reported after the examination by the test administrator personnel that the scribe independently answered the questions.
  • A compensatory time of twenty minutes per hour or otherwise advised shall be permitted for the candidates with locomotor disability and cerebral palsy where dominant (writing) extremity is affected to the extent of slowing the performance of function (minimum of 40% impairment).
  • Visually Impaired candidates (who suffer from not less than 40% of disability) may opt to view the contents of the test in magnified font and all such candidates will be eligible for compensatory time of 20 minutes for every hour or otherwise advised of examination.
  • These guidelines are subject to change in terms of GoI guidelines/ clarifications, if any, from time to time.

How to Apply

  • Candidates need to apply online only from January 26, 2026, up to February 15, 2026. No other mode of application will be accepted.
  • Scan their: Photograph (4.5cm × 3.5cm), Signature (with black ink), Left thumb impression (on white paper with black or blue ink), A handwritten declaration (on a white paper with black ink) (text given below), The consolidated Mark Sheets of Graduation and Post-Graduation, Graduation and Post-Graduation Degree, Caste Certificate (if applicable) Ensuring that all these scanned documents adhere to the required specifications as given in this Advertisement.
  • Signature in CAPITAL LETTERS will NOT be accepted.
  • The left thumb impression should be properly scanned and not smudged. (If a candidate is not having left thumb, he/she may use his/ her right thumb for applying.)
  • The text for the handwritten declaration is as follows – “I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required.”
  • The above-mentioned handwritten declaration has to be in the candidate’s handwriting and in English only. If it is written and uploaded by anybody else or in any other language, the application will be considered as invalid.
  • Keep the necessary details/documents ready to make Online Payment of the requisite application fee/ intimation charges.
  • Have a valid personal email ID and mobile no., which should be kept active till the completion of this Recruitment Process. Bank may send intimation to download call letters for the Examination etc. through the mentioned e-mail ID and / or SMS. In case a candidate does not have a valid personal e-mail ID, he/she should create his/her new e-mail ID and mobile no. before applying on-line and must maintain that email account and mobile number.
  • Candidates to visit Online Application and click on the option "APPLY ONLINE" which will open a new screen.
  • To register, choose the tab "Click here for New Registration" and enter Name, Contact details and Email-id. A Provisional Registration Number and Password will be generated by the system and displayed on the screen. Candidate should note down the Provisional Registration Number and Password. An Email & SMS indicating the Provisional Registration number and Password will also be sent.
  • In case the candidate is unable to complete the application form in one go, he / she can save the data already entered by choosing "SAVE AND NEXT" tab. Prior to submission of the online application, candidates are advised to use the "SAVE AND NEXT" facility to verify the details in the online application form and modify the same if required. Visually Impaired candidates should fill the application form carefully and verify/ get the details verified to ensure that the same are correct prior to final submission.
  • Candidates are advised to carefully fill and verify the details filled in the online application themselves as no change will be possible/ entertained after clicking the COMPLETE REGISTRATION BUTTON.
  • The Name of the candidate or his /her father/ Husband etc. should be spelt correctly in the application as it appears in the Certificates/ Mark sheets/Identity proof. Any change/alteration found may disqualify the candidature.
  • Validate your details and save your application by clicking the 'Validate your details' and 'Save & Next' button.
  • Candidates can proceed to upload Photo & Signature as per the specifications given in the Guidelines for Scanning and Upload of Photograph and Signature detailed under point "C".
  • Candidates can proceed to fill other details of the Application Form.
  • Click on the Preview Tab to preview and verify the entire application form before COMPLETE REGISTRATION.
  • Modify details, if required, and click on 'COMPLETE REGISTRATION' ONLY after verifying and ensuring that the photograph, signature uploaded and other details filled by you are correct.
  • Click on 'Payment' Tab and proceed for payment.
  • Click on 'Submit' button.
  • The application form is integrated with the payment gateway and the payment process can be completed by following the instructions.
  • The payment can be made by using Debit Cards (RuPay/Visa/MasterCard/Maestro), Credit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards/ Mobile Wallets.
  • After submitting your payment information in the online application form, PLEASE WAIT FOR THE INTIMATION FROM THE SERVER. DO NOT PRESS BACK OR REFRESH BUTTON IN ORDER TO AVOID DOUBLE CHARGE.
  • On successful completion of the transaction, an e-Receipt will be generated.
  • Non-generation of 'E-Receipt' indicates PAYMENT FAILURE. On failure of payment, Candidates are advised to login again using their Provisional Registration Number and Password and repeat the process of payment.
  • Candidates are required to take a printout of the e-Receipt and online Application Form containing fee details. Please note that if the same cannot be generated, online transaction may not have been successful.
  • For Credit Card users: All charges are listed in Indian Rupee. If you use a non-Indian credit card, your bank will convert to your local currency based on prevailing exchange rates.
  • To ensure the security of your data, please close the browser window once your transaction is completed.
  • There is facility to print application form containing fee details after payment of fees.
  • While filling in the Online Application Form the candidate will be provided with separate links for uploading Photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration.
  • Click on the respective link “Upload Photograph / signature / Upload left thumb impression / handwritten declaration/ other relevant documents”.
  • Browse and select the location where the Scanned Photograph / signature / left thumb impression / handwritten declaration/ other relevant document’s file has been saved.
  • Select the file by clicking on it
  • Click the ‘Open/Upload’
  • If the file size and format are not as prescribed, an error message will be displayed.
  • Preview of the uploaded image will help to see the quality of the image. In case of unclear / smudged, the same may be re-uploaded to the expected clarity /quality.

Selection Process

  • In the event of number of applications being large, Commission may adopt any one of the following modes for shortlisting the candidates for the next stage of the recruitment process:- (a) On the basis of percentage of marks of the candidates in the minimum educational qualification prescribed in the advertisement. (b) On the basis of percentage of marks of the candidates in different educational qualifications, with weightage as decided by the Commission. (c) On the basis of desirable qualifications or any one or all of the desirable qualifications, if more than one desirable qualification is prescribed. (d) On the basis of higher educational qualifications than the minimum/essential qualification prescribed in the advertisement. (e) On the basis of higher experience in the relevant field than the minimum prescribed in the advertisement. (f) By counting experience before or after the acquisition of minimum/essential qualifications (g) By holding a Screening test and/or Subject Knowledge Test.
  • Generally, the Commission has a three stage recruitment process i.e. Screening Test followed by Subject Knowledge Test and interview. The Commission can decide to hold a Screening Test and then a Subject Knowledge Test or it may directly hold a Subject Knowledge Test without holding a Screening Test.

General Information / Instructions

  • The number of post is liable to variation.
  • The qualifications of each post are as per the relevant Service Rules. The candidates should ensure that they possess the qualifications mentioned in the advertisement.
  • The eligibility of the candidate with regard to age, educational qualifications, experience etc. shall be determined on the Closing Date fixed for submission of online application forms.
  • All applicants must fulfil the essential requirements of the post and other conditions stipulated in the advertisement on the Closing Date. They are advised to ensure before applying that they possess the essential qualification and experience, if any, required for the post for which they are applying. They should also possess all relevant certificates and documents in support of their claim regarding educational qualification, age, experience, domicile, caste, category etc. on or before the closing date.
  • No certificate or document issued after the Closing Date will be accepted by the Commission at any stage of the selection process.
  • The improvement in marks done by a candidate after the Closing Date shall not be considered for any purpose in this recruitment.
  • Fees once paid will not be refunded.

Team Leader (Safety) - CP/01/26

  • Qualification: Full time Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering
  • Experience: Minimum 15 years' experience in high rise buildings/KWA projects/Irrigation/shore protection/Harbour projects with experience of managing and working in the field of health and safety
  • Essential: Candidates should hold OSHA or NEBOSH certification

Team Leader (Civil) - CP/02/26

  • Qualification: Full time Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering
  • Experience: Minimum 15 years' experience in high rise buildings/KWA Projects with experience in handling engineering aspects including interface coordination

Team Leader (MEP) - CP/03/26

  • Qualification: Full time Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent OR Full time Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent
  • Experience: Minimum 15 years' experience in high rise building projects/KWA projects with experience in handling engineering and overall coordination
  • Essential: Should have a good knowledge in Electrical/HVAC/Fire fighting ELV & Plumbing system including interface coordination

Team Leader (QC) - CP/04/26

  • Qualification: Full time Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering
  • Experience: Minimum 15 years' experience in high rise building projects/KWA projects with experience in the field of quality control
  • Essential: Shall possess experience in quality assurance/control, auditing design projects, developing QMS, and inspection/testing/product conformity. The concerned should be a Certified Quality Auditor (CQA)

Project Engineer (Civil) - CP/05/26

  • Qualification: Full time Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering
  • Experience: Minimum 7 years' experience in Building/water supply/shore protection works/waterways/irrigation/Harbour, etc.

Project Engineer (MEP) - CP/06/26

  • Qualification: Full time Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent OR Full time Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent
  • Experience: Minimum 7 years' experience in Electrical/HVAC/Fire fighting ELV & Plumbing system including interface coordination

Junior Engineer (Civil) - CL/01/26

  • Qualification: Full time Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering OR Full Time Diploma in Civil Engineering
  • Experience: Minimum 7 years' experience for diploma holders and 05 years for degree holders, with specific experience in relevant project category (Building/water supply/shore protection works/waterways/irrigation/Harbour)

Junior Engineer (MEP) - CL/02/26

  • Qualification: Full time Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent OR Full Time Diploma in Engineering in Electrical/Electrical & Electronics
  • Experience: Minimum 7 years' experience for diploma holders and 05 years for degree holders, in electrical Engineering with specific experience in relevant project category (Building/water supply/shore protection works/waterways/irrigation/Harbour Electrical/HVAC/Fire Fighting, ELV & Plumbing systems)

Important Notes on Qualification

  • The period of training/internship/teaching/academic/fellowship/PhD research experience shall not be counted towards post qualification experience
  • The candidate should possess Degree recognized by AICTE; from a University incorporated by an Act of Central or State legislature in India or other Educational Institutions established by an Act of Parliament or declared to be Deemed as University under Section 3 of the University Grants Commission Act, 1956
  • Sections A & B examinations of the Institution of Engineers (India), with enrolment on or before 31.05.2013, which is treated as equivalent to Degree by the Government of India and recognized by AICTE shall be accepted
  • Experience shall be calculated as on 26.02.2026

Salary/Stipend

For Team Leaders (CP/01/26 to CP/04/26)

  • Pay Scale: Rs. 70,000 - Rs. 2,00,000
  • Approximate CTC: Rs. 19.85 Lakhs Per Annum
  • Components: Basic pay and DA, fixed/variable allowances 23% of Basic Pay, HRA/Lease, Contribution to PF, Gratuity as per Payment of Gratuity Act

For Project Engineers (CP/05/26 to CP/06/26)

  • Pay Scale: Rs. 50,000 – Rs. 1,60,000
  • Approximate CTC: Rs. 14.22 Lakhs Per Annum
  • Components: Basic pay and DA, fixed/variable allowances 23% of Basic Pay, HRA/Lease, Contribution to PF, Gratuity as per Payment of Gratuity Act

For Junior Engineers - Degree Holders (CL/01/26 & CL/02/26)

  • For 5 years minimum experience:
    • Monthly Basic Pay: Rs. 25,504
    • Gross Monthly Pay: Rs. 46,417
    • Yearly CTC: Rs. 5,57,008

For Junior Engineers - Diploma Holders (CL/01/26 & CL/02/26)

  • For 7 years minimum experience:
    • Monthly Basic Pay: Rs. 18,940
    • Gross Monthly Pay: Rs. 34,471
    • Yearly CTC: Rs. 4,13,651

Other Benefits (As per company rules applicable to contract employees)

  • Leaves
  • Maternity Leave
  • Medical facility
  • Accident/Death Insurance
  • Leave Encashment

Note: Remuneration mentioned above is only indicative. Actual remuneration shall depend upon place of posting and other terms & conditions of appointment.

Age Limit (as on 26.02.2026)

  • Maximum Age Limit: 55 years as on the last date of application i.e. 26.02.2026
  • Age Relaxation for SC/ST: 5 years
  • Age Relaxation for OBC-NCL: 3 years
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD: 10 years; in addition to the age relaxation permissible for SC/ST/OBC-NCL category candidates, subject to the post being identified suitable for PWD
  • Note: Relaxation in upper age limit shall be applicable for PwBD candidates irrespective of the fact whether the post is reserved or not, provided the post is identified suitable for PwBDs
  • PWD candidates suffering from not less than 40% of the relevant disability shall only be eligible for the benefit of PWD

Category Fee Amount

EWS/SC/ST/PWD Candidates NIL

No application fee is required for any category.

Event Date

Walk-in Interview for CL/01/26 & CL/02/26 25.02.2026 to 27.02.2026

Selection Process

  • All candidates who successfully submitted their online application form shall be provisionally allowed to appear for Document Scrutiny/verification process
  • The eligibility of the candidates with respect to the post applied will be verified during document scrutiny
  • Thereafter, the shortlisted/eligible candidates shall be allowed to appear for Interview
  • RITES Ltd. reserves the right to shortlist the number of candidates for selection out of eligible candidates
  • Weightage Distribution: Interview - 100%
    • Technical & Professional proficiency - 65%
    • Personality, Communication & Competency - 35%
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks:
    • 60% marks for UR/EWS in interview
    • 50% marks for SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/PWD against reserved posts in interview
  • There will be no minimum qualifying marks required in the aggregate
  • Interviews will be conducted on first come first served basis
  • Candidates can appear for Walk-in Interview at any one of the mentioned venues
  • Candidates have the option to appear for interview either in Hindi or English
  • Based on the requirement and discretion of RITES, the selection process may be conducted from RITES' Regional Offices

General Information/Instructions

  • The appointment shall be purely on contract basis initially for a period of one year, extendable until completion of the assignment subject to mutual consent and satisfactory performance
  • Selected candidates shall be liable for posting anywhere in India as per Company requirements
  • Instant recruitment is being done for deployment of personnel at client's site in the state of Kerala
  • Issuance of offer letter of engagement to the selected candidates shall be subject to approval of CV by the client
  • Appointment of selected candidates will be subject to their being found medically fit in the Medical Examination to be conducted as per RITES Rules and Standards of Medical Fitness for the relevant post
  • Reservation/relaxation/concessions to EWS/SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/PWD/Ex-SM/J&K Domicile would be provided against reserved posts (where applicable) as per extant Govt. orders
  • Before applying, candidates should ensure that they satisfy the necessary conditions and requirements of the position
  • Community certificate (SC/ST/OBC) should be in the format prescribed by Government of India only
  • OBC candidates included in the Central List with certificate not more than 12 months old (with clear mention of candidate not belonging to "Creamy Layer") in the GOI prescribed format only will be considered

  • Departmental candidates of RITES and candidates working in Government Departments/PSU shall be allowed to join RITES only after being properly relieved from their parent organization
  • If it is detected at any stage of recruitment that a candidate does not fulfill the eligibility norms and/or that he/she has furnished any incorrect/false information or has suppressed any material fact(s), his/her candidature is liable for cancellation
  • Management reserves the right to cancel/restrict/enlarge/modify/alter the selection/recruitment process at any stage, without issuing any further notice or assigning any reason thereafter
  • The number of vacancies may vary
  • No train/bus fare/TA/DA shall be payable
  • Legal jurisdiction will be Delhi in case of any dispute
  • Any corrigendum/addendum to this advertisement will be displayed only on the Company's website www.rites.com

How to Apply

  • Interested candidates fulfilling the eligibility criteria are required to apply online in the registration format available in the Career Section of RITES website, http://www.rites.com
  • While submitting the online application, the system would generate 'Registration No.' on top of online form. Note down this "Registration No." and quote it for all further communication with RITES Ltd.
  • While filling up the required details, candidates are advised to carefully and correctly fill the details of "Identity Proof"
  • After filling up the required details under the "Fill/Modify Application Form", candidate should submit the application
  • Keep a copy of Application Form submitted and carry the same at the time of the selection
  • A copy of online APPLICATION FORM containing the registration number is to be printed, signed, and retained
  • The same is to be submitted at the time of Scrutiny of Documents/Interview along with SELF-ATTESTED PHOTO COPIES of the following documents strictly in the following order:
    • 1 recent passport size colour photograph
    • A copy of updated CV/Resume
    • High School certificate for proof of Date of Birth
    • Certificates of Academic & Professional qualifications and statements of marks of all the qualifications for all semesters/years
    • EWS/SC/ST/OBC Certificate in the prescribed format by Govt. of India (if applicable)
    • Proof of Identity & Address (Passport, Voter ID, Driving license, Aadhaar Card etc)
    • PAN Card
    • Proof of different periods of experience as claimed in the Application Form
    • Any other document in support of your candidature
    • PWD Certificate as per latest format (if applicable)
  • No documents are to be submitted while submitting online application
  • Hard copies of documents are not to be sent to this office through post/courier
  • The original testimonials/documents along with one self-attested copy will have to be produced at the time of selection
  • Candidates should submit only one application for one vacancy and application once submitted cannot be altered
  • A valid e-mail ID is essential for submission of the online application
  • Candidate has to bring duly filled two copies of Annexure A, documents in chronological order and submit at the time of Document verification/Selection process
  • Queries should be sent to [email protected] with VC No., Registration/Roll No., Name of Candidate, and valid email address

Walk-in Interview Venues

  • Venue 1: RITES Ltd., Shikhar, Plot No. 1, Sector – 29, Near IFFCO Chowk Metro Station, Gurugram – 122001, Haryana
  • Venue 2: RITES LTD, Ground floor, Calsar Heather Punnen Road, Opposite Hilton Hotel, Statue, Thiruvananthapuram- 695001, Kerala
  • Reporting Time: Between 09:30 AM to 12:30 PM

Eligibility Criteria

  • M.D. in General Medicine recognized by Medical Council of India with at least 05 years of experience after passing M.D.

  • Doctor empanelled with PSU/Banks at present/previously will be given preference by the Bank.

Salary/Stipend

  • Remuneration: Rs. 800/- per hour.
  • Engagement on contractual basis; no benefits as available to Part-Time/Full-Time employees of the Bank like leave, leave fare concession, Provident Fund, Gratuity, Bonus, reimbursement of medical expenses, etc.

Important Dates

Event Date
Last date for receipt of application by Ordinary/Speed post 12/02/2025

Selection Process

  • Applications received will be scrutinized by the Bank.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview by email.
  • Based on the interview, final selection will be done for engagement to the post of Medical Consultant on contractual basis.
  • Engagement letter will be sent to the selected candidate by email.
  • If selected candidate refuses or does not accept the offer of engagement within stipulated timeline, next candidate from waiting list as per interview marks (in highest to lowest order) would be offered the engagement.

General Information/Instructions

  • Working hours: 08 hours per week (visiting days to be decided as per convenience of staff).
  • Initially the period of contract shall be for two years and can be extended by two years after each term if performance is found satisfactory.
  • The contract is terminable with two months' notice from either side.
  • Medical Consultant will have to make arrangement of a suitable substitute at his/her own cost acceptable to the Bank in case of continuous absence for more than two days.
  • Medical Consultant will not be eligible for benefits available to Part-Time/Full-Time employees such as leave, leave fare concession, Provident Fund, Gratuity, Bonus, reimbursement of medical expenses, Brief case, Newspaper etc.
  • The engagement is temporary and no claim shall be made for regular employment or pay and perks payable to regular employees.
  • The Bank reserves the right to alter the duty hours and location at its discretion to suit administrative and operative requirements.
  • Any dispute arising on account of the contract shall be subject to the jurisdiction of the Courts of the respective state/place where Zonal Office is located.
  • Medical Consultant shall maintain strict secrecy regarding the Bank's affairs and the affairs of its constituents and shall not divulge any confidential information.
  • Medical Consultant shall serve the Bank honestly and faithfully and use utmost endeavour to promote the interests of the Bank.
  • Medical Consultant shall not indulge in any act of sexual harassment of any individual at workplace.
  • The contract is liable to be terminated if the Medical Consultant is arrested for debt or on a criminal charge or is detained in pursuance of any process of law.
  • The Bank reserves the right to raise the minimum eligibility standards in order to limit the number of candidates to be called for interview.
  • The Bank will not entertain any correspondence with applicants who have not been called for the interview.
  • Candidates are advised to thoroughly read the advertisement and satisfy themselves about their eligibility before submitting the application.

How to Apply

  • Interested candidates may send the application in the attached format as at Annex-I.
  • Attach self-attested copies of PAN/AADHAR, Registration certificate, educational qualification and experience certificates, etc.
  • Applications must be sent by Ordinary/Speed post.
  • The envelope should be superscribed as "Application for engagement of Medical Consultant on contractual basis at Punjab & Sind Bank, Zonal Office Gurgaon".
  • Applications should reach on or before 12.02.2025.
  • Address to send application: The Zonal Manager, Punjab & Sind Bank, Zonal Office Gurgaon, Plot No.-151, Sector-44, Kanhai Colony Gurgaon, Haryana-122003.
  • All details in the application form must be filled by the applicant.
  • Applications which do not contain the full particulars called for are liable to be rejected.
  • Self-attested copies of certificates regarding age, educational qualifications, registration certificate, experience, etc. should accompany the application.
  • If the candidate is working for any institution/hospital, the details thereof and working hours therein should be indicated.

Haryana Police Constable 2026 - Selection Process

The selection for HSSC Constable Recruitment 2026 will be conducted through a multi-stage process as per the CET Policy for Group C. Candidates must qualify in each stage to proceed to the next:

Selection Stages:

  1. Physical Measurement Test (PMT) - Qualifying Nature
  2. Physical Screening Test (PST) - Qualifying Nature
  3. Knowledge Test (Written Exam) - 97% Weightage
  4. NCC Certificate Bonus Marks - Up to 3% Weightage
  5. Document Verification
  6. Medical Examination

Stage 1: Physical Measurement Test (PMT)

Nature: Qualifying (No marks awarded)

Purpose: To verify if candidates meet the prescribed physical standards

Parameters to be Measured:

Measurement Male (General) Male (Reserved) Female (General) Female (Reserved)
Height 170 cm 168 cm 158 cm 156 cm
Chest (Unexpanded) 83 cm 81 cm - -
Chest Expansion 4 cm minimum 4 cm minimum - -

Note: Standard digital measurement devices shall be used for accurate measurements. Candidates failing to meet the prescribed standards will be disqualified.

Stage 2: Physical Screening Test (PST)

Nature: Qualifying (No marks awarded)

Purpose: To judge physical fitness and endurance

Running Requirements:

Category Distance Time Limit
Male Candidates 2.5 Kilometers 12 Minutes
Female Candidates 1.0 Kilometer 6 Minutes
Ex-Servicemen 1.0 Kilometer 5 Minutes

Note: RFID (Radio Frequency Identification Device) or superior technology will be used to record timings accurately. Candidates must complete the race within the prescribed time limit.

Stage 3: Knowledge Test (Written Examination)

Weightage: 97% of total marks

Exam Mode: Objective Type, Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs)

Qualifying Marks:

  • General Category: Minimum 50% marks
  • Reserved Category (SC/BC/EWS): Minimum 40% marks

Syllabus Topics:

Subject/Topic Weightage
General Studies Important
General Science Important
Current Affairs Important
General Reasoning Important
Mental Aptitude Important
Numerical Ability Important
Agriculture & Animal Husbandry Important
Computer Knowledge 10%
Haryana GK & History 20%

Exam Pattern:

  • Medium: Bilingual (English & Hindi)
  • Question Type: Objective Type MCQs
  • Negative Marking: Yes - 0.97 marks deduction for unattempted questions
  • Duration: To be announced

Important: Commission shall shortlist candidates equal to ten times (10x) the advertised posts for each category for the Knowledge Test based on CET merit.

Stage 4: NCC Certificate Bonus Marks (3% Weightage)

Maximum Marks: 03 marks

NCC Certificate Type Bonus Marks
NCC 'A' Certificate 01 mark
NCC 'B' Certificate 02 marks
NCC 'C' Certificate 03 marks

Note: Candidates possessing valid NCC certificates must upload them during the application process to claim bonus marks.

Stage 5: Document Verification

Candidates shortlisted after the Knowledge Test will be called for document verification. Required documents include:

  • 10th and 12th mark sheets and certificates
  • CET scorecard
  • Date of birth proof
  • Category certificate (SC/BC/EWS - if applicable)
  • Domicile certificate (Haryana resident)
  • Character certificate
  • NCC certificate (if claiming bonus marks)
  • ESM certificate (for ex-servicemen)
  • Aadhar Card
  • Recent photographs

Stage 6: Medical Examination

Selected candidates will undergo medical examination by the appointing authority before final appointment. Candidates must be:

  • Medically fit as per police service standards
  • Free from any physical deformities
  • Having good eyesight (vision standards as prescribed)
  • Mentally sound and stable

Note: Medical fitness and character verification will be done by the appointing authority before final appointment. Candidates found medically unfit will be disqualified.

Final Merit List Preparation:

Final Selection = Knowledge Test (97%) + NCC Bonus (3%)

Merit list will be prepared category-wise based on the total marks obtained. In case of tie, age criteria (older candidate preferred) will be applied.

How to Apply Online for Haryana Police Constable Recruitment 2026

Candidates can apply online for HSSC Constable Recruitment 2026 by following the step-by-step procedure given below. The online application process is simple and can be completed in 10-15 minutes:

Before You Start - Keep These Ready:

  • Scanned copy of recent passport size photograph (JPG/JPEG format, max 50KB)
  • Scanned copy of signature (JPG/JPEG format, max 20KB)
  • Valid email ID and active mobile number
  • 10th and 12th certificates for educational details
  • CET scorecard for CET roll number and marks
  • Category certificates (if applicable)
  • NCC certificate (if claiming bonus marks)
  • ESM certificate (for ex-servicemen category)
  • Aadhar Card

Step-by-Step Application Process:

Step 1: Visit Official Website

Go to the HSSC official recruitment portal: https://adv012026.hryssc.com or visit main website hssc.gov.in and click on "Advertisement 01/2026" link

Step 2: Read Official Notification

Download and carefully read the complete official notification PDF to understand all eligibility criteria, important dates, and instructions

Step 3: Click on "Apply Online"

On the homepage, click on the "Apply Online" button/link for Constable Recruitment 2026

Step 4: New Registration

If you are a first-time user:

  • Click on "New Registration"
  • Fill basic details (Name, Date of Birth, Email ID, Mobile Number)
  • Create a password
  • Complete the registration process
  • Note down your Registration ID and Password

Step 5: Login to Application Portal

Login using your Registration ID and Password to access the online application form

Step 6: Fill Application Form

Fill all sections of the application form carefully:

  • Personal Details: Name, Father's Name, Mother's Name, Date of Birth, Gender, etc.
  • Communication Details: Address, Email, Mobile Number, District, PIN Code
  • Educational Qualifications: 10th and 12th details (Board, Year, Roll No, Marks)
  • CET Details: CET Roll Number, Exam Year, Marks Obtained, Percentage
  • Category Information: Select your category (General/SC/BC/EWS/ESM)
  • Post Preference: Select preferred post (Male/Female Constable/GRP)
  • NCC Details: If you have NCC certificate, fill certificate details
  • Experience: Any relevant experience (if applicable)

Step 7: Upload Required Documents

Upload scanned copies of the following documents:

  • Recent passport size color photograph (white background, with date and name)
  • Signature on white paper
  • 10th certificate/mark sheet
  • 12th certificate/mark sheet
  • CET scorecard
  • Category certificate (if applicable - SC/BC/EWS)
  • NCC certificate (if claiming bonus marks)
  • ESM certificate (for ex-servicemen)
  • Undertaking as per Annexure V (download format from website)

Note: Ensure all documents are in prescribed format and size. Poor quality uploads may lead to rejection.

Step 8: Review Application Form

Before final submission:

  • Click on "Preview" button
  • Carefully check all filled details
  • Verify uploaded documents
  • Ensure there are no spelling mistakes or wrong entries

Important: No corrections will be allowed after final submission (except during correction window, if provided)

Step 9: Declaration & Final Submission

Read the declaration carefully and tick the checkbox confirming:

  • All information provided is true and correct
  • You meet all eligibility criteria
  • Documents uploaded are genuine

Click on "Final Submit" button

Step 10: Download/Print Application Form

After successful submission:

  • Download the submitted application form (PDF)
  • Take 2-3 printouts for future reference
  • Save the application number/registration ID
  • Keep the printout safe - you'll need it during PMT/PST/DV

Important Instructions for Online Application:

  • Apply well in advance, don't wait for the last date to avoid technical issues
  • Only online applications will be accepted - no offline/postal applications
  • Candidates who applied for Advertisement 14/2024 must apply afresh for this recruitment
  • No application fee required for any category
  • Use good internet connection while filling and submitting the form
  • Fill all mandatory fields marked with asterisk (*)
  • Upload only genuine documents - fake documents will lead to cancellation
  • Take printout immediately after submission as website may be slow near deadline
  • Keep your email ID and mobile number active for future communications
  • Hard copy of application form along with uploaded documents must be brought when called by HSSC
  • Documents not uploaded with application will not be entertained later
