  • For Scientist/Engineer ‘SD’ (Post Codes 01-03): Initial screening based on online applications through ISRO Live Register portal to shortlist candidates for interview; prescribed qualifications are minimum requirements and do not automatically ensure eligibility; final selection based on performance in interview only.
  • For Scientist/Engineer ‘SC’ (Post Codes 04-16): Two level recruitment process consisting of a Written Test and a Personal Interview.
  • Written Test pattern includes Part-A (Area/Discipline Specific MCQs), Part-B (Aptitude/Ability MCQs) for all relevant post codes, and Part-C (Descriptive technical questions) additionally for M.E./M.Tech-based recruitment (Post Codes 04-11), with specified duration, marks, and negative marking rules.
  • Candidates are shortlisted for Interview in ratio 1:5 based on Written Test performance, with a minimum of 10 candidates; for reserved vacancies, candidates are shortlisted in 1:5 ratio independently of UR shortlisting.
  • Qualifying criteria specify minimum percentage marks in each part of the Written Test and aggregate marks in the Interview, with different thresholds for UR and reserved candidates as given in the advertisement.
  • For final panel generation for Scientist/Engineer ‘SC’, 50% weightage is given to Written Test marks and 50% to Interview marks.
  • Tie-breaking in panel for Scientist/Engineer ‘SC’ posts uses, in order, marks in Written Test, marks in essential qualification, and date of birth (older candidates placed higher).

General Information/Instructions

  • Only online applications will be entertained; physical applications will not be accepted. Posts are temporary but likely to continue; number of vacancies is provisional and may change depending on organisational requirements.
  • ISRO/DOS/Centres/Autonomous Bodies reserve the right to cancel recruitment at any stage, and to post candidates to any ISRO Centre/Unit situated anywhere in India as and when required.
  • Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification. No interim correspondence/phone calls will be entertained regarding details already provided in the advertisement.
  • Candidates must ensure they fulfil eligibility criteria and comply with instructions in the advertisement and application form; any incorrect information at any stage will lead to cancellation of candidature.
  • Vacancies for Computer Science Engineering under Post Code 07 are for ISRO Centres/Units, while vacancy under Post Code 08 is for NESAC (Autonomous body under DOS); separate applications and fee payment are required if candidates apply for both.
  • Candidates can apply for more than one post; SAC reserves the right to conduct examination for two or more posts simultaneously as per administrative exigency; candidates applying for multiple posts should select the same city for the written test.
  • The online recruitment portal will be available on SAC website (https://www.sac.gov.in or https://careers.sac.gov.in) from 23.01.2026 (1000 hrs) to 12.02.2026 (1700 hrs). ISRO Live Register portal at https://www.isro.gov.in (Career tab) must be used for registration/update for Scientist/Engineer ‘SD’ posts.
  • Application once submitted online cannot be edited. After submission and successful payment, withdrawal is not permitted, and no refund will be granted on grounds of withdrawal.
  • PwBD candidates must produce original disability certificate in prescribed format, issued by a duly constituted Medical Board, indicating at least 40% benchmark disability, in accordance with the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016.
  • Important contact numbers for technical queries during online application are 079-2691 5512/10, and for general queries 079-2691 3022/24; email address is [email protected], available between 10:00 AM to 05:00 PM, except Saturday, Sunday and National Holidays.

How to Apply for ISRO SAC Scientist/ Engineer Posts 2026?

  • Applications will be received online only through ISRO Live Register portal and SAC’s recruitment portal. Candidates must register or update their registration in ISRO’s Live Register portal at https://www.isro.gov.in (Career tab) on or before 12.02.2026 (1700 hrs).
  • For online registration and application, the link will be hosted on SAC website https://www.sac.gov.in or https://careers.sac.gov.in from 23.01.2026 (1000 hrs) to 12.02.2026 (1700 hrs.); only online mode of applications will be accepted.
  • Upon online registration, an online Registration Number will be generated, which must be carefully preserved for future reference. After registration, candidates must proceed to complete the online application, verify all details, and then submit.
  • Applicants must provide a valid and correct e-mail ID in the online application compulsorily, as e-Admit Cards for Written Test/Personal Interview will be sent only through e-mail; no separate hard copy will be sent.
  • Candidates must upload clear images/scanned copies of their recent colour passport size photograph (not older than 6 months), signature, essential/pre-requisite qualification certificates, and applicable caste/PwBD/ESM certificates in specified formats and sizes, failing which their applications will be rejected.
  • Photograph must be in .jpg/.jpeg format (maximum 1MB, 500x500 pixels), signature in .jpg/.jpeg format (maximum 1MB, 700x200 pixels), and certificates in .pdf format (maximum 1MB). Selfies, blurred photos, black and white photos, or unclear signatures will lead to rejection.
  • After filling all details and uploading documents, candidates will be redirected to Bharatkosh payment portal for application fee payment, where they must select a payment aggregator and mode (net banking, UPI, credit/debit card), complete payment, and retain SMS/email confirmation.
  • In case payment is debited but confirmation is not received, candidates are advised to wait 24 hours before initiating a new transaction. All applicable service charges for payment of application fee are to be borne by the applicant.
  • During online application, candidates must choose a city for written examination from the list of eighteen cities including Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Bhopal, Bhubaneshwar, Chandigarh, Chennai, Dehradun, Guwahati, Hyderabad, Jaipur, Kolkata, Lucknow, Mumbai, Nagpur, New Delhi, Raipur, Ranchi and Thiruvananthapuram. SAC reserves the right to conduct examination only in Ahmedabad or in other city/cities as feasible.
  • Candidates are advised to bring, on the day of Written Test, a valid Government-issued photo ID in original and printed copy of the e-Admit Card sent to their email. They should also keep a printout/screenshot of the online application summary for future reference, as the site will not remain open for printing after 1700 hours of 12.02.2026.

Selection Process

  • Selection will be based on a one-stage competitive examination through MCQ (Multiple Choice Question) type Computer Based Response Test (CBRT) / OMR method.
  • The examination will be conducted in two parts: Part-A and Part-B.
  • Part-A (90 Marks): Reasoning & Data Interpretation (30 marks), Quantitative Aptitude (30 marks), Constitution, Current Affairs, English and Gujarati Comprehension (30 marks).
  • Part-B (120 Marks): Questions related to technical qualification and its applications.
  • Total 210 questions will be asked for 210 marks.
  • Total time allotted: 3 hours (180 minutes) for both parts combined.
  • Negative Marking: 1/4 mark will be deducted for each wrong answer.
  • Minimum Qualifying Standard: 40% for both Part-A and Part-B separately.
  • Merit list will be prepared based on marks obtained in the competitive examination.
  • Candidates equal to approximately two times the number of vacancies will be called for certificate verification based on provisional merit list.
  • Final selection will be made based on merit and office preference given by candidates.

  • All instructions and updates regarding the recruitment process will be published on the Board's website https://gsssb.gujarat.gov.in.
  • Candidates must keep checking the Board's website regularly for updates.
  • The mobile number and email ID provided in the application must remain active throughout the recruitment process.

  • Candidates found guilty of unfair means will face legal action as per the Act.

  • Click on "Online Application" and select GSSSB.
  • Select Advertisement No. 357/202526 for Draftsman, Class-3 and click on Apply.
  • Click on "More Details" to read the detailed advertisement.
  • Click on "Apply Now" to open the application form.
  • Fill in Personal Details carefully (fields with red asterisk * are mandatory).
  • Fill in Educational Details accurately.
  • Accept the Assurance (Guarantee) by selecting "Yes" and click "Save".
  • An Application Number will be generated after saving. Note down this number for future reference.
  • Upload recent passport size photograph (white background) and signature in JPG format (not exceeding 15 KB).
  • Photo size: 5 cm height and 3.6 cm width; Signature size: 2.5 cm height and 7.5 cm width.
  • After uploading photo and signature, click on "Confirm Application" and verify all details.
  • Make corrections if necessary before confirming. No changes can be made after confirmation.
  • After confirming, a Confirmation Number will be generated. Save this number.

Eligibility Criteria

Chief Manager - Boiler Operation

  • Full time B.E. / B.Tech (Mechanical / Chemical) with First Class from recognized Institute/University. Candidate must have passed Boiler Operation Engineer Certificate.
  • Around 20 Years of Post-Qualification Experience in Boiler Operation & Maintenance of large industrial organization.

Chief Manager - Maintenance

  • Full time B.E. / B.Tech (Mechanical) with First Class from recognized Institute/University.
  • Around 20 Years of Post-Qualification Experience in Plant Maintenance of large industrial organization.

Engineer - Instrumentation (On Contract)

  • Full time B.E. / B.Tech (Instrumentation & Control) with First Class from a reputed and recognized Institute/University.
  • Minimum 4 years of Post Qualification experience in instrumentation department in process industries with focus on plant data integration, sensor checks, operations of DCS / APC etc.

Engineer - IT (On Contract)

  • Full time B.E. / B.Tech (Computer Science / Information Technology) with First Class from a reputed and recognized Institute/University.
  • Minimum 4 years of Post Qualification experience in managing IT Infrastructure, IT databases etc.

Data Scientist (On Contract)

  • Full time B.E. / B.Tech (Computer Science / Information Technology) with First Class from a reputed and recognized Institute/University.
  • Minimum 4 years of Post Qualification experience in machine learning based analytics, implementation of digital initiatives, analytics model development etc.

Chief Manager - Training Centre

  • full-time MBA(HR) / MHRM /MSW / MLW other equivalent qualification from reputed Institute/University.
  • Around 20 Years of Post-Qualification Experience in training & development of large industrial organization.

Chief Manager - Administration

  • full-time MBA(HR) / MHRM /MSW / MLW other equivalent qualification from reputed Institute/University.
  • Around 20 Years of Post-Qualification Experience in Administration Department of large industrial organization.

Chief Manager - Electrical

  • B.E. / B.Tech (Electrical) with First Class from recognized Institute/University.
  • Around 20 Years of Post-Qualification Experience in Electrical Maintenance of large industrial organization.

  • Maximum Age limit for Chief Manager: Around 45 Years
  • Maximum Age limit for Data Scientist and Engineer: Around 28 Years
  • Age relaxation is applicable as per rules.

  • Starting Date for Apply Online: 28-01-2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 03-02-2026

Responsibilities

  • Lead and oversee the operation of all boiler units to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient steam generation in line with production requirements and statutory norms.

  • Monitor boiler performance parameters (pressure, temperature, efficiency, fuel consumption, heat rate) and implement corrective actions to optimize efficiency and reduce energy losses.

  • Plan, coordinate, and supervise preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance of boilers and auxiliaries to minimize downtime and extend equipment life.

  • Ensure strict compliance with boiler safety regulations, factory acts, pollution control norms, and other statutory requirements, including inspections, certifications, and audits.

  • Manage fuel procurement, handling, storage, and consumption efficiently; evaluate alternative fuels and implement cost-effective fuel utilization strategies.

  • Lead, mentor, and train boiler operation and maintenance staff; ensure proper shift management, competency development, and adherence to standard operating procedures (SOPs).

  • Identify root-cause analysis of boiler failures, trips, or abnormal operations; implement corrective and preventive measures to avoid recurrence.

Selection Process

  • Selection will be based on One Stage Competitive Written Examination
  • Examination will be conducted through MCQ (Multiple Choice Questions) in CBRT/OMR (Computer Based Response Test/Optical Mark Recognition) mode
  • The examination will consist of one question paper divided into Part-A and Part-B
  • Part-A (Total 90 Marks): Logical Reasoning & Data Interpretation (30 marks), Mathematical Aptitude (30 marks), Indian Constitution, Current Affairs, Gujarati & English Comprehension (30 marks)
  • Part-B (Total 120 Marks): Questions related to the subject and its applications (120 marks). Subject syllabus will be as per the prescribed educational qualification
  • Total Questions: 210 questions (Part-A: 90 questions + Part-B: 120 questions)
  • Total Time: 3 hours (180 minutes) for both parts combined
  • Negative Marking: 1/4 mark will be deducted for each wrong answer
  • Minimum Qualifying Standard: 40% marks in Part-A and 40% marks in Part-B separately
  • Final merit list will be prepared based on total marks obtained (or normalized marks) in the examination

General Information/Instructions

  • Only online applications will be accepted through https://ojas.gujarat.gov.in website
  • Candidates must read the entire advertisement carefully before applying
  • All updates regarding recruitment will be published on GSSSB website https://gsssb.gujarat.gov.in
  • Candidates must keep all original certificates (educational qualifications, age proof, caste certificate, disability certificate if applicable, etc.) with them while filling online application
  • Once the application is confirmed, no changes will be allowed in any details
  • Candidates must upload recent passport size photograph with white background taken within one year from the last date of application
  • The same photograph must be used throughout the recruitment process
  • Mobile number and email ID provided in application form must remain active throughout the recruitment process
  • Reserved category posts are reserved only for candidates who are originally from Gujarat
  • For SEBC category candidates, Non-Creamy Layer certificate for financial year 2022-23/2023-24/2024-25 is mandatory
  • Widow women candidates will get 5% additional marks in the competitive examination
  • Sports quota candidates who have represented in National/International or Inter-University or All India School Federation competitions will get 5% additional marks
  • Computer basic knowledge certificate is mandatory for appointment
  • Candidates appearing in the examination must comply with all instructions given in the admit card
  • Any unfair means adopted during examination will lead to disqualification and legal action under Gujarat Public Examination (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2023
  • The Board reserves the right to cancel/modify the advertisement or recruitment process at any stage
  • For any guidance regarding educational qualification, age limit, online application or fee payment, contact GSSSB office at phone number: 079-23258916

How to Apply

  • Visit the official website https://ojas.gujarat.gov.in
  • Click on "Online Application" and select GSSSB
  • Select Advertisement No. 372/202526, Occupational Therapist, Class-3 and click on "Apply"
  • Click on "Apply now" option
  • Fill all mandatory fields marked with red asterisk (*) in "Personal Details"
  • Fill "Educational Details" section
  • Accept the terms and conditions in "Assurance" section by selecting "Yes" and click "Save"

  • Verify all details carefully and click on "Confirm Application"
  • Once confirmed, Confirmation Number will be generated

  • Download and print the application form and fee receipt for future reference
  • Keep the printed application form safe until the recruitment process is complete

IITGN IPDF 2026 Vacancy & Project Details

The advertisement is for an Institute Postdoctoral Fellow (IPDF) position at IIT Gandhinagar for the project titled “Thermodynamic Framework Development and Fabrication of Stable Lubricant Infused Micropatterned Slippery Non-Wetting Surfaces for Underwater Applications”. The candidate will contribute to the development and validation of a thermodynamic framework for designing and fabricating liquid-based slippery hydrophobic micropatterned surfaces for underwater applications.

Experimental techniques such as spin coating, dip coating, lithography, electron microscopy, contact angle goniometry and drop adhesion tests will be used, and the durability of slippery surfaces for underwater applications will be investigated.

Eligibility Criteria for IITGN Institute Postdoctoral Fellow 2026

1. Educational Qualification

Candidates must fulfill the following essential requirements:

  • Ph.D. degree in one of the following or allied fields with relevant background:
    Materials Science and Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Ceramic Engineering, Food Engineering, Chemistry, Physics.
  • The percentage/grade points should be a minimum of 60% or equivalent grade from graduation onwards.
  • At least 55% marks or equivalent in classes 10th and 12th is required.
  • Candidates who have submitted Ph.D. thesis are also eligible to apply.

2. Age Limit

The advertisement does not specify an age limit for the Institute Postdoctoral Fellow position.

3. Project-related Skills

Given the project description, candidates are expected to have relevant research background and interest in:

  • Thermodynamic framework development for liquid-based slippery hydrophobic surfaces.
  • Experimental techniques such as spin coating, dip coating, lithography, electron microscopy, contact angle goniometry and drop adhesion tests.
  • Investigation of durability of slippery surfaces for underwater applications.

Selection Process for IITGN Institute Postdoctoral Fellow 2026

The selection process will involve:

  • Shortlisting of candidates based on eligibility, academic performance and relevant research background.
  • Interview conducted in online mode.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be informed regarding the date and time of the interview via email.

Application Fee for IITGN Institute Postdoctoral Fellow 2026

  • The advertisement does not mention any application fee.

How to Apply for IITGN Institute Postdoctoral Fellow Recruitment 2026?

Eligible candidates can apply for IITGN Institute Postdoctoral Fellow 2026 by following these steps:

  1. Prepare your academic and research details, including information required for an online application form.
  2. Visit the application link provided in the advertisement:
    https://forms.gle/5XnvkjJ5x4nNQVP18
  3. Fill the Google Form application carefully with all required details.
  4. Submit the online application form on or before 10 February 2026.
  5. For any queries, candidates may email Dr. Sriharitha Rowthu at [email protected].

  • Part-B (120 Marks): Questions related to technical qualification and its applications.
  • Total 210 questions will be asked for 210 marks.
  • Total time allotted: 3 hours (180 minutes) for both parts combined.
  • Negative Marking: 1/4 mark will be deducted for each wrong answer.
  • Minimum Qualifying Standard: 40% for both Part-A and Part-B separately.
  • Merit list will be prepared based on marks obtained in the competitive examination.
  • Candidates equal to approximately two times the number of vacancies will be called for certificate verification based on provisional merit list.

  • An Application Number will be generated after saving. Note down this number for future reference.
  • Upload recent passport size photograph (white background) and signature in JPG format (not exceeding 15 KB).
  • Photo size: 5 cm height and 3.6 cm width; Signature size: 2.5 cm height and 7.5 cm width.

  • 2 ) For Urology - (i) MS/DNB in General Surgery with MCH/DrNB in Urology with MCI recognized Medical College/Institution (ii) Five years' experience in concerned Super Speciality after obtaining first PG degree.

Salary/ Stipend

  • Basic Pay Rs. 67,700/- in the Level-11 & Index-1 of Pay Matrix (Pre-revised Basic pay Rs. 18,750/- (PB-3) with Grade Pay Rs. 6600/-) and allowances applicable under ESIC rules and Scheme of Senior Residency.
  • a) Full Time - Consolidated amount of Rs 2,00,000/- per month b) Part Time - Consolidated amount of Rs 1,00,000/- per month

Age Limit

  • Not exceeding 45 years as on interview date. Age limit is relaxable by 03 years for OBC & 05 years for SC/ST candidates.
  • Age not exceeding 69 years as on interview date.

Application Fee

  • Candidates belonging to the UR/OBC category have to deposit a Demand Draft (Non-Refundable) of Rs. 300/- in the favour of "ESI Fund Account No. -1" payable to Ahmedabad at the time of interview. Note: - SC/ST/ PWD/Female candidates have been exempted for payment of fee.

Important Dates

Walk-in Interview 2 February 2026

Selection Process

  • Walk-in Interview

General Information / Instructions

1. Reservation for SC/ST/OBC/PH is as per Central Government rules. The candidate appointed under PWD quota will be adjusted against the vacancy of respective categories of SC/ST/OBC/EWS/General.
2. Candidates seeking reservation benefits under SC/ST/OBC/EWS category must produce original certificate in prescribed format of Govt. of India in support of their claim.
1. This is a rolling advertisement, applicable for filling the vacancies declared above as well as any unfilled and/or newly created posts through subsequent amendment notifications (issued as short notices) to be published only on the official websites, i.e., www.esic.gov.in/recruitments and www.bapunagarhospital.esic.gov.in/recruitments.
2. Walk-in interviews shall be conducted for vacancies that remain unfilled and/or as per the operational requirements of the Hospital as on the date of interview. The number of vacancies available shall be published on the ESIC website (www.esic.gov.in/recruitments and www.bapunagarhospital.esic.gov.in/recruitments) at least 5-7 days prior to the scheduled Walk-in Interview, proposed to be held on the 1st of every month, or on the next working day in case of a holiday, subject to change due to administrative exigencies.
3. Eligible and interested candidates who fulfill the prescribed eligibility criteria in all respects may appear for the Walk-in Interview on the notified date.
4. Applicants applying in response to this advertisement are advised to satisfy themselves regarding their eligibility for the post applied for. They must fulfill the eligibility criteria in all respects as on the date of the Walk-in Interview.
1. The candidate should report at 09:30 AM for verification of documents at Conference hall (2nd Floor) of ESIC Model Hospital, Bapunagar, Ahmedabad. Only candidates clear the document verification will be allowed to appear before the interview panel.
3. The tenure of Senior Residency is for a period of total 03 years (including any service rendered as SR earlier on ad-hoc/ regular basis in government institution). The appointment will be initially for a period of one year, which is extendable for a period of 03 years on an annual basis, subject to satisfactory performance to be reviewed every year.
4. Tenure of Contractual Part/Full time Super Specialist will be for one year (which is extendable only for full time super specialist for a period of 03 years on an annual basis, subject to satisfactory performance to be reviewed every year and requirement), or till faculty is posted in the concerned Super Specialty, whichever is earlier.
5. Candidates claiming reservation/age relaxation on ground of belonging to the OBC should submit the community certificate as prescribed by GOI, DOPT OM No. 36012/12/22/93-ESTT. (SCT) dated 08/09/93 which is modified by GOI DOPT OM No. 36033/3/2004(Res.) dated 09/03/2004 and time to time failing which the benefit of reservation/relaxation will not be given or their application shall be rejected. The OBC-NCL Certificate should be valid.
6. Candidates seeking reservation benefits under SC/ST/OBC/EWS category must produce original certificates in the prescribed format of Govt. of India.
7. The selected candidates shall have to pay Rs. 30,000/- (Thirty thousand rupees only) as Security Deposit (Senior Resident/ Super Specialist) and make an agreement on a Rs. 300/- Non-Judicial Stamp paper to be purchased by the candidate at the time of joining.
8. No claim of any service benefit like PF, Pension, Gratuity, Medical allowance, Seniority, Promotion and leave etc., will be admissible.
9. No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the interview and joining purpose.
10. Private Practice of any kind will not be allowed.
11. Candidates working in Govt./ Private Hospital / Institute should produce NOC from their department at the time of Interview.
12. Applicants having completed 3 years of Senior Residency period in any government hospital, are not eligible for applying under residency scheme.
13. The service of SR will be governed by Residency Scheme and terms & conditions of the agreement.
14. Resignation from service will require 01 month of notice period or pay in lieu thereof in case of SR Scheme (03 Year), Specialist and Super Specialist.
15. Vacancies can change depending upon actual requirement at the time of interview.
16. Hostel accommodation / quarters will not be provided.
17. The Medical Superintendent, ESIC Model Hospital Bapunagar Ahmedabad reserves the right to fill up all post / partial post / not to fill up any post without assigning any reason, whatsoever.

How to Apply

  • The eligible and desirous candidates with duly filled in application form (Annexure-A) should appear for walk-in-interview with their application along with original certificates and one set of self-attested photocopy of the relevant documents in support of age, qualifications, attempt, Mark Sheet, Degree, MCI/State Registration, Category & Experience certificate etc. and two recent passport size photographs.
  • Applicants are advised to report to the office of Medical Superintendent, ESIC Model Hospital, Bapunagar, Ahmedabad (Gujarat) on the dates of interview up to 11:00 AM, any application received thereafter will not be entertained.

  • The prescribed qualification for Graduate/Diploma holders shall be from a recognized University/Institute as a regular full-time course in the relevant trade/discipline with a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate (45% for SC/ST and PwBD category candidates for the posts reserved for them).
  • Candidates holding a qualification acquired through part-time/correspondence/distance education mode are not eligible.
  • Candidates possessing higher professional qualifications such as BE/B.Tech., MBA, CA, LLB, MCA, or any such equivalent qualification or pursuing higher qualification and having completed the same on or before joining apprenticeship training, shall not be eligible.
  • Wherever CGPA/OGPA or Letter Grade is awarded in the ITI/Degree/Diploma examinations, its equivalent aggregate percentage of marks must be indicated by the candidates in the Online Application as per the norms adopted by Board/University/Institute.

Experience

  • Candidates having job experience for a period of one year or more after the attainment of the qualification shall not be eligible to be engaged as Apprentice.
  • Candidates who have completed five years after acquiring the prescribed qualification as on date of reckoning eligibility criteria shall also not be eligible for engagement as Apprentices.
  • A Candidate may undergo maximum two apprenticeship training and the second training shall not be in the same trade. There shall be minimum one year gap between two apprenticeship training, provided that the previous training is completed.

Salary/Stipend

  • Rate of stipend payable to apprentices per month shall be as prescribed under Apprentices Act, 1961/1973.
  • The stipend will be in accordance with The Apprenticeship Rules, 1992 read with The Apprenticeship (Amendment) Rules, 2019 & 2025 as amended from time to time and Corporation's guidelines.
  • During the period of Apprenticeship, apart from monthly stipend as prescribed above, no other monetary or non-monetary benefit/facility such as accommodation, HRA, conveyance, medical facility etc. shall be admissible to apprentices.
  • Candidates have to make their own arrangement for accommodation, conveyance, medical etc.
  • Duration of Apprenticeship Training: 12 months from the date of engagement.

Age Limit (as on 31/01/2026)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 24 years
  • Age Relaxation for SC/ST: Relaxation in upper age up to 5 years to SC/ST candidates considered against reserved positions will be allowed.
  • Age Relaxation for OBC (NCL): Relaxation in upper age up to 3 years to OBC (NCL) candidates considered against reserved positions will be allowed.
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD: Relaxation in upper age up to 10 years for PwBD candidates will be allowed irrespective of reservation of posts to them.
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD-SC/ST: Further, upper age relaxation of 5 years to PwBD candidates belonging to SC/ST category will be allowed.
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD-OBC(NCL): Upper age relaxation of 3 years to PwBD-OBC(NCL) candidates will be allowed.

Application Fee

  • No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 23/01/2026
Date of Opening of Online Application 28/01/2026
Last Date of Submission of Online Application 10/02/2026, 11:59 PM (IST)
Cut-off Date for Age, Qualification etc. 31/01/2026

Selection Process

  • Candidates registered in the NAPS/NATS Portal and applying against the notification shall be considered for selection.
  • Panel cum Merit List of all the candidates, who have applied against a respective post in the portal and meeting the notified eligibility criteria, shall be prepared based on the percentage of marks in descending order obtained in the essential qualification applicable to the trade applied for.
  • Aggregate of marks of all subjects of all years/semesters will be considered for eligibility.
  • In case of a similar rank in merit based on the percentage of marks obtained in the essential qualifying examination, a candidate with an earlier date of birth (older in age) shall be considered. In case of same date of birth, candidates having a higher percentage of marks in Matriculation shall be considered.
  • There shall be No Written Test or Personal Interview.
  • In case a reserved seat remains unfilled, the same shall be reallocated in the following order of priority: first to SC, then to ST, thereafter to OBC, followed by EWS, and finally to UR.
  • Verification of the original documents shall be done before joining of the candidate as an Apprentice.
  • Engagement of selected candidates is subject to their being declared medically fit as per the requirement of the Corporation.

General Information/Instructions

  • Reservation of seats to SC/ST/OBC (Non Creamy Layer-NCL)/PwBD/Economically Weaker Section (EWS) candidates shall be as per the applicable Government guidelines.
  • The minimum prescribed qualification marks will be relaxed by 5% for candidates belonging to SC/ST/PwBD categories considered against reserved positions.
  • In case of candidates belonging to OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) category, name of OBC caste mentioned in the certificate should fall in the Central List of OBCs of the respective State and Non-Creamy Layer status should be valid as on cut-off date of reckoning eligibility criteria.
  • Candidates are advised to ensure that they are Medically Fit as per IndianOil's pre-engagement medical standard.
  • The trades are suitable for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) as per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, with minimum 40% disability.
  • Candidates can apply for one Trade Code ONLY. Candidates applying for more than one Trade Code will not be considered for any post and their applications will be summarily rejected.
  • Only one mobile number and one email ID can be used for applying for the post. The same mobile number and email ID cannot be used by any other candidate for filling online application for this notification.
  • Candidates, who are pursuing higher qualification on the date of final submission of online application but have acquired/completed the same subsequently at the time of document verification, shall also not be eligible for engagement and shall not be allowed to Join.
  • Suppression of information regarding possession or pursuing higher qualification shall render a candidate ineligible for consideration at any stage of selection & termination any time during engagement, if engaged.
  • The terms and conditions of engagement of the apprentices shall be governed by The Apprentices Act, 1961 and Rules 1992 as amended from time to time.
  • Upon completion of the apprenticeship period, the Corporation shall have NO obligation to offer employment to such Apprentices NOR can an Apprentice claim the right for employment on the grounds of completion of Apprenticeship.
  • Candidates are advised to maintain the same registered e-mail ID and mobile number till the completion of apprenticeship training.
  • Candidates are advised to periodically visit the official website https://www.iocl.com/apprenticeships as all future correspondence and latest information shall be shared only on the website.

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Candidates willing to apply must register as a Technician/Trade/Graduate Apprentice online in the following portals under the respective State as per their Trades:
    • Trade Apprentice: Data Entry Operator (Fresher Apprentices)/Domestic Data Entry Operator (Skill Certificate Holders) at https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in
    • Technician Apprentice: (Mechanical/Electrical/Telecommunication & Instrumentation) at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php
    • Trade Apprentice (Assistant-Human Resource/Accountant) at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php
  • Step 2: Candidates meeting the prescribed eligibility criteria may LOGIN to the respective NATS/NAPS Portal using their User ID/Email ID and APPLY for the apprenticeship Openings/Opportunities with the Establishment ID of Indian Oil Corporation Limited mentioned below:
    • Eastern Region Pipelines (ERPL) - NATS: EWBKOC000079, NAPS: E11181900005
    • Western Region Pipelines (WRPL) - NATS: WGJRAC000006, NAPS: E11182400087
    • Northern Region Pipelines (NRPL) - NATS: NHRPPC000001, NAPS: E12180600006
    • Southern Region Pipelines (SRPL) - NATS: STNCHC000040, NAPS: E12183300008
    • South Eastern Region Pipelines (SERPL) - NATS: EORBBSC000001, NAPS: E02252100002
  • Step 3: Candidates must complete the application for Openings/Opportunities in respective NATS/NAPS Portal from 28/01/2026 to 10/02/2026. Before applying against an opportunity, the candidate MUST ensure that their profile (Personal details, Educational details, Category etc.) along with aggregate percentage are appearing correctly in their application.
  • Step 4: After applying against an opportunity in the respective NAPS/NATS Portal, the candidate must complete their registration/application for apprentice positions in Indian Oil Pipelines portal at https://plapps.indianoilpipelines.in/
  • Step 5: The candidate must use the same e-mail ID and Mobile Number used in respective NAPS/NATS Portal which must be valid for the entire apprenticeship period.
  • Step 6: There are two steps for Registration process (Part-I & Part-II) in Indian Oil Pipelines portal:
    • Part-I Registration: Candidate must fill their basic details like name, category etc. and must create their own password. After successful Part-I registration, system generated registration number is sent to their registered email id/SMS.
    • Part-II Registration: Candidates must upload their scanned photograph (Size: between 20-50 KB in JPG Format) and signature in black ink (Size: between 10-30 KB in JPG Format) and furnish educational qualification, experience details etc. and submit the same. This is the final submission process and after that candidates cannot change the details furnished.
  • Step 7: Candidates must complete the application process in Indian Oil Pipelines portal at https://plapps.indianoilpipelines.in/ from 28/01/2026 to 10/02/2026.
  • Step 8: The candidate must mention the registration/enrolment number of NAPS/NATS Portal while applying for apprentice positions in Indian Oil Pipelines Portal.
  • Step 9: After successfully applying/registration of Online Application in Indian Oil Pipelines Portal, the candidate must take a printout of the filled-in online application for future reference.
  • Important: No other means/mode of application shall be accepted other than what is mentioned above. Candidates to ensure that they have successfully applied for the relevant opportunity through respective NAPS/NATS Portal BEFORE applying/registration in Indian Oil Pipelines Portal.
  • Applications/Registration which are incomplete or are received in any other mode/form or not fulfilling the eligibility criteria and/or those received after the last date of submission of application shall not be considered "Eligible" and treated as "Rejected".

Application Fee

  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD): Exempted from payment of application fee.
  • SC/ST category candidates: Rs. 800/- plus Transaction Charges as applicable.

Item / Activity Timeline / Remarks

Selection Process

  • Candidates who successfully submit online applications will appear in an online Computer Based Test (CBT) conducted in English language only, on an all-India basis.
  • For Group ‘A’ posts: CBT of 85 MCQs (85 marks) and Interview of 15 marks; total 100 marks with minimum qualifying criteria of 40% (General/EWS) and 35% (SC/ST/OBC).
  • For Group ‘B’ and ‘C’ posts: CBT of 100 MCQs (100 marks) with minimum qualifying criteria of 40% (General/EWS) and 35% (SC/ST/OBC); no interview for Group ‘B’ and ‘C’ posts.
  • There will be negative marking of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer in CBT.
  • Shortlisting will be done post-CBT for scrutiny of applications and document verification, using candidate-wise merit and prescribed ratios (3× or 5× of posts as applicable).
  • For Staff Car Driver Ordinary Grade and Security Guard Grade-II, shortlisted candidates must qualify Trade Test/Physical Efficiency Test as per parameters given in the guidelines.
  • Final selection will be based purely on merit: marks in CBT for Group ‘B’ and ‘C’ posts, and CBT plus Interview for Group ‘A’ posts, subject to verification of documents and eligibility conditions.

General Information/Instructions

  • Information relating to this recruitment including Addendum/Corrigendum, CBT notice, results, eligibility notice, provisional and final results will be displayed only on PGIMER’s website; no individual intimation will be sent.
  • All applicants must read the Guidelines and Help Manual carefully before online registration and ensure that no column is left blank and all entries are correct; once submitted, entries cannot be changed.
  • Candidature of applicants is purely provisional at all stages and may be cancelled if eligibility conditions are not met or incorrect information is found at any stage, even after appointment.
  • Incomplete applications, applications without requisite documents, applications where fee is not paid properly, or where eligibility/age criteria are not met, are liable to be rejected without correspondence.
  • No offline application form or copy of downloaded application form will be accepted by PGIMER.
  • Roll Numbers/Admit Cards for the CBT will be available online only and must be downloaded from the website; they will not be sent by post.
  • No TA/DA will be admissible for appearing in document verification or further stages of recruitment.
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify the applicant; candidates must be in good mental and bodily health as per medical examination requirements.

How to Apply

  • Candidates must visit PGIMER website (www.pgimer.edu.in), check the advertisement and confirm their eligibility before applying online.
  • Applicants should have a valid personal e-mail ID and mobile number, which must remain active throughout the recruitment process; these are required for initial registration and communication.
  • Candidates must first complete online registration by filling mandatory details like Advertisement Number, Date, Name (as per Matriculation), Date of Birth, Mobile Number and Email ID; these details cannot be changed once registered.
  • After registration, candidates should log in using their User ID and password, fill the Online Application Form section-wise (personal information, qualifications, experience, and document uploads), and then proceed to fee payment.
  • Application fee must be paid online through Net Banking/Credit Card/Debit Card using the payment gateway on the application portal; fee is non-refundable.
  • Candidates must upload legible scanned copies of required documents: educational qualifications (from Matric onwards), mark sheets, date of birth proof, category certificates, experience certificates, NOC (if applicable), etc.
  • Photograph must be a clear passport-size coloured photo with light background, in .jpg/.jpeg format, 50–80 KB in size, showing the candidate’s name and date of photograph (snapped on or after 01.10.2025).
  • After final submission and successful fee payment, candidates should take a printout of the completed application form for future reference; no changes are allowed after final submission.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Essential Academic Qualifications: Graduation in any discipline from a recognised University or any equivalent qualification recognised as such by the Central Government including Integrated Dual Degree (IDD). Candidates possessing qualifications such as Medical, Engineering, Chartered Accountant, Cost Accountant would also be eligible.
  • Experience: Minimum 2 years' experience as on 31.12.2025 as an officer in any Scheduled Commercial Bank or any Regional Rural Bank as listed in Second Schedule of Reserve Bank of India.
  • Salary Requirement: Candidates having experience in Scheduled Commercial Banks other than Public Sector Banks/Regional Rural Banks shall be drawing minimum annual gross salary of Rs. 9.50 lacs for each year and shall provide documentary evidence for their annual gross salary such as Form-16/Annual Income Statement (AIS)/pay slips for last 24 months or certificate from employer.
  • Local Language: Candidates applying for vacancies of a particular Circle should be proficient (reading, writing and understanding) in any one of the specified opted local language of that Circle.
  • Exclusions: Candidates working with subsidiaries of Scheduled Commercial Banks, candidates working in SBI in clerical/supervisory cadre, employees engaged on contract basis, and candidates who have resigned from officer grade in SBI/Associate Banks will not be eligible to apply.
  • CIBIL Status: Candidates who have defaulted in repayment under any lending arrangement with Banks or NBFCs including credit card dues and have not regularised/repaid their outstanding are not eligible for appointment.
  • Character & Antecedents: Candidates against whom there is/are adverse report regarding character & antecedents, moral turpitude are not eligible to apply for the post.

Salary/Stipend

  • Starting basic pay is Rs. 48,480/- in the scale of 48480-2000/7-62480-2340/2-67160-2680/7-85920 applicable to Junior Management Grade Scale-I plus 2 advance increments.
  • The official will also be eligible for D.A, H.R.A/Lease rental, C.C.A, PF, Contributory Pension Fund i.e., NPS, LFC, Medical Facility etc. and other allowances & perquisites as per rules in force from time to time.

Age Limit (as on 31.12.2025)

  • Minimum Age: 21 years (candidates must have been born not later than 31.12.2004)
  • Maximum Age: 30 years (candidates must have been born not earlier than 01.01.1996)
  • Age Relaxation for SC/ST: 5 Years
  • Age Relaxation for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer): 3 Years
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD (SC/ST): 15 Years
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD (OBC): 13 Years
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD (Gen/EWS): 10 Years
  • Age Relaxation for Eligible Ex-Servicemen: 5 Years
  • Note: Cumulative age relaxation will not be available either under the above items or in combination with any other items.

Application Fee

Category Fee Amount
General/EWS/OBC Rs. 750/-
SC/ST/PwBD Nil
  • Fee/charges once paid will NOT be refunded on any account nor can it be held in reserve for any other examination or selection.

  • Transaction charges for online payment, if any, will be borne by the candidates.

Online Registration of Application & Payment of Fees Last Date 18/02/2026

Selection Process

  • Phase 1 - Online Examination: Online test will consist of Objective Tests for 120 marks and Descriptive Test for 50 marks. The duration of objective test is 2 hours consisting of 4 Sections - English Language (30 marks, 30 minutes), Banking Knowledge (40 marks, 40 minutes), General Awareness/Economy (30 marks, 30 minutes), and Computer Aptitude (20 marks, 20 minutes). The Descriptive Test (30 minutes) will be a Test of English Language (Letter Writing & Essay) for total 50 marks.
  • Phase 2 - Screening: The Screening Committee will examine whether candidates fulfil the required eligibility criteria of experience and match the job profile submitted by candidates with the job profile of Scale-I Generalist Officer of State Bank of India. Candidates numbering up to 3 times (approx.) of the Circle wise and Category wise vacancies will be called for interview from the top of the merit list.
  • Phase 3 - Interview: Interview will consist of 50 marks. Candidates will have to score minimum qualifying marks in interview to be considered for final selection.
  • Phase 4 - Local Language Proficiency Test: Test of knowledge of specified opted local language will be conducted for provisionally selected candidates before joining the Bank. Candidates who produce 10th or 12th standard mark sheet/certificate evidencing having studied the specified opted local language will not be required to undergo the language test.
  • Final Selection: Final merit list is prepared based on normalization of marks scored in Online Test and Interview with 75:25 weightage respectively. Marks secured by candidates in Online Test (out of 170 marks) are converted to out of 75 marks and Interview scores (out of 50 marks) are converted to out of 25 marks.
  • Note: There will be no penalty for wrong answers marked in Objective Tests. Sectional marks will not be maintained for Online Examination.

General Information/Instructions

  • The candidate will have to apply for vacancy of one Circle only. A candidate applying against vacancy of one Circle will not be eligible to apply against vacancy of any other Circle.
  • Candidature of the applicant will be considered only against the vacancies in the Circle for which he/she has applied/opted. Merit list will be drawn Circle wise and category wise.
  • Selected candidates will be posted in the Circle against whose vacancy they are selected.
  • The selected candidates will not be entitled for Inter-Circle transfer/Corporate Centre Posting/Corporate Centre Establishment Posting/Foreign Posting up to his/her promotion to SMGS-IV Grade OR 12 years of service, whichever is later.
  • On joining, the selected candidates will be designated as "Circle Based Officers" (CBOs) and will be on probation for a period of 6 months from their joining the Bank.
  • The CBOs will be subjected to continuous assessment during probation period for judging their suitability for confirmation.
  • Reservation for Person with Benchmark Disability (PwBD) candidates is horizontal and will be guided by various guidelines of Government of India. Only those persons with benchmark disabilities (not less than 40% of a specified disability) would be eligible for reservation.
  • OBC category candidates should submit the OBC certificate on format prescribed by Govt. of India, having "Non-Creamy Layer (NCL)" clause issued during period 01.04.2025 to the date of interview.
  • EWS candidates are required to produce 'Income & Asset Certificate' issued based on gross annual income for the Financial Year 2024-25 and valid for the year 2025-26 at the time of interview.
  • Candidates serving in Government/Quasi Government, Public Sector Undertakings including Nationalised Banks/RRBs are required to submit 'No Objection Certificate' from their employer at the time of interview.
  • Bank will arrange pre-examination training (PET) in online mode for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates in consonance with the guidelines issued by Government of India.
  • Outstation candidates called for interview will be reimbursed Railway AC-III fare for the shortest route in India or actual expenses incurred (whichever is lower) from place of residence/posting to Interview venue.
  • Bank reserves right to cancel the recruitment process entirely at any stage.
  • Any legal proceedings in respect of any matter of claim or dispute arising out of this advertisement can be instituted only in Mumbai and Courts/Tribunals/Forums at Mumbai only shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction.
  • Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.
  • State Bank of India does not endorse, authorize or associate with any external coaching platform, consultancy, individual or digital channel claiming to provide guaranteed selection, influence in recruitment or insider guidance.

How to Apply

  • Candidates can apply online only from 29.01.2026 to 18.02.2026. No other mode of application will be accepted.
  • Candidates should have valid email ID and mobile no. which should be kept active till the declaration of final results.
  • Visit Bank's website https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings and open the Online Application Form available under 'Current Openings'.
  • Fill the application carefully. Once the application is filled completely, candidates should submit the data.
  • After ensuring the correctness of the particulars of the application form, candidate should pay fees through the payment gateway integrated with the application.
  • The payment can be made by using debit card/credit card/Internet Banking by providing information as asked on the screen.
  • On successful completion of the transaction, e-receipt and application form will be generated, which may be printed for record.
  • Before applying online, candidates will be required to have a scanned (digital) image of their photograph, signature, left thumb impression, handwritten declaration, and all relevant documents (ID Proof, Date of Birth Proof, Job Profile, Resume, Educational Certificates, Experience Certificate, Form-16, Salary Slip) as per specifications.
  • Candidates should download their call letter (for Online Exam & Interview) by entering their registration number and password/date of birth from the Bank's website. No hard copy of the call letter will be sent by post.
  • Candidates who are called for online exam/interview will be required to bring one photo identity proof such as Passport/Aadhaar/PAN Card/Driving License/Voter's Id Card/Bank Passbook with duly attested Photograph in original as well as a self-attested photocopy thereof.
  • Not more than one application should be submitted by a candidate. In case of multiple applications, only the last valid (completed) application will be retained.
  • Helpdesk: In case of any problem, queries may be made at telephone no. 022-22820427 (between 11:00 AM to 05:00 PM on working days) or lodge their query on http://cgrs.ibps.in. Candidates should mention 'RECRUITMENT OF CIRCLE BASED OFFICERS IN STATE BANK OF INDIA-2026' in the subject.

  • Dental Surgeon: Bachelor of Dental Surgery (B.D.S.) from institutions recognized by Dental Council of India. Valid registration with the West Bengal Dental Council. General Information / Instructions

  1. Please visit official website of Health & Family Welfare Department of Government of West Bengal, i.e. wbhealth.gov.in; then on your left side of Home page, under E Governance go to “Online Recruitment”, and click “Online Recruitment”, from where the Home page of Online Recruitment will open.   2. Only online applications will be accepted.

  14. Candidates must ensure that the e-mail address and Mobile Numbers provided in the Online Application Form are their own or Parents/Guardians only as all information/ communication will be sent by DHFWS through e-mail on the registered e-mail address or SMS on the registered Mobile Number only.

  16. Period of engagement will be initially up to 31st March' 2026. (It may/will be extended further subject to satisfactory performance in current and subsequent Financial year/s).
  17. Working Experience will be calculated as the period from the date obtaining the required qualifications (for the specific mentioned positions) till the last date of online submission. In Experience certificate, period of work done actually should be mentioned clearly otherwise, it will be rejected. Designation of authority issuing experience certificate must be clear and legible. If required and in doubt, experience certificates will be cross verified with authority issuing such certificates and if any discrepancy is found, the said experience will NOT be calculated at the time of final scoring.
  18. Before final selection, shortlisted candidates belonging to the SC, ST, OBC-A, and OBC-B categories will be directed to furnish original certificate issued by competent authority
  19. Online registration number generated at the time of online application must be retained by all applicants for future reference. Office of the undersigned is not liable to give any information regarding the online registration number in future.

The applicants will have to follow the website for all information/instructions pertaining to the recruitment process.

  23. Application fees of Rs. 100/- (Rupees One hundred only) or Rs.50/- (Rupees Fifty only) should be deposited online for each post following Government guidelines. The online deposition of application fees can be done through net banking or credit/debit card system through an online interface. If the payment is successful, the candidate will have to login again using application ID and Date of Birth for the final submission application and complete process 'Continue after registration'.
  24. No TA/DA is admissible for candidates.
  25. Candidates are instructed to follow the website (www.wbhealth.gov.in & www.murshidabad.gov.in) regularly for any future reference, information/instructions pertaining to the recruitment process.
  26. Age will be calculated as on 01/01/2026 (1st January 2026).
  27. Candidates will not be allowed to edit after submission of the online application.
  28. Hardcopy, printed copy of the online registration form should be retained by all applicants for document verification purposes. Without registration form no candidates will be entertained for original testimonials verification by the authority.

Eligibility Criteria

The candidates having completed their graduation and postgraduation courses through correspondence/part-time/open university/open learning/external/distance learning are not eligible.
  • Experience: Minimum 01 year of Post Qualification (Post Graduation or Chartered Accountant) work experience in a reputed commercial bank/financial institution/state level term lending institution, with skills in project finance, credit appraisal, term lending, analysis of cross-border risks and financing of overseas joint-ventures.

Salary/ Stipend

  • Deputy Manager (I): ₹ 48480-2000-62480-2340-67160-2680-85920
  • In addition to the pay, officers will be eligible for allowances, perquisites and benefits, as applicable to the Grade as per Bank’s rules, prevalent at the time of joining. Residential accommodation may be provided subject to availability or alternatively leased accommodation scheme is in place. Schemes for granting loans for housing, vehicle, personal computer, children education etc. are also available.

Age Limit (as on 31-12-2025)

  • Not below 21 years and not above 28 years as on December 31, 2025.
  • Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe (SC/ST): 33 Years
  • Other Backward Classes (Non-Creamy Layer): 31 Years
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) - PwBD (SC/ ST): 43 Years
  • PwBD (OBC-NCL): 41 Years
  • PwBD (UR/ EWS): 38 Years

Application Fee

  • ₹ 600/- for General and OBC candidates
  • ₹ 100/- (Intimation charges) for SC/ST/ PwBD /EWS and Female candidates

Important Dates

Website link opens 26 January 2026
Last day for applying and payment of Examination fee 15 February 2026
Tentative month of Written Examination February 2026

Selection Process

  • The Selection Process will comprise Written test and Personal Interview.
  • Candidates who are shortlisted based on the performance in the Written test will be called for Personal Interview.
  • Final list shall be drawn based on overall performance of the candidate in Written examination and interviews. The marks obtained in written examination out of [Out of 100 with 70% weightage] and Interview [Out of 100 with 30% weightage] shall form the basis for final selection.

General Information / Instructions

  • Reservation for Economically Weaker Section (EWS) in recruitment is governed by Office Memorandum no. 36039/1/2019-Estt (Res) dt. 31.01.2019 of Department of Personnel & Training, Ministry of Personnel (DoPT), Public Grievance & Pensions, Government of India. EWS vacancies are tentative and subject to further directives of Government of India and outcome of any litigation. The appointment is provisional and is subject to the income & Asset certificate being verified through the proper channels. Benefit of reservation under EWS category can be availed upon production of an ‘Income and Asset Certificate’ issued by a Competent Authority in the format prescribed by Government of India. Candidates may please note that they should be in possession of Income and Assets Certificate as mentioned above issued on or after 01.04.2025 and before the date of document verification at the time of interview. Candidates qualifying for interview under EWS category would be required to submit EWS certificate, at the time of interview. In case candidates fail to produce the same at the time of interview, they will not be allowed to appear for interview. Further, their request for interview under General category will also not be entertained.
  • NOTE: Reservations are applicable as per prevailing Government of India (GoI) guidelines.
  • All the eligibility [age, educational qualification etc.] shall be computed as mentioned in subsequent paragraphs.
  • Candidates should possess excellent communication skills and should be proficient in the use of computers and information technology.
  • Candidates from Universities / Institutes awarding degrees based on ratings / grades other than numerical marks (i.e. CGPA/GPA/any other form), may please note that if the equivalent aggregate percentage of marks is not mentioned in the mark sheet/certificate, candidates are required to furnish a letter from the head of the Institute / Controller of Examination of the University, stating clearly, the methodology of conversion of the grades into percentage (conversion formula) and the numerical marks equivalent to their rating/grades.
  • The University / Institute should be recognised / approved by Government / AICTE / UGC. The candidates having completed their graduation and postgraduation courses through correspondence/part-time/open university/open learning/external/distance learning are not eligible.
  • Reservation for candidates belonging to reserved category will be in accordance with the prevailing GoI guidelines. Candidates must state their reservation status clearly in the application. Applicants should produce in original their degree certificates, caste, experience and any other relevant certificates at the time of interview/ at any stage of the subsequent process.
  • 10% reservation in direct recruitment in civil posts and services in GoI is provided to the persons belonging to EWS, who are not covered under the scheme of reservation for SCs, STs and OBCs. The benefit of reservation under EWS can be availed upon production of an Income and Asset Certificate issued by a Competent Authority.
  • Relaxations are provided to the candidates belonging to SC, ST, OBC and for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBDs) category. As per DOPT circular no. 36034/2/2013 dated April 08, 2013, in direct recruitment by way of All India Competitive Examination, the maximum relaxation of 5 years in upper age limit is allowed to Ex-servicemen for appointment in Group A (i.e., Officers cadre).
  • For candidates belonging to OBC category, certificate should specifically contain a clause that the candidate does not belong to creamy layer section and is excluded from the benefits of the reservation for other backward classes in civil posts and services under Government of India. OBC caste certificate containing the Non-Creamy layer clause should be valid as on the last date of applying (issued within one year prior to the last date for applying). Caste name mentioned in certificate should tally letter by letter with Central Government list/notification.
  • Candidates belonging to OBC category but coming under creamy layer and/or if their caste does not find place in the Central List are not entitled to OBC reservation. They should indicate their category as General in the application form.
  • The selected candidates will be posted anywhere in India, depending on the requirement of the Bank. Therefore, only candidates willing to serve anywhere in India should apply.
  • Selected candidates may also be transferred to offices outside India with their consent.
  • All the educational qualifications mentioned above should be from a University / Institution / Board recognized by Govt. of India / approved by Govt. Regulatory Bodies. In case the date of passing is not properly mentioned in the mark- sheet or provisional certificate, proper document from Board / University indicating the date of declaration of results has to be submitted at the time of interview. In case the result of a particular examination is posted on the website of the University / Institute and web-based certificate is issued, then proper document / certificate in original issued and signed by the appropriate authority of the University / Institute indicating the date of passing that examination properly mentioned thereon will be reckoned for verification and further process
  • Only those who satisfy the required age and qualification criteria should apply. Applications that do not meet with the requirements will be rejected and no correspondence in this regard will be entertained.
  • Interested candidates must fill in an Online Application Form. The application link will be live from January 26, 2026. Application in any other format will not be considered and will be rejected by the Bank, irrespective of fulfilling the eligibility criteria. Only Online Applications will be considered by the Bank. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.
  • Applicants are requested to ensure their eligibility before applying for any post. Fees once paid will not be refunded in case the applicant is not found to be eligible for the said post.
  • The date and timing of the Written test will be advised to the eligible candidates at a later date by notification on our website, personal email and/or SMS.
  • Depending upon the requirement and suitability of the candidates, the Bank reserves the right to cancel/restrict/curtail/enlarge the recruitment process including the number of vacancies, if need so arises, without any further notice and without assigning any reason therefor.
  • No correspondence will be entertained from any ineligible and non-selected candidate. In all matters regarding eligibility, the selection process, the stages at which the scrutiny of eligibility is to be undertaken, documents to be produced for the selection process, assessment, prescribing minimum qualifying standards in the selection process, number of vacancies, communication of results, etc., the Bank’s decision shall be final and binding on the candidates and no correspondence shall be entertained in this regard.
  • Selected candidates, who are already in service must produce a proper relieving letter / discharge certificate in original from their present employer at the time of joining, failing which they shall not be allowed to join the Bank.
  • Selected candidates (Deputy Managers), at the time of joining the Bank, will have to execute a personal bond for ₹ 3 lakh to serve the Bank for a minimum period of 5 years from the date of joining the Bank.
  • Any legal proceedings in respect of any matter of claim / dispute arising out of this advertisement and / or an application in response thereto can be instituted only in Mumbai and courts / tribunals / forums at Mumbai only shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction to try any clause / dispute.
  • The Bank reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process entirely at any stage.
  • Candidates are advised in their own interest that they should not furnish any particulars that are false, tampered with or fabricated and should not suppress any material information while submitting application. At the time of examination, interview or in a subsequent selection procedure, if a candidate is (or has been) found guilty of: (i) Using unfair means (ii) Impersonating or procuring impersonation by any person, OR (iii) Misbehaving in the examination/interview hall or disclosing, publishing, reproducing, transmitting, storing or facilitating transmission and storage of contents of the test(s) or any information therein in whole or part thereof in any form or by any means, verbal or written, electronically or mechanically for any purpose, OR (iv) Resorting to any irregular or improper means in connection with his/ her candidature, OR (v) Obtaining support for his/ her candidature by unfair means, OR (vi) Carrying mobile phones or similar electronic devices of communication in the examination/ interview hall. Such a candidate may, in addition to rendering himself/ herself liable to criminal prosecution, shall be liable; a) to be disqualified from the examination for which he/ she is a candidate: b) to be debarred either permanently or for a specified period from any examination conducted by the Bank. c) for termination of service, if he/ she has already joined the Bank.
  • CANDIDATES REPORTING LATE i.e., after the reporting time specified on the call letter for Examination will not be permitted to take the examination. The reporting time mentioned on the call letter is prior to the Start time of the test. Though the duration of the examination is 2 hours 30 minutes, candidates may be required to be at the venue for about 4 hours including the time required for completion of various formalities such as verification and collection of various requisite documents, giving of instructions, etc.
  • In the examination hall as well as at the time of interview, the call letter along with original and a photocopy of the candidate’s currently valid photo identity (bearing exactly the same name as it appears on the call letter) such as PAN Card/ Passport/ Permanent Driving License/ Voter’s Card/ Bank Passbook with photograph/ Photo identity proof issued by a Gazetted Officer on official letterhead along with photograph / Photo identity proof issued by a People’s Representative on official letterhead along with photograph / valid recent Identity Card issued by a recognized College/ University/ Aadhar card/ E-Aadhar Card with a photograph/ Employee ID/ Bar Council Identity Card with photograph should be submitted to the invigilator for verification. The candidate’s identity will be verified with respect to his/her details on the call letter, in the Attendance List and requisite documents submitted. If identity of the candidate is in doubt the candidate may not be allowed to appear for the Examination.
  • Ration Card and Learner’s Driving License are not valid id proof.
  • Note: Candidates must produce in original the photo identity proof and submit photocopy of the photo identity proof along with Examination call letter as well as the Interview Call Letter while attending the examination/ interview respectively, without which they will not be allowed to take up the examination/ interview. Candidates must note that the name as appearing on the call letter (provided during the process of registration) should exactly match the name as appearing on the photo identity proof. Female candidates who have changed first/last/middle name post marriage must take special note of this. If there is any mismatch between the name indicated in the Call Letter and Photo Identity Proof the candidate will not be allowed to appear for the examination. In case of candidates who have changed their name, will be allowed only if they produce original Gazette notification / their original marriage certificate / affidavit in original.
  • 1. The examination will be conducted at venues given in the respective call letters.
  • 2. No request for change of centre/venue/date/session for Examination shall be entertained.
  • 3. Export-Import Bank of India, however, reserves the right to cancel any of the Examination Centres and/ or add some other Centres, at its discretion, depending upon the number of candidates, administrative feasibility, etc.
  • 4. Export-Import Bank of India also reserves the right to allot the candidate to any Centre other than the one he/she has opted for.
  • 5. Candidate will appear for the examination at an Examination Centre at his/her own risks and expenses and Export-Import Bank of India will not be responsible for any injury, expense or losses etc. of any nature.
  • 6. Choice of centre once exercised by the candidate will be final. If sufficient number of candidates do not opt for a particular centre for examination, OR if the number of candidates is more than the capacity available for exam for a centre, Export-Import Bank of India reserves the right to allot any other centre to the candidate.
  • Decision of Export-Import Bank of India in all matters relating to recruitment will be final and binding on the candidate. No correspondence or personal enquiries shall be entertained by the Export-Import Bank of India in this behalf.
  • Export-Import Bank of India would be analysing the responses (answers) of individual candidates with those of other candidates to detect patterns of similarity of right and wrong answers. If in the analytical procedure adopted by Export-Import Bank of India in this regard, it is inferred/ concluded that the responses have been shared and scores obtained are not genuine/ valid, Export-Import Bank of India reserves the right to cancel the candidature of the concerned candidates and the result of such candidates (disqualified) will be withheld.
  • There will be no sectional cut off but the final list for interviews will be drawn based on the candidate’s performance in the written test.
  • Instances for providing incorrect information and/or process violation by a candidate detected at any stage of the selection process will lead to disqualification of the candidate from the selection process and he/she will not be allowed to appear in any recruitment process of Export-Import Bank of India in the future. If such instances go undetected during the current selection process but are detected subsequently, such disqualification will take place with retrospective affect.
  • A pre-recruitment training will be organised for the candidates from reserved categories. Details of the training and its mode of delivery (online / offline) will be intimated to the candidates who opt for it through the online application form. Details will be shared with such candidates after the last date of registration.
  • Candidates whose writing speed is adversely affected permanently for any reason can use their own scribe at their cost during the examination. In all such cases where a scribe is used, the following rules will apply:
  • • The candidate will have to arrange his/her own scribe at his/her own cost.
  • • The scribe arranged by the candidate should not be a candidate for the same examination. If violation of the above is detected at any stage of the process, candidature of both the candidate and the scribe will be cancelled. Candidates eligible for and who wish to use the services of a scribe in the examination should invariably carefully indicate the same in the online application form. Any subsequent request may not be favourably entertained.
  • • A person acting as a scribe for one candidate cannot be a scribe for another candidate.
  • • The scribe may be from any academic stream.
  • • Both the candidate as well as scribe will have to give a suitable undertaking confirming that the scribe fulfils all the stipulated eligibility criteria for a scribe mentioned above. Further in case it later transpires that he/she did not fulfil any laid down eligibility criteria or suppressed material facts the candidature of the applicant will stand cancelled, irrespective of the result of the examination.
  • • Those candidates who use a scribe shall be eligible for compensatory time of 20 minutes for every hour of the examination or as otherwise advised.

  • Candidates who were earlier employed in ECHS but whose services were terminated/not extended for second year employment need not apply

  • 4 ECHS Polyclinics under Station Cell Kolkata: Kolkata, Salt Lake, Howrah and Baruipur

Reservation for Ex-Servicemen

  • 60% reservation: Gynecologist, Medical Officer, Dental Officer
  • 70% reservation: All other posts including Dental Assistant, Lab Technician, Nursing Assistant, Pharmacist, Physiotherapist, DEO/Clerk, Driver, Female Attendant, Safaiwala, Peon, Chowkidar

Working Hours

  • General Staff: 48 hours per week (8 hours x 6 days) from Monday to Saturday. Sunday will be holiday

  • Admissible 2.5 days/1.5 days as applicable for every completed month during contractual period
  • Leave will lapse if accumulated at the end of six months

Termination of Services

  • Contract can be terminated by either side by giving one month's notice

On-the-Job Training

  • Selected Medical Officer, Dental Officer & Gynecologists have to undergo 10 days OJT (On-the-Job Training) without any financial benefits for assuming charge as contractual employee

Important Instructions

    • PAN Card photocopy

    • 12th Certificate
    • Graduation Certificate

    • Valid Medical/Dental Council Registration Certificate
    • Valid Driving License for LMV (for drivers only)
    • PPO, Discharge Book, ESM I/Card (For ESM only)
    • Medical Fitness Certificate
    • Experience Certificates (as applicable)
    • No Objection Certificate from current employer (if applicable)
    • Copy of Record of Service (for ESM)
  • Submit application to: OIC Station Cell (ECHS) Kolkata, Headquarters Bengal Sub Area, 246 AJC Bose Road, near SSKM Hospital, Alipore, Kolkata-27
  • Submit by 18 February 2026 at 1800 hrs through registered post or by hand
  • For details, contact Tele No: 033-2230 0883, Email: [email protected]
