Eligibility Criteria

Qualification Requirements

  • Technician Apprentice (Mechanical): Three years full time Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or Automobile Engineering. Lateral entry candidates after Class-XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year of Diploma course are also eligible.
  • Technician Apprentice (Electrical): Three years full time Diploma in Electrical Engineering or Electrical & Electronics Engineering. Lateral entry candidates after Class-XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year of Diploma course are also eligible.
  • Technician Apprentice (Telecommunication & Instrumentation): Three years full time Diploma in Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering, Electronics & Radio Communication Engineering, Instrumentation & Control Engineering, Instrumentation & Process Control Engineering, or Electronics Engineering from a Government recognized Institute. Lateral entry candidates after Class-XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year of Diploma course are also eligible.
  • Trade Apprentice (Assistant-Human Resource): Full Time Bachelor degree (Graduation) from a Government recognized Institute/University.
  • Trade Apprentice (Accountant): Full Time Bachelor degree (Graduation) in Commerce from a Government recognized Institute/University.
  • Data Entry Operator (Fresher Apprentices): Minimum 12th Pass (but below Graduate).
  • Domestic Data Entry Operator (Skill Certificate Holders): Minimum 12th Pass (but below Graduate). Additionally, candidates should possess Skill Certificate of Domestic Data Entry Operator for training of less than one year issued by an awarding body recognized under National Skill Qualifications Framework or any other authority recognized by the Central Government.

Essential Qualifications

  • Candidate should have already passed the prescribed qualification on the date of reckoning eligibility criteria which is 31/01/2026.
  • Candidates whose result of the qualifying examination is awaited on the date of reckoning eligibility criteria are not eligible to apply.
  • The prescribed qualification for Graduate/Diploma holders shall be from a recognized University/Institute as a regular full-time course in the relevant trade/discipline with a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate (45% for SC/ST and PwBD category candidates for the posts reserved for them).
  • Candidates holding a qualification acquired through part-time/correspondence/distance education mode are not eligible.
  • Candidates possessing higher professional qualifications such as BE/B.Tech., MBA, CA, LLB, MCA, or any such equivalent qualification or pursuing higher qualification and having completed the same on or before joining apprenticeship training, shall not be eligible.
  • Wherever CGPA/OGPA or Letter Grade is awarded in the ITI/Degree/Diploma examinations, its equivalent aggregate percentage of marks must be indicated by the candidates in the Online Application as per the norms adopted by Board/University/Institute.

Experience

  • Candidates having job experience for a period of one year or more after the attainment of the qualification shall not be eligible to be engaged as Apprentice.
  • Candidates who have completed five years after acquiring the prescribed qualification as on date of reckoning eligibility criteria shall also not be eligible for engagement as Apprentices.
  • A Candidate may undergo maximum two apprenticeship training and the second training shall not be in the same trade. There shall be minimum one year gap between two apprenticeship training, provided that the previous training is completed.

Salary/Stipend

  • Rate of stipend payable to apprentices per month shall be as prescribed under Apprentices Act, 1961/1973.
  • The stipend will be in accordance with The Apprenticeship Rules, 1992 read with The Apprenticeship (Amendment) Rules, 2019 & 2025 as amended from time to time and Corporation's guidelines.
  • During the period of Apprenticeship, apart from monthly stipend as prescribed above, no other monetary or non-monetary benefit/facility such as accommodation, HRA, conveyance, medical facility etc. shall be admissible to apprentices.
  • Candidates have to make their own arrangement for accommodation, conveyance, medical etc.
  • Duration of Apprenticeship Training: 12 months from the date of engagement.

Age Limit (as on 31/01/2026)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 24 years

  • Age Relaxation for OBC (NCL): Relaxation in upper age up to 3 years to OBC (NCL) candidates considered against reserved positions will be allowed.

  • Age Relaxation for PwBD-OBC(NCL): Upper age relaxation of 3 years to PwBD-OBC(NCL) candidates will be allowed.

Selection Process

  • Candidates registered in the NAPS/NATS Portal and applying against the notification shall be considered for selection.
  • Panel cum Merit List of all the candidates, who have applied against a respective post in the portal and meeting the notified eligibility criteria, shall be prepared based on the percentage of marks in descending order obtained in the essential qualification applicable to the trade applied for.
  • Aggregate of marks of all subjects of all years/semesters will be considered for eligibility.
  • In case of a similar rank in merit based on the percentage of marks obtained in the essential qualifying examination, a candidate with an earlier date of birth (older in age) shall be considered. In case of same date of birth, candidates having a higher percentage of marks in Matriculation shall be considered.
  • There shall be No Written Test or Personal Interview.
  • In case a reserved seat remains unfilled, the same shall be reallocated in the following order of priority: first to SC, then to ST, thereafter to OBC, followed by EWS, and finally to UR.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates are advised to ensure that they are Medically Fit as per IndianOil's pre-engagement medical standard.

  • Step 4: After applying against an opportunity in the respective NAPS/NATS Portal, the candidate must complete their registration/application for apprentice positions in Indian Oil Pipelines portal at https://plapps.indianoilpipelines.in/

Eligibility Criteria

  • Officer-in-Charge: Post Graduate degree in Social Work / Sociology / Child Development / Human Rights / Public Administration / Psychology / Psychiatry / Law / Public Health / Community Resource Management from a recognized university; at least 3 years’ experience of working with the Govt./NGO in documentation, training & capacity building, project formulation/implementation, monitoring & supervision preferably in the field of Women & Child Development/Social Welfare; proficiency in computers.
  • Counsellor: Graduate in Social Work / Sociology / Psychology / Public Health / Counselling from a recognized university OR PG Diploma in Counselling and Communication; at least 1 year of working experience with the Govt./NGO preferably in the field of Women & Child Development; proficiency in computers.
  • Child Welfare Officer (CWO) / Case Worker / Probation Officer: Graduate preferably in Social Work / Sociology / Social Science or LLB from a recognized university; experience of at least 2 years of working with Govt./NGO/Legal Matters preferably in the field of Women & Child Rights; good understanding of Women & Child rights & protection issues; weightage for work experience; proficiency in computers.
  • House Father: H.S. or equivalent; other preferred qualification – at least 3 years’ experience in child care programme/institutes.
  • Para Medical Staff: H.S. passed & Diploma in Nursing / Pharmacy; other preferred qualification – at least 3 years’ experience in the relevant field.
  • Store Keeper cum Accountant: Graduate in Commerce / Accountancy (Hons.) will get weightage; other preferred qualification – knowledge of computer operation & 3 years’ experience in the relevant field.
  • Cook: As per notification; consolidated remuneration Rs. 12,000/- per month.
  • Helper-cum-Night Watchman (Erstwhile Helper): M.P. or equivalent (relaxed to class VIII passed for Home inmates only); other preferred qualification – experience in relevant field.
  • House Keeper: As per notification; consolidated remuneration Rs. 12,000/- per month.

Salary/Stipend

  • Officer-in-Charge: Consolidated remuneration of Rs. 33,100/- per month.
  • Counsellor: Consolidated remuneration of Rs. 23,170/- per month.
  • Child Welfare Officer (CWO)/Case Worker/Probation Officer: Consolidated remuneration of Rs. 23,170/- per month.
  • House Father: Consolidated remuneration of Rs. 14,564/- per month.
  • Para Medical Staff: Consolidated remuneration of Rs. 12,000/- per month.
  • Store Keeper cum Accountant: Consolidated remuneration of Rs. 18,536/- per month.
  • Cook, Helper-cum-Night Watchman (Erstwhile Helper), House Keeper: Consolidated remuneration of Rs. 12,000/- per month.
  • All posts are purely contractual and renewable every year as per rules.

Age Limit (as on 06-01-2026)

  • Officer-in-Charge: 27–42 years as on date of notification.
  • Counsellor: 23–40 years as on date of notification.
  • Child Welfare Officer (CWO)/Case Worker/Probation Officer: 21–40 years as on date of notification.
  • House Father, Para Medical Staff, Store Keeper cum Accountant: 21–40 years as on date of notification.
  • Cook, Helper-cum-Night Watchman (Erstwhile Helper), House Keeper: 18–40 years as on date of notification.

  • Details of application fee are not mentioned in the notification.

Date of Notification 06.01.2026

Last date of hard copy submission of application with required documents 30.01.2026 up to 5 p.m.

Selection Process

  • Examination procedure includes Written test, Computer test and Viva-voce/Personality test as applicable to the post.
  • For Sl. No. 1, 2 and 3: Written test of 80 marks (Arithmetic – 20, G.K. – 15, English – 15, Bengali – 10, Child Protection – 20), Computer test (MS-Office, Internet, e-mail) of 10 marks and Viva-voce of 10 marks.
  • For Sl. No. 4: Written test of 90 marks (Arithmetic – 20, G.K. – 20, English – 15, Bengali – 15, Child Protection – 20) and Viva-voce of 10 marks.
  • For Sl. No. 5: Written test of 90 marks (Arithmetic – 20, G.K. – 20, English – 15, Bengali – 15, Child Health – 20) and Viva-voce of 10 marks.
  • For Sl. No. 6: Written test of 80 marks (Arithmetic – 20, G.K. – 15, English – 15, Bengali – 10, Accountancy – 20), Computer test (MS-Office, Internet, e-mail) of 10 marks and Viva-voce of 10 marks.
  • For Sl. No. 7, 8 and 9: Viva-voce test of 10 marks will be held.
  • After scrutiny of submitted application forms, admit cards for eligible candidates shall be uploaded on the district website mentioning date, time and venue of examinations.
  • Working candidates must submit “No Objection Certificate to appear for the examination” from the present employer.
  • District Authority reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process at any stage; no TA/DA will be given for appearing in the examination.

General Information/Instructions

  • Applications are invited from Indian citizens for filling up 26 contractual posts of Govt. run Child Care Institute (CCI) under Mission Vatsalya Scheme situated at Pragati Balak Bhawan (CCI for boys), Vill.- Tantigeria, PO.- Midnapore, PS.- Kotwali, Dist.- Paschim Medinipur, PIN.- 721102.
  • Recruitment is as per direction of relevant Government orders and following 100-point roster of vacancies of Labour Department, Govt. of West Bengal.
  • All contractual posts are renewable every year.
  • Experience certificates must clearly mention employer’s and employee’s name, name of the post, date of joining and date of leaving; otherwise, experience certificate will be treated as invalid.
  • Candidature will be cancelled if candidate fails to submit any requisite document(s).
  • Working candidates applying for the posts must submit No Objection Certificate from present employer to appear for the examination.
  • District Authority reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process at any stage and no representation in this matter will be entertained.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the examination.
  • For more detailed information, District Child Protection Unit, District Collectorate, PO.- Midnapore, Dist.- Paschim Medinipur, Pin.- 721101 may be contacted.

How to Apply

  • Eligible intending candidates must submit their application form only online in the district website (http://www.paschimmedinipur.gov.in).
  • After online submission, candidates must submit hard copy of application along with acknowledgement slip and all required documents either through registered post or at the Drop Box at District Child Protection Unit, Office of the District Magistrate, PO.- Midnapore, Dist.- Paschim Medinipur, Pin.- 721101, West Bengal.
  • Self-attested copies of date of birth, caste certificate (where applicable), address proof and certificates & mark sheets of MP or equivalent, HS, Degree and Master Degree as per post criteria must be enclosed.
  • Self-attested basic computer course certificate must be attached where applicable.
  • Experience certificates must contain all required details; incomplete experience certificates will be treated as invalid.
  • Last date of online and hard copy submission of application with required documents is 30.01.2026 up to 5 p.m.

Eligibility Criteria

  • MBBS from Institution recognized by National Medical Commission (NMC).
  • Completion of compulsory internship with Internship Completion Certificate.

Salary/Stipend

  • Pay Scale: Rs. 15,600–39,100 + Grade Pay Rs. 5,400 (6th CPC).
  • Level 10 of the Pay Matrix of the Seventh Pay Commission.
  • NPA (Non-Practicing Allowance) admissible for Medical Graduates as per rules.
  • No travelling or other allowances will be paid to the candidate for joining the post.

Age Limit

  • Maximum Age Limit for Junior Resident: Not exceeding 33 years as on the date of publishing this notification in Institute website.
  • No age relaxation available to SC/ST/OBC candidates applying for unreserved vacancies.
  • Age relaxation for PwD (OPH) candidates: 10 years beyond the upper age limit.
  • Age relaxation to other categories will be applicable as per DoPT instructions; regulated as per Government of India rules.

Application Fee

  • Application Fees: Rs. 1,000/- (Rupees One Thousand only) for Unreserved/OBC/EWS candidates.
  • Payment Mode: Demand Draft in favour of “AIIMS KALYANI INTERNAL RESOURCES ACCOUNT” payable at Kalyani.

Date & Time of Interview 04.02.2026, 10:00 Hrs onward (candidates reporting after 10:00 AM will not be allowed)

  • Interview will be conducted after verifying application and requisite documents of candidates at reporting time.
  • All candidates completing eligibility criteria by 31 January 2026 are eligible.
  • Depending on requirement, authorities may increase or decrease number of seats/posts; decision of authorities shall be final.

  • The appointment is purely on tenure basis and initially for a period of 6 months only; it does not vest any right to claim regular appointment, permanent absorption or continued contractual appointment.
  • The tenure engagement will automatically expire on completion of 6 months and can be terminated at any time by the Institute; employee may resign with one month notice or salary in lieu thereof.
  • This appointment is whole time; private practice of any kind is prohibited and appointees may be required to work in shifts, including Trauma & Emergency Medicine, or any other area as required.
  • Appointees must conform to rules of discipline and conduct applicable to Institute employees; they should not have been convicted by any Court of Law; canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate.
  • If any declaration or information is found false or material information is willfully suppressed, the candidate will be liable to removal from service and further action as deemed fit by appointing authority.

  • Accepted/rejected application status and all updates will be posted on the Institute website; AIIMS Kalyani will not be responsible for non-receipt of email communication.

  • Produce original documents at the time of walk-in interview, including MBBS degree, internship completion certificate, registration certificate, proof of attempts, category certificate, identity and address proofs.

  • Ensure to report at AIIMS Kalyani, Administrative Building, Ground Floor, Welcome Center, by 09:00 Hrs on 04.02.2026; candidates reporting after 10:00 AM will not be allowed.
  • For clarification and enquiries, candidates may write to [email protected] as mentioned in the advertisement.

  • The ratio of the number of vacant posts to be filled and the number of candidates to be called for interview does not exceed 1:15. If the number of applications received is large, and it is not convenient for the University to interview all applicants, the number of candidates shortlisted for interview may be subjected to the aforementioned ratio of 1:15 based on the qualifying criteria decided by the University.

  • The upper age limit for the prescribed post shall be relaxable to the applicants already working in the University system as per Govt. of India / UGC rules / regulation / orders etc. applicable to these advertised posts.

  • The candidates must apply through the Samarth Porta.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Citizenship: A candidate must be a citizen of India.
  • Age Limit: A candidate must have attained the age of 21 years and must not be above the age of 42 years as on 1st January 2025; he/she must not have been born earlier than 2nd January 1983 and not later than 1st January 2004. Upper age limit is relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST/SEBC/Women/Ex-Servicemen and by 10 years for PwD with permanent disability of 40% or more, with cumulative benefit for PwD of SC/ST/SEBC categories.
  • Educational Qualification (Essential): A candidate must hold a Bachelor’s Degree from any University incorporated by an Act of the Central or a State Legislature in India or an Educational Institution established by an Act of Parliament or deemed to be a University under Section-3 of the UGC Act, 1956 or a Foreign University approved by the Central Government from time to time.
  • Odia Language Requirement: The candidate must be able to read, write and speak Odia and must have passed Middle School Examination with Odia as a language subject OR passed High School Certificate or equivalent examination with Odia as medium of examination in non-language subjects OR passed Odia as a language subject in final examination of Class-VII from a recognised school OR passed a test in Odia in Middle English School standard conducted by the Government of Odisha.
  • Marital Status Condition: A candidate who has more than one spouse living or, in case of a woman candidate, is married to a person having one spouse living, shall not be eligible unless exempted by the State Government.
  • Government Servants: Government servants (temporary or permanent) are eligible, provided they possess requisite qualifications and are within the prescribed age limit and obtain No Objection Certificate from the competent authority.
  • Character & Health: A candidate must have good moral character and be of sound mental and physical health and free from any physical defect likely to interfere with the discharge of duties.

Salary/Stipend

  • For Odisha Police Service, Group-A (Junior Branch) – Group-A Service: Rs. 56,100/- in Level-12, Cell-1 in the Pay Matrix under Rule-3 of ORSP Rules, 2017.
  • For Group-B Services (Odisha Taxation & Accounts Service, Odisha Co-operative Service, Odisha Skill Development & Employment Service, Odisha Labour Service, Odisha Excise Service, Odisha Tourism Service): Rs. 44,900/- in Level-10, Cell-1 in the Pay Matrix under Rule-3 of ORSP Rules, 2017.

Age Limit

  • Minimum Age: 21 years.
  • Maximum Age: 42 years.
  • The candidate must not have been born earlier than 02/01/1983 and not later than 01/01/2004.
  • Upper age limit relaxable by 5 years for SC, ST, SEBC, Women and Ex-Servicemen candidates.
  • Upper age limit relaxable by 10 years for Persons with Disabilities having permanent disability of 40% or more; PwD candidates of SC/ST/SEBC categories are eligible for cumulative age relaxation.

Application Fee

  • Candidates other than SC, ST and PwD category shall have to pay examination fee of Rs. 700/- (Rupees Seven hundred only).
  • Payment Mode: Online mode while filling the Online Application Form (Credit Card, Debit Card, UPI, Net Banking, Wallet, etc.).
  • The examination fees paid shall be refunded only to those candidates who actually appear in both the papers of the Preliminary Examination.
  • Applications without payment of examination fee (except SC/ST/PwD candidates) will be treated as incomplete and summarily rejected.
  • Candidates must furnish bank account details in the Online Application Form for refund where required.

Important Dates

Event Date

Selection Process

  • The Combined Competitive Recruitment Examination shall comprise:
    • Preliminary Examination (Objective type) for selection of candidates for Main Examination.
    • Main Examination (Written) and Interview for Personality Test for selection to various services and posts.
  • Preliminary Examination: Two compulsory papers of Objective Type (Multiple Choice Questions), General Studies Paper-I (200 marks) and General Studies Paper-II (200 marks), each of 2 hours duration.
  • General Studies Paper-II is a qualifying paper with minimum qualifying marks of 33; selection to Main Examination is based on marks in General Studies Paper-I and qualifying the Paper-II as per rules.
  • There shall be negative marking: for each wrong answer, one-third (0.33) of the marks assigned to a question shall be deducted; multiple answers to a question are treated as wrong.
  • Main Examination: Written examination consists of nine papers – two qualifying language papers (Odia and English) in Part-I and seven papers in Part-II (Essay, General Studies-I, II, III, IV and two Optional subject papers).
  • Marks obtained in Part-II papers and Interview (Personality Test) are counted for ranking; language papers in Part-I are qualifying in nature.
  • Interview (Personality Test) carries 250 marks; final ranking is based on total marks of Main Written and Interview.
  • Candidates are allotted to various Services based on ranks and service preference.

General Information/Instructions

  • The provisions of the Odisha Conduct of Examinations Act, 1988 are applicable; any violation or malpractice will attract disciplinary action and possible criminal prosecution.
  • Penalty provisions under Rule-18 of Odisha Civil Services Combined Competitive Recruitment Examination Rules, 1991 shall apply.
  • Reservation and relaxation benefits for SC, ST and SEBC are admissible only to those categories of Odisha.
  • Community/caste status once mentioned in the online application shall be treated as final and cannot be changed later.
  • The advertisement does not bind the Government to make appointment; the number of vacancies is subject to change without notice depending on public service requirements.
  • Misrepresentation or suppression of information in the online application will result in cancellation of candidature and penalty as decided by the Commission.
  • Mere empanelment in the select list does not confer any right to appointment unless the Government is satisfied about suitability after necessary enquiry.
  • No request for withdrawal of candidature or change of category will be entertained.
  • Candidates must carefully fill service/post preference; change of preference after submission of online application will not be allowed.
  • Candidates must answer papers in their own handwriting; only PwD candidates with specified disabilities may use a scribe as per rules.

How to Apply

  • Candidates must go through the detailed advertisement available on the website of OPSC before filling the Online Application Form.
  • Candidates must apply online through the OPSC website (https://opsc.gov.in).
  • The link for registration and payment of examination fee will be available from 20/01/2026 to 20/02/2026 (5.00 P.M.).
  • The last date for submission of registered online application is 27/02/2026 (5.00 P.M.).
  • Applications received through any mode other than online shall not be accepted and will be summarily rejected.
  • After declaration of result of the Main Written Examination, candidates called for Interview/Personality Test will be required to submit print-out/hard copy of online application along with photocopies of documents as stated in the advertisement on the day of document verification.

  • Use of MOBILE PHONES and other electronic devices BANNED: Mobile phones or any other communication devices are not allowed inside the premises, where the examination is being conducted. Any infringement of these instructions shall entail disqualification including ban from future examinations.
  • Candidates are not permitted to use or be in possession of calculators in examination premises.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Revenue Inspector (RI): Bachelor’s Degree in any discipline or equivalent from a recognized University with knowledge in computer application. Age: over 20 years and below 42 years as on 1st January, 2025.
  • ICDS Supervisor: Bachelor’s Degree in Arts, Science or Commerce or its equivalent. Only women candidates; age not less than 21 years and not more than 42 years as on 1st January, 2025.
  • Village Agricultural Worker (VAW): Passed +2 Science or +2 Vocational course in Agriculture related subject in Crop Production (CP) / Horticulture (HORT) / Repair and Maintenance of Power Driven Farm Machinery (PDFM) from a recognized Board/Council/Institution; Diploma in Agriculture Polytechnic under OUAT is desirable and carries 5% extra marks in Written Test.
  • Junior Assistant (JA): Passed +3 in Arts / Science / Commerce or equivalent with knowledge of Computer Skill.
  • Assistant Revenue Inspector (ARI): Passed Higher Secondary Examination (10+2) conducted by CHSE, Odisha or equivalent, or Diploma in Engineering from Institution under State Council for Technical Education & Vocational Training, Odisha affiliated to AICTE, having knowledge in computer application.
  • Amin: Passed Higher Secondary Examination (10+2) conducted by CHSE, Odisha or equivalent, or Diploma in Engineering from Institution under State Council for Technical Education & Vocational Training, Odisha affiliated to AICTE, with knowledge in computer application (as per detailed table text).
  • Statistical Field Surveyor (SFS): Passed 10+2 examination conducted by CHSE, Odisha or CBSE or CISCE or any other examination equivalent thereto.
  • Odia language: Must be able to read, write and speak Odia and must have passed ME School Exam with Odia as language subject, or Matriculation with Odia as medium in non-language subjects, or passed Odia as a language subject in Class VII or above, or passed Odia language test in ME School Standard conducted by School & Mass Education Department.
  • Other criteria: Must be a citizen of India, of good character, and if married must not have more than one spouse living except as exempted under personal law.
  • Junior Assistant-specific: Must have registered name in an Employment Exchange of the concerned district (or State/Special Employment Exchange with Resident Certificate of concerned district) on or before the date of submission of online application.
  • Persons with Disabilities (PwDs): Must possess Permanent Disability Certificate / UDID card with not less than 40% disability in the category and sub-category suitable for the post, as per Annexures I to VII.
  • Ex-Servicemen: Must possess Identity Card/Discharge Certificate/documents in support of defence service and furnish an undertaking about non-availment of earlier re-employment under Government of Odisha.

Salary/Stipend

  • Revenue Inspector (RI): Pay Scale ₹ 35400–112400, Pay Matrix Level-9, Cell-01 under R & DM Department.
  • ICDS Supervisor: Pay Scale ₹ 35400–112400, Pay Matrix Level-9, Cell-01 under W & CD Department.
  • Village Agricultural Worker (VAW): Pay Scale ₹ 21700–69100, Pay Matrix Level-5, Cell-01 under A & FE Department.
  • Junior Assistant (JA): Pay Scale ₹ 19900–63200, Pay Matrix Level-4, Cell-01 under Finance, R & DM, A & FE, W & CD Departments.
  • Assistant Revenue Inspector (ARI): Pay Scale ₹ 19900–63200, Pay Matrix Level-4, Cell-01 under R & DM Department.
  • Amin: Pay Scale ₹ 18000–56900, Pay Matrix Level-3, Cell-01 under R & DM Department.
  • Statistical Field Surveyor (SFS): Pay Scale ₹ 18000–56900, Pay Matrix Level-3, Cell-01 under Planning & Convergence Department.

Age Limit

  • Revenue Inspector (RI): Over 20 years and below 42 years.
  • ICDS Supervisor: Not less than 21 years and not more than 42 years; Anganwadi Workers get additional 5 years relaxation for ICDS Supervisor only, besides general relaxation.
  • Village Agricultural Worker (VAW): Minimum 21 years and maximum 42 years.
  • Junior Assistant (JA): Minimum 21 years and maximum 42 years.
  • Assistant Revenue Inspector (ARI): Over 20 years and below 42 years.
  • Amin: As per post-wise age and educational qualification table, within 21–42 years.
  • Statistical Field Surveyor (SFS): Minimum 21 years and maximum 42 years.
  • SC/ST/SEBC: Upper age relaxed by 5 years.
  • Women (for RI, ARI, VAW, JA, Amin & SFS): Upper age relaxed by 5 years; for ICDS Supervisor (women-only post) this additional 5 years is not applicable, except for Anganwadi Workers as stated.
  • Persons with Disabilities (PwDs): Upper age relaxed by 10 years; PwDs of SC/ST/SEBC entitled to cumulative age relaxation over category relaxation as per Odisha Civil Service (Fixation of Upper Age Limit) Rules, 1989.
  • Ex-Servicemen: For RI & ICDS Supervisor, upper age relaxed by 5 years; for other posts, relaxation by total period of defence service rendered, subject to conditions mentioned.
  • RI, ARI & Amin: Age relaxation up to five years for candidates having actual work experience in settlement/consolidation organisations.

Application Fee

  • As per Odisha Payment of Recruitment Examination Fees and Refund Rules, 2025.
  • Candidates other than Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST) and Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) shall pay Examination Fee of ₹ 500/- using Net Banking / Credit Card / Debit Card / UPI through Payment Gateway during online application.
  • SC, ST and PwDs candidates are exempted from payment of Examination Fee.
  • Examination fee of ₹ 500/- shall be refunded to applicants who actually appear in the examination, after verification of attendance records, to the same bank account / payment method used at registration.
  • No refund is admissible to applicants who fail to appear in the examination for any reason.
  • If Confirmation Page is not generated after fee payment, transaction will be cancelled and refund credited within 48 hours; applicant must make another payment for successful application in such cases.

Important Dates

Event Start Date End Date
Online Registration (Fresh candidates – New User who have not registered earlier) 07.01.2026 31.01.2026
Re-registration (Registered User who already have User ID for any previous post) 07.01.2026 31.01.2026
Submission of Online Application (after Registration / Re-registration) 07.01.2026 15.02.2026
Last date of receipt of online applications - 22.02.2026

Selection Process

  • Stage-I: Written Test – 100 marks, MCQ type in OMR/CBRE mode, of minimum standard of High School Certificate Examination.
  • Written Test pattern: Mathematics (20 questions, 20 marks), General Studies (20, 20), English (20, 20), Odia (15, 15), Computer (15, 15), Logical Reasoning (10, 10); duration 1½ hours.
  • Negative marking: One-fourth (0.25) of marks assigned to a question deducted for each wrong answer; multiple answers treated as wrong; no penalty for unattempted questions.
  • Minimum qualifying marks (Written): 30% for ST, SC, PwDs, Ex-Servicemen and Sportspersons; 35% for others. VAW candidates with Diploma in Agriculture Polytechnic (OUAT) get 5% extra marks (capped at total marks).
  • Stage-II: Practical Skill Test in Basic Computer Skills – 50 marks, 1 hour; qualifying in nature with minimum 40% for all candidates.
  • Number of candidates shortlisted for Practical Skill Test: not less than 3 times the number of vacancies, category/special category wise, as per merit and availability; Commission may vary as per requirement.
  • Merit Lists: Provisional Master Merit List based on marks / normalized score in Written Test; Provisional Screening List for Practical Skill Test; Provisional Merit List of Practical Skill Test; Screening List for Document Verification; Provisional Select Lists post-wise / district-wise.
  • Document Verification & Counselling: Shortlisted candidates undergo document verification by District Level Board and then counselling for choice of post and Department/District/Range; allotment based on merit-cum-choice and availability.
  • Commission reserves right to conduct additional/re-test for Written/Skill Test, reschedule tests, and cancel part or whole of recruitment at any stage.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates must apply online only through OSSSC website; applications other than online / incomplete shall be summarily rejected.
  • All eligibility conditions (except age) must be fulfilled as on the last date of submission of online application.
  • No Admission Letter shall be issued to candidates whose application is incomplete or who do not fulfil prescribed eligibility criteria.
  • Provisional Admission Letters / Intimation Letters for Written Test and Practical Skill Test shall be uploaded on www.osssc.gov.in only; no hard copy will be sent by post.
  • Candidates must regularly visit the Commission’s website to track notices, exam dates, and download Admission / Intimation Letters using User ID and Password.
  • Information uploaded on website will not be supplied separately under RTI Act, 2005 and will remain available for a specific period only; candidates should download and preserve it.
  • Candidature remains purely provisional and is liable to rejection at any stage for deficiency / misrepresentation / use of unfair means.
  • Multiple application forms by a candidate are not permitted and will lead to cancellation of result and other penalties as per rules.
  • In CBRE mode, appearing in more than one shift/date by furnishing false information is treated as unfair means and penalised.
  • Commission’s decision on eligibility, acceptance/rejection of applications, penalties, mode of selection, exam conduct, test centre allotment, preparation of merit list, allocation of post, and debarment is final and binding.

How to Apply

  • Visit OSSSC website www.osssc.gov.in and click on “Apply Online”.
  • Registration (New User): Fresh candidates who have not registered earlier for any recruitment of OSSSC must complete Registration by providing required details and uploading full specimen signature and passport-size photograph in prescribed formats and sizes.
  • Re-registration (Registered User): Candidates already registered for any other OSSSC post must login using existing User ID and select “Re-registration” option for this post.
  • Mere Registration / Re-registration does not mean filing of online application; candidates must login again and fill and submit the detailed Online Application Form as per instructions on the screen.
  • Fill in all data and information as per certificates/records, upload required documents, and make Examination Fee payment (if applicable) through available online payment modes.
  • Ensure that the photograph and signature uploaded are clearly identifiable/visible; otherwise registration/application is liable to rejection.
  • Use own valid personal e-mail ID and mobile number with validity till completion of recruitment process for receiving Activation Key, alerts, and for downloading Admission Letters; do not share or change this contact during the process.
  • Submit online application well in advance without waiting for the last date to avoid last-hour rush.
  • Take printout of Confirmation Page after successful submission and fee payment (where applicable).

Eligibility Criteria for NABARD Development Assistant Recruitment 2026

  • Essential Qualifications:
    • For Development Assistant: Bachelor's Degree in any discipline with minimum 50% marks in aggregate (pass class for SC/ST/PWBD/Ex-Servicemen) from a recognized University/Institution
    • For Development Assistant (Hindi): Bachelor's Degree from recognized University in English/Hindi medium with Hindi and English as compulsory or elective subject with minimum 50% marks (pass class for SC/ST/PWBD/EXS) OR Bachelor's Degree with Hindi and English as main subjects with minimum 50% marks
    • Knowledge of word processing on PC (for both posts)
    • Candidate must be able to translate from English to Hindi and vice-versa (for DA Hindi)
  • Essential Qualifications for Ex-Servicemen:
    • Ex-servicemen (except dependents) should either be graduate from recognized University OR
    • Should have passed matriculation or equivalent exam of Armed Forces and rendered at least 15 years of defence service
  • Language Proficiency:
    • Candidates applying for post in a particular State should be proficient in official language of the State (read, write, speak and understand)
    • Official language would be the main language declared in State gazette of concerned state
  • Desirable:
    • Knowledge of computer applications and word processing
    • Proficiency in state's official language
Important Notes:
  • All educational qualifications should be from Universities/Institutions incorporated by Act of Central or State legislature or declared deemed University under Section-3 of UGC Act 1956
  • For CGPA/OGPA conversion: 6.75=60%, 6.25=55%, 5.75=50%, 5.25=45% (on 10-point scale)
  • Percentage calculation: Total marks obtained divided by aggregate maximum marks (49.99% treated as less than 50%)

Salary/Stipend

  • Pay Scale: Rs. 20,700(1)-1,200(3)-24,300-1,440(4)-30,060-1,920(6)-41,580-2,080(2)-45,740-2,370(3)-52,850-2,850(1)-55,700 (20 years)
  • Starting Basic Pay: Rs. 23,100/- per month (including two advance increments)
  • Initial Monthly Gross Emoluments: Approximately Rs. 46,500/-
  • Allowances:
    • Dearness Allowance (DA)
    • House Rent Allowance (HRA)
    • City Compensatory Allowance (CCA)
    • Transport Allowance
    • Other allowances as admissible from time to time
  • Perquisites:
    • NABARD residential accommodation (subject to availability)
    • Reimbursement of petrol for vehicle for official purpose
    • Brief Case allowance
    • Knowledge updation allowance
    • Allowance for furnishing of residence
    • Dispensary facility and medical reimbursement (OPD/Hospitalization)
    • Interest free Festival Advance
    • Leave Travel Concession (once in two years for self, spouse and eligible dependents)
    • Loans & Advances at concessional rates for Housing, Car, Education, Consumer Articles, Personal Computer
    • New Pension Scheme (NPS) with Defined Contribution
    • Gratuity and Group Term Insurance Plan
  • Career Prospects: Reasonable prospects for promotion to higher grades

  • Maximum Age: 35 years (Born not later than 01/01/2005)
  • Age Relaxation:
    • Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe: 5 years (upto 40 years)
    • Other Backward Classes (OBC): 3 years (upto 38 years)
    • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PWBD): 10 years for General (upto 45 years), 13 years for OBC (upto 48 years), 15 years for SC/ST (upto 50 years)
    • Ex-Servicemen: Service rendered in Armed Forces plus additional 3 years (subject to maximum 50 years)
    • Widows/Divorced Women/Women Judicially Separated (SC/ST): 5 years (upto 40 years)

Selection Process for NABARD Development Assistant Recruitment 2026

  • Stage-I: Preliminary Examination (Online) - Qualifying Nature
    • For Development Assistant:
      • Test of English Language: 40 Questions, 40 Marks, 20 Minutes
      • Test of Numerical Ability: 30 Questions, 30 Marks, 20 Minutes
      • Test of Reasoning: 30 Questions, 30 Marks, 20 Minutes
      • Total: 100 Questions, 100 Marks, 60 Minutes
    • For Development Assistant (Hindi):
      • Test of English Language: 40 Questions, 40 Marks, 20 Minutes
      • Test of Professional Knowledge (Hindi/English): 30 Questions, 30 Marks, 20 Minutes
      • Test of Reasoning: 30 Questions, 30 Marks, 20 Minutes
      • Total: 100 Questions, 100 Marks, 60 Minutes
    • Shortlisting ratio: Maximum 1:25 based on performance
  • Stage-II: Main Examination (Online)
    • For Development Assistant:
      • Test of Reasoning: 30 Questions, 30 Marks, 30 Minutes
      • Quantitative Aptitude: 30 Questions, 30 Marks, 30 Minutes
      • General Awareness (Agriculture, Rural Development, Banking): 50 Questions, 50 Marks, 25 Minutes
      • Computer Knowledge: 40 Questions, 40 Marks, 20 Minutes
      • Test of English Language (Descriptive - Essay, Precis, Report/Letter): 3 Questions, 50 Marks, 30 Minutes
      • Total: 200 Marks, 135 Minutes
    • For Development Assistant (Hindi):
      • Test of Reasoning: 20 Questions, 20 Marks, 25 Minutes
      • Test of Professional Knowledge (Hindi/English): 50 Questions, 50 Marks, 35 Minutes
      • General Awareness (Agriculture, Rural Development, Banking): 40 Questions, 40 Marks, 25 Minutes
      • Computer Knowledge: 40 Questions, 40 Marks, 20 Minutes
      • Test of English Language (Descriptive): 3 Questions, 50 Marks, 30 Minutes
      • Total: 200 Marks, 135 Minutes
  • Stage-III: Language Proficiency Test (LPT) - Qualifying Nature
    • Conducted after Main Examination at Regional Office
    • Test conducted in official language of concerned State
    • Candidates who passed 10th/12th with declared language as subject are exempted (need to submit proof)
    • Candidates not qualifying LPT will not be offered appointment
  • Negative Marking:
    • 1/4th mark deducted for each wrong answer in objective tests (both phases)
  • Final Merit List:
    • State-wise merit list based on Main Examination marks only (Preliminary marks not added)
    • Both Objective Test and Descriptive Test marks of Main Exam added for final merit
  • Tie Resolution:
    • Higher educational qualification
    • If tie in qualification, higher marks in graduation
    • If tie in graduation marks, higher age preference
  • Wait List:
    • Upto 50% of vacancies (State-category wise), minimum 3 candidates
    • Valid for one year from approval date or next recruitment declaration, whichever earlier
  • Medium: Bilingual (English and Hindi) except English/Hindi language test
  • Biometric Verification: Mandatory at all stages from Main Examination onwards
  • Medical Fitness: Appointment subject to being declared medically fit as per Bank rules

General Information/Instructions

  • NABARD is wholly owned by Government of India and is equal opportunity employer
  • Candidates can apply only ONLINE through www.nabard.org
  • Candidates can apply for vacancies in one State only
  • Candidates can apply for only one post - either Development Assistant or Development Assistant (Hindi)
  • Admission to examination purely provisional without verification of documents
  • NABARD reserves right to increase/reduce vacancies or cancel recruitment process
  • Valid personal email ID and mobile number mandatory (kept active till completion of recruitment)
  • DigiLocker integration available for voluntary document upload
  • Only one application per post - multiple applications will result in retention of last valid application only
  • Biometric data (thumb impression) and photograph capture from Main Examination onwards
  • Pre-recruitment training for SC/ST/OBC/PWBD candidates (free, online mode) - request in application
  • Candidates reporting late after reporting time will not be permitted
  • Photo Identity Proof mandatory (PAN/Passport/Driving License/Voter Card/Aadhar/Employee ID etc.)
  • Ration Card and Learner's Driving License NOT valid ID proof
  • Female candidates who changed name after marriage must produce Gazette notification/marriage certificate/affidavit
  • Government/PSU employees need NOC at interview, proper discharge certificate before appointment
  • Calculators, mobile phones, bluetooth devices strictly prohibited in examination hall
  • Candidates appear at own cost and risk
  • Legal proceedings only in Mumbai courts
  • NABARD may shift/cancel/add examination centers depending on response
  • Choice of center once exercised is final - no change requests entertained
  • Canvassing in any form will be disqualification
  • Mark sheets not furnished - marks available on website after recruitment
  • Question papers not disclosed to anybody
  • OBC certificate valid for financial year 2025-26, issued on or after 01/04/2025
  • EWS certificate valid for financial year 2025-26, issued on or after 01/04/2025
  • SC/ST candidates from Maharashtra require validity certificate from Scrutiny Committee
  • PWBD candidates with 40% or above disability eligible for reservation
  • All notices/communications on website or by registered post/email deemed sufficient

How to Apply for NABARD Development Assistant Recruitment 2026?

  • Step 1: Visit official website www.nabard.org
  • Step 2: Click on "Recruitment to the post of Development Assistant / Development Assistant (Hindi)-2026" in advertisement page
  • Step 3: Click "Click here for New Registration"
  • Step 4: Enter basic details (Name, Contact, Email ID)
  • Step 5: Note down Provisional Registration Number and Password (sent via Email/SMS)
  • Step 6: Before filling application, scan and prepare:
    • Recent passport size photograph (4.5 cm x 3.5 cm) - 200x230 pixels, 20-50 KB, JPG format
    • Signature with black ink (not capital letters) - 140x60 pixels, 10-20 KB
    • Left thumb impression on white paper with black/blue ink - 240x240 pixels, 20-50 KB
    • Handwritten declaration in English on white paper with black ink - 800x400 pixels, 50-100 KB
    • Text: "I...(Name), hereby declare that all information submitted by me in application form is correct, true and valid.

  • Represented the Country in any of the Category–C Championships/events OR
  • At least 3rd position in Federation Cup Championships (Senior Category) OR
  • Represented a state or equivalent Unit, except in Marathon and Cross Country with at least 8th position in Senior National Championships only

Categorization of International Championships

  • Category-A: Olympic Games (Senior)
  • Category-B: World Cup (Junior/Youth/Senior); World Championships (Junior/Senior); Asian Games (Senior); Commonwealth Games (Senior); Youth Olympics; Davis Cup (Tennis); Champions Trophy (Hockey); Thomas/Uber Cup (Badminton)

Special Note for Athletics

  • Medal winning performance in National Inter State Senior Athletics Championship may also be considered for recruitment against the post having Grade Pay -1900/-
  • Gold Medal winner in Open National Championship (Senior), Inter-State Athletics Championship (Senior) and Asian Championship (Senior) may be considered in GP 2400/-/2800/-

Closing Date (For residents of Andaman, Nicobar & Lakshadweep) 24/02/2026 at 18:00 Hrs

Selection Process

  • Selection will be based upon performance in sports Trials and Sports Achievements
  • Certificate (Sports & Educational) Verification will be done by a duly constituted Recruitment Committee of this railway
  • The venue & date for Trials and Certificate Verification will be intimated to the eligible candidates

Distribution of Marks

  • Candidates who are found FIT in the Trial will be considered for the next stage of recruitment
  • Candidates securing 25 Marks or more against Game skill, physical fitness and coach's observation during Trial are treated as FIT candidates
  • The Recruitment process is based purely on the merit of the candidates as per vacancies, in a particular discipline, notified
  • In case more than one sports persons score the same mark, preference would be given to the younger candidate to decide the merit

General Information/Instructions

  • Applications are invited from eligible Sportspersons who are Indian nationals for recruitment against Sports Quota (Open Advt.) for the year 2025-26 in East Coast Railway
  • There is no reservation for SC/ST/OBC/EWS communities. The candidates having the required performance in the particular sports discipline will be selected on the basis of overall merit secured irrespective of their communities
  • The notification with the application form are available in East Coast Railway website www.rrcbbs.org.in
  • Application Form should be made on a good quality white A-4 (210x297 mm) size paper using ONE SIDE ONLY
  • The candidate has to fill up required information in his/her own handwriting using blue/black ball point pen
  • The application should be filled either in English or Hindi but not in any other language
  • One recent passport size photograph (4cm x 5cm) should be affixed on the application form without fail
  • One loose extra photograph with name, date of birth, and signature of the candidate written on the backside should be attached along with the application form
  • Candidates are required to sign in English or in Hindi in the prescribed places provided in the application form
  • Candidates should give two left thumb impressions (LTI) in the application form. If the LTIs are not clear and are smudged, the application will liable to be rejected
  • Only Date of Birth as recorded in the Matriculation/High School Examination Certificate is to be considered
  • Candidate should write his/her name, father's name/husband's name in capital letters as given in educational Certificate
  • Selected candidates are likely to be posted anywhere on East Coast Railway after successful completion of all pre-appointment formalities, including training wherever prescribed
  • Eligible applicants will be issued with call letters through their registered e-mail id only, for the sports trials
  • East Coast Railway will upload the list of eligible and ineligible candidates in the website www.rrcbbs.org.in for general information and viewing
  • Individual requests for change in dates/venue for trials etc. shall not be entertained under any circumstances
  • Selected candidates have to pass the requisite medical fitness standards prior to appointment
  • In the event of appointment as Clerk-cum-typist posts in Group-C railway service, candidates will be required to acquire typing proficiency of 30 w.p.m. in English or 25 w.p.m. in Hindi within a period of four years from the date of appointment
  • Selected candidates will have to submit Service Bond of 5 years at the time of appointment
  • Sportspersons recruited against sports quota shall be terminated from service summarily, if the information and documents furnished by him/her for recruitment are found incorrect/fake at any stage
  • Decision of East Coast Railway in all matters relating to this recruitment shall be final
  • No TA/DA/Accommodation will be given for appearing in the selection trial/interview. Candidates will have to bring their own kit
  • Candidates may be required to stay during the selection for 2-3 days for which they have to make their own arrangements
  • All documents may be self attested
  • Candidates applying for more than one game/event shall submit separate applications with separate fee
  • Those candidates who are debarred from appearing in any of the RRB/RRC exams need not apply unless their debarment period is over by the closing date
  • Canvassing in any form will attract disqualification
  • Railway Administration shall not be responsible for any postal delay. Late applications would be summarily rejected
  • The Railway Administration has all rights reserved to fix any date, as deemed suitable, change of place or postponement of Trials at its own convenience, which can also be cancelled due to unforeseen exigencies
  • For any legal dispute, the jurisdiction will be the Central Administrative Tribunal, Cuttack
  • Recruitment is purely merit based. East Coast Railway have not appointed any agent or coaching centre for acting on its behalf for this recruitment

How to Apply

  • Candidates should download the application form from East Coast Railway website www.rrcbbs.org.in or www.eastcoastrail.indianrailways.gov.in

  • Clearly indicate the specific sports discipline, event, and position applying for
  • Send applications by Ordinary/Speed Post to: The Dy. Chief Personnel Officer(Rectt.), 2nd Floor, South Block, Rail Sadan, PO-Mancheswar, Chandrasekharpur, Bhubaneswar, Odisha – 751017
  • Alternatively, drop applications directly in Drop Box placed at: Office premises of Principal Chief Personnel Officer, 2nd Floor, South Block, Rail Sadan, PO-Mancheswar, Chandrasekharpur, Bhubaneswar, Odisha – 751017

Eligibility Criteria

  • Forester: Must have passed +2 Science from recognized University, Institution or Board with knowledge in basic Computer skills. Must have attained age of 18 years and not above 32 years as on 1st January, 2025.
  • Forest Guard: Must have passed High School Certificate Examination (10+) from recognized Board or Institution. Age: within 18–32 years as on 1st January, 2025 as per table.
  • Excise Constable: Must have passed +2 Examination or equivalent conducted by Council of Higher Secondary Education, Odisha or any other recognized Board or Council. Must have attained age of 21 years and not above 32 years as on 1st January, 2025.
  • Odia language: Must be able to read, write & speak Odia and must have passed Middle English School Examination with Odia as language subject, or Matriculation with Odia as medium in non-language subjects, or Odia as language subject in Class VII or above, or passed Odia test in ME School Standard conducted by School & Mass Education Department.
  • Other eligibility: Must be a citizen of India, of good character, and if married must not have more than one spouse living except where exempted under applicable personal law.
  • Sportsperson: Applicants claiming reservation as Sportsperson must possess valid Sportsperson Identity Card issued by Sports & Youth Services Department, Government of Odisha as on date of submission of application and upload scanned original card.
  • Persons with Disabilities (PwDs): Must possess Permanent Disability Certificate / UDID card with not less than 40% disability in relevant category and sub-category, along with suitable physical requirements and functional classification as required for the post; must enter details in online application. Benchmark PwDs get compensatory time @ 20 minutes per hour in Written Test and may avail scribe with prior permission.
  • Ex-Servicemen: Must possess Identity Card / Discharge Certificate / documents supporting defence service and furnish undertaking that no re-employment under Government of Odisha has been availed earlier.
  • Excise Constable – Medical/Physical conditions: Must not have knock knee, bow legs, flat foot, varicose veins, squint in eyes, poor vision, colour blindness, inability to flex fingers properly, or other obvious deformities; no impediment in speech and hearing. Candidates with disability or deformity are not eligible for Excise Constable.
  • Forester/Forest Guard – PwD exclusion: No Persons with Disabilities shall be eligible for these posts except Leprosy Cured Persons and Acid Attack Victims as per prescribed reservation.

Salary/Stipend

  • Forester: Pay Scale ₹ 25500–81100, Pay Matrix Level-7, Cell-1 under Forest, Environment & Climate Change Department.
  • Forest Guard: Pay Scale ₹ 19900–63200, Pay Matrix Level-4, Cell-01 under Forest, Environment & Climate Change Department.
  • Excise Constable: Pay Scale ₹ 19900–63200, Pay Matrix Level-4, Cell-01 under Excise Department.

Age Limit (as on 01-01-2025)

  • Forester: Minimum 18 years and maximum 32 years.
  • Forest Guard: Age within 18–32 years as specified for the post; age reckoned as on 1st January, 2025.
  • Excise Constable: Must have attained age of 21 years and must not be above 32 years as on 1st January, 2025.
  • SC/ST/SEBC/Women: Upper age relaxable by 5 years.
  • Persons with Disabilities (PwDs): Upper age relaxable by 10 years.
  • Ex-Servicemen: Upper age relaxable by total period of defence service rendered, subject to not having more than six months of service remaining on last date of online application and conditions related to prior re-employment.
  • A candidate coming under more than one category is eligible for only one relaxation, which is most beneficial, except PwDs under SC/ST/SEBC who are entitled to cumulative 10 years relaxation over normal category relaxation as per Odisha Civil Service (Fixation of Upper Age Limit) Rules, 1989.

Application Fee

  • As per Odisha Payment of Recruitment Examination Fees and Refund Rules, 2025.
  • Candidates other than Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST) and Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) shall pay Examination Fee of ₹ 500/- using Net Banking / Credit Card / Debit Card / UPI through Payment Gateway during online application.
  • SC, ST and PwDs candidates are exempted from payment of Examination Fee.
  • Examination Fee of ₹ 500/- paid shall be refunded to applicants who actually appear for the examination after conduct of examination and verification of attendance records.
  • Refund shall be credited to the bank account or payment method used at the time of registration; applicants are advised to use their own account to avoid inconvenience.
  • No refund shall be admissible to applicants who fail to appear in the examination for any reason whatsoever.
  • If Confirmation Page is not generated after payment, the transaction will be cancelled and amount refunded within 48 hours; applicants then need to make another payment/transaction to complete the application.

Important Dates

Event Start Date End Date
Online Registration (Fresh candidates – New User) 07.01.2026 31.01.2026
Re-registration (Registered User) 07.01.2026 31.01.2026
Submission of Online Application (after Registration / Re-registration) 07.01.2026 15.02.2026
Last date of receipt of online applications - 22.02.2026

Selection Process

  • Stage-I: Written Test – 100 marks, MCQ type in OMR/CBRE mode, of minimum standard of High School Certificate Examination.
  • Written Test pattern: Mathematics (20 questions, 20 marks), General Studies (25 questions, 25 marks), English (20 questions, 20 marks), Odia (15 questions, 15 marks), Computer (20 questions, 20 marks); duration 1½ hours.
  • Negative marking: One-fourth (0.25) of marks for each question deducted for every wrong answer; more than one option marked is treated as wrong; no penalty for unattempted questions.
  • Minimum qualifying marks (Written): 30% for ST, SC, PwD, Ex-Servicemen and Sportsperson categories; 35% for all other candidates.
  • Questions and answer options of all segments will be bilingual (except English and Odia language subjects); in case of any confusion in Odia version, English version shall prevail.
  • In CBRE mode, examination may be held on multiple dates/shifts using multiple question sets; normalization formula will be adopted to convert raw scores into normalized scores.
  • Candidates may select maximum three preferred districts for test centre; Commission may allot another district depending on infrastructure / capacity.
  • For Excise Constable, bonus marks are awarded to candidates possessing NCC certificates: NCC ‘B’ Certificate – 01 mark; NCC ‘C’ Certificate – 02 marks.
  • Stage-II: Physical Test – Physical Standard Measurement (PSM) and Physical Efficiency Test (PET) for all three posts; number of candidates shortlisted for Physical Test shall not be less than 3 times the number of vacancies, category-wise, subject to Commission’s discretion.
  • Physical Standard Measurement – Forester/Forest Guard: Minimum Height and Chest as prescribed by category and gender (e.g., Men UR/SEBC/SC: 168 cm height, chest 81 cm unexpanded with up to 5 cm expansion; Men ST: 158 cm height; Women UR/SEBC/SC/ST: 153 cm height). Color blindness is disqualification.
  • Physical Standard Measurement – Excise Constable: Category-wise minimum Height, Weight and Chest (e.g., Men UR/SEBC: 168 cm height, 55 kg weight, chest 79–84 cm; Men SC/ST: 163 cm, 50 kg, 76–81 cm; Women UR/SEBC: 158 cm, 47.5 kg; Women SC/ST: 153 cm, 45 kg). Minimum 5 cm difference between unexpanded and expanded chest.
  • Physical Efficiency Test – Forester/Forest Guard: Male (all categories): Walking Test 25 km in 4 hours; Female (all categories): Walking Test 16 km in 4 hours.
  • Physical Efficiency Test – Excise Constable: Male: Running 1.6 km in 7 minutes and Long Jump 3.66 m in 3 attempts; Female: Running 1.6 km in 9 minutes and Long Jump 2.75 m in 3 attempts.
  • Failure to qualify in any PSM/PET event leads to disqualification from recruitment for the concerned post.
  • Merit Lists & Further Stages: Provisional Master Merit List of Written Test; Provisional Screening List for Physical Test; Provisional Merit List of Physical Test; Screening List for Document Verification; Document Verification by District Level Board; Counselling for post and district/circle/division choice; Post-wise, District/Circle/Division-wise Provisional Select Lists based on merit-cum-choice and availability.
  • OSSSC reserves the right to conduct additional/re-test for Written/Physical Test, reschedule tests, cancel part or whole of recruitment, and decide all matters of eligibility, selection and debarment.

General Information/Instructions

  • Applications are invited online through OSSSC website www.osssc.gov.in; applications other than online mode or incomplete applications shall be summarily rejected.
  • All eligibility conditions except age must be fulfilled as on the last date of submission of online application.
  • Provisional Admission / Intimation Letters for Written Test and Physical Test will be uploaded on the Commission’s website well before examination dates; dates of tests will also be advertised in local newspapers.
  • Candidates must download Admission / Intimation Letters from www.osssc.gov.in using their User ID & Password; no printed letters will be sent by post or any other mode.
  • Candidates should visit the Commission’s website at regular intervals for notices, exam schedules, results and other updates.
  • Information uploaded on the website will not be supplied under the RTI Act, 2005 and will remain there only for a specific period; candidates should download and keep necessary documents.
  • Candidature is purely provisional and liable to rejection at any stage for inadequacy, deficiency, misrepresentation, suppression, wrong information or use of unfair means.
  • Multiple application forms by a candidate are not allowed; such cases will lead to cancellation of result and will be treated as unfair means.
  • Candidates who fail to appear/qualify at any stage of the recruitment process shall not be considered for final selection.
  • The Commission shall sponsor exactly the same number of candidates as total vacancies advertised, category-wise, for each post as per merit and availability.
  • The decision of the Commission on eligibility, acceptance/rejection of applications, penalty, mode of selection, exam conduct, test centre allocation, preparation of merit lists, post allocation and debarment shall be final and binding; no correspondence will be entertained.

How to Apply

  • Visit OSSSC website www.osssc.gov.in and refer to “How do I register/re-register/apply” on the Home page for step-by-step procedure.
  • Registration (New User): Fresh candidates who have not registered earlier for any OSSSC recruitment must register by clicking “Apply Online” on the Home page and filling the Registration Form.
  • Re-registration (Registered User): Candidates already registered for any other OSSSC post with a User ID must login and select the “Re-registration” option under the Applicant Menu for this recruitment.
  • Mere Registration / Re-registration does not constitute submission of Online Application; candidates must login again, furnish all required data and submit the Online Application Form as guided by the system.
  • Incomplete applications shall be summarily rejected; no Admission Letter will be issued to candidates with incomplete applications or who do not fulfil eligibility criteria.
  • Pre-requisites: Payment of ₹ 500/- Examination Fee (for non-SC/ST/PwDs); scanned full specimen signature in jpg/jpeg/png (20–50 KB); scanned recent passport size colour photograph in jpg/jpeg/png (20–100 KB); certificates and mark sheets for entering educational details.
  • Photograph and signature must be clearly identifiable/visible; otherwise Registration / Application is liable to rejection.
  • Applicants must use their own valid personal e-mail ID and mobile number with validity till completion of recruitment for receiving Activation Key, alerts and Admission Letters; they should not share/change these details.
  • Submit Online Application well before the last date to avoid last-hour rush in the online application system.

  • All computations of age shall be done with respect to 02/02/2026

Application Fee

  • UR/OBC/EWS Candidates: Rs. 1,000 (Application Fee & Processing Fee)
  • SC/ST/PwBD Candidates: Rs. 500 (Processing Fee only)
  • Internal Candidates: No fee applicable
  • Payment Mode: Internet Banking Account, UPI or Debit Card through SBI Collect
  • Important Note: Application or Processing fee is non-refundable under any circumstances
  • Candidates are required to verify their eligibility before paying the application or processing fee
  • Once payment is made, the State Bank Collect Reference Number and the date of payment is required to be entered in the NALCO online application form
  • No request for editing of payment details and issue of call letter will be entertained in wrong submission cases and candidature will stand rejected

Important Dates

Event Date & Time
Notification Date 07/01/2026
Opening of Online Application 13/01/2026 (10:00 AM)
Last Date for Online Payment 02/02/2026 (04:00 PM)
Last Date for Online Application 02/02/2026 (05:00 PM)
Computation Date for Age/Experience/Qualification 02/02/2026

Selection Process

  • The assessment for E03 grade vacancies will be made through Written Test or Computer-Based Test (CBT) and Personal Interview (PI)
  • Weightage: Written Test/CBT - 85%, Personal Interview - 15%
  • Initial shortlisting of the candidate will be done based on the criteria or experience mentioned along with information or declaration provided by the candidate at the time of submission of online application
  • The Written Test or CBT shall be conducted at one or more locations or centers as decided by the Management
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks in Written Test/CBT and Personal Interview:
    • Un-reserved posts: 50% in each component
    • SC/ST/OBC (Non creamy layer) and UR(PwBD): 40%
    • OBC(PwBD)/SC(PwBD)/ST(PwBD): 30%
  • Candidates shall be called in the ratio of 1:10 for Personal Interview based on the marks scored in Written Test or CBT
  • Candidates are required to produce their original certificates for verification before the final stage of selection process
  • In case any false declaration, incorrect information, suppression of facts or unable to provide required document against the declaration, the candidate will be disqualified
  • Mere meeting the advertised specification does not entitle a candidate to be considered for selection process
  • The management reserves the right to raise the minimum eligibility standards or criteria by taking into account the standard of qualification and or experience to restrict the number of candidates for assessment

General Information/Instructions

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply
  • Candidates need to apply online in the career section of NALCO website only
  • Applications received through any other mode will not be accepted and will summarily be rejected
  • While applying online, candidate needs to upload the signature and self-attested scanned copy of recent passport size colour photograph, qualification proofs, proof related to experience, recent salary slip and document related to the existing employers or copy of annual IT return
  • Submission of incorrect, invalid, non-legible documents or incomplete application shall be rejected summarily
  • Applicants are advised to keep a copy of online submitted application (hard copies) along with submitted documents for future reference
  • There is no need to send hard copy of the application or documents by post
  • A candidate shall be considered for one post only. Candidates applying for more than one post will attract cancellation of the candidature
  • No request with respect to change in any data entered by the candidate will be entertained once the online application is submitted successfully
  • Any request for change in date or venue of the selection process will not be entertained
  • No enquiry shall be entertained seeking advice on eligibility criteria
  • The e-mail id mentioned in the application form must remain valid for one year. All future communication with the candidates will take place through e-mail only
  • Candidates working in PSUs or Government should generally apply through proper channel or produce No Objection Certificate at the time of interview
  • Canvassing by a candidate in any form shall disqualify his or her candidature
  • Any dispute with regard to the said recruitment will be settled within the jurisdiction of Cuttack, Odisha only
  • The Management reserves the right to fill up or not to fill up any of the above positions without assigning any reason whatsoever
  • NALCO also reserves the right to cancel, restrict, modify, alter the recruitment process and also reserves the right to increase or decrease the post advertised

Reservation & Relaxation

  • Reservations or relaxations for SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS/PwBD (degree of disability 40% or above) candidates as per Government guidelines are applicable
  • In case any increase in the number of total posts, the number of reserved category posts will vary in accordance to the Government guidelines
  • For claiming the benefit of reservation or concessions applicable for PwBDs, the candidates will have to submit a disability certificate as per formats prescribed by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment vide notification no.G.S.R. 591 (E) dated 15.06.2017
  • Category SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/EWS/PwBD once filled in the online application form will not be changed
  • The reserved category candidates are required to submit requisite certificate in the prescribed format of Government of India, issued by the Competent Authority, at the time of personal interview
  • If the SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/EWS/PwBD certificate has been issued in a language other than English or Hindi, the candidates will be required to submit a self-attested translated copy of the same either in English or Hindi
  • The OBC candidates who belong to "Creamy Layer" are not entitled for concession admissible to OBC category and such candidates have to indicate their category as UR
  • The OBC(NCL) candidates are required to submit requisite certificate in prescribed format of Government of India, from a Competent Authority issued in the financial year 2025-26
  • The name of the caste and community indicated in the OBC (NCL) certificate must appear in the Central list of Other Backward Classes
  • OBC candidates will have to give a self-undertaking indicating that they belong to OBC (NCL) category also at the time of personal interview
  • The EWS candidates are required to submit requisite Income and Assets Certificate issued by the Competent Authority in prescribed format, which should be valid for FY 2025-26

Medical Fitness

  • The final appointment of the candidate in the Company will be subject to their passing the Company's Medical Examination as per standards laid down under NALCO Medical examination Rules amended from time to time
  • Candidates must be found medically fit by the Company's Medical Officer or Board
  • The decision of Medical Board constituted by the Company will be final and binding

Placement

  • During the probation period and or after absorption, selected candidates will be posted in the NALCO's Units or Offices anywhere in India or abroad or any of the subsidiaries, joint ventures, business associates of NALCO
  • Selected candidates are transferable as per the requirement of the Organisation
  • The selected candidates may be assigned jobs, functions, assignments related to their area as per the requirements of the Company including shift operation

Travel Allowance

  • Candidates attending the Personal Interview will be reimbursed the travel expenses limited to IInd class AC to and fro train or bus fare from their communication address mentioned in the online application, by the shortest route on production of tickets or proof of journey for E03 grade post
  • No change in communication address will be entertained at a later stage for the purpose of reimbursement of TA
  • In case of Written Test or CBT, only SC/ST/PwBD candidates will be eligible for reimbursement

How to Apply

  • Candidates need to apply online in the career section of NALCO website (www.nalcoindia.com)
  • Candidates are advised to read the instructions carefully and fill-in the online application form giving accurate information
  • While applying online, candidate needs to upload:
    • Signature (scanned copy)
    • Self-attested scanned copy of recent passport size colour photograph
    • Qualification proofs
    • Proof related to experience
    • Recent salary slip
    • Document related to the existing employers or copy of annual IT return
  • The candidates must ensure that all relevant documents are duly uploaded as per requirements
  • First make payment through SBI Collect portal by clicking on Pay Application fee through SBI Collect on NALCO website
  • Select "Odisha" under the State of the Corporate/Institution and "PSU- Public Sector Undertaking" under type of Corporate/Institution
  • Select "NATIONAL ALUMINIUM COMPANY LTD" under PSU- Public Sector Undertaking
  • Select Payment Category and choose "Recruitment- 10260105 (For UR/OBC/EWS)" or "Recruitment-10260105 (For SC/ST/PwBD)" as applicable
  • Fill the Name, Discipline, Category, Date of Birth, Registered Email Id and Mobile No. as required on the Payment portal and submit
  • Ensure that the same Email Id and Mobile No. details are used during the whole registration process
  • Payment may be made using Net Banking, Debit Card or UPI
  • On successful payment, one e-receipt will be generated in PDF format with SB Collect Reference Number
  • Note down the Reference Number as the same would be required during next Step of online application process
  • Enter the State Bank Collect Reference Number and the date of payment in the NALCO online application form on Career page of the website
  • Applicants are advised to keep a copy of online submitted application (hard copies) along with submitted documents for future reference
  • There is no need to send hard copy of the application or documents by post
