Selection Process

  • Eligible candidates will be short-listed based on initial screening, relevance of experience and other credentials possessed, and only shortlisted candidates will be called for personal interview.
  • Candidates are required to meet the stipulated criteria with respect to qualification and Post Professional Qualification Experience (PPQE) as an Executive or in the capacity of an Executive, and must produce requisite documents during document verification prior to interview.
  • Candidates will be shortlisted and called for interview in the ratio of 1:10 (maximum) as per company rules; if candidates fulfilling minimum eligibility criteria exceed the 1:10 ratio, those with more relevant experience will be considered first.
  • In case of tie in relevant experience, candidates who secured more marks in the qualifying examination will be considered first; if marks are also the same, the elder candidate in age will be considered first.
  • The selection process, including qualifying marks, will be governed by the extant Recruitment Rules (Recruitment Manual) of the company as amended from time to time.
  • Date, time and venue of the interview will be intimated only to shortlisted candidates via email and the list of shortlisted candidates will also be hosted on HAL website.
  • The suitability of shortlisted candidates will be assessed by a Selection Committee through interview on parameters such as knowledge of the job, general knowledge particularly in spheres allied/connected with the post, personality, educational qualifications and PPQE.
  • Merely meeting the qualification and/or PPQE requirements does not entitle candidates to be shortlisted for interview.

General Information/Instructions

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • Mere submission of application will not entail right for claiming appointment; candidates should satisfy themselves regarding eligibility criteria before applying.
  • HAL reserves the right to restrict/enlarge/modify/alter the requirements advertised and also reserves the right to raise eligibility criteria to restrict the number of candidates to be called for interview.
  • The number of vacancies indicated is provisional and may increase, decrease or even become NIL depending upon actual requirements; HAL reserves the right to cancel notified vacancies at its discretion and such decision will be final and binding.
  • Candidates possessing qualifications acquired through Correspondence/Distance Education/Part Time/E-learning will not be considered and are not eligible to apply.
  • Candidates must submit original documents supporting percentage conversion from CGPA/OGPA/letter grade to percentage at the time of interview, if applicable.
  • Candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen categories must submit valid certificates in prescribed format issued by Competent Authority at the time of interview/document verification.
  • For OBC (NCL) reservation benefits, candidates must belong to Non-Creamy Layer, caste/community name must appear in Central List of OBC, and OBC (NCL) certificate must be in prescribed format and not older than six months as on 31-01-2026.
  • Candidates employed in Central/State Government Departments, PSUs, Autonomous Organizations, Quasi Government Organizations, Armed Forces or Para-Military Forces must produce No Objection Certificate (NOC) or applicable document at the time of document verification; failure to do so will result in disqualification from interview and ineligibility for TA reimbursement.
  • Candidates found eligible to appear for interview will be reimbursed/paid train/bus fare from contact/mailing address to venue of interview by shortest route on production of proof of journey as per company rules.
  • Post Professional Qualification Experience (PPQE) in PSUs/Central/State Government/Private Organizations must be supported by experience certificates on official letterhead and will be subject to scrutiny regarding nature of experience, responsibilities and assignments.
  • Candidates who have left a PSU after availing VRS benefits, if selected, will be required to return the VRS compensation to the concerned PSU.
  • Present vacancies are identified to be filled by external candidates only through Direct Recruitment; applications of internal candidates will not be considered.
  • Name of candidate, Date of Birth and Father’s/Mother’s Name must match Matriculation/10th Standard certificate/mark sheet; where date of birth is not available, school leaving certificate indicating date of birth will be considered as per applicable state rules.
  • Applications not in conformity with advertisement requirements, incomplete applications, discrepancies in information, applications without required enclosures or those received after last date will not be considered and application fee will not be refunded.
  • Appointment of selected candidates is subject to satisfactory medical reports from HAL Industrial Health Centre, verification of caste and verification of character & antecedents from concerned authorities.
  • Selected candidates will be on probation for a period of one year from date of joining and may be posted at HAL Koraput Division or anywhere in India based on company requirements; candidates will not be allowed to apply for transfer for initial three years of service.
  • If any information furnished in application is found to be false, incomplete or not in conformity with eligibility criteria, candidature/appointment will be revoked/terminated at any stage without reference.
  • All correspondence will be through email only to the valid email ID provided by candidate in the application form; email ID must remain valid for at least one year from date of interview.
  • Any further information/corrigendum/addendum will be uploaded only on HAL website (www.hal-india.co.in); candidates are required to visit HAL website regularly for updates.
  • HAL reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process entirely at any stage.
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature.
  • Any dispute/cause with regard to recruitment will be settled within the jurisdiction of Koraput / Jeypore Court only.
  • Self-attested photocopies of specified documents (SSC/SSLC/10th certificate, mark sheets, degree certificates, experience documents, salary slips, NOC, category certificates, discharge certificate, J&K domicile certificate, disability certificate, registration certificate with State Medical Council, recent photograph, proof of application fees) must be attached with application as per list provided in the notification.

How to Apply

  • Candidate is required to download the “Application Form” from Careers link at HAL website www.hal-india.co.in.
  • The candidate shall fill in all relevant details in the application form, affix latest passport size photograph, sign the application form at the designated place and forward the same by Post / Courier.
  • The completed application must reach the Chief Manager (HR), R & P Section, HAL, Koraput Division, Sunabeda, Odisha, Pin-763002 on or before 31-01-2026.
  • Self-attested copies of all relevant testimonials/documents must be enclosed along with the application form to substantiate the details filled therein.
  • Candidates must ensure their eligibility for the posts notified prior to forwarding the application form.
  • All queries in connection with this notification may be forwarded to the Email ID: [email protected].
  • It is noted that the information posted in HAL website only is considered authentic; candidates should verify newspaper advertisements through HAL website.

Eligibility Criteria

Qualification Requirements

  • Technician Apprentice (Mechanical): Three years full time Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or Automobile Engineering. Lateral entry candidates after Class-XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year of Diploma course are also eligible.
  • Technician Apprentice (Electrical): Three years full time Diploma in Electrical Engineering or Electrical & Electronics Engineering. Lateral entry candidates after Class-XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year of Diploma course are also eligible.
  • Technician Apprentice (Telecommunication & Instrumentation): Three years full time Diploma in Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering, Electronics & Radio Communication Engineering, Instrumentation & Control Engineering, Instrumentation & Process Control Engineering, or Electronics Engineering from a Government recognized Institute. Lateral entry candidates after Class-XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year of Diploma course are also eligible.
  • Trade Apprentice (Assistant-Human Resource): Full Time Bachelor degree (Graduation) from a Government recognized Institute/University.
  • Trade Apprentice (Accountant): Full Time Bachelor degree (Graduation) in Commerce from a Government recognized Institute/University.
  • Data Entry Operator (Fresher Apprentices): Minimum 12th Pass (but below Graduate).
  • Domestic Data Entry Operator (Skill Certificate Holders): Minimum 12th Pass (but below Graduate). Additionally, candidates should possess Skill Certificate of Domestic Data Entry Operator for training of less than one year issued by an awarding body recognized under National Skill Qualifications Framework or any other authority recognized by the Central Government.

Essential Qualifications

  • Candidate should have already passed the prescribed qualification on the date of reckoning eligibility criteria which is 31/01/2026.
  • Candidates whose result of the qualifying examination is awaited on the date of reckoning eligibility criteria are not eligible to apply.
  • The prescribed qualification for Graduate/Diploma holders shall be from a recognized University/Institute as a regular full-time course in the relevant trade/discipline with a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate (45% for SC/ST and PwBD category candidates for the posts reserved for them).
  • Candidates holding a qualification acquired through part-time/correspondence/distance education mode are not eligible.
  • Candidates possessing higher professional qualifications such as BE/B.Tech., MBA, CA, LLB, MCA, or any such equivalent qualification or pursuing higher qualification and having completed the same on or before joining apprenticeship training, shall not be eligible.
  • Wherever CGPA/OGPA or Letter Grade is awarded in the ITI/Degree/Diploma examinations, its equivalent aggregate percentage of marks must be indicated by the candidates in the Online Application as per the norms adopted by Board/University/Institute.

Experience

  • Candidates having job experience for a period of one year or more after the attainment of the qualification shall not be eligible to be engaged as Apprentice.
  • Candidates who have completed five years after acquiring the prescribed qualification as on date of reckoning eligibility criteria shall also not be eligible for engagement as Apprentices.
  • A Candidate may undergo maximum two apprenticeship training and the second training shall not be in the same trade. There shall be minimum one year gap between two apprenticeship training, provided that the previous training is completed.

Salary/Stipend

  • Rate of stipend payable to apprentices per month shall be as prescribed under Apprentices Act, 1961/1973.
  • The stipend will be in accordance with The Apprenticeship Rules, 1992 read with The Apprenticeship (Amendment) Rules, 2019 & 2025 as amended from time to time and Corporation's guidelines.
  • During the period of Apprenticeship, apart from monthly stipend as prescribed above, no other monetary or non-monetary benefit/facility such as accommodation, HRA, conveyance, medical facility etc. shall be admissible to apprentices.
  • Candidates have to make their own arrangement for accommodation, conveyance, medical etc.
  • Duration of Apprenticeship Training: 12 months from the date of engagement.

Age Limit (as on 31/01/2026)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 24 years
  • Age Relaxation for SC/ST: Relaxation in upper age up to 5 years to SC/ST candidates considered against reserved positions will be allowed.
  • Age Relaxation for OBC (NCL): Relaxation in upper age up to 3 years to OBC (NCL) candidates considered against reserved positions will be allowed.
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD: Relaxation in upper age up to 10 years for PwBD candidates will be allowed irrespective of reservation of posts to them.
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD-SC/ST: Further, upper age relaxation of 5 years to PwBD candidates belonging to SC/ST category will be allowed.
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD-OBC(NCL): Upper age relaxation of 3 years to PwBD-OBC(NCL) candidates will be allowed.

Application Fee

  • No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 23/01/2026
Date of Opening of Online Application 28/01/2026
Last Date of Submission of Online Application 10/02/2026, 11:59 PM (IST)
Cut-off Date for Age, Qualification etc. 31/01/2026

Selection Process

  • Candidates registered in the NAPS/NATS Portal and applying against the notification shall be considered for selection.
  • Panel cum Merit List of all the candidates, who have applied against a respective post in the portal and meeting the notified eligibility criteria, shall be prepared based on the percentage of marks in descending order obtained in the essential qualification applicable to the trade applied for.
  • Aggregate of marks of all subjects of all years/semesters will be considered for eligibility.
  • In case of a similar rank in merit based on the percentage of marks obtained in the essential qualifying examination, a candidate with an earlier date of birth (older in age) shall be considered. In case of same date of birth, candidates having a higher percentage of marks in Matriculation shall be considered.
  • There shall be No Written Test or Personal Interview.
  • In case a reserved seat remains unfilled, the same shall be reallocated in the following order of priority: first to SC, then to ST, thereafter to OBC, followed by EWS, and finally to UR.
  • Verification of the original documents shall be done before joining of the candidate as an Apprentice.
  • Engagement of selected candidates is subject to their being declared medically fit as per the requirement of the Corporation.

General Information/Instructions

  • Reservation of seats to SC/ST/OBC (Non Creamy Layer-NCL)/PwBD/Economically Weaker Section (EWS) candidates shall be as per the applicable Government guidelines.
  • The minimum prescribed qualification marks will be relaxed by 5% for candidates belonging to SC/ST/PwBD categories considered against reserved positions.
  • In case of candidates belonging to OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) category, name of OBC caste mentioned in the certificate should fall in the Central List of OBCs of the respective State and Non-Creamy Layer status should be valid as on cut-off date of reckoning eligibility criteria.
  • Candidates are advised to ensure that they are Medically Fit as per IndianOil's pre-engagement medical standard.
  • The trades are suitable for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) as per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, with minimum 40% disability.
  • Candidates can apply for one Trade Code ONLY. Candidates applying for more than one Trade Code will not be considered for any post and their applications will be summarily rejected.
  • Only one mobile number and one email ID can be used for applying for the post. The same mobile number and email ID cannot be used by any other candidate for filling online application for this notification.
  • Candidates, who are pursuing higher qualification on the date of final submission of online application but have acquired/completed the same subsequently at the time of document verification, shall also not be eligible for engagement and shall not be allowed to Join.
  • Suppression of information regarding possession or pursuing higher qualification shall render a candidate ineligible for consideration at any stage of selection & termination any time during engagement, if engaged.
  • The terms and conditions of engagement of the apprentices shall be governed by The Apprentices Act, 1961 and Rules 1992 as amended from time to time.
  • Upon completion of the apprenticeship period, the Corporation shall have NO obligation to offer employment to such Apprentices NOR can an Apprentice claim the right for employment on the grounds of completion of Apprenticeship.
  • Candidates are advised to maintain the same registered e-mail ID and mobile number till the completion of apprenticeship training.
  • Candidates are advised to periodically visit the official website https://www.iocl.com/apprenticeships as all future correspondence and latest information shall be shared only on the website.

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Candidates willing to apply must register as a Technician/Trade/Graduate Apprentice online in the following portals under the respective State as per their Trades:
    • Trade Apprentice: Data Entry Operator (Fresher Apprentices)/Domestic Data Entry Operator (Skill Certificate Holders) at https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in
    • Technician Apprentice: (Mechanical/Electrical/Telecommunication & Instrumentation) at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php
    • Trade Apprentice (Assistant-Human Resource/Accountant) at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php
  • Step 2: Candidates meeting the prescribed eligibility criteria may LOGIN to the respective NATS/NAPS Portal using their User ID/Email ID and APPLY for the apprenticeship Openings/Opportunities with the Establishment ID of Indian Oil Corporation Limited mentioned below:
    • Eastern Region Pipelines (ERPL) - NATS: EWBKOC000079, NAPS: E11181900005
    • Western Region Pipelines (WRPL) - NATS: WGJRAC000006, NAPS: E11182400087
    • Northern Region Pipelines (NRPL) - NATS: NHRPPC000001, NAPS: E12180600006
    • Southern Region Pipelines (SRPL) - NATS: STNCHC000040, NAPS: E12183300008
    • South Eastern Region Pipelines (SERPL) - NATS: EORBBSC000001, NAPS: E02252100002
  • Step 3: Candidates must complete the application for Openings/Opportunities in respective NATS/NAPS Portal from 28/01/2026 to 10/02/2026. Before applying against an opportunity, the candidate MUST ensure that their profile (Personal details, Educational details, Category etc.) along with aggregate percentage are appearing correctly in their application.
  • Step 4: After applying against an opportunity in the respective NAPS/NATS Portal, the candidate must complete their registration/application for apprentice positions in Indian Oil Pipelines portal at https://plapps.indianoilpipelines.in/
  • Step 5: The candidate must use the same e-mail ID and Mobile Number used in respective NAPS/NATS Portal which must be valid for the entire apprenticeship period.
  • Step 6: There are two steps for Registration process (Part-I & Part-II) in Indian Oil Pipelines portal:
    • Part-I Registration: Candidate must fill their basic details like name, category etc. and must create their own password. After successful Part-I registration, system generated registration number is sent to their registered email id/SMS.
    • Part-II Registration: Candidates must upload their scanned photograph (Size: between 20-50 KB in JPG Format) and signature in black ink (Size: between 10-30 KB in JPG Format) and furnish educational qualification, experience details etc. and submit the same. This is the final submission process and after that candidates cannot change the details furnished.
  • Step 7: Candidates must complete the application process in Indian Oil Pipelines portal at https://plapps.indianoilpipelines.in/ from 28/01/2026 to 10/02/2026.
  • Step 8: The candidate must mention the registration/enrolment number of NAPS/NATS Portal while applying for apprentice positions in Indian Oil Pipelines Portal.
  • Step 9: After successfully applying/registration of Online Application in Indian Oil Pipelines Portal, the candidate must take a printout of the filled-in online application for future reference.
  • Important: No other means/mode of application shall be accepted other than what is mentioned above. Candidates to ensure that they have successfully applied for the relevant opportunity through respective NAPS/NATS Portal BEFORE applying/registration in Indian Oil Pipelines Portal.
  • Applications/Registration which are incomplete or are received in any other mode/form or not fulfilling the eligibility criteria and/or those received after the last date of submission of application shall not be considered "Eligible" and treated as "Rejected".

General Manager (Rolling Stock)

  • Desirable: Candidate should have experience of working in construction on projects of railways / metros/ other PSUs/ private sector dealing with rolling stock; Candidate should be conversant with international competitive bidding, computerized environment working and latest rolling stock technologies; Adequate experience in planning, designing, supply, testing & commissioning of Rolling Stock for underground/ elevated metro/ rail projects in urban & suburban environment including consultancy works related to urban rail projects; Candidates with experience of working of modern urban rail systems will be preferred

Assistant General Manager (PST)

  • Qualification: Full time degree in Electrical Engineering from recognized & reputed university
  • Essential Experience: Officers having total minimum 7 yrs of post qualification experience with following criteria - For CDA: Working in Grade Pay of Rs. 6,600/- (CDA) 7th CPC with minimum 2 yrs experience in desirable domain for the post OR Working in Grade Pay of Rs. 5,400/- (CDA) with minimum 5 yrs experience in desirable domain for the post; For IDA: Currently working in Govt. Entities in IDA pay scale of Rs. 60,000 – 1,80,000/- with minimum 2 yrs experience in desirable domain for the post or Currently working in IDA pay scale of Rs. 50,000 – 1,60,000 with minimum 5 yrs experience in desirable domain for the post; OR Total minimum 10 yrs of post qualification experience in reputed private sector in Executive grade in desirable domain for the post with minimum CTC of Rs. 12 Lacs
  • Desirable: Candidate should have experience of working in construction projects of Railways/ Metros/ other PSUs/ private sector dealing in 25 kV Traction/ Traction Power Supply/ Traction SCADA works; Candidate should be conversant with computerized designing & drawings related to latest 25 kV Traction/ Traction Power Supply/ Traction SCADA technologies and should be conversant with international bidding procedures; Candidate with working experience of modern metro rail systems will be preferred

  • Desirable: Candidates should have experience of Construction and Maintenance of Civil & Track structure in Railways /Metro; Candidates should have experience of working on projects of stations/tunnels/viaduct and bridges/ ballastless track works/tracks of Urban Railways; Candidate should be conversant with international competitive bidding, computerized environment working; Adequate experience in planning, designing, supplying, testing and commissioning of civil engineering works for underground Metro/ rail projects in urban & suburban environment including consultancy works related to urban rail projects; Candidates with experience of working of modern urban rail system will be preferred; Candidates should have experience and knowledge of interface with railway related disciplines such as Civil, Tracks, Signalling, Electrification and Rolling Stock

  • Desirable: Candidate should have experience of working in construction projects of railways / metros/ other PSUs /private sector dealing in signal and telecom; Candidate should be conversant with computerized environment working and the latest Signaling & Telecommunications (S&T) technologies; Candidates with experience of working of CBTC based signaling systems will be preferred

Junior Engineer-II (S&T)

  • Qualification: Full time B.E. / B. Tech or Diploma in Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering discipline from a Govt. recognized Institute / University
  • Essential Experience: For Diploma holders: A total minimum of 08 years of post-qualification with minimum 3 years of experience in Grade Pay of Rs.4200/- (CDA) or its equivalent in IDA Pay scale of Rs. 34,020 - 64,310/- (W5) in the Desirable domain in government organizations Or A total minimum of 09 years of post-qualification experience including minimum 03 years of service in the Desirable domain in any reputed private sector with minimum CTC of Rs. 05 Lacs; For Degree holders: A total minimum of 06 years of post-qualification experience with minimum of 02 years of service in the Desirable domain in Rs. 34,020 - 64,310/- (W5) grade in the IDA pay scale or its equivalent in other government organizations in a different type of pay scale; Or A total minimum of 07 years of post-qualification experience including minimum 02 years of service in the Desirable domain in any reputed private sector with minimum CTC of Rs. 05 Lacs
  • Desirable: Candidates having experience in the field of Signalling & Telecom department in Metro Rail/ Railway/ Railway PSU's/ Metro related Infrastructure Industries will be preferred; Candidates should have experience of working in Construction projects of Railways/ Metro/ other PSU's/ Private Sector dealing with latest technology in Signalling or Telecommunication or Automatic Fare Collection (AFC) systems; Adequate experience in supervising S&T related work, coordination between various contractors at Site; Candidate should have exposure in managing and controlling various types of documentations

Assistant (IT)-I

  • Desirable: Knowledge of Project IT Applications such as Primavera P6/ ERP/ eOffice, Working experience in reputed companies of Private/ Govt. Sector of IT related Fields; Candidates having experience in Metro/ Railway/ Railway PSU's/ Metro in IT field will be preferred

HoD on each page; statement showing year-wise availability of ACRs and grading signed by Secretary/HoD; and Vigilance & administrative clearances.

Crucial Date 10 February 2026

Selection Process

  • The applications received shall be scrutinized and shortlisted.
  • Candidates will be shortlisted in the light of their qualification, experience and other details provided in the application form.
  • Shortlisted candidates may be called for test/ interview etc. before selection.

General Information / Instructions

  • The initial period of engagement shall be 2 years which can be extended to additional 2 years on the basis of performance with no further extension. There shall be a performance review after every 6 months of engagement of the professional.
  • The appointment of professionals will be on Full Time Basis and they would not be permitted to take up any other assignment during the period of appointment as Jr. Professional Intern with MbPA.
  • A certificate regarding successful completion of engagement shall be issued by the concerned Department/ Division in the enclosed format (Annexure III). Professionals not completing a period of 1 (one) Year will not be issued any experience certificate.
  • Jr. Professional Intern engaged on contractual basis shall not be entitled to any kind of allowance e.g. Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, Transport Allowance, Transport Facility, Personal Staff, CGHS, Medical Reimbursement etc.
  • Jr. Professional Intern shall not be entitled to TA/DA for joining the assignment or on its completion. For any travel if required, compensation will be as per norms laid down by MbPA at the time of travel.
  • TDS as admissible shall be deducted from the monthly remuneration of Jr. Professional Interns . A TDS certificate shall be issued by the concerned department on demand.
  • Jr. Professional Intern shall be eligible for Casual Leave of 20 Days in a calendar year on pro- rata basis. His/her absence beyond 20 days in a Year (On pro-rata basis) shall lead to deductions in remuneration. Any un-availed leave cannot be carried over to next calendar Year. MbPA would be free to terminate the services of Jr. Professional Intern in case of absence of more than 15 days beyond the entitled leave. No carry forward of the unconsumed leave as also no encashment of leave would be allowed.
  • As regards accommodation facility, accommodation at MbPA quarters can be provided, subject to availability of accommodation in the category of Class III B quarters and on the personnel engaged. The rent payable for accommodation will be @10% of consolidated remuneration and single licence fees per month. In addition, electricity & water charges would be recovered on actual consumption basis. In case accommodation at MbPA Quarters is availed, a Security Deposit of amount equivalent to two times of rent payable per month, will have to be paid as a security against Rent, electricity, water charges and damages, if any. The deposit will be refunded after receiving No Dues Certificate from competent Authorities of concerned Departments.
  • As regards, Medical facility, since MbPA has its own Hospital, OPD as well as IPD facility will be provided to contractual personnel at MbPA hospital/ dispensary along with medicines. However, the Jr. Professional Intern will not be referred outside for treatment. No medical facilities would be available to family/ dependent of the Jr. Professional Intern.
  • A candidate can apply for engagement only once during a financial year. The applicants who do not fulfill the eligibility conditions, their applications shall be rejected.
  • Applicants must clearly indicate their area(s) of interest.
  • Mere fulfillment of qualification or shortlisting shall not confer any right to be engaged as Jr. Professional Intern .

How to Apply

  • Interested candidates may submit their application(s) in the prescribed format (Application form) by:
  • Downloading the application format (Annexure –IV-B) from website www.mumbaiport.gov.in (‘People & Career/Jobs’ menu).
  • Filling the application format with the required details and declaration.
  • The filled in application form along with required documents for determining eligibility is to be dropped in the drop box kept at the below mentioned address on or before the last date of application i.e. 10.02.2026 by superscribing on the envelope as “Application for engagement of Jr. Professional Interns on contract basis” in Mechanical and Electrical Engineering Department. The Chief Mechanical Engineer, Mumbai Port Authority Mechanical and Electrical Engineering Department Sustainability House, 2nd Floor, Dr. S.B.Road (Old Goa Street), Ballard Estate,Fort,Mumbai-400 001
  • Merely submitting Resume/ CVs and incomplete application will liable to be rejected.

  8. The selected candidate(s) have to furnish security deposit for Rs. 25,000/- in the form of Demand-Draft in favour of IRCTC Ltd payable at Mumbai.

How to Apply

The completed application form has to be submitted at the venue of the interview for verification along with original documents, one set of attested copies of requisite documents and two recent passport size photographs.

If any of these shortcomings is / are detected even after appointment, his /her services are liable to be terminated without notice.

  • Any canvassing or creating influence for undue advantage shall lead to disqualification from the process.

  • Candidates should visit Bank's website www.bankofbaroda.bank.in/Career.htm and register themselves online in the appropriate Online Application Format, available through the link being enabled on the Careers-> Current Opportunities on the Bank's website & pay the application fee using Debit Card / Credit Card / Internet Banking/ UPI etc.
  • Candidates need to upload their Bio-data while filling online application. Candidates are also required to upload their scanned photograph, signature and other documents related to their eligibility.
  • Candidates are advised to carefully fill in the online application themselves as no change in any of the data filled in the online application will be possible/ entertained.
  • The name of the candidate should be spelt correctly in the application as it appears in the certificates/ mark sheets. Any change/ alteration found may disqualify the candidature.
  • An online application which is incomplete in any respect and unsuccessful fee payment will not be considered as valid and will summarily be rejected.
  • Candidates shall also be required to submit supporting documents such as Date of Birth Proof, Graduation/Mandatory Qualification Certificate/s, Other Certifications, Experience Letter, Document showing Break up of CTC, Latest Salary Slips, etc. at the time of submitting the online application form

  • Konkan Railway Corporation Limited, a PSU under Ministry of Railways, invites applications for MPHW on fixed term contract basis in Medical Department for initial period of one year; contract can be extended based on performance and KRCL requirements.

  • If any document/certificate/information is found incorrect or false at any stage, contractual service will be terminated immediately without prior notice, and legal action may be initiated.
  • Selected candidates must pass prescribed medical examination for fitness before entering into contract.
  • No accommodation will be provided, and no food or food/mess allowance will be paid by KRCL.
  • Any kind of canvassing will result in disqualification at any stage of selection without assigning reasons; no further correspondence will be entertained.
  • Contract appointee will be governed by Indian Laws and subject to judicial courts in concerned State; statutory Income Tax, Professional Tax and other taxes will be deducted at source as applicable.

How to Apply

  • Bring:
    • Duly filled application in prescribed format (Annexure-A).
    • All original certificates (age proof, qualification, experience, caste certificate etc.).
    • One set of self-attested copies of all required certificates.
    • Two recent passport size photographs.
    • Character certificate from Gazetted/Executive Officer.
  • Applications not conforming to prescribed format or having illegible/ambiguous/without certificates or incomplete will be summarily rejected.

Selection Process

  • Only those candidates eligible in all respects and have qualified in the relevant GATE 2023/2024/2025 Score and have submitted their applications with all necessary documents shall only be considered for further selection process in MRVC.
  • Based on their GATE Score, candidates shall be shortlisted for document verification and personal interview on the basis of discipline-wise category-wise merit list (Not more than 5 times of vacancies).
  • In case a candidate does not appear for document verification along with original documents, his/her candidature shall be rejected.
  • Upon completion of document Verification, the candidates shall be Personally Interviewed.
  • Candidates shall obtain information about their status through the Corporation's website only.
  • Weightage to Different Parameters: GATE score (out of 100) 80%, Personal Interview 20%.
  • The qualifying percentage of marks in the personal interview is 60%.
  • In case of a tie in the total marks (GATE Score weightage + Personal Interview marks) scored between two or more candidates, following criteria will be adopted in order of sequence for deciding position in merit list: The candidate having higher score in the relevant GATE examination will be ranked higher. Where GATE scores are tied, candidates older in age shall be placed higher in the merit list. Where both GATE score and date of birth are tied, candidates with higher marks in qualifying degree shall be placed higher in the merit list.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidature of a candidate is liable to be rejected at any stage of engagement process or after engagement or joining, if any information provided by the candidate is false or is found to be not in conformity with eligibility criteria mentioned in the advertisement.
  • Candidates if shortlisted for document verification and Personal Interview are required to bring their valid GATE- Admit Card and GATE Score Card, Engineering Graduation Mark Sheet, Engineering Graduation Certificate, PG certificate if any, SSC Mark Sheet, Date of Birth Certificate/ID proof, SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS Certificate as the case may be, copy of the Application Form and recent Passport size photograph (photograph should match with the one pasted in the Application Form) for verification with other relevant documents at the time of document verification.
  • Photocopies of the original identification documents shall not be acceptable. Candidates will not be permitted to appear for the personal interview if original and valid photo ID proof is not presented along with the GATE Admit Card and Score Card.
  • Valid OBC-NCL/EWS certificate should be produced as per the format at Annexure II & III valid on the closing date of the application.
  • Candidates employed with Government Departments / PSUs / Autonomous Bodies have to produce NOC failing which they would not be allowed to appear for document verification.
  • Candidates must correctly enter their name, date of birth, qualification details. Applications once submitted cannot be altered. Accordingly, no request for change in applicant's data after submission of application shall be entertained.
  • MRVC reserves the right to cancel / restrict / enlarge/ modify / alter the engagement process, if need so arises, without issuing any further notice or assigning any reason whatsoever.
  • Only Indian Nationals of age 18 years or above are eligible to apply for the post.
  • Before applying, the candidate should ensure that he / she fulfills the eligibility criteria and other norms mentioned in this advertisement.
  • Essential qualification should be recognized in India and from a recognized Institution or University.
  • Date of issuance of final mark sheet shall be taken as the date of acquiring qualification.
  • Wherever CGPA/OGPA/DGPA is awarded, its equivalent percentage of marks must be indicated in the application form as per norms adopted by University / Institute.
  • Percentage of marks obtained by the candidate in the bachelor's degree shall be calculated based on the practice followed by the university/institution from where the candidate has obtained the degree. In case the candidates are awarded grades/CGPA instead of marks, the conversion of grades/CGPA to percentage of marks shall be based on the procedure certified by the university/ institution from where they have obtained the bachelor's degree. In case the university/ institution does not have any scheme for converting CGPA into equivalent marks, the equivalence would be established by dividing the candidate's CGPA by the maximum possible CGPA and multiplying the result with 100.
  • Marks in Essential Qualification will not be rounded off for deciding eligibility of any candidate.
  • Mere submission of application to MRVC does not guarantee the adequacy of candidature for being considered for further selection process.
  • All information regarding this recruitment process would be made available in the career section of MRVC website only. Applicants are advised to check the website periodically for important updates. All correspondences shall be made through the registered e-mail ID only.
  • For any queries regarding this recruitment please send email to [email protected].
  • Legal jurisdiction will be Mumbai in case of any cause / dispute.

How to Apply

  • Candidates should have a valid personal email ID, which should be kept active till the completion of selection process. MRVC shall send communication calling shortlisted candidates for Document Verification etc. through e-mail only.
  • Application should be complete in all respects, and as per the prescribed format. Applications not conforming to the prescribed format and without the required documents annexed will be summarily rejected.
  • THE LAST DATE FOR SUBMISSION OF APPLICATION BY MAIL IS 10.02.2026.

Eligibility Criteria

Qualification Requirements

  • Technician Apprentice (Mechanical): Three years full time Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or Automobile Engineering. Lateral entry candidates after Class-XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year of Diploma course are also eligible.
  • Technician Apprentice (Electrical): Three years full time Diploma in Electrical Engineering or Electrical & Electronics Engineering. Lateral entry candidates after Class-XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year of Diploma course are also eligible.
  • Technician Apprentice (Telecommunication & Instrumentation): Three years full time Diploma in Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering, Electronics & Radio Communication Engineering, Instrumentation & Control Engineering, Instrumentation & Process Control Engineering, or Electronics Engineering from a Government recognized Institute. Lateral entry candidates after Class-XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year of Diploma course are also eligible.
  • Trade Apprentice (Assistant-Human Resource): Full Time Bachelor degree (Graduation) from a Government recognized Institute/University.
  • Trade Apprentice (Accountant): Full Time Bachelor degree (Graduation) in Commerce from a Government recognized Institute/University.
  • Data Entry Operator (Fresher Apprentices): Minimum 12th Pass (but below Graduate).
  • Domestic Data Entry Operator (Skill Certificate Holders): Minimum 12th Pass (but below Graduate). Additionally, candidates should possess Skill Certificate of Domestic Data Entry Operator for training of less than one year issued by an awarding body recognized under National Skill Qualifications Framework or any other authority recognized by the Central Government.

Essential Qualifications

  • Candidate should have already passed the prescribed qualification on the date of reckoning eligibility criteria which is 31/01/2026.
  • Candidates whose result of the qualifying examination is awaited on the date of reckoning eligibility criteria are not eligible to apply.
  • The prescribed qualification for Graduate/Diploma holders shall be from a recognized University/Institute as a regular full-time course in the relevant trade/discipline with a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate (45% for SC/ST and PwBD category candidates for the posts reserved for them).
  • Candidates holding a qualification acquired through part-time/correspondence/distance education mode are not eligible.
  • Candidates possessing higher professional qualifications such as BE/B.Tech., MBA, CA, LLB, MCA, or any such equivalent qualification or pursuing higher qualification and having completed the same on or before joining apprenticeship training, shall not be eligible.
  • Wherever CGPA/OGPA or Letter Grade is awarded in the ITI/Degree/Diploma examinations, its equivalent aggregate percentage of marks must be indicated by the candidates in the Online Application as per the norms adopted by Board/University/Institute.

Experience

  • Candidates having job experience for a period of one year or more after the attainment of the qualification shall not be eligible to be engaged as Apprentice.
  • Candidates who have completed five years after acquiring the prescribed qualification as on date of reckoning eligibility criteria shall also not be eligible for engagement as Apprentices.
  • A Candidate may undergo maximum two apprenticeship training and the second training shall not be in the same trade. There shall be minimum one year gap between two apprenticeship training, provided that the previous training is completed.

Salary/Stipend

  • Rate of stipend payable to apprentices per month shall be as prescribed under Apprentices Act, 1961/1973.
  • The stipend will be in accordance with The Apprenticeship Rules, 1992 read with The Apprenticeship (Amendment) Rules, 2019 & 2025 as amended from time to time and Corporation's guidelines.
  • During the period of Apprenticeship, apart from monthly stipend as prescribed above, no other monetary or non-monetary benefit/facility such as accommodation, HRA, conveyance, medical facility etc. shall be admissible to apprentices.
  • Candidates have to make their own arrangement for accommodation, conveyance, medical etc.
  • Duration of Apprenticeship Training: 12 months from the date of engagement.

Age Limit (as on 31/01/2026)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 24 years
  • Age Relaxation for SC/ST: Relaxation in upper age up to 5 years to SC/ST candidates considered against reserved positions will be allowed.
  • Age Relaxation for OBC (NCL): Relaxation in upper age up to 3 years to OBC (NCL) candidates considered against reserved positions will be allowed.
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD: Relaxation in upper age up to 10 years for PwBD candidates will be allowed irrespective of reservation of posts to them.
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD-SC/ST: Further, upper age relaxation of 5 years to PwBD candidates belonging to SC/ST category will be allowed.
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD-OBC(NCL): Upper age relaxation of 3 years to PwBD-OBC(NCL) candidates will be allowed.

Application Fee

  • No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 23/01/2026
Date of Opening of Online Application 28/01/2026
Last Date of Submission of Online Application 10/02/2026, 11:59 PM (IST)
Cut-off Date for Age, Qualification etc. 31/01/2026

Selection Process

  • Candidates registered in the NAPS/NATS Portal and applying against the notification shall be considered for selection.
  • Panel cum Merit List of all the candidates, who have applied against a respective post in the portal and meeting the notified eligibility criteria, shall be prepared based on the percentage of marks in descending order obtained in the essential qualification applicable to the trade applied for.
  • Aggregate of marks of all subjects of all years/semesters will be considered for eligibility.
  • In case of a similar rank in merit based on the percentage of marks obtained in the essential qualifying examination, a candidate with an earlier date of birth (older in age) shall be considered. In case of same date of birth, candidates having a higher percentage of marks in Matriculation shall be considered.
  • There shall be No Written Test or Personal Interview.
  • In case a reserved seat remains unfilled, the same shall be reallocated in the following order of priority: first to SC, then to ST, thereafter to OBC, followed by EWS, and finally to UR.
  • Verification of the original documents shall be done before joining of the candidate as an Apprentice.
  • Engagement of selected candidates is subject to their being declared medically fit as per the requirement of the Corporation.

General Information/Instructions

  • Reservation of seats to SC/ST/OBC (Non Creamy Layer-NCL)/PwBD/Economically Weaker Section (EWS) candidates shall be as per the applicable Government guidelines.
  • The minimum prescribed qualification marks will be relaxed by 5% for candidates belonging to SC/ST/PwBD categories considered against reserved positions.
  • In case of candidates belonging to OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) category, name of OBC caste mentioned in the certificate should fall in the Central List of OBCs of the respective State and Non-Creamy Layer status should be valid as on cut-off date of reckoning eligibility criteria.
  • Candidates are advised to ensure that they are Medically Fit as per IndianOil's pre-engagement medical standard.
  • The trades are suitable for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) as per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, with minimum 40% disability.
  • Candidates can apply for one Trade Code ONLY. Candidates applying for more than one Trade Code will not be considered for any post and their applications will be summarily rejected.
  • Only one mobile number and one email ID can be used for applying for the post. The same mobile number and email ID cannot be used by any other candidate for filling online application for this notification.
  • Candidates, who are pursuing higher qualification on the date of final submission of online application but have acquired/completed the same subsequently at the time of document verification, shall also not be eligible for engagement and shall not be allowed to Join.
  • Suppression of information regarding possession or pursuing higher qualification shall render a candidate ineligible for consideration at any stage of selection & termination any time during engagement, if engaged.
  • The terms and conditions of engagement of the apprentices shall be governed by The Apprentices Act, 1961 and Rules 1992 as amended from time to time.
  • Upon completion of the apprenticeship period, the Corporation shall have NO obligation to offer employment to such Apprentices NOR can an Apprentice claim the right for employment on the grounds of completion of Apprenticeship.
  • Candidates are advised to maintain the same registered e-mail ID and mobile number till the completion of apprenticeship training.
  • Candidates are advised to periodically visit the official website https://www.iocl.com/apprenticeships as all future correspondence and latest information shall be shared only on the website.

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Candidates willing to apply must register as a Technician/Trade/Graduate Apprentice online in the following portals under the respective State as per their Trades:
    • Trade Apprentice: Data Entry Operator (Fresher Apprentices)/Domestic Data Entry Operator (Skill Certificate Holders) at https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in
    • Technician Apprentice: (Mechanical/Electrical/Telecommunication & Instrumentation) at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php
    • Trade Apprentice (Assistant-Human Resource/Accountant) at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php
  • Step 2: Candidates meeting the prescribed eligibility criteria may LOGIN to the respective NATS/NAPS Portal using their User ID/Email ID and APPLY for the apprenticeship Openings/Opportunities with the Establishment ID of Indian Oil Corporation Limited mentioned below:
    • Eastern Region Pipelines (ERPL) - NATS: EWBKOC000079, NAPS: E11181900005
    • Western Region Pipelines (WRPL) - NATS: WGJRAC000006, NAPS: E11182400087
    • Northern Region Pipelines (NRPL) - NATS: NHRPPC000001, NAPS: E12180600006
    • Southern Region Pipelines (SRPL) - NATS: STNCHC000040, NAPS: E12183300008
    • South Eastern Region Pipelines (SERPL) - NATS: EORBBSC000001, NAPS: E02252100002
  • Step 3: Candidates must complete the application for Openings/Opportunities in respective NATS/NAPS Portal from 28/01/2026 to 10/02/2026. Before applying against an opportunity, the candidate MUST ensure that their profile (Personal details, Educational details, Category etc.) along with aggregate percentage are appearing correctly in their application.
  • Step 4: After applying against an opportunity in the respective NAPS/NATS Portal, the candidate must complete their registration/application for apprentice positions in Indian Oil Pipelines portal at https://plapps.indianoilpipelines.in/
  • Step 5: The candidate must use the same e-mail ID and Mobile Number used in respective NAPS/NATS Portal which must be valid for the entire apprenticeship period.
  • Step 6: There are two steps for Registration process (Part-I & Part-II) in Indian Oil Pipelines portal:
    • Part-I Registration: Candidate must fill their basic details like name, category etc. and must create their own password. After successful Part-I registration, system generated registration number is sent to their registered email id/SMS.
    • Part-II Registration: Candidates must upload their scanned photograph (Size: between 20-50 KB in JPG Format) and signature in black ink (Size: between 10-30 KB in JPG Format) and furnish educational qualification, experience details etc. and submit the same. This is the final submission process and after that candidates cannot change the details furnished.
  • Step 7: Candidates must complete the application process in Indian Oil Pipelines portal at https://plapps.indianoilpipelines.in/ from 28/01/2026 to 10/02/2026.
  • Step 8: The candidate must mention the registration/enrolment number of NAPS/NATS Portal while applying for apprentice positions in Indian Oil Pipelines Portal.
  • Step 9: After successfully applying/registration of Online Application in Indian Oil Pipelines Portal, the candidate must take a printout of the filled-in online application for future reference.
  • Important: No other means/mode of application shall be accepted other than what is mentioned above. Candidates to ensure that they have successfully applied for the relevant opportunity through respective NAPS/NATS Portal BEFORE applying/registration in Indian Oil Pipelines Portal.
  • Applications/Registration which are incomplete or are received in any other mode/form or not fulfilling the eligibility criteria and/or those received after the last date of submission of application shall not be considered "Eligible" and treated as "Rejected".

Eligibility Criteria

Selection Process

  • Phase 1 - Online Examination: Online test will consist of Objective Tests for 120 marks and Descriptive Test for 50 marks. The duration of objective test is 2 hours consisting of 4 Sections - English Language (30 marks, 30 minutes), Banking Knowledge (40 marks, 40 minutes), General Awareness/Economy (30 marks, 30 minutes), and Computer Aptitude (20 marks, 20 minutes). The Descriptive Test (30 minutes) will be a Test of English Language (Letter Writing & Essay) for total 50 marks.
  • Phase 2 - Screening: The Screening Committee will examine whether candidates fulfil the required eligibility criteria of experience and match the job profile submitted by candidates with the job profile of Scale-I Generalist Officer of State Bank of India. Candidates numbering up to 3 times (approx.) of the Circle wise and Category wise vacancies will be called for interview from the top of the merit list.
  • Phase 3 - Interview: Interview will consist of 50 marks. Candidates will have to score minimum qualifying marks in interview to be considered for final selection.
  • Phase 4 - Local Language Proficiency Test: Test of knowledge of specified opted local language will be conducted for provisionally selected candidates before joining the Bank. Candidates who produce 10th or 12th standard mark sheet/certificate evidencing having studied the specified opted local language will not be required to undergo the language test.
  • Final Selection: Final merit list is prepared based on normalization of marks scored in Online Test and Interview with 75:25 weightage respectively. Marks secured by candidates in Online Test (out of 170 marks) are converted to out of 75 marks and Interview scores (out of 50 marks) are converted to out of 25 marks.
  • Note: There will be no penalty for wrong answers marked in Objective Tests. Sectional marks will not be maintained for Online Examination.

General Information/Instructions

  • The candidate will have to apply for vacancy of one Circle only. A candidate applying against vacancy of one Circle will not be eligible to apply against vacancy of any other Circle.
  • Candidature of the applicant will be considered only against the vacancies in the Circle for which he/she has applied/opted. Merit list will be drawn Circle wise and category wise.
  • Selected candidates will be posted in the Circle against whose vacancy they are selected.
  • The selected candidates will not be entitled for Inter-Circle transfer/Corporate Centre Posting/Corporate Centre Establishment Posting/Foreign Posting up to his/her promotion to SMGS-IV Grade OR 12 years of service, whichever is later.
  • On joining, the selected candidates will be designated as "Circle Based Officers" (CBOs) and will be on probation for a period of 6 months from their joining the Bank.
  • The CBOs will be subjected to continuous assessment during probation period for judging their suitability for confirmation.
  • Reservation for Person with Benchmark Disability (PwBD) candidates is horizontal and will be guided by various guidelines of Government of India. Only those persons with benchmark disabilities (not less than 40% of a specified disability) would be eligible for reservation.
  • OBC category candidates should submit the OBC certificate on format prescribed by Govt. of India, having "Non-Creamy Layer (NCL)" clause issued during period 01.04.2025 to the date of interview.
  • EWS candidates are required to produce 'Income & Asset Certificate' issued based on gross annual income for the Financial Year 2024-25 and valid for the year 2025-26 at the time of interview.
  • Candidates serving in Government/Quasi Government, Public Sector Undertakings including Nationalised Banks/RRBs are required to submit 'No Objection Certificate' from their employer at the time of interview.
  • Bank will arrange pre-examination training (PET) in online mode for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates in consonance with the guidelines issued by Government of India.
  • Outstation candidates called for interview will be reimbursed Railway AC-III fare for the shortest route in India or actual expenses incurred (whichever is lower) from place of residence/posting to Interview venue.
  • Bank reserves right to cancel the recruitment process entirely at any stage.
  • Any legal proceedings in respect of any matter of claim or dispute arising out of this advertisement can be instituted only in Mumbai and Courts/Tribunals/Forums at Mumbai only shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction.
  • Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.
  • State Bank of India does not endorse, authorize or associate with any external coaching platform, consultancy, individual or digital channel claiming to provide guaranteed selection, influence in recruitment or insider guidance.

How to Apply

  • Candidates can apply online only from 29.01.2026 to 18.02.2026. No other mode of application will be accepted.
  • Candidates should have valid email ID and mobile no. which should be kept active till the declaration of final results.
  • Visit Bank's website https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings and open the Online Application Form available under 'Current Openings'.
  • Fill the application carefully. Once the application is filled completely, candidates should submit the data.
  • After ensuring the correctness of the particulars of the application form, candidate should pay fees through the payment gateway integrated with the application.
  • The payment can be made by using debit card/credit card/Internet Banking by providing information as asked on the screen.
  • On successful completion of the transaction, e-receipt and application form will be generated, which may be printed for record.
  • Before applying online, candidates will be required to have a scanned (digital) image of their photograph, signature, left thumb impression, handwritten declaration, and all relevant documents (ID Proof, Date of Birth Proof, Job Profile, Resume, Educational Certificates, Experience Certificate, Form-16, Salary Slip) as per specifications.
  • Candidates should download their call letter (for Online Exam & Interview) by entering their registration number and password/date of birth from the Bank's website. No hard copy of the call letter will be sent by post.
  • Candidates who are called for online exam/interview will be required to bring one photo identity proof such as Passport/Aadhaar/PAN Card/Driving License/Voter's Id Card/Bank Passbook with duly attested Photograph in original as well as a self-attested photocopy thereof.
  • Not more than one application should be submitted by a candidate. In case of multiple applications, only the last valid (completed) application will be retained.
  • Helpdesk: In case of any problem, queries may be made at telephone no. 022-22820427 (between 11:00 AM to 05:00 PM on working days) or lodge their query on http://cgrs.ibps.in. Candidates should mention 'RECRUITMENT OF CIRCLE BASED OFFICERS IN STATE BANK OF INDIA-2026' in the subject.

Eligibility Criteria

Important Dates

Date Type Date
Start date of submission of application form 01.01.2026
Closing date for receipt of application 30.01.2026

Selection Process

  • Applicants shall apply for the only one post from which he/she had superannuated. The application of the applicants applying for any other posts will not be considered.
  • Eligible applicants meeting the minimum eligibility criteria as specified under this notification will be assessed based on the specified parameters such as Physical Attendance and Annual Confidential Report (ACR) in the preceding three years of superannuation, excluding the year of superannuation except in case of employees who have superannuated on March 31st.
  • I. Physical Attendance - 15 Marks for 3 years (5 Marks per year) a) For above 90% of physical attendance in a year- 5 Marks, b) For 80% to 90% of physical attendance in a year - 3 Marks, c) For 70% to below 80% of physical attendance in a year - 2 Marks, d) For less than 70% of physical attendance in a year - 0(Zero) Marks
  • Note (b):- i. Physical Attendance would mean the actual attendance put in by an applicant employee excluding all forms of absence from work such as leave, sick etc. However, would include absence from duty by virtue of ‘on-duty’ approved on account of PME, VTC, other Training and release from duty on account of official tour/company events. ii. Percentage would be computed by taking the total number of days of working of the respective mine, including Sundays and holidays in a year, as denominator.
  • II. Annual Confidential Report (ACR) – 15 Marks for 3 years (5 Marks per year) a) For ‘Outstanding’/‘Excellent’ grade in a year- 5 Marks b) For ‘Very Good’ grade in a year- 3 Marks
  • Note (c):- i. ‘Year’ for the selection criteria mentioned above would mean a Financial Year for the calendar month of April to March. ii. The data of physical attendance and ACR earned will be taken from the official record of the employee concerned.
  • III. Other selection/eligibility criteria shall be as provided in the guidelines of CIL for availing the services of superannuated non-executive employees.
  • IV. In cases where more than one applicant secures equal marks for the post, the tie will be resolved by applying the following methods one after another: (i) Marks scored in the ACR (Higher grade will be given preference) (ii) Date of Birth (Younger will be given preference) (iii) Date of Appointment (Junior would be given preference)
  • V. Provisional merit panels of shortlisted applicants for different Posts, who are fulfilling the eligibility criteria, will be derived in the order of marks scored, after resolving tie as prescribed and by giving reservation as applicable.

General Information/Instructions

  • Before submitting the application, the applicant must ensure that he/ she fulfills all the eligibility criteria and other norms mentioned in this Notification. He/ she may cross check the information such as Date of Birth, Caste Category, Contact Details, and Qualifications etc. furnished in the application form before finally submitting the same. The basic details such as date of birth, date of appointment, date of superannuation, caste etc. will be considered as recorded in the service record of the candidate.
  • The decision of NCL management regarding eligibility criteria, acceptance or rejection of applications, mode of selection to the post etc. shall be final and binding on all applicants. No correspondence will be entertained from the applicants found ineligible.
  • Applicants should carefully fill up their category (General/ SC/ ST/ OBC-(NCL) in their Application form.
  • All correspondences with the applicants shall be done either through Speed Post / Registered email id & Mobile number (as may be necessary) and all general information shall be provided through NCL website. Applicants are advised to check/ visit NCL website (www.nclcil.in) regularly for further updates.
  • NCL will not take any responsibility for the applicants not being able to submit their applications within the prescribed closing dates on account of any reasons.
  • Selected applicants could be posted in any of the Area/Unit/Hospital of NCL and transferred to other Area/Unit/Hospital of NCL during the engagement period.
  • No TA/ DA will be paid for joining on being selected.
  • NCL management reserves the right to modify/ alter/ restrict/ enlarge/ cancel the engagement process, and revise the number of vacancies, at its discretion without assigning any reasons whatsoever. The decision of the NCL management will be final and no appeal will be entertained in this regard.
  • Court of Jurisdiction for any dispute will be Honorable High Court of Jabalpur M.P.
  • Reservation of SC/ST/OBC (NCL) CENTRE LIST will be applicable as per Govt. of India rules and guidelines, notifications and amendments from time to time issued in this regard.
  • Applicant(s) who wish to be considered against reserved vacancies and seek other concessions applicable to the reserved categories must submit requisite certificate(s) issued by Competent Authority for availing such reservation.
  • SC/ ST/ OBC (NCL) applicants who are selected on their merit will not be adjusted against the reserved vacancies. Such applicant (s) will be accommodated against the un- reserved vacancies earmarked for UR category. The reserved vacancies will be filled up separately from amongst the eligible SC/ST/OBC (NCL) applicants.
  • Provisional offer of Engagement will be issued, subject to being found medically fit in the Company's Medical Examination (IME) as per the laid down Rules related to Medical Examination of CIL.
  • The candidates offered provisional offer of engagement shall have to report within 7 days from the date of receipt of the letter with all the original and valid educational and technical qualification certificates along with caste certificate, as applicable.
  • The initial engagement of the selected candidate would be for a period of one year from the date of joining subject to the upper age limit of 65 years as provided in the CIL guidelines. It is extendable for another term of one year subject to his performance during the initial term of engagement, medical fitness, mutual consent, norms and other terms and conditions stipulated in the guidelines of CIL mentioned above and also subject to the upper age limit of 65 years. In either case, the engagement period will be limited to the age of 65 years.
  • The engagement of a candidate on the selected post shall stand terminated automatically on the expiry of the initial period of engagement unless and otherwise it is extended for the second term as provided in this notification. In the event of extension for a second term, the engagement shall stand terminated automatically on the expiry of the second term so extended.
  • During the course of engagement, if it is found that the candidate is not fulfilling the eligibility criteria, in any respect, his/her offer of engagement shall be cancelled.
  • Remuneration, Deductions, Medical Facilities and Working Days, Hours of work, Leave, Holidays & Rest Days etc. shall be governed as per the guidelines of CIL issued vide CIL/C-5B/MP & IR/Non Ex./Guidelines/268 dated: 12/10/2020.

How to Apply

  • The interested applicants shall fill the prescribed application form by entering all the relevant details specified in the application form and submit By hand to the Office of the Staff Officer (HR) of the Concerned Area/Unit/Hospital from where the applicant has superannuated.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Designation: Assistant Professor (Pay Level 10, Rs. 57,700 – 98,200, minimum salary Rs. 70,900; 7th CPC with admissible allowances).
  • Essential Qualification:
    • Ph.D. in the relevant discipline.
    • All candidates must have first class in the preceding degrees, i.e., from graduation (UG) onwards.
    • If “first class” is not mentioned, candidates should have at least 6.5 CGPA/CPI on a 10-point scale or 60% marks in aggregate; conversions given by the Institute/University may be considered.
    • If CGPA/CPI is on a different scale, a certificate by authorized signatory confirming first class or equivalent 10-point scale conversion must be attached.
    • Degrees must be awarded by recognized Universities/Institutes.
    • At least one degree from graduation onward should be from IISc/IITs/IIITs/NITs/IIMs/ISI/IISERs, or the candidate should be working in regular pay scale at one of these institutions; candidates with degrees from high-ranked foreign institutions (QS/World Ranking preferably up to 500) are also eligible.
  • Relevant Experience: None required (fresh Ph.D. holders are eligible).
  • Other Essential Requirements: None specified beyond academic criteria.
  • Additional Desirable Requirements: At least one publication in an SCI journal.
  • Age and Inbreeding:
    • Fresh appointments beyond 35 years in case of Assistant Professor are discouraged, except for candidates with exceptionally brilliant research career and ongoing or approved externally funded research project.
    • Inbreeding is strictly prohibited for three years: applicants should not have been awarded their highest degree (Ph.D.) from ABV-IIITM Gwalior within three years prior to the last date of application.
  • Reservation-related Eligibility:
    • Reserved category candidates must attach category certificates in prescribed Government of India format issued by competent authority not below Tahsildar or First Class Magistrate.
    • OBC-NCL/EWS certificates must be obtained on or after 01/04/2025, and a latest certificate issued after 01/04/2026 must be produced at interview.
    • PwD candidates must have at least 40% disability in specified categories and produce medical certificate in prescribed form.
    • EWS candidates must meet criteria as per Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment instructions.
  • Department-wise Core & Research Specializations (indicative):
    • Information Technology – Core: Information Technology or Computer Science and Engineering. Required Research: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition, Computer Graphics and Multimedia, Quantum Communication and Sensing, Distributed Computing System Design, Security and Cryptography, Theory of Computing, Big Data Analysis.
    • Engineering Sciences – Core: Scientific Computing and Environmental Science. Required Research: Quantum Computing, Machine Learning, Data Science, Generative AI, Environmental Science.
    • Computer Science and Engineering – Core: Computer Science & Engineering or Information Technology. Required Research: Theoretical Computer Science, Human Computer Interaction, Artificial Intelligence, Augmented and Virtual Reality, Data Science and Big Data Analytics, Ethical and Trustworthy AI, Generative and Agentic AI, Software Engineering, Distributed Algorithms and Systems.
    • Management Studies – Core: Management, AI & Business Intelligence. Required Research: Indian Culture, Business Communication, Ethics and Moral Values, Indian Knowledge System, Entrepreneurship and Innovation, Managerial Economics, Business Intelligence, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, IT-enabled Management, Public Policy, Behavioral Sciences.

Salary/Stipend

  • New Pension Scheme (NPS) of Government of India is applicable to fresh recruits as per Institute rules.

Age Limit 

  • Fresh appointments beyond the age of 35 years in case of Assistant Professor are discouraged.
  • Exception: Candidates with exceptionally brilliant research career and with ongoing or approved externally funded research project may be considered beyond 35 years.
  • The date for determining eligibility regarding qualifications, experience and preferred age limit is the closing date, i.e., last date of submission of application (25/02/2026).

Application Fee

  • General, OBC-NCL and EWS candidates: Non-refundable application fee of Rs. 1,000/-.
  • Candidates of other categories: Non-refundable application fee of Rs. 500/-.
  • Fee must be paid into the following bank account:
    • Name of Account Holder: Director, ABV-IIITM Gwalior.
    • Bank: Bank of India.
    • Branch: IIITM Campus, ABV-IIITM Gwalior, Morena Link Road, Gwalior, MP – 474015.
    • IFSC: BKID0009462; MICR Code: 474013010; SWIFT Code: BKIDINBBGWA; Bank Account Number: 945210110000969.

Selection Process

  • Selection will be made in two phases:
    • Phase I: Shortlisted candidates will appear for a presentation on teaching and research in their specialization.
    • Phase II: Interview by the duly constituted Selection Committee.
  • Mere fulfilment of minimum qualifications and experience does not entitle a candidate to be called for presentation or interview.
  • A Screening Committee will shortlist eligible and desirable candidates based on qualifications, area of expertise, research outputs and experience higher than those prescribed; norms may vary across departments/posts.
  • The invitation for interview indicates suitability but does not guarantee recommendation or selection.
  • If a candidate has failed to secure the same post (same pay level) in two previous attempts or within the last six months, he/she will not be entertained again unless there is significant new achievement.
  • Final recruitment and pay-fixation will be decided by the Board of Governors based on Selection Committee recommendations.

General Information/Instructions

  • Selected candidates’ appointments are subject to being found physically fit by the institute medical authority and joining duty within specified time.
  • In case of disputes, jurisdiction lies with courts where the institute is situated.

  • Ensure comprehensive details of teaching, research, industrial experience and achievements are included.

  • Candidates should regularly visit the institute website (www.iiitm.ac.in) for updates, as all information regarding recruitment and interview schedule will be published only on the website and/or communicated via email.
