Eligibility Criteria

Qualification Requirements

  • Technician Apprentice (Mechanical): Three years full time Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or Automobile Engineering. Lateral entry candidates after Class-XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year of Diploma course are also eligible.
  • Technician Apprentice (Electrical): Three years full time Diploma in Electrical Engineering or Electrical & Electronics Engineering. Lateral entry candidates after Class-XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year of Diploma course are also eligible.
  • Technician Apprentice (Telecommunication & Instrumentation): Three years full time Diploma in Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering, Electronics & Radio Communication Engineering, Instrumentation & Control Engineering, Instrumentation & Process Control Engineering, or Electronics Engineering from a Government recognized Institute. Lateral entry candidates after Class-XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year of Diploma course are also eligible.
  • Trade Apprentice (Assistant-Human Resource): Full Time Bachelor degree (Graduation) from a Government recognized Institute/University.
  • Trade Apprentice (Accountant): Full Time Bachelor degree (Graduation) in Commerce from a Government recognized Institute/University.
  • Data Entry Operator (Fresher Apprentices): Minimum 12th Pass (but below Graduate).
  • Domestic Data Entry Operator (Skill Certificate Holders): Minimum 12th Pass (but below Graduate). Additionally, candidates should possess Skill Certificate of Domestic Data Entry Operator for training of less than one year issued by an awarding body recognized under National Skill Qualifications Framework or any other authority recognized by the Central Government.

Essential Qualifications

  • Candidate should have already passed the prescribed qualification on the date of reckoning eligibility criteria which is 31/01/2026.
  • Candidates whose result of the qualifying examination is awaited on the date of reckoning eligibility criteria are not eligible to apply.
  • The prescribed qualification for Graduate/Diploma holders shall be from a recognized University/Institute as a regular full-time course in the relevant trade/discipline with a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate (45% for SC/ST and PwBD category candidates for the posts reserved for them).
  • Candidates holding a qualification acquired through part-time/correspondence/distance education mode are not eligible.
  • Candidates possessing higher professional qualifications such as BE/B.Tech., MBA, CA, LLB, MCA, or any such equivalent qualification or pursuing higher qualification and having completed the same on or before joining apprenticeship training, shall not be eligible.
  • Wherever CGPA/OGPA or Letter Grade is awarded in the ITI/Degree/Diploma examinations, its equivalent aggregate percentage of marks must be indicated by the candidates in the Online Application as per the norms adopted by Board/University/Institute.

Experience

  • Candidates having job experience for a period of one year or more after the attainment of the qualification shall not be eligible to be engaged as Apprentice.
  • Candidates who have completed five years after acquiring the prescribed qualification as on date of reckoning eligibility criteria shall also not be eligible for engagement as Apprentices.
  • A Candidate may undergo maximum two apprenticeship training and the second training shall not be in the same trade. There shall be minimum one year gap between two apprenticeship training, provided that the previous training is completed.

Salary/Stipend

  • Rate of stipend payable to apprentices per month shall be as prescribed under Apprentices Act, 1961/1973.
  • The stipend will be in accordance with The Apprenticeship Rules, 1992 read with The Apprenticeship (Amendment) Rules, 2019 & 2025 as amended from time to time and Corporation's guidelines.
  • During the period of Apprenticeship, apart from monthly stipend as prescribed above, no other monetary or non-monetary benefit/facility such as accommodation, HRA, conveyance, medical facility etc. shall be admissible to apprentices.
  • Candidates have to make their own arrangement for accommodation, conveyance, medical etc.
  • Duration of Apprenticeship Training: 12 months from the date of engagement.

Age Limit (as on 31/01/2026)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 24 years
  • Age Relaxation for SC/ST: Relaxation in upper age up to 5 years to SC/ST candidates considered against reserved positions will be allowed.
  • Age Relaxation for OBC (NCL): Relaxation in upper age up to 3 years to OBC (NCL) candidates considered against reserved positions will be allowed.
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD: Relaxation in upper age up to 10 years for PwBD candidates will be allowed irrespective of reservation of posts to them.
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD-SC/ST: Further, upper age relaxation of 5 years to PwBD candidates belonging to SC/ST category will be allowed.
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD-OBC(NCL): Upper age relaxation of 3 years to PwBD-OBC(NCL) candidates will be allowed.

Application Fee

  • No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 23/01/2026
Date of Opening of Online Application 28/01/2026
Last Date of Submission of Online Application 10/02/2026, 11:59 PM (IST)
Cut-off Date for Age, Qualification etc. 31/01/2026

Selection Process

  • Candidates registered in the NAPS/NATS Portal and applying against the notification shall be considered for selection.
  • Panel cum Merit List of all the candidates, who have applied against a respective post in the portal and meeting the notified eligibility criteria, shall be prepared based on the percentage of marks in descending order obtained in the essential qualification applicable to the trade applied for.
  • Aggregate of marks of all subjects of all years/semesters will be considered for eligibility.
  • In case of a similar rank in merit based on the percentage of marks obtained in the essential qualifying examination, a candidate with an earlier date of birth (older in age) shall be considered. In case of same date of birth, candidates having a higher percentage of marks in Matriculation shall be considered.
  • There shall be No Written Test or Personal Interview.
  • In case a reserved seat remains unfilled, the same shall be reallocated in the following order of priority: first to SC, then to ST, thereafter to OBC, followed by EWS, and finally to UR.
  • Verification of the original documents shall be done before joining of the candidate as an Apprentice.
  • Engagement of selected candidates is subject to their being declared medically fit as per the requirement of the Corporation.

General Information/Instructions

  • Reservation of seats to SC/ST/OBC (Non Creamy Layer-NCL)/PwBD/Economically Weaker Section (EWS) candidates shall be as per the applicable Government guidelines.
  • The minimum prescribed qualification marks will be relaxed by 5% for candidates belonging to SC/ST/PwBD categories considered against reserved positions.
  • In case of candidates belonging to OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) category, name of OBC caste mentioned in the certificate should fall in the Central List of OBCs of the respective State and Non-Creamy Layer status should be valid as on cut-off date of reckoning eligibility criteria.
  • Candidates are advised to ensure that they are Medically Fit as per IndianOil's pre-engagement medical standard.
  • The trades are suitable for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) as per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, with minimum 40% disability.
  • Candidates can apply for one Trade Code ONLY. Candidates applying for more than one Trade Code will not be considered for any post and their applications will be summarily rejected.
  • Only one mobile number and one email ID can be used for applying for the post. The same mobile number and email ID cannot be used by any other candidate for filling online application for this notification.
  • Candidates, who are pursuing higher qualification on the date of final submission of online application but have acquired/completed the same subsequently at the time of document verification, shall also not be eligible for engagement and shall not be allowed to Join.
  • Suppression of information regarding possession or pursuing higher qualification shall render a candidate ineligible for consideration at any stage of selection & termination any time during engagement, if engaged.
  • The terms and conditions of engagement of the apprentices shall be governed by The Apprentices Act, 1961 and Rules 1992 as amended from time to time.
  • Upon completion of the apprenticeship period, the Corporation shall have NO obligation to offer employment to such Apprentices NOR can an Apprentice claim the right for employment on the grounds of completion of Apprenticeship.
  • Candidates are advised to maintain the same registered e-mail ID and mobile number till the completion of apprenticeship training.
  • Candidates are advised to periodically visit the official website https://www.iocl.com/apprenticeships as all future correspondence and latest information shall be shared only on the website.

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Candidates willing to apply must register as a Technician/Trade/Graduate Apprentice online in the following portals under the respective State as per their Trades:
    • Trade Apprentice: Data Entry Operator (Fresher Apprentices)/Domestic Data Entry Operator (Skill Certificate Holders) at https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in
    • Technician Apprentice: (Mechanical/Electrical/Telecommunication & Instrumentation) at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php
    • Trade Apprentice (Assistant-Human Resource/Accountant) at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php

  • (j) Experience Certificate, if any
  • (k) Candidates working in Government Institution- No Objection Certificate
  • (l) Publications, if any
  • (m) Any other relevant documents
  • Candidates who do not produce the above-mentioned original documents at the time of interview will not be considered for Admission.
  • Leave. The leave entitlement of the appointee shall be governed by the Institute’s leave rules as amended from time to time.
  • All original documents to be brought on the date of interview as mentioned in para 9 above.

Eligibility Criteria

  • The candidate must have passed the 12th grade from any board established by law in India or possess an equivalent qualification recognized by the government.
  • The required educational qualification must be held at the time of application, and the relevant mark sheets or certificates should be available.
  • Candidates who are "Appeared" or "Appearing" are not eligible for the application.
  • The candidate is responsible for providing proof of the educational qualification's authenticity and equivalency, and the board's decision will be final on this matter.
  • Additional qualifications such as an “O” level computer certificate from DOEACC/NIELIT, two years of service in the Territorial Army, or a "B" certificate from the National Cadet Corps will be given preference in case of a tie in marks.
  • These additional qualifications are for preference purposes only and will not carry separate marks, and only one additional qualification can be considered for preference.

Salary/Stipend

  • Rs 21,700 to 69,100

Age Limit 

  • For male candidates: The age should be between 18 to 22 years as of 01-07-2025. This means the candidate should have been born between 02 July 2003 and 01 July 2007.
  • For female candidates: The age should be between 18 to 25 years as of 01-07-2025. This means the candidate should have been born between 02 July 2000 and 01 July 2007.
  • Age relaxation of 5 years is applicable for candidates from SC/ST, OBC, Uttar Pradesh state employees, etc., and for ex-servicemen based on their service period.
  • Detailed age limits for different categories are provided in the official notification.

Application Fee

  • General / EWS / OBC candidates: ₹500/
  • SC / ST candidates: ₹400/
  • The fee is to be paid online via Debit/Credit card, Internet Banking, or UPI and will not be refunded under any circumstances.

Selection Process

  • The selection process includes an offline objective type written exam (300 marks, 150 questions, 2 hours, OMR-based) covering General Knowledge, General Hindi, Numerical and Mental Ability, Mental Aptitude, Intelligence, and Logical Ability.
  • The minimum passing marks are: Unreserved 30%, EWS 25%, OBC 25%, SC/ST 20%. Candidates scoring below these marks will be disqualified.
  • Those who qualify the written exam will be called for document verification and physical standard tests (PST), which are qualifying in nature.
  • Physical Standard Test (PST) includes separate minimum height, chest (for males), and weight (for females) standards. A minimum chest expansion of 5 cm is mandatory for males.
  • A Physical Efficiency Test (PET) will follow for qualified candidates. Men must complete 4.8 km in 25 minutes, and women must complete 2.4 km in 14 minutes. Candidates failing to meet these timings will be disqualified.
  • The final selection will be based on written exam marks, reservation policy, Merit-cum-Order of Preference, medical exam, and character verification.

General Information/Instructions

  • The number of vacancies may change before the exam, and the recruitment may be canceled at any level without any reason.
  • Vertical and horizontal reservations are valid only for Uttar Pradesh permanent residents, and reservations for women are applicable as per departmental guidelines.
  • All caste certificates and age relaxation proofs must be issued by competent authorities as per the prescribed format before the last date, otherwise the benefit will not be given.
  • Candidates with criminal records, bigamy, or moral turpitude are disqualified for service.
  • Physically handicapped candidates are not eligible for police services, as per the relevant rules.
  • Any false documents or information will lead to the disqualification of the candidate, and legal action can be taken.
  • All information related to the recruitment will be available only on the official website, and no personal correspondence will be made. The decision of the board will be final and binding.

How to Apply

  • Candidates must complete One Time Registration (OTR) before applying online, requiring a unique email ID and mobile number.
  • OTR will be validated via Aadhaar-based OTP and possibly DigiLocker; candidates are advised to update their Aadhaar and mobile number.
  • After OTR, candidates will log in on the official website and complete the online application form.
  • The application form should be filled accurately with all necessary documents uploaded via scanning or DigiLocker.
  • Government employees must upload a "No Objection Certificate," and only one application per candidate will be accepted.
  • Once the form is completed, candidates should pay the application fee online and take a printout of the preview for future reference.
  • During the online application, the candidate's real-time photograph will be taken, and technical standards for photographs, signatures, etc., must be adhered to.
  • Candidates must choose the order of preference for posts, and no changes will be allowed later.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualification (Post Doctoral Fellow - PDF): Ph.D or equivalent degree with relevant experience, and three research papers published in SCI/SCIE journals.
  • Qualification (Research Associate -I - RA-I): Ph.D. OR having 3 years of research, or design and development experience after MSc/MS/ME/M.Tech, with at least one research paper published in a SCI/SCIE journal.
  • Qualification (Junior Research Fellow - JRF): B.E./B.Tech and MSc/M.E./M.Tech. in CSE / IT / Cybersecurity / AI / ML / Data Science or any other relevant branch, both with First Class (minimum 65% marks or 7.0 CGPA on a 10-point scale) from a recognized institution. The candidate must have qualified NET or GATE.
  • Desirable Qualification (for all positions): Candidates having hands-on experience or good knowledge in Two or more of the following areas will be preferred: Computer Network (specially OSI Layer, Traffic Analysis & Communications Protocols), VPN and proxy identification using network traffic (Layer-7) and Deep Packet Inspection (DPI), Applying AI / ML / Deep Learning models for VPN detection and anomaly classification, Using Agentic AI for automated or intelligent decision-making, Graph-based analysis of network data, Working with VPN and proxy repositories, including dark web indicators, Packet capture and analysis using tools such as Wireshark, TShark, or tcpdump, Developing web dashboards for data visualization and alerts, Performing time-series and real-time network analysis using telemetry data, Detecting network anomalies using adaptive thresholds, Following ethical research practices in data handling and analysis, Knowledge of programming in Python and experience with shell scripting or similar tools for data processing and automation will be an added advantage.

Salary/ Stipend

  • Post Doctoral Fellow (PDF): ₹90,000 per month (including HRA) as per institute/project norms.
  • Research Associate -I (RA-I): ₹58,000 per month + HRA (as per institute/project norms).
  • Junior Research Fellow (JRF): ₹37,000 per month + HRA (as per institute/project norms).

Important Dates

Notification Date 05 January 2026
Application Submission Rolling basis (open until filled)

Selection Process

  • Shortlisting based on application and need of the project
  • Interview (Online/Offline Mode)

General Information / Instructions

  • The above post is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project.
  • The applicant will be responsible for the authenticity of information, other documents and scan copies submitted.
  • The interview will be conducted in Online/Offline Mode. Further details will be sent to only shortlisted candidates.
  • The offer of appointment to the candidates will be purely on contractual basis for one year initially. It may be extended for another year/till the completion of the project, whichever is earlier, based on the satisfactory performance of the candidate.
  • The selected candidates need to join immediately.
  • No TA/DA will be applicable to the candidates for appearing for the interview or joining the duty.
  • The Institute reserves the right to accept applications at any time, and consider candidates of exceptional credentials without applications. Qualification and experience may be relaxed at any point of time for exceptional candidates.
  • Mere possessing the prescribed qualification does not ensure that the candidate would be called for Interview. The shortlisting will be done based on the need of the project.
  • Only shortlisted candidates will be informed by e-mail about the interview date. So, the candidate must provide valid E-mail IDs in their applications.
  • The first and foremost responsibility of the candidate is to fulfil the jobs’ requirements to complete the above mentioned project in a timely manner.
  • The JRF can be promoted to SRF after two years of relevant research experience and on the recommendation of the project progress monitoring committee.
  • The RA-I can be promoted to RA-II after one year of relevant research experience and on the recommendation of the project progress monitoring committee.
  • The association between PI and the candidate can be discontinued at any time by giving one month’s notice in writing either by the PI of the project to the candidate, or by candidate to the PI of the project.
  • Candidates selected for this position are encouraged to apply for the regular PhD program at IIIT Allahabad, provided they satisfy the eligibility criterion followed by the selection process laid down by the institute.

How to Apply

  • Candidates must submit the duly completed application in the prescribed format (Annexure-I) along with copies of supporting documents only in soft copy form.
  • The application package should be sent via email to [email protected] with the subject line: “Application for the post of JRF/RA-I/PDF”.
  • In addition, applicants must fill out the appropriate Google Form corresponding to the position they are applying for: For Junior Research Fellow (JRF): https://forms.gle/brW1XC6JbAozGcDh7 , For Research Associate-I (RA-I): https://forms.gle/zr7hZ3gRTGjzrwPf6 , For Post-Doctoral Fellow (PDF): https://forms.gle/7sMSpT2wbK5EPxVR9 .
  • Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for interviews as and when a suitable sufficient number of applications are received, and the position will remain open until filled.
  • For any queries, candidates may contact through email at [email protected] or on mobile at +91-8840071479.

Eligibility Criteria

  • The candidate must be a citizen of India.
  • Applicants must apply separately for each Position/Post with applicable form fee, using the prescribed online application form on the University website.
  • Qualifications for each post (Registrar, Dean, Assistant Registrar, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor) are specified under “Qualifications” and “Teaching Positions” sections, including required degrees, marks, experience and, where applicable, veterinary registration.
  • For Assistant Professor (non-Veterinary disciplines): Master’s degree in relevant discipline with at least 60% marks or equivalent, with evidence of NET (ICAR-ASRB/UGC-CSIR), or Doctorate degree in relevant subject with two published research papers (NAAS rating above 4.0).
  • For Assistant Professor (Veterinary disciplines): Recognized veterinary qualification under Indian Veterinary Council Act 1984, B.V.Sc. & A.H. with at least 55% marks, Master’s degree in relevant Veterinary discipline with at least 60% marks and NET, or Doctorate degree with two NAAS-rated research papers.
  • Associate Professor (non-Veterinary): Doctoral degree in relevant subject including relevant basic sciences, eight years’ experience in relevant subject in specified pay bands, and contributions to research / teaching / extension evidenced by publications and innovations.
  • Associate Professor (Veterinary): Recognized veterinary qualification, B.V.Sc. & A.H. with at least 55% marks, Master’s in relevant Veterinary discipline with at least 55% marks, and other qualifications similar to non-veterinary disciplines (doctorate, experience, publications).
  • Registrar: Master’s degree with at least 55% marks or equivalent; at least 15 years of teaching or administrative experience in specified cadres, or 15 years of administrative experience with eight years as Deputy Registrar or equivalent.
  • Dean, College of Veterinary & Animal Science: Recognized veterinary qualification; B.V.Sc. & A.H. with at least 55% marks; Master’s and Doctorate degrees in relevant Veterinary disciplines; minimum 15 years of teaching/research experience with at least 5 years as Professor or equivalent; outstanding research contributions.
  • Assistant Registrar: Master’s degree with at least 55% marks or equivalent grade and good academic record; experience as per desirable condition for service in administration/establishment in specified grades is preferred.

  • Statutory Positions (Registrar, Dean): Level 14 as per 7th CPC Pay Matrix.
  • Associate Professor: Level 13A as per 7th CPC Pay Matrix.
  • Assistant Professor: Level 10A as per 7th CPC Pay Matrix.
  • Assistant Registrar (Non-Teaching): Level 10 as per 7th CPC Pay Matrix.
  • Higher initial pay may be considered for exceptionally qualified and deserving candidates if recommended by the Selection Committee.

Age Limit 

  • Registrar: Preferably below 57 years as on last date of advertisement; tenure of 5 years or till attaining age of 62 years, whichever is earlier.
  • Dean, College of Veterinary & Animal Science: Preferably below 57 years as on last date of advertisement; tenure of 5 years or till attaining age of superannuation (65 years), whichever is earlier.
  • Assistant Registrar: Preferably below 40 years as on last date of advertisement.
  • Associate Professor (all disciplines): Preferably below 47 years as on last date of advertisement.
  • Assistant Professor (all disciplines): Preferably below 40 years as on last date of advertisement (age may be relaxed as per Section 10 of Recruitment Rules for Teaching Employees).
  • Relaxation of age and experience is available for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD and other categories as per UGC/Government of India norms and Section 10 of Recruitment Rules, with possible additional relaxation for women candidates and employees of specified institutions.

Application Fee

  • Application fee is non-refundable and must be paid through online mode only.
  • General and other candidates: Rs. 1000/- (per application form).
  • SC / ST / PwBD candidates: Rs. 500/-.
  • Women candidates are exempted from payment of prescribed fee.
  • No other means of payment (IPO/money order/DD etc.) will be accepted.

Date of Notification (Advertisement Dated) 21.01.2026
Date of commencement of online application 22.01.2026, 10.00 AM
Last date for submission of online application 21.02.2026 till 5.00 PM
Last date for receiving printout (hard copy) of online application form with enclosures 28.02.2026 till 5.00 PM

Selection Process

  • Direct recruitment to Statutory, Teaching and Non-Teaching posts will be on the basis of merit through all India advertisement and selection by duly constituted Selection Committees.
  • Screening of applications will be done using post-wise Score-Card Guidelines (Dean, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor) and/or additional criteria decided by the Screening Committee.
  • The ratio of candidates called for interview will generally not exceed 1:20 and not be less than 1:3 for each post, subject to candidates securing at least 60% marks in screening.
  • Weightage of score card and interview will be in the ratio of 70:30 for Associate Professor and above, and 80:20 for Assistant Professor.
  • The University may adopt short-listing criteria such as higher qualifications, experience or desirable qualifications to restrict the number of candidates called for interview.

General Information/Instructions

  • Applicants must apply online through the University website and additionally send hard copies (signed, with all enclosures already uploaded) by Indian postal service to the Registrar within the stipulated time.
  • The envelope of the hard copy must clearly mention “Application for the post ……………….” and “Post Code………”; applications received in any other manner will be rejected.

How to Apply

  • After completing the online application and uploading all required documents, candidates must take a printout of the hard copy, sign all pages and enclosures, and send it by Indian postal service to the Registrar, Rani Lakshmi Bai Central Agricultural University, Gwalior Road, Jhansi – 284003.

  • The Bank reserves the right to review the rate of remuneration from time to time, as well as the dispensary to be attached for the BMC and alter the duty hours at its discretion in case it becomes expedient to suit administrative and operative requirements.

  • The engagement under the contract is temporary. No claim shall lie for regular employment on that basis at any stage or pay and perks payable to regular employees of the Bank.
  • The contract will be terminable during the period of the contract, upon three months' notice on either side or three months remuneration in lieu thereof.
  • Your contract will be valid for a period of three years from the date of engagement subject to your accepting the above terms and conditions and observing the code of conduct of the Bank as given in Annex II. The contract will be reviewed every year.
  • Any dispute arising on account of the contract shall be subject to the jurisdiction of the Courts of Kanpur.

How to Apply

  • Applications are invited from eligible candidates in the prescribed format.
  • The application should be sent in a sealed cover superscribed "Application for Engagement of Part Time Bank's Medical Consultant on contractual basis".

Selection Process

  • RNU, DDK Dehradun/Prasar Bharati reserves the right to shortlist suitable candidates who apply for various categories of casual assignees based on relevant age, education, experience, and other criteria. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for skill tests/auditions/interviews.
  • RNU, DDK Dehradun/Prasar Bharati reserves the right to conduct any skill tests (written, interview, computer-based test, test through video conferencing, audition, screen test, etc.) in any format—such as multiple choice or descriptive for written exams, group discussion or one-on-one interviews, voice modulation tests, editing software proficiency, etc.—to assess the skills, suitability, and personality of the shortlisted candidates. No TA/DA will be paid to the shortlisted candidates who will be called for the skill tests/audition/interview.

General Information / Instructions

  • The empanelment process is being conducted to identify suitable candidates who may be engaged purely on a casual basis for performing specific assignments in RNU DDK Dehradun. The persons selected through empanelment process shall have no claim, either implicit or explicit, for absorption or regularization in RNU DDK Dehradun/Prasar Bharati.
  • Selection through the empanelment process does not guarantee assignments from RNU DDK Dehradun. Assignments will be provided to empanelled candidates by RNU DDK Dehradun on an ‘as and when required’ basis. Candidates cannot demand assignments as a right and will have no claim to receiving assignments from RNU DDK Dehradun/Prasar Bharati.
  • The empanelment shall commence from the date of issuance of the Doordarshan News order, as approved by the Director General, DD News, listing the names of selected candidates in various categories of casual assignees. If required, the performance of the assignees on the panel may be reviewed through a duly constituted committee.
  • Applicants are required to submit self-attested photocopies of all relevant documents demonstrating their compliance with age, experience, education and other criteria. Applications submitted without the necessary self-attested documents will be summarily rejected, and no further correspondence will be entertained regarding incomplete applications.
  • For determining the age, experience, and education criteria, relevant certificates shall be considered up to and including the date of issuance of this notification.
  • Candidates are requested to keep checking inbox/ spam/junk folders for any communication from email id : [email protected], [email protected].
  • The remuneration fee offered for selected candidates in empanelment process shall strictly follow the prevailing fee structure for casual assignees working in RNU, DD News.
  • If a candidate wishes to apply for multiple causal categories, a separate application form needs to be submitted.
  • Any attempt at canvassing or undue influence will result in the immediate disqualification of the candidate.
  • Director General, DD News, reserves the right to cancel the empanelment process at any time, without prior notice.

How to Apply

  • Candidates who are eligible and willing to adhere to the terms and conditions outlined above may submit their applications in the prescribed format (Annexure I-A), along with self-attested copies of all necessary documents, including certificates of educational qualifications, proof of age, experience certificates, and any other relevant documents. Applications should be addressed to the Head, Regional News Unit (RNU), Doordarshan Kendra, Post – Prasar Bharati Building, Near Rispana Bridge, Haridwar Bypass, Dehradun-248001, and sent by Speed Post only. The envelope must be clearly marked with the heading “Empanelment of (Name of the category) for RNU, DDK, Dehradun.”
  • Applications must be received by RNU, DDK Dehradun by 15th February 2026. Applications submitted in person, by hand, or by any other mode will not be accepted. RNU shall not be held responsible for any delays in postal delivery.
  • A separate detailed CV may also be submitted along with the prescribed application format (Annexure I-A), if candidates wish to provide additional information about their academic and professional skills and achievements. However, the prescribed application format (Annexure I-A) must be submitted without exception.
